`README.md`:

```md
# Headcraft Roblox Connection

**A modular, server-authoritative admin, moderation and anti-cheat framework for Roblox – with a Cmdr-style command console, a full admin panel, the official Roblox Ban API and an optional connection to the [Headcraft](https://headcraft.cloud) backend and Discord.**

**Website & dashboard:** [headcraft.cloud](https://headcraft.cloud)

Headcraft Roblox Connection is a modular, server-authoritative admin, moderation and anti-cheat framework for Roblox games. It includes a Cmdr-style console (F3) with autocomplete, an arrow-key suggestion list and Tab completion for players, durations, ranks and permissions, plus an eight-page admin panel (F2). More than 35 commands cover kick, ban/tempban via the official Roblox Ban API, mute (hides the muted player's chat), warnings, teleport, ranks and permissions. A rank system with inheritance, group ranks and per-user permissions checks every action on the server. The anti-cheat detects speed, fly, noclip, teleport and remote spam, among others; it starts in monitor mode and only punishes once enabled. Optionally, the game connects to the Headcraft backend over signed HTTPS requests (HMAC-SHA256): sessions, heartbeats, moderation, detections, remote commands from the dashboard and Discord notifications. Without a backend, everything runs offline.

> The in-game texts (command messages, admin panel, notifications) are in German.

---

## Features at a glance

- **Command engine** – 37 commands with aliases, typed arguments, optional and rest arguments, multi-target selectors (`all`, `others`, `admins` …), server-side validation and per-command permissions.
- **Cmdr-style console (F3)** – live suggestions from the server, an 8-row suggestion list you can navigate with ↑/↓, Tab or click to accept, a signature hint that highlights the argument you are typing, command history and an output pane.
- **Chat commands** – every command also works in chat with the `;` prefix.
- **Admin panel (F2)** – eight pages: Overview, Players, Moderation, Anti-Cheat, Commands, Permissions, Logs and Settings.
- **Ranks and permissions** – eight built-in ranks with inheritance, custom roles, group-rank rules, fixed UserId assignments and per-player permission grants and revokes. The game owner (or group owner) is always Owner.
- **Moderation** – permanent and temporary bans through `Players:BanAsync` (the official Roblox Ban API, including alt-account handling by Roblox), kicks, warnings, mutes with automatic expiry, and a persistent moderation history.
- **Mute that really mutes** – muted players cannot send messages, and their chat window and input bar are hidden until the mute ends.
- **Anti-cheat** – 12 server-side detection modules feeding a risk score with decay, thresholds and optional automatic actions. Starts in *Monitor* mode so nothing gets punished before you have checked the results.
- **Backend connection (optional)** – signed requests to the Headcraft API: server heartbeats, player sessions, moderation and detection sync, events, remote commands from the web dashboard, remote configuration and version checks. Discord notifications are sent by the backend, so no Discord token ever lives in your game.
- **Offline first** – without HTTP or a project ID the framework simply runs locally.

---

## Installation

### Option A: the model / Creator Store package

1. Insert the `HeadcraftConnection` model. It lands in `Workspace` and **does nothing there** – the server bootstrap only starts inside `ServerScriptService`.
2. Drag the three folders to their destinations:

   | Package folder | Destination |
   |---|---|
   | `ServerScriptService/Headcraft` | `ServerScriptService` |
   | `ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft` | `ReplicatedStorage` |
   | `StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/HeadcraftClient` | `StarterPlayer › StarterPlayerScripts` |

3. Delete the now-empty `HeadcraftConnection` folder from `Workspace`.

### Option B: from the source in this repository

The repository contains every script as a plain `.lua` file in `scripts/`, sorted by its location in the place. [`tree.txt`](tree.txt) shows the full instance tree with the class of every object (`Script`, `LocalScript`, `ModuleScript`, `Folder`, `RemoteFunction`, `RemoteEvent`).

1. Recreate the hierarchy from `tree.txt` in Studio, using `scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/` as the clean package source:
   - `ServerScriptService/Headcraft` with the `Bootstrap` **Script** and all ModuleScripts,
   - `ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft` with its ModuleScripts and a `Remotes` folder (`Command`, `Request` and `Autocomplete` as RemoteFunctions; `Push` and `ClientReport` as RemoteEvents),
   - `StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/HeadcraftClient` as a **LocalScript**.
2. Paste each file's contents into the matching script. A module that has children (for example `Configuration` with `Ranks`, or `AdminUI` with `Pages`) is a ModuleScript with child objects, not a folder.
3. Start a playtest. The output should show the framework starting without errors.

---

## Quick start

1. Install the framework (see above) and start a playtest.
2. As the owner of the place you automatically have the **Owner** rank.
3. Press **F2** for the admin panel or **F3** for the console, or type `;help` in chat.
4. Give your team ranks with `setrank <player> <rank>` or permanently in `ServerScriptService › Headcraft › Configuration › Ranks`.
5. Watch the anti-cheat in *Monitor* mode for a while (`detections`, Anti-Cheat page). Switch to `anticheat Enforce` only once you are happy with the results.
6. To use the Headcraft backend, follow [Headcraft backend and Discord](#headcraft-backend-and-discord).

---

## Command console and chat commands

**Console (F3).** Type a command and get suggestions as you type:

- Suggestions come from the server and only show commands you are allowed to run.
- **↑ / ↓** move through the suggestion list. When there are no suggestions, they browse your command history.
- **Tab** or a click inserts the selected suggestion.
- **Enter** runs the command, **Escape** closes the console.
- Above the input, a signature hint such as `ban <targets> [duration] [reason]` highlights the argument you are currently typing.
- Results and errors appear in the output pane, which keeps the last 60 lines.

**Chat.** Prefix any command with `;`, for example `;kick Player123 Spamming`. Names and aliases are case-insensitive.

**Parsing rules:**

- Arguments are separated by spaces. Use quotes for arguments that contain spaces.
- A *rest* argument (usually the reason) takes the rest of the line, quotes optional.
- Optional arguments may be left out. If a word does not fit an optional argument, it moves to the next one. For example, in `ban Player123 Spamming in chat` the word "Spamming" is not a duration, so it becomes part of the reason and the ban is permanent.
- Input is limited to 500 characters.

---

## Command reference

`<arg>` is required, `[arg]` is optional, and `...` marks a rest argument.

### Player and moderation

| Command | Aliases | Arguments | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kick` | `k` | `<targets> [reason...]` | Player.Kick | Kicks one or more online players with a reason. |
| `ban` | `b` | `<targets> [duration] [reason...]` | Player.Ban | Bans one or more players; permanent without a duration. |
| `tempban` | `tb` | `<targets> <duration> [reason...]` | Player.Ban | Bans for a finite duration (`perm` is rejected). |
| `unban` | `ub` | `<target> [reason...]` | Player.Ban | Lifts a ban by player or UserId (also offline). |
| `warn` | `w` | `<targets> <reason...>` | Moderation.Warn | Adds a permanent warning to the player's history. |
| `mute` | `m` | `<targets> [duration] [reason...]` | Moderation.Mute | Mutes players for a duration or permanently. |
| `unmute` | `um` | `<targets> [reason...]` | Moderation.Mute | Lifts a mute. |
| `freeze` | `fz` | `<targets>` | Player.Manage | Freezes players on the server (anchored, no movement). |
| `unfreeze` | `ufz` | `<targets>` | Player.Manage | Releases frozen players and restores movement. |
| `bring` | `br` | `<targets>` | Player.Teleport | Brings players to you. |
| `goto` | `gt` | `<target>` | Player.Teleport | Teleports you to a player. |
| `teleport` | `tp` | `<target> <destination...>` | Player.Teleport | Teleports a player to `x,y,z` or to another player. |
| `respawn` | `rs` | `<targets>` | Player.Manage | Reloads the players' characters. |
| `spectate` | `spec` | `[target or off]` | Admin.Panel | Starts or stops spectating a player. |

### History and profiles

| Command | Aliases | Arguments | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `viewhistory` | `vh` | `<target> [limit]` | Moderation.ViewHistory | Moderation history of a player (default 50, 1–200). |
| `viewwarnings` | `vw` | `<target>` | Moderation.ViewHistory | All warnings of a player. |
| `viewprofile` | `vp` | `<target>` | Admin.Panel | Session, rank, bans, mutes, risk and history in one view. |
| `moderationhistory` | `mh` | `[Bans, Warnings, Mutes or History]` | Moderation.ViewHistory | Most recent actions of a given kind. |

### Ranks and permissions

| Command | Aliases | Arguments | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `setrank` | `rank` | `<target> <rank>` | Admin.ManageRanks | Sets a player's rank. You cannot change your own rank or assign a rank at or above your own. |
| `removerank` | `derank` | `<target>` | Admin.ManageRanks | Removes a local rank assignment and restores the default. |
| `permissions` | `perms` | `[target]` | Admin.Panel | Shows the rank and resolved permissions (yourself if empty). |
| `grantpermission` | `grant` | `<target> <permission>` | Admin.ManagePermissions | Grants a single permission on top of the rank. |
| `revokepermission` | `revoke` | `<target> <permission>` | Admin.ManagePermissions | Revokes a single permission. |

### Anti-cheat

| Command | Aliases | Arguments | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anticheat` | `ac` | `[Monitor or Enforce] [enabled]` | AntiCheat.Manage | Shows the status, or sets the mode and on/off. |
| `detections` | `dets` | `[target] [limit]` | AntiCheat.ViewDetections | Latest detections, optionally for one player (default 25, 1–200). |
| `detectioninfo` | `di` | `<id>` | AntiCheat.ViewDetections | All fields of one detection. |
| `whitelist` | `wl` | `<target> [true or false]` | AntiCheat.Manage | Exempts a player from the anti-cheat. |
| `blacklist` | `bl` | `<target> [true or false]` | AntiCheat.Manage | Removes a player from the whitelist. |
| `setrisk` | `sr` | `<target> <score>` | AntiCheat.Manage | Sets the risk score directly (0–10000). |
| `resetrisk` | `rr` | `<target>` | AntiCheat.Manage | Resets the risk score to zero. |

### Server and utility

| Command | Aliases | Arguments | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `announce` | `say` | `<message...>` | Server.Announce | Server-wide announcement to all players. |
| `serverinfo` | `si` | – | Admin.Panel | Uptime, player count, place and job. |
| `players` | `pl` | `[limit]` | Admin.Panel | Active players with rank, session and risk score. |
| `shutdown` | `sd` | – | Server.Shutdown | Announces and then shuts down the server. |
| `clearlogs` | `cl` | – | Logs.Manage | Clears the admin, security and system logs and the moderation history. |
| `help` | `h` | `[command]` | – | Commands you are allowed to use, or details of one command. |
| `cmds` | `commands` | `[category]` | – | Lists your allowed commands, optionally filtered by category. |

---

## Argument types

| Type | Accepts | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| player | Full name, name prefix, `@DisplayName`, UserId (also offline players), `me` | `Player123`, `Play`, `@Builder`, `156`, `me` |
| players | Everything *player* accepts, plus `all`, `others`, `random`, `admins`, `nonadmins` | `all`, `others`, `admins` |
| duration | Seconds as a plain number, unit combinations (`s m h d w`), `perm` / `permanent` | `90`, `30s`, `10m`, `2h`, `1d12h`, `1w`, `perm` |
| rank | Any built-in or custom rank (case-insensitive) | `Moderator`, `admin` |
| permission | A known permission, a family wildcard or `*` | `Moderation.Warn`, `Player.*` |
| boolean | `true/false`, `1/0`, and the German `ja/nein`, `an/aus` | `true` |
| integer | Whole numbers within the command's range | `25` |
| command | A command name or alias | `ban`, `tp` |

Invalid durations such as `10x`, `-5m` or `0` are rejected with a clear message.

## Ranks and permissions

### Built-in ranks

| Rank | Priority | Inherits | Adds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player | 0 | – | – |
| TrialModerator | 40 | Player | Moderation.Warn, Moderation.Mute, Moderation.ViewHistory |
| Moderator | 50 | TrialModerator | Player.Kick, Player.Teleport, AntiCheat.ViewDetections, Admin.Panel |
| Developer | 60 | Player | Admin.Panel, Logs.View, AntiCheat.ViewDetections, Server.Announce |
| Admin | 70 | Moderator | Player.Ban, Player.Manage, AntiCheat.Manage, Server.Manage, Server.Announce, Logs.View |
| HeadAdmin | 80 | Admin | Admin.ManageRanks, Admin.ManagePermissions, Logs.Manage |
| CoOwner | 90 | HeadAdmin | Server.Shutdown |
| Owner | 100 | CoOwner | `*` (everything) |

### All permissions

`Player.Kick`, `Player.Ban`, `Player.Teleport`, `Player.Manage`, `Moderation.Warn`, `Moderation.Mute`, `Moderation.ViewHistory`, `AntiCheat.ViewDetections`, `AntiCheat.Manage`, `Admin.ManageRanks`, `Admin.ManagePermissions`, `Admin.Panel`, `Server.Manage`, `Server.Announce`, `Server.Shutdown`, `Logs.View`, `Logs.Manage`. Wildcards such as `Player.*` cover a whole family, and `*` covers everything.

### Where ranks come from

The sources are checked in this order: backend sync, then the DataStore (`Headcraft_Ranks`, written by `setrank`), then `Configuration/Ranks`. The owner of the place (or the owner of the owning group) is always Owner. Players can only act on players with a lower rank (the Owner can act on everyone), and can only assign ranks below their own.

```lua
-- ServerScriptService › Headcraft › Configuration › Ranks
UserIds = { [1234567] = "Admin" },
Groups = { { GroupId = 123456, MinRank = 250, Rank = "HeadAdmin" } },
Roles = {
    Builder = { Name = "Builder", Priority = 55, Inherits = { "Player" }, Permissions = { "Admin.Panel" }, Color = "#38BDF8" },
},
```

---

## Moderation

- **Bans** use `Players:BanAsync` (`ApplyToUniverse = true`, alt accounts included, `Duration = -1` for permanent bans), so Roblox itself keeps banned players and their alt accounts, as detected by Roblox, out of every place and server of the experience. `unban` calls `Players:UnbanAsync`. The framework also stores every ban in its own DataStore, together with the reason, moderator, duration and expiry, so it can show them in the history and the admin panel. In Studio, Roblox skips the Ban API calls; they only take effect on live servers.
- **Temporary bans** and **mutes** expire automatically, also across server restarts.
- **Mutes** block messages through `TextChatService` and hide the muted player's chat window and input bar until the mute ends. The previous chat state is restored afterwards.
- **Warnings** are permanent entries in the player's history.
- **History** – every action (who, whom, what, why, when) is written to a persistent history that `viewhistory`, `viewprofile`, `moderationhistory` and the admin panel read.
- **Self-protection** – you cannot ban yourself, and you can only act on players with a lower rank than yours.

---

## Anti-cheat

All checks run on the server. Nothing the client reports is trusted.

| Module | What it detects |
|---|---|
| Speed | Horizontal distance per time compared with the server-side allowed WalkSpeed plus tolerance. |
| Fly | Time in the air without ground contact (downward raycast), vertical speed and humanoid state; swimming, climbing, sitting and ragdoll are excluded. |
| Noclip | Raycasts between the last and the current position against colliding geometry. Parts tagged `HeadcraftNoclipIgnore` are ignored. |
| Teleport | Jumps of more than a set number of studs in one sample without a registered movement exception. |
| Jump | Infinite jump (gaining height in mid-air) and manipulated jump heights. |
| Humanoid | WalkSpeed, JumpPower, HipHeight, PlatformStand, MaxHealth and health regeneration compared with the values the server expects. |
| Physics | Implausible assembly velocities, fling spikes and abused network ownership. |
| Remote | Rate-limit and validation violations on framework remotes, plus game remotes you register. |
| Tool | Tools in the character or backpack that the server did not hand out (opt-in strict mode). |
| Character | Missing, renamed or deleted required parts compared with a baseline taken at spawn. |
| Instance | Client-created movers in the character and unanchored, network-owned parts near the player (strict movers opt-in). |
| Pattern | Several small violations from different categories within a time window. |

**Risk and actions.** Every detection adds to the player's risk score, which decays over time (`RiskDecayPerMinute`). Thresholds map the score to actions: Log, NotifyAdmin, Warn, Kick, TempBan and Ban, each with its own cooldown.

**Modes.** In **Monitor** mode (the default) detections are only logged and shown to admins. In **Enforce** mode with `AutomaticActions = true` the actions are carried out.

**Legitimate movement.** If your game teleports or speeds up players itself, register this through the `MovementExceptions` service so it is not flagged. Tools you hand out can be allowed with `DetectionManager:AllowTool(player, toolName)`.

---

## Admin panel

Press **F2**. The panel is only built for players with at least one admin permission, and every button still goes through the same server-side permission check as the commands.

| Page | Contents |
|---|---|
| Overview | Uptime, player count, detections in the last hour and a live activity feed. |
| Players | Live player list with rank, risk and account age; actions for the selected player. |
| Moderation | Bans, mutes and warnings with history. |
| Anti-Cheat | Mode, recent detections and per-player risk. |
| Commands | Every command you may use, with aliases, arguments and description, plus an input to run commands. |
| Permissions | Ranks, inheritance and individual permission grants. |
| Logs | Admin, security and system logs. |
| Settings | Anti-cheat switches (enabled, mode, automatic actions), framework status and backend connection. |

Toasts inform admins about detections, moderation actions and announcements in real time.

---

## Headcraft backend and Discord

The backend connection is optional. When enabled, the game server talks to the Headcraft API (`https://api.headcraft.cloud/roblox/v1`):

- **Authentication** – `POST /auth/verify` at startup. Every request carries `X-Project-Id`, `X-Api-Key`, `X-Timestamp` and `X-Nonce`. If your project requires signatures, an `X-Signature` (HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp, nonce, method, path and the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON body) is added as well.
- **Server heartbeats** with the current player list every 30 seconds.
- **Player sessions**, **moderation actions**, **detections** and **events** are queued and sent in batches, with retries, exponential backoff, `Retry-After` handling and a circuit breaker.
- **Remote commands** – the server polls the dashboard for commands (kick, ban, tempban, unban, warn, mute, unmute, announce, setrank, kill, heal, settime, setgravity, cleanup, shutdown) and acknowledges each one with its result.
- **Remote configuration** is fetched every 5 minutes, and version checks report the installed framework version.
- **Bans from the dashboard** are enforced in game through the Roblox Ban API.
- **Discord** – notifications are sent by the backend. The game never holds a Discord token.

### Setup

1. Create a project in the [Headcraft dashboard](https://headcraft.cloud) and copy the project ID (`prj_…`).
2. Set `ProjectId` in `ServerScriptService › Headcraft › Configuration`.
3. Store the API key in the **Creator Hub → your experience → Secrets** as `headcraft_api_key`. Never paste it into a script.
4. Turn on **Game Settings → Security → Allow HTTP Requests**.
5. If the dashboard enforces signatures, set `Credentials.SigningSecret` in the server configuration. This file is never replicated to clients.

For Studio testing only, `Credentials.FallbackApiKey` can hold a key. It is ignored outside Studio – leave it empty before you publish.

---

## Configuration reference

`ServerScriptService › Headcraft › Configuration` (server only):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ProjectId` | `"YOUR_PROJECT_ID"` | Headcraft project ID. |
| `Credentials.SecretName` | `"headcraft_api_key"` | Name of the Roblox secret that holds the API key. |
| `Credentials.FallbackApiKey` | `nil` | Studio-only test key. |
| `Credentials.SigningSecret` | `nil` | Only needed when signatures are enforced. |
| `Backend.Enabled` | `true` | Turns the backend connection on or off. |
| `Backend.BaseURL` | `https://api.headcraft.cloud/roblox/v1` | API endpoint. |
| `Backend.TimeoutSeconds` / `MaxRetries` | `10` / `3` | Request timeout and retries. |
| `Backend.SyncIntervalSeconds` | `15` | How often queues are sent. |
| `Backend.HeartbeatSeconds` | `30` | Heartbeat interval. |
| `Backend.CommandPollSeconds` | `10` | Remote command polling interval. |
| `Backend.ConfigRefreshSeconds` | `300` | Remote configuration refresh. |
| `Backend.DetectionBatchSize` / `MaxQueue` | `25` / `500` | Batch size and queue limit. |
| `Backend.Events` | server lifecycle on, player events off | Which of the 11 event types are also sent to `/events`. |
| `AntiCheat.Enabled` | `true` | Master switch. |
| `AntiCheat.DetectionMode` | `"Monitor"` | `Monitor` or `Enforce`. |
| `AntiCheat.AutomaticActions` | `false` | Carry out actions when thresholds are reached. |
| `AntiCheat.RiskDecayPerMinute` | `2` | Risk decay. |
| `AntiCheat.Thresholds` | 0 / 10 / 20 / 40 / 70 / 100 | Log, NotifyAdmin, Warn, Kick, TempBan, Ban. |
| `AntiCheat.Actions` | cooldowns, TempBan 24 h | Per-action switches, cooldowns and durations. |
| `AntiCheat.Modules` | all on | Per-module switches; `Tool.Strict` and `Instance.StrictMovers` are opt-in. |
| `Admin.Prefix` | `";"` | Chat command prefix. |
| `Logging.Level` / `MaxEntries` | `"Info"` / `1000` | Log level and size. |

`ReplicatedStorage › Headcraft › Shared › Configuration` (visible to clients, so never put secrets here): `Admin.Prefix`, `Interface.Enabled`, `Interface.Theme`, `Interface.ToggleKey` (`F2`) and `Interface.ConsoleKey` (`F3`).

---

## Security model

- **Server-authoritative.** Every command, panel action and autocomplete request is validated on the server: types, ranges, permissions, rank hierarchy and rate limits. Hiding UI is never the only protection.
- **No secrets in replicated code.** API key and signing secret stay on the server, preferably in Roblox Secrets. The shared configuration contains no credentials.
- **No dynamic code.** No `loadstring`, no downloaded code, no remote requires.
- **Rate-limited remotes** – violations are reported to the anti-cheat's Remote module.
- **Signed backend requests** with a timestamp and nonce against replay attacks.
- **Persistence** – bans, mutes, warnings, history, ranks and the whitelist are stored in DataStores and read again after server restarts.

---

## Architecture

```
ServerScriptService/Headcraft
├── Bootstrap            starts the framework (only inside ServerScriptService)
├── Configuration        server configuration + Ranks
├── Core                 Framework, ModuleLoader, DataService, EventService, PermissionService,
│                        PlayerService, RemoteService, AdminRequests
├── Commands             CommandParser, CommandExecutor, CommandRegistry, TypeRegistry,
│                        PermissionChecker, Definitions/ (Player, Moderation, Permissions,
│                        AntiCheat, Server, Utility)
├── Moderation           BanService, KickService, MuteService, WarnService, HistoryService
├── AntiCheat            DetectionManager, RiskManager, DetectionLogger, MovementExceptions,
│                        Detections/ (12 modules)
└── Backend              APIClient, Authentication, Crypto, SyncManager, UpdateManager
ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft
├── Client               AdminUI (+ 8 pages), Console, CommandClient, ChatControl,
│                        Notifications, Interface (Theme, Components)
├── Shared               Constants, Types, Configuration, Utilities
└── Remotes              Command, Request, Autocomplete (RemoteFunction); Push, ClientReport (RemoteEvent)
StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/HeadcraftClient
```

Each service is a module with `Name`, `Dependencies`, `Init`, `Start` and `Destroy`. The module loader sorts the services by their dependencies, initializes them and then starts them. A failing optional service is logged without taking the rest down.

---

## Repository layout

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/` | The clean, publishable package: server, shared and client code plus a `README` module. Start here. |
| `scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/` | The framework as installed in the test place (server side). |
| `scripts/ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft/` | Client and shared modules as installed in the test place. |
| `scripts/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/` | The `HeadcraftClient` LocalScript. |
| `scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/` | Older reference models that were kept in the test place. They are not part of the framework. |
| `tree.txt` | The complete instance tree of the place, with class names. |
| `DECOMPILATION-NOTES.txt` | Extraction report: all 352 scripts were copied from their plain-text source; nothing was decompiled from bytecode. |

All configuration in this repository is neutral: `ProjectId = "YOUR_PROJECT_ID"`, no API key and no signing secret.

---

## Known limitations

- `BanAsync` / `UnbanAsync` are skipped by Roblox in Studio; bans only take real effect on live servers (the framework's own ban records work everywhere).
- Commands that need a second player (`bring`, `goto` towards someone else) can only be tested fully with several players, for example with Studio's multi-client test or on a live server.
- The in-game interface is German.

local function toPermissionSet(value: any): { [string]: boolean }
	local set = {}
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return set
	end
	for key, entry in pairs(value) do
		if type(key) == "string" and entry == true then
			set[key] = true
		elseif type(entry) == "string" then
			set[entry] = true
		end
	end
	return set
end

local function toPermissionList(value: any): { string }
	local list = {}
	for permission in pairs(toPermissionSet(value)) do
		table.insert(list, permission)
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return list
end

local function escapeArgument(text: any): string
	local value = string.gsub(tostring(text or ""), "[\r\n]", " ")
	value = string.gsub(value, "\\", "\\\\")
	value = string.gsub(value, '"', '\\"')
	return '"' .. value .. '"'
end

local function buildCommand(name: any, userId: any, reason: any): string
	if type(name) ~= "string" or not string.match(name, "^[%w_]+$") then
		return ""
	end
	if type(userId) ~= "number" or userId < 1 or userId % 1 ~= 0 then
		return ""
	end
	local text = ("%s %d"):format(name, userId)
	if type(reason) == "string" and reason ~= "" then
		return text .. " " .. escapeArgument(reason)
	end
	return text
end

local function addWindowDecoration(window: Frame)
	Theme.corner(Theme.Radius.Medium).Parent = window
	Theme.stroke(Theme.Colors.Border, 0.35, 1).Parent = window
end

function AdminUI.new(client: any, bootstrap: any?): any

function AdminUI:Has(permission: string): boolean
	if type(permission) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	if self._permissions["*"] or self._permissions[permission] then
		return true
	end
	local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
	return family ~= nil and self._permissions[family .. ".*"] == true or false
end

function AdminUI:HasAny(permissions: { string }?): boolean
	if type(permissions) ~= "table" or #permissions == 0 then
		return true
	end
	for _, permission in ipairs(permissions) do
		if self:Has(permission) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function AdminUI:MakeContext()
	local ui = self
	local client = self._client

	-- Seiten rufen die Kontextfunktionen mal mit Punkt, mal mit Doppelpunkt auf (ctx.Request(...) bzw.
	-- ctx:Request(...)). Ist das erste Argument der Kontext selbst (oder die UI), wird es übersprungen.
	local context
	local function isSelf(value)
		return value == ui or (context ~= nil and value == context)
	end
	local function action(first, second, third)
		if isSelf(first) then
			return second, third
		end
		return first, second
	end

	context = {
		Client = client,
		Theme = Theme,
		Components = Components,
		Constants = Constants,
		Maid = Maid,
		Util = Util,
		Signal = Signal,
		Prefix = self._prefix,
		Rank = self._rank,
		Version = self._version,
	}

	context.Permissions = self._permissionList
	context.Request = function(a, b, c)
		local name, args = action(a, b, c)
		return client:Request(name, args)
	end
	context.Command = function(a, b)
		local text = action(a, b)
		return client:Command(text)
	end
	context.Autocomplete = function(a, b)
		local text = action(a, b)
		return client:Autocomplete(text)
	end
	context.OnPush = function(a, b)
		local channel, fn = action(a, b)
		return client:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	context.Report = function(a, b, c)
		local kind, data = action(a, b, c)
		return client:Report(kind, data)
	end
	context.HasPermission = function(a, b)
		local permission = action(a, b)
		return ui:Has(permission)
	end
	context.OpenPage = function(a, b)
		local name = action(a, b)
		return ui:OpenPage(name)
	end
	context.Notify = function(a, b, c, d)
		if isSelf(a) then
			ui._notify(b, c, d)
		else
			ui._notify(a, b, c)
		end
	end
	context.SetStatus = function(a, b)
		local text = action(a, b)
		ui:SetStatus(text)
	end
	context.Escape = function(a, b)
		local text = action(a, b)
		return escapeArgument(text)
	end
	context.BuildCommand = function(a, b, c, d)
		if isSelf(a) then
			return buildCommand(b, c, d)
		end
		return buildCommand(a, b, c)
	end
	return context
end

function AdminUI:SetNotify(fn: (kind: string, title: string, message: string) -> ())
	if type(fn) == "function" then
		self._notify = fn
	end
end

function AdminUI:SetStatus(text: string)
	self._status.Text = tostring(text or "Bereit.")
end

function AdminUI:BuildNav()
	for _, child in ipairs(self._sidebar:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._navButtons)
	for _, name in ipairs(PAGE_ORDER) do
		if self:HasAny(PAGE_PERMISSIONS[name]) then
			local button = Components.Button(PAGE_LABELS[name], "ghost")
			button.Name = "Nav" .. name
			button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
			button.Parent = self._sidebar
			self._navButtons[name] = button
			button.Activated:Connect(function()
				self:OpenPage(name)
			end)
		end
	end
	if next(self._navButtons) == nil then
		local hint = Components.Label("Keine zugänglichen Bereiche.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
		hint.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
		hint.Parent = self._sidebar
	end
	self:UpdateNavState()
end

function AdminUI:UpdateNavState()
	for name, button in pairs(self._navButtons) do
		local active = name == self._activePage
		button.BackgroundColor3 = active and Theme.Colors.Accent or Theme.Colors.Surface
		button.TextColor3 = active and Theme.Colors.Text or Theme.Colors.TextSecondary
	end
end

function AdminUI:ShowErrorPage(message: string)
	self._pageFrame:ClearAllChildren()
	local errorState = Components.ErrorState(message, function()
		if self._activePage then
			self:OpenPage(self._activePage)
		end
	end)
	errorState.ZIndex = 5
	errorState.Parent = self._pageFrame
end

function AdminUI:OpenPage(name: string): boolean
	if type(name) ~= "string" or not self:HasAny(PAGE_PERMISSIONS[name]) then
		return false
	end
	if self._activePage == name and self._pageInstance then
		if type(self._pageInstance.OnShow) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				self._pageInstance:OnShow()
			end)
		end
		return true
	end
	if self._pageInstance then
		local current = self._pageInstance
		pcall(function()
			current:Destroy()
		end)
		self._pageInstance = nil
	end
	self._activePage = name
	self._pageFrame:ClearAllChildren()
	self:UpdateNavState()
	self:SetStatus(("Bereich: %s"):format(PAGE_LABELS[name] or name))

	local moduleScript = self._loadedModules[name]
	if moduleScript == nil then
		moduleScript = script.Pages:FindFirstChild(name)
		self._loadedModules[name] = moduleScript
	end
	if not moduleScript then
		self:ShowErrorPage(("Seite %s ist nicht vorhanden."):format(name))
		return false
	end
	local ok, pageModule = pcall(require, moduleScript)
	if not ok or type(pageModule) ~= "table" or type(pageModule.new) ~= "function" then
		self:ShowErrorPage(("Seite %s konnte nicht geladen werden."):format(name))
		return false
	end
	local built, page = pcall(pageModule.new, self._pageFrame, self._ctx)
	if not built or type(page) ~= "table" or type(page.Destroy) ~= "function" then
		self:ShowErrorPage(("Seite %s konnte nicht aufgebaut werden."):format(name))
		return false
	end
	self._pageInstance = page
	if type(page.OnShow) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			page:OnShow()
		end)
	end
	return true
end

function AdminUI:DestroyPages()
	if self._pageInstance then
		local current = self._pageInstance
		pcall(function()
			current:Destroy()
		end)
		self._pageInstance = nil
	end
	self._activePage = nil
	self._pageFrame:ClearAllChildren()
end

function AdminUI:RefreshPermissions(permissions: any, rank: string?)
	local wasAdmin = self._isAdmin
	self._permissions = toPermissionSet(permissions)
	self._permissionList = toPermissionList(permissions)
	if type(rank) == "string" then
		self._rank = rank
	end
	self._isAdmin = self:Has("Admin.Panel")
	self._subtitle.Text = ("Rang %s · Version %s · Präfix %s"):format(self._rank, self._version, self._prefix)

	if not self._isAdmin then
		self:DestroyPages()
		self:BuildNav()
		self:SetVisible(false)
		self._miniButton.Visible = false
		return
	end

	self._miniButton.Visible = true
	self:BuildNav()
	if not wasAdmin then
		self:OpenPage("Overview")
		self:SetVisible(true)
		return
	end
	if self._activePage and not self:HasAny(PAGE_PERMISSIONS[self._activePage]) then
		self:DestroyPages()
		local first = nil
		for _, name in ipairs(PAGE_ORDER) do
			if self:HasAny(PAGE_PERMISSIONS[name]) then
				first = name
				break
			end
		end
		if first then
			self:OpenPage(first)
		else
			self:SetVisible(false)
		end
	end
end

function AdminUI:SetVisible(open: boolean, instant: boolean?)
	self._visible = open == true
	self._tweenToken += 1
	local token = self._tweenToken
	if self._visible then
		self._miniButton.Text = "Schließen"
		self._root.Visible = true
		if instant then
			self._root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
			return
		end
		self._root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.54, 0)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(self._root, TWEEN, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) })
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Once(function()
			if token ~= self._tweenToken then
				tween:Cancel()
			end
		end)
		return
	end
	self._miniButton.Text = "Admin"
	if instant then
		self._root.Visible = false
		return
	end
	local tween = TweenService:Create(self._root, TWEEN, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.56, 0) })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		if token == self._tweenToken and not self._visible then
			self._root.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

function AdminUI:Toggle()
	self:SetVisible(not self._visible)
end

function AdminUI:IsVisible()
	return self._visible
end

function AdminUI:SetSidebar(open: boolean)
	self._sidebarOpen = open == true
	self:UpdateLayout()
end

function AdminUI:UpdateLayout()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end
	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	local scale = math.clamp(math.min(1, viewport.X / 1180, viewport.Y / 740), 0.5, 1)
	self._scale.Scale = scale
	local compact = viewport.X < 760
	if not self._sidebarUserSet then
		self._sidebarOpen = not compact
	end
	self._sidebar.Visible = self._sidebarOpen
	local contentX = self._sidebarOpen and SIDEBAR_WIDTH or 0
	self._content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(contentX, HEADER_HEIGHT)
	self._content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -contentX, 1, -HEADER_HEIGHT - FOOTER_HEIGHT)
	self._menuButton.Text = self._sidebarOpen and "Menü zu" or "Menü"
	self._miniButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 44 or 76, 28)
	self._miniButton.Text = compact and "HC" or (self._visible and "Schließen" or "Admin")
end

function AdminUI:Destroy()
	self._maid:Clean()
	self:DestroyPages()
	table.clear(self._navButtons)
	table.clear(self._loadedModules)
end

return AdminUI

--!nonstrict
-- Anti-Cheat: Live-Erkennungen, Risikowerte, Details und Whitelist.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local Page = {}

local DETECTION_LIMIT = 200

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		return family ~= nil and perms[family .. ".*"] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function onPush(ctx: any, channel: string, fn: (any) -> ())
	if type(ctx.OnPush) == "function" then
		return ctx:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.OnPush) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	return { Disconnect = function() end }
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local t = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d.%02d.%04d %02d:%02d:%02d", t.day or 0, t.month or 0, t.year or 0, t.hour or 0, t.min or 0, t.sec or 0)
end

local function toArray(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	if type(data.items) == "table" then
		return data.items
	end
	if type(data.detections) == "table" then
		return data.detections
	end
	if type(data.scores) == "table" then
		return data.scores
	end
	if type(data.whitelist) == "table" then
		return data.whitelist
	end
	if #data > 0 then
		return data
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, value in pairs(data) do
		if type(value) == "table" or type(value) == "number" then
			table.insert(out, value)
		end
	end
	return out
end

local SEVERITY_ORDER = { Information = 0, Low = 1, Medium = 2, High = 3, Critical = 4 }

local function severityRank(value: any): number
	local key = tostring(value or "Information")
	return SEVERITY_ORDER[key] or 0
end

function Page.new(parentFrame: Frame, ctx: any)

	severityLabel.Parent = filters

	local severitySelect = Components.Select({ "Alle", "Information", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Critical" }, "Alle", function(value)
		severityFilter = tostring(value or "Alle")
		renderDetections()
	end)
	severitySelect.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 34)
	severitySelect.Parent = filters

	local whitelistUserInput = Components.TextInput("UserId für Whitelist …")
	whitelistUserInput.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 34)
	whitelistUserInput.Parent = filters

	local whitelistAdd = Components.Button("Whitelist setzen", "secondary")
	whitelistAdd.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 34)
	whitelistAdd.Parent = filters

	local whitelistRemove = Components.Button("Entfernen", "ghost")
	whitelistRemove.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 34)
	whitelistRemove.Parent = filters

	local left = Components.Card("Erkennungen")
	left.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 116)
	left.Size = UDim2.new(0.64, -8, 1, -116)
	left.Parent = root

	local right = Components.Card("Details & Risiko")
	right.Position = UDim2.new(0.64, 8, 0, 116)
	right.Size = UDim2.new(0.36, -8, 1, -116)
	right.Parent = root

	local leftBody = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -56), Color3.new())
	leftBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	leftBody.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 44)
	leftBody.Parent = left

	local rightBody = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -56), Color3.new())
	rightBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rightBody.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 44)
	rightBody.Parent = right

	local canManage = has(ctx, "AntiCheat.Manage")
	whitelistAdd.Active = canManage
	whitelistAdd.AutoButtonColor = canManage
	whitelistAdd.TextTransparency = canManage and 0 or 0.45
	whitelistRemove.Active = canManage
	whitelistRemove.AutoButtonColor = canManage
	whitelistRemove.TextTransparency = canManage and 0 or 0.45

	local columns = {
		{ key = "Timestamp", title = "Zeit", width = 1.5, format = function(v)
			return formatTime(v)
		end },
		{ key = "UserId", title = "UserId", width = 0.9 },
		{ key = "Category", title = "Kategorie", width = 1.2 },
		{ key = "Severity", title = "Schweregrad", width = 1 },
		{ key = "Confidence", title = "Konf.", width = 0.7, format = function(v)
			local n = tonumber(v)
			return n and string.format("%d%%", math.floor(n * 100)) or "-"
		end },
		{ key = "RiskScore", title = "Risiko", width = 0.7 },
	}

		scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
		scroll.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 5
		scroll.Parent = rightBody
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
		layout.Parent = scroll

		local function line(label: string, value: string)
			local l = Components.Label(label .. ": " .. value, Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Text)
			l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
			l.TextWrapped = true
			l.Parent = scroll

		heading.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
		heading.Parent = scroll

		if type(selectedDetection) == "table" then
			line("ID", tostring(selectedDetection.Id or "-"))
			line("UserId", tostring(selectedDetection.UserId or "-"))
			line("Kategorie", tostring(selectedDetection.Category or "-"))
			line("Schweregrad", tostring(selectedDetection.Severity or "-"))
			local conf = tonumber(selectedDetection.Confidence)
			line("Konfidenz", conf and string.format("%d%%", math.floor(conf * 100)) or "-")
			line("Risiko", tostring(selectedDetection.RiskScore or "-"))
			line("Zeit", formatTime(selectedDetection.Timestamp))
			local meta = selectedDetection.Metadata
			if type(meta) == "table" then
				local metaLabel = Components.Label("Metadaten", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary, true)
				metaLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				metaLabel.Parent = scroll
				local count = 0
				for k, v in pairs(meta) do
					count += 1
					if count > 20 then
						line("…", "weitere Metadaten ausgeblendet")
						break
					end
					local valueText
					if type(v) == "table" then
						valueText = "[Tabelle]"
					else
						valueText = tostring(v)
					end
					if #valueText > 120 then
						valueText = string.sub(valueText, 1, 117) .. "..."
					end
					line(tostring(k), valueText)
				end
				if count == 0 then
					line("Metadaten", "Keine")
				end
			end
		else
			local empty = Components.Label("Wähle eine Erkennung aus, um Details zu sehen.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
			empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
			empty.TextWrapped = true
			empty.Parent = scroll
		end

		local riskTitle = Components.Label("Risikowerte (Top)", Theme.TextSize.Subheading, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
		riskTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
		riskTitle.Parent = scroll

		if #riskScores == 0 then
			local emptyRisk = Components.Label("Keine Risikowerte verfügbar.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
			emptyRisk.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
			emptyRisk.Parent = scroll
		else
			local max = math.min(#riskScores, 10)
			for i = 1, max do
				local entry = riskScores[i]
				if type(entry) == "table" then
					local uidNum = tonumber(entry.UserId or entry.userId)
					local uid = uidNum and tostring(uidNum) or "?"
					local score = tonumber(entry.Score or entry.score or entry.RiskScore or 0) or 0
					local wl = uidNum ~= nil and whitelist[uidNum] == true
					local text = string.format("Spieler %s · Risiko %d%s", uid, math.floor(score), wl and " · Whitelist" or "")
					local l = Components.Label(text, Theme.TextSize.Small, wl and Theme.Colors.Success or Theme.Colors.Text)
					l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
					l.Parent = scroll
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function passesFilters(item: any): boolean
		if type(item) ~= "table" then
			return false
		end
		if categoryFilter ~= "Alle" and tostring(item.Category or "") ~= categoryFilter then
			return false
		end
		if severityFilter ~= "Alle" and tostring(item.Severity or "") ~= severityFilter then
			return false
		end
		return true
	end

	local function rebuildCategoryOptions()
		local seen: { [string]: boolean } = { Alle = true }
		local list = { "Alle" }
		for _, item in ipairs(detections) do
			if type(item) == "table" then
				local cat = tostring(item.Category or "")
				if cat ~= "" and not seen[cat] then
					seen[cat] = true
					table.insert(list, cat)
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			if a == "Alle" then
				return true
			end
			if b == "Alle" then
				return false
			end
			return a < b
		end)
		if not seen[categoryFilter] then
			categoryFilter = "Alle"
		end
		setCategoryOptions(list, categoryFilter)
	end

	renderDetections = function()
		local filtered = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(detections) do
			if passesFilters(item) then
				table.insert(filtered, item)
			end
		end
		table.sort(filtered, function(a, b)
			local ta = tonumber(a.Timestamp) or 0
			local tb = tonumber(b.Timestamp) or 0
			if ta == tb then
				return severityRank(a.Severity) > severityRank(b.Severity)
			end
			return ta > tb
		end)
		renderTable(filtered)
		renderDetails()
	end

	local function setWhitelistState(whitelisted: boolean)
		if not has(ctx, "AntiCheat.Manage") then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Berechtigung", "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung AntiCheat.Manage.")
			return
		end
		local userId = tonumber(whitelistUserInput.Text)
		if not userId or userId < 1 or userId % 1 ~= 0 then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Whitelist", "Bitte eine gültige numerische UserId eingeben.")
			return
		end
		setStatus(ctx, "Whitelist wird aktualisiert …")
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, result = callRequest(ctx, "SetWhitelist", { userId = userId, whitelisted = whitelisted })
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			if ok then
				whitelist[userId] = whitelisted and true or nil
				notify(ctx, "success", "Whitelist", whitelisted and "Spieler wurde zur Whitelist hinzugefügt." or "Spieler wurde von der Whitelist entfernt.")
				renderDetails()
			else
				notify(ctx, "error", "Whitelist", tostring(result or "Whitelist konnte nicht aktualisiert werden."))
				setStatus(ctx, "Whitelist konnte nicht aktualisiert werden.")
			end
		end)
	end

	whitelistAdd.Activated:Connect(function()
		setWhitelistState(true)
	end)
	whitelistRemove.Activated:Connect(function()
		setWhitelistState(false)
	end)

	local function loadAll()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		setStatus(ctx, "Anti-Cheat-Daten werden geladen …")
		task.spawn(function()
			local okDet, detData = callRequest(ctx, "GetDetections", { limit = DETECTION_LIMIT })
			local okRisk, riskData = callRequest(ctx, "GetRiskScores")
			local okWl, wlData = callRequest(ctx, "GetWhitelist")
			if destroyed then
				return
			end

			if okDet then
				table.clear(detections)
				for _, item in ipairs(toArray(detData)) do
					if type(item) == "table" then
						table.insert(detections, item)
					end
				end
				while #detections > DETECTION_LIMIT do
					table.remove(detections)
				end
			else
				notify(ctx, "error", "Anti-Cheat", tostring(detData or "Erkennungen konnten nicht geladen werden."))
			end

			if okRisk then
				table.clear(riskScores)
				for _, item in ipairs(toArray(riskData)) do
					if type(item) == "table" then
						table.insert(riskScores, item)
					end
				end
				table.sort(riskScores, function(a, b)
					return (tonumber(a.Score or a.score or a.RiskScore) or 0) > (tonumber(b.Score or b.score or b.RiskScore) or 0)
				end)
			end

			if okWl then
				table.clear(whitelist)
				local wlList = toArray(wlData)
				if #wlList > 0 then
					for _, item in ipairs(wlList) do
						if type(item) == "number" then
							whitelist[item] = true
						elseif type(item) == "string" then
							local uid = tonumber(item)
							if uid then
								whitelist[uid] = true
							end
						elseif type(item) == "table" then
							local uid = tonumber(item.UserId or item.userId or item.Id)
							local wl = item.whitelisted
							if wl == nil then
								wl = item.Whitelisted
							end
							if uid and wl == true then
								whitelist[uid] = true
							end
						end
					end
				elseif type(wlData) == "table" then
					for k, v in pairs(wlData) do
						local uid = tonumber(k)
						if uid and v == true then
							whitelist[uid] = true
						end
					end
				end
			end

			rebuildCategoryOptions()
			renderDetections()
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("Anti-Cheat geladen: %d Erkennungen.", #detections))
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(loadAll)

	maid:Give(onPush(ctx, "Detection", function(payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		table.insert(detections, 1, payload)
		while #detections > DETECTION_LIMIT do
			table.remove(detections)
		end
		if visible then
			rebuildCategoryOptions()
			renderDetections()
		end
	end))

	local api = {}

	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		loadAll()
	end

	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end

	return api
end

return Page

--!nonstrict
-- Commands: Browser, Konsole mit Autocomplete und History.
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local Page = {}

local HISTORY_LIMIT = 50
local COMMAND_HISTORY_LIMIT = 100

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function callCommand(ctx: any, text: string): any
	if type(ctx.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx:Command(text)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Command(text)
	end
	return { success = false, message = "Command ist nicht verfügbar." }
end

local function callAutocomplete(ctx: any, text: string): { suggestions: { any } }
	if type(ctx.Autocomplete) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Autocomplete(text)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "table" then
			return result
		end
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Autocomplete) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx.Client:Autocomplete(text)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "table" then
			return result
		end
	end
	return { suggestions = {} }
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function toArray(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	if type(data.commands) == "table" then
		return data.commands
	end
	if type(data.history) == "table" then
		return data.history
	end
	if type(data.items) == "table" then
		return data.items
	end
	if #data > 0 then
		return data
	end
	return {}
end

local function formatArgs(args: any): string
	if type(args) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, arg in ipairs(args) do
		if type(arg) == "table" then
			local name = tostring(arg.Name or arg.name or "?")
			local typ = tostring(arg.Type or arg.type or "string")
			local required = arg.Required == true or arg.required == true
			local piece = string.format("%s:%s", name, typ)
			if required then
				piece = piece .. "!"
			end
			table.insert(parts, piece)
		elseif type(arg) == "string" then
			table.insert(parts, arg)
		end
	end
	if #parts == 0 then
		return "-"
	end
	return table.concat(parts, ", ")
end

local function formatAliases(aliases: any): string
	if type(aliases) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(aliases) do
		if type(a) == "string" and a ~= "" then
			table.insert(parts, a)
		end
	end
	if #parts == 0 then
		return "-"
	end
	return table.concat(parts, ", ")
end

function Page.new(parentFrame: Frame, ctx: any)
	local maid = Maid.new()
	local Components = ctx.Components
	local Theme = ctx.Theme
	local destroyed = false
	local visible = false

	local commands: { any } = {}
	local serverHistory: { any } = {}
	local localHistory: { string } = {}
	local localHistoryIndex = 0
	local suggestions: { any } = {}
	local suggestionIndex = 0
	local autocompleteToken = 0

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "CommandsPage"
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.Parent = parentFrame

	local title = Components.Label("Commands", Theme.TextSize.Title, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 32)
	title.Parent = root

	local subtitle = Components.Label("Command-Browser, Konsole und History.", Theme.TextSize.Body, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
	subtitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)
	subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 20)
	subtitle.Parent = root

	local refreshButton = Components.Button("Aktualisieren", "secondary")
	refreshButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	refreshButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	refreshButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 34)
	refreshButton.Parent = root

	local left = Components.Card("Verfügbare Commands")
	left.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 64)
	left.Size = UDim2.new(0.58, -8, 1, -64)
	left.Parent = root

	local right = Components.Card("Konsole & History")
	right.Position = UDim2.new(0.58, 8, 0, 64)
	right.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, -8, 1, -64)
	right.Parent = root

	local leftBody = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -56), Color3.new())
	leftBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	leftBody.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 44)
	leftBody.Parent = left

	local rightBody = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -56), Color3.new())
	rightBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rightBody.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 44)
	rightBody.Parent = right

	local columns = {
		{ key = "Name", title = "Name", width = 1.2 },
		{ key = "Category", title = "Kategorie", width = 1 },
		{ key = "Description", title = "Beschreibung", width = 2.2 },
		{ key = "Aliases", title = "Aliase", width = 1.1 },
		{ key = "Args", title = "Argumente", width = 1.8 },
	}
	local tableRoot, renderTable = Components.Table(columns, {}, nil, { filter = true, pageSize = 100, emptyText = "Keine Commands verfügbar." })
	tableRoot.Parent = leftBody

	local consoleOutput = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	consoleOutput.Name = "ConsoleOutput"
	consoleOutput.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.Background
	consoleOutput.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	consoleOutput.BorderSizePixel = 0
	consoleOutput.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	consoleOutput.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -164)
	consoleOutput.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	consoleOutput.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	consoleOutput.ScrollBarThickness = 5
	consoleOutput.Parent = rightBody
	Theme.corner(Theme.Radius.Small).Parent = consoleOutput
	Theme.stroke().Parent = consoleOutput
	local outputPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	outputPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
	outputPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
	outputPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
	outputPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
	outputPadding.Parent = consoleOutput
	local outputLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	outputLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
	outputLayout.Parent = consoleOutput

	local function appendOutput(text: string, color: Color3?)
		local line = Components.Label(text, Theme.TextSize.Small, color or Theme.Colors.Text)
		line.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0)
		line.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		line.TextWrapped = true
		line.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		line.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
		line.RichText = false
		line.Parent = consoleOutput

		local children = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(consoleOutput:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				table.insert(children, child)
			end
		end
		while #children > COMMAND_HISTORY_LIMIT do
			children[1]:Destroy()
			table.remove(children, 1)
		end
		task.defer(function()
			if consoleOutput.Parent then
				consoleOutput.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, consoleOutput.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y))
			end
		end)
	end

	local inputRow = Components.Frame("InputRow", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36), Color3.new())
	inputRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	inputRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -156)
	inputRow.Parent = rightBody

	local commandInput = Components.TextInput("Command eingeben … (; optional)")
	commandInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 1, 0)
	commandInput.Parent = inputRow

	local runButton = Components.Button("Ausführen", "primary")
	runButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	runButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	runButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 36)
	runButton.Parent = inputRow

	local suggestionsFrame = Components.Frame("Suggestions", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised)
	suggestionsFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	suggestionsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -116)
	suggestionsFrame.Visible = false
	suggestionsFrame.ZIndex = 20
	Theme.corner(Theme.Radius.Small).Parent = suggestionsFrame
	Theme.stroke().Parent = suggestionsFrame
	suggestionsFrame.Parent = rightBody
	local suggestionsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	suggestionsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
	suggestionsLayout.Parent = suggestionsFrame
	local suggestionsPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	suggestionsPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
	suggestionsPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
	suggestionsPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
	suggestionsPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
	suggestionsPadding.Parent = suggestionsFrame

	local function clearSuggestions()
		for _, child in ipairs(suggestionsFrame:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local function renderSuggestions()
		clearSuggestions()
		if #suggestions == 0 then
			suggestionsFrame.Visible = false
			return
		end
		suggestionsFrame.Visible = true
		local max = math.min(#suggestions, 8)
		for i = 1, max do
			local entry = suggestions[i]
			local text = type(entry) == "table" and tostring(entry.display or entry.text or "") or tostring(entry)
			local desc = type(entry) == "table" and tostring(entry.description or "") or ""
			local button = Components.Button(desc ~= "" and (text .. "  ·  " .. desc) or text, "ghost")
			button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
			button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			button.ZIndex = 21
			if i == suggestionIndex then
				button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.Accent
				button.TextColor3 = Theme.Colors.Text
			end
			button.Parent = suggestionsFrame
			local btnPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
			btnPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
			btnPadding.Parent = button
			button.Activated:Connect(function()
				local value = type(entry) == "table" and tostring(entry.text or entry.display or "") or tostring(entry)
				commandInput.Text = value
				commandInput.CursorPosition = #commandInput.Text + 1
				suggestions = {}
				suggestionIndex = 0
				renderSuggestions()
				commandInput:CaptureFocus()
			end)
		end
	end

	local function acceptSuggestion(): boolean
		if suggestionIndex < 1 or suggestionIndex > #suggestions then
			return false
		end
		local entry = suggestions[suggestionIndex]
		local value = type(entry) == "table" and tostring(entry.text or entry.display or "") or tostring(entry)
		commandInput.Text = value
		commandInput.CursorPosition = #commandInput.Text + 1
		suggestions = {}
		suggestionIndex = 0
		renderSuggestions()
		return true
	end

	local function requestAutocomplete(text: string)
		autocompleteToken += 1
		local token = autocompleteToken
		task.spawn(function()
			local result = callAutocomplete(ctx, text)
			if destroyed or token ~= autocompleteToken then
				return
			end
			local list = {}
			if type(result) == "table" and type(result.suggestions) == "table" then
				for _, s in ipairs(result.suggestions) do
					if type(s) == "table" or type(s) == "string" then
						table.insert(list, s)
					end
					if #list >= 8 then
						break
					end
				end
			end
			suggestions = list
			suggestionIndex = #suggestions > 0 and 1 or 0
			renderSuggestions()
		end)
	end

	commandInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		local text = commandInput.Text
		if string.gsub(text, "%s", "") == "" then
			suggestions = {}
			suggestionIndex = 0
			renderSuggestions()
			return
		end
		requestAutocomplete(text)
	end)

	commandInput.Focused:Connect(function()
		if commandInput.Text ~= "" then
			requestAutocomplete(commandInput.Text)
		end
	end)

	commandInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if not destroyed then
				suggestionsFrame.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end)

	maid:Give(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, _processed)
		if not visible or destroyed then
			return
		end
		if not commandInput:IsFocused() then
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
			if #suggestions > 0 then
				acceptSuggestion()
				task.defer(function()
					if not destroyed and commandInput.Parent then
						commandInput:CaptureFocus()
						commandInput.CursorPosition = #commandInput.Text + 1
					end
				end)
			end
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			if #suggestions > 0 then
				suggestionIndex = math.clamp(suggestionIndex + 1, 1, #suggestions)
				renderSuggestions()
			elseif #localHistory > 0 and localHistoryIndex > 0 then
				localHistoryIndex -= 1
				if localHistoryIndex == 0 then
					commandInput.Text = ""
				else
					commandInput.Text = localHistory[#localHistory - localHistoryIndex + 1] or ""
				end
				commandInput.CursorPosition = #commandInput.Text + 1
			end
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			if #suggestions > 0 then
				suggestionIndex = math.clamp(suggestionIndex - 1, 1, #suggestions)
				renderSuggestions()
			elseif #localHistory > 0 then
				localHistoryIndex = math.clamp(localHistoryIndex + 1, 1, #localHistory)
				local idx = #localHistory - localHistoryIndex + 1
				commandInput.Text = localHistory[idx] or ""
				commandInput.CursorPosition = #commandInput.Text + 1
			end
			return
		end
	end))

	local function executeConsole()
		local text = commandInput.Text
		if string.gsub(text, "%s", "") == "" then
			return
		end
		table.insert(localHistory, text)
		while #localHistory > HISTORY_LIMIT do
			table.remove(localHistory, 1)
		end
		localHistoryIndex = 0
		appendOutput("> " .. text, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
		commandInput.Text = ""
		suggestions = {}
		suggestionIndex = 0
		renderSuggestions()
		setStatus(ctx, "Command wird ausgeführt …")
		task.spawn(function()
			local result = callCommand(ctx, text)
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			if type(result) == "table" and result.success == true then
				appendOutput(tostring(result.message or "Erfolgreich ausgeführt."), Theme.Colors.Success)
				setStatus(ctx, "Command erfolgreich ausgeführt.")
			else
				local message = type(result) == "table" and tostring(result.message or "Command fehlgeschlagen.") or "Command fehlgeschlagen."
				appendOutput(message, Theme.Colors.Error)
				setStatus(ctx, "Command fehlgeschlagen.")
			end
		end)
	end

	runButton.Activated:Connect(executeConsole)
	commandInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
		if enterPressed then
			executeConsole()
		end
	end)

	local historyLabel = Components.Label("Server-History", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary, true)
	historyLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -72)
	historyLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
	historyLabel.Parent = rightBody

	local historyList = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	historyList.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	historyList.BorderSizePixel = 0
	historyList.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -52)
	historyList.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52)
	historyList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	historyList.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	historyList.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	historyList.Parent = rightBody
	local historyLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	historyLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
	historyLayout.Parent = historyList

	local function renderServerHistory()
		for _, child in ipairs(historyList:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local max = math.min(#serverHistory, 10)
		for i = 1, max do
			local entry = serverHistory[i]
			local text
			if type(entry) == "table" then
				text = tostring(entry.rawText or entry.command or entry.Command or entry.message or "")
				if text == "" then
					local uid = tostring(entry.userId or entry.UserId or "?")
					local cmd = tostring(entry.commandName or entry.CommandName or "Command")
					text = string.format("%s: %s", uid, cmd)
				end
			else
				text = tostring(entry)
			end
			local line = Components.Label(text, Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
			line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
			line.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			line.Parent = historyList
		end
		if max == 0 then
			local empty = Components.Label("Keine Command-History verfügbar.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
			empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
			empty.Parent = historyList
		end
	end

	local function loadData()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		setStatus(ctx, "Commands werden geladen …")
		task.spawn(function()
			local okCmd, cmdData = callRequest(ctx, "GetCommands")
			local okHist, histData = callRequest(ctx, "GetCommandHistory")
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			if okCmd then
				table.clear(commands)
				for _, item in ipairs(toArray(cmdData)) do
					if type(item) == "table" then
						table.insert(commands, {
							Name = tostring(item.Name or item.name or "-"),
							Category = tostring(item.Category or item.category or "-"),
							Description = tostring(item.Description or item.description or "-"),
							Aliases = formatAliases(item.Aliases or item.aliases),
							Args = formatArgs(item.Args or item.args),
							raw = item,
						})
					end
				end
				table.sort(commands, function(a, b)
					if a.Category == b.Category then
						return string.lower(a.Name) < string.lower(b.Name)
					end
					return string.lower(a.Category) < string.lower(b.Category)
				end)
				renderTable(commands)
			else
				notify(ctx, "error", "Commands", tostring(cmdData or "Commands konnten nicht geladen werden."))
			end
			if okHist then
				table.clear(serverHistory)
				for _, item in ipairs(toArray(histData)) do
					table.insert(serverHistory, item)
				end
				renderServerHistory()
			end
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("%d Commands geladen.", #commands))
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(loadData)

	local api = {}

	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		loadData()
	end

	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end

	return api
end

return Page

--!nonstrict
-- Protokolle: Admin-, Security- und System-Logs.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local Page = {}

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local t = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d.%02d.%04d %02d:%02d:%02d", t.day or 0, t.month or 0, t.year or 0, t.hour or 0, t.min or 0, t.sec or 0)
end

local function toArray(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	if type(data.logs) == "table" then
		return data.logs
	end
	if type(data.entries) == "table" then
		return data.entries
	end
	if type(data.items) == "table" then
		return data.items
	end
	if #data > 0 then
		return data
	end
	return {}
end

function Page.new(parentFrame: Frame, ctx: any)
	local maid = Maid.new()
	local Components = ctx.Components
	local Theme = ctx.Theme
	local destroyed = false
	local visible = false
	local currentTab = "Admin"
	local loading = false
	local loadToken = 0

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "LogsPage"
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.Parent = parentFrame

	local title = Components.Label("Protokolle", Theme.TextSize.Title, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 32)
	title.Parent = root

	local subtitle = Components.Label("Admin-, Sicherheits- und Systemprotokolle.", Theme.TextSize.Body, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
	subtitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)
	subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 20)
	subtitle.Parent = root

	local refreshButton = Components.Button("Aktualisieren", "secondary")
	refreshButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	refreshButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	refreshButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 34)
	refreshButton.Parent = root

	local body = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -114), Color3.new())
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 114)
	body.Parent = root

	local function mountTable(rows: { any })
		body:ClearAllChildren()
		local columns = {
			{ key = "Timestamp", title = "Zeit", width = 1.5, format = function(v) return formatTime(v) end },
			{ key = "Level", title = "Level", width = 0.8 },
			{ key = "Tag", title = "Tag", width = 1.2 },
			{ key = "Message", title = "Nachricht", width = 3.2 },
		}
		local normalized = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(rows) do
			if type(item) == "table" then
				table.insert(normalized, {
					Timestamp = item.Timestamp or item.timestamp or item.Time or item.time,
					Level = tostring(item.Level or item.level or "-"),
					Tag = tostring(item.Tag or item.tag or item.Category or item.category or "-"),
					Message = tostring(item.Message or item.message or "-"),
					raw = item,
				})
			end
		end
		table.sort(normalized, function(a, b)
			return (tonumber(a.Timestamp) or 0) > (tonumber(b.Timestamp) or 0)
		end)
		local tableRoot, _ = Components.Table(columns, normalized, nil, { filter = true, pageSize = 100, emptyText = "Keine Protokolleinträge vorhanden." })
		tableRoot.Parent = body
	end

	local function loadTab(tab: string)
		if destroyed or loading then
			return
		end
		loading = true
		loadToken += 1
		local token = loadToken
		setStatus(ctx, string.format("%s-Protokolle werden geladen …", tab))
		body:ClearAllChildren()
		Components.Spinner("Protokolle werden geladen …").Parent = body
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetLogs", { kind = tab, limit = 200 })
			if destroyed or token ~= loadToken then
				return
			end
			loading = false
			if not ok then
				local message = tostring(data or "Protokolle konnten nicht geladen werden.")
				body:ClearAllChildren()
				Components.ErrorState(message, function()
					loadTab(tab)
				end).Parent = body
				notify(ctx, "error", "Protokolle", message)
				return
			end
			local rows = toArray(data)
			mountTable(rows)
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("%s-Protokolle geladen: %d Einträge.", tab, #rows))
		end)
	end

	local tabsBar, selectTab = Components.Tabs({ "Admin", "Security", "System" }, function(name)
		currentTab = name
		loadTab(name)
	end)
	tabsBar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 64)
	tabsBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
	tabsBar.Parent = root

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		loadTab(currentTab)
	end)

	local api = {}
	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		loadTab(currentTab)
	end
	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end
	return api
end

return Page

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Moderation: Bans, Warnungen, Mutes und History.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local Page = {}

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		return family ~= nil and perms[family .. ".*"] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function callCommand(ctx: any, text: string): any
	if type(ctx.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx:Command(text)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Command(text)
	end
	return { success = false, message = "Command ist nicht verfügbar." }
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function escapeArg(ctx: any, value: any): string
	if type(ctx.Escape) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Escape(value)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "string" then
			return result
		end
	end
	local text = string.gsub(tostring(value or ""), "[\r\n]", " ")
	text = string.gsub(text, "\\", "\\\\")
	text = string.gsub(text, '"', '\\"')
	return '"' .. text .. '"'
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local t = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d.%02d.%04d %02d:%02d", t.day or 0, t.month or 0, t.year or 0, t.hour or 0, t.min or 0)
end

local function formatExpiry(expiresAt: any): string
	if expiresAt == nil then
		return "Permanent"
	end
	if type(expiresAt) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	return formatTime(expiresAt)
end

local function toRows(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) == "table" then
		if type(data.records) == "table" then
			return data.records
		end
		if type(data.items) == "table" then
			return data.items
		end
		if type(data.list) == "table" then
			return data.list
		end
		if #data > 0 then
			return data
		end
	end
	return {}
end

local function normalizeRows(rows: { any }): { any }
	local normalized = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(rows) do
		if type(item) == "table" then
			table.insert(normalized, item)
		end
	end
	table.sort(normalized, function(a, b)
		local ta = tonumber(a.Timestamp) or 0
		local tb = tonumber(b.Timestamp) or 0
		return ta > tb
	end)
	return normalized
end

function Page.new(parentFrame: Frame, ctx: any)
	local maid = Maid.new()
	local Components = ctx.Components
	local Theme = ctx.Theme

		unbanButton.Visible = currentTab == "Bans" and has(ctx, "Player.Ban")
	end

					return formatTime(v)
				end },
				{ key = "ExpiresAt", title = "Läuft ab", width = 1.4, format = function(v)
					return formatExpiry(v)
				end },
				{ key = "Source", title = "Quelle", width = 0.8 },
			}
		elseif tab == "Warnings" then
			return {
				{ key = "UserId", title = "UserId", width = 1 },
				{ key = "Reason", title = "Grund", width = 3 },
				{ key = "ModeratorId", title = "Moderator", width = 1 },
				{ key = "Timestamp", title = "Zeit", width = 1.6, format = function(v)
					return formatTime(v)
				end },
				{ key = "Source", title = "Quelle", width = 0.8 },
			}
		elseif tab == "Mutes" then

				{ key = "UserId", title = "UserId", width = 1 },
				{ key = "Reason", title = "Grund", width = 2.4 },
				{ key = "ModeratorId", title = "Moderator", width = 1 },
				{ key = "Timestamp", title = "Zeit", width = 1.4, format = function(v)
					return formatTime(v)

				{ key = "ExpiresAt", title = "Läuft ab", width = 1.4, format = function(v)
					return formatExpiry(v)
				end },
				{ key = "Source", title = "Quelle", width = 0.8 },
			}
		end
		return {
			{ key = "UserId", title = "UserId", width = 0.9 },
			{ key = "Type", title = "Typ", width = 0.9 },
			{ key = "Reason", title = "Grund", width = 2.6 },
			{ key = "ModeratorId", title = "Moderator", width = 0.9 },

				return formatTime(v)
			end },
			{ key = "Source", title = "Quelle", width = 0.8 },
		}
	end

	local function mountTable(tab: string, rows: { any })
		body:ClearAllChildren()
		selectedRecord = nil
		local cols = columnsForTab(tab)
		local tableRoot = Components.Table(cols, rows, function(item)
			selectedRecord = item
		end, { filter = true, pageSize = 100, emptyText = "Keine Einträge vorhanden." })
		tableRoot.Parent = body
	end

		if destroyed then
			return
		end

		loadToken += 1

		body:ClearAllChildren()
