```lua
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetModeration", { kind = tab })
			if destroyed or token ~= loadToken then
				return
			end
			loading = false
			if not ok then
				local message = tostring(data or "Moderationsdaten konnten nicht geladen werden.")
				body:ClearAllChildren()
				local err = Components.ErrorState(message, function()

				end)
				err.Parent = body
				notify(ctx, "error", "Moderation", message)
				setStatus(ctx, "Moderationsdaten konnten nicht geladen werden.")
				return
			end
			local rows = normalizeRows(toRows(data))
			mountTable(tab, rows)
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("%s geladen: %d Einträge.", tab, #rows))
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(function()

	end)

	unbanButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if currentTab ~= "Bans" then
			return
		end
		if not has(ctx, "Player.Ban") then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Berechtigung", "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung für Unban.")
			return
		end
		if type(selectedRecord) ~= "table" then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Unban", "Bitte zuerst einen Ban-Eintrag auswählen.")
			return
		end
		local userId = tonumber(selectedRecord.UserId or selectedRecord.userId)
		if not userId or userId < 1 or userId % 1 ~= 0 then
			notify(ctx, "error", "Unban", "Der ausgewählte Eintrag enthält keine gültige UserId.")
			return
		end
		Components.Dialog(root, "Ban aufheben", string.format("Grund für das Aufheben des Bans von %d eingeben …", userId), function(reason)
			local cmd = string.format("unban %d %s", userId, escapeArg(ctx, reason))
			setStatus(ctx, "Unban wird ausgeführt …")
			task.spawn(function()
				local result = callCommand(ctx, cmd)
				if destroyed then
					return
				end
				if type(result) == "table" and result.success == true then
					notify(ctx, "success", "Unban", tostring(result.message or "Ban wurde aufgehoben."))
					loadTab("Bans")
				else
					local message = type(result) == "table" and tostring(result.message or "Unban fehlgeschlagen.") or "Unban fehlgeschlagen."
					notify(ctx, "error", "Unban", message)
					setStatus(ctx, "Unban fehlgeschlagen.")
				end
			end)
		end, { reasonRequired = true, danger = true, confirmText = "Ban aufheben" })
	end)

	local api = {}

	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		updateUnbanVisibility()
		loadTab(currentTab)
	end

	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end

	return api
end

return Page
```

```lua
local ACTIVITY_LIMIT = 200

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	if type(ctx.Has) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Has(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		if family and (perms[family .. ".*"] == true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function onPush(ctx: any, channel: string, fn: (any) -> ())
	if type(ctx.OnPush) == "function" then
		return ctx:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.OnPush) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	return { Disconnect = function() end }
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local localTime = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(localTime) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", localTime.hour or 0, localTime.min or 0, localTime.sec or 0)
end

local function trimList(list: { any }, limit: number)
	while #list > limit do
		table.remove(list)
	end
end

local function severityText(severity: any): string
	local value = tostring(severity or "Information")
	return value
end

local function detectionMessage(item: any): string
	if type(item) ~= "table" then
		return "Erkennung empfangen"
	end
	local userId = tostring(item.UserId or "?")
	local category = tostring(item.Category or "Unbekannt")
	local severity = severityText(item.Severity)
	local confidence = type(item.Confidence) == "number" and math.floor(item.Confidence * 100) or 0
	return string.format("[%s] %s · Spieler %s · %d%%", severity, category, userId, confidence)
end

local function activityMessage(item: any): string
	if type(item) ~= "table" then
		return "Aktivität"
	end
	local kind = tostring(item.Kind or "Aktivität")
	local message = tostring(item.Message or "")
	if message == "" then
		message = kind
	end
	return string.format("[%s] %s", kind, message)
end

			table.clear(activities)

				if type(item) == "table" then
					table.insert(activities, item)
				end
			end

			renderActivity()
			renderDetections()

			if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then

		if visible then
			renderActivity()
		end
	end))

		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		table.insert(detections, 1, payload)
		trimList(detections, DETECTION_LIMIT)
		if visible then
			renderDetections()
		end
	end))

	local refreshRunning = true
	maid:Give(function()
		refreshRunning = false
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while refreshRunning and not destroyed do
			task.wait(REFRESH_SECONDS)
			if refreshRunning and not destroyed and visible then
				loadOverview()
			end
		end
	end)

	local api = {}

	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		if #activities == 0 and #detections == 0 then
			loadOverview()
		else
			renderActivity()
			renderDetections()
		end
	end

	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		refreshRunning = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end

	return api
end
```

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Berechtigungen: Rollen, Matrix, Zuweisungen und Command-basierte Änderungen.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)

local Page = {}

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		return family ~= nil and perms[family .. ".*"] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function callCommand(ctx: any, text: string): any
	if type(ctx.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx:Command(text)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Command(text)
	end
	return { success = false, message = "Command ist nicht verfügbar." }
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function escapeArg(ctx: any, value: any): string
	if type(ctx.Escape) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Escape(value)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "string" then
			return result
		end
	end
	local text = string.gsub(tostring(value or ""), "[\r\n]", " ")
	text = string.gsub(text, "\\", "\\\\")
	text = string.gsub(text, '"', '\\"')
	return '"' .. text .. '"'
end

local KNOWN_PERMISSIONS = {
	"Player.Kick", "Player.Ban", "Player.Teleport", "Player.Manage",
	"Moderation.Warn", "Moderation.Mute", "Moderation.ViewHistory",
	"AntiCheat.ViewDetections", "AntiCheat.Manage",
	"Admin.ManageRanks", "Admin.ManagePermissions", "Admin.Panel",
	"Server.Manage", "Server.Announce", "Server.Shutdown",
	"Logs.View", "Logs.Manage",
}

local function toArray(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	if type(data.roles) == "table" then
		return data.roles
	end
	if #data > 0 then
		return data
	end
	return {}
end

local function roleHasPermission(role: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(role) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	local perms = role.Permissions or role.permissions
	if type(perms) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(perms) do
		if p == "*" or p == permission then
			return true
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		if family and p == family .. ".*" then
			return true
		end
	end
	local inherits = role.Inherits or role.inherits
	-- Inheritance resolution is server-side; we display what's in data.
	-- If server provides resolved, use it.
	local resolved = role.ResolvedPermissions or role.resolvedPermissions
	if type(resolved) == "table" then
		for _, p in ipairs(resolved) do
			if p == "*" or p == permission then
				return true
			end
			local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
			if family and p == family .. ".*" then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function Page.new(parentFrame: Frame, ctx: any)
	local maid = Maid.new()
	local Components = ctx.Components
	local Theme = ctx.Theme
	local destroyed = false
	local visible = false

	local roles: { any } = {}
	local assignments: { any } = {}

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "PermissionsPage"
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.Parent = parentFrame

	local title = Components.Label("Berechtigungen", Theme.TextSize.Title, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 32)
	title.Parent = root

	local subtitle = Components.Label("Rollen, Berechtigungsmatrix und Zuweisungen.", Theme.TextSize.Body, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
	subtitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)
	subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 20)
	subtitle.Parent = root

	local refreshButton = Components.Button("Aktualisieren", "secondary")
	refreshButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	refreshButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	refreshButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 34)
	refreshButton.Parent = root

	local left = Components.Card("Rollen & Matrix")
	left.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 64)
	left.Size = UDim2.new(0.62, -8, 1, -64)
	left.Parent = root

	local right = Components.Card("Zuweisungen & Änderungen")
	right.Position = UDim2.new(0.62, 8, 0, 64)
	right.Size = UDim2.new(0.38, -8, 1, -64)
	right.Parent = root

	local leftBody = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -56), Color3.new())
	leftBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	leftBody.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 44)
	leftBody.Parent = left

	local rightBody = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -56), Color3.new())
	rightBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rightBody.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 44)
	rightBody.Parent = right

	local canManageRanks = has(ctx, "Admin.ManageRanks")
	local canManagePerms = has(ctx, "Admin.ManagePermissions")

	local function renderMatrix()
		leftBody:ClearAllChildren()
		local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
		scroll.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 5
		scroll.Parent = leftBody
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
		layout.Parent = scroll

		if #roles == 0 then
			Components.EmptyState("Keine Rollen verfügbar.").Parent = scroll
			return
		end

		local sortedRoles = table.clone(roles)
		table.sort(sortedRoles, function(a, b)
			return (tonumber(a.Priority or a.priority) or 0) > (tonumber(b.Priority or b.priority) or 0)
		end)

		for _, role in ipairs(sortedRoles) do
			local roleName = tostring(role.Name or role.name or "Rolle")
			local priority = tonumber(role.Priority or role.priority) or 0
			local card = Components.Frame("Role", UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0), Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised)
			card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			Theme.corner(Theme.Radius.Small).Parent = card
			card.Parent = scroll
			local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
			pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
			pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
			pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
			pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
			pad.Parent = card
			local vlayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
			vlayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
			vlayout.Parent = card

			local header = Components.Label(string.format("%s (Priorität %d)", roleName, priority), Theme.TextSize.Body, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
			header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
			header.Parent = card

			local inherits = role.Inherits or role.inherits
			if type(inherits) == "table" and #inherits > 0 then
				local inh = Components.Label("Erbt von: " .. table.concat(inherits, ", "), Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
				inh.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
				inh.TextWrapped = true
				inh.Parent = card
			end

			local permText = {}
			for _, perm in ipairs(KNOWN_PERMISSIONS) do
				if roleHasPermission(role, perm) then
					table.insert(permText, perm)
				end
			end
			local permsLabel = Components.Label(#permText > 0 and ("Berechtigungen: " .. table.concat(permText, ", ")) or "Berechtigungen: keine direkten", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
			permsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
			permsLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			permsLabel.TextWrapped = true
			permsLabel.Parent = card
		end
	end

	local loadData

	local function renderAssignmentsAndActions()
		rightBody:ClearAllChildren()
		local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
		scroll.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 5
		scroll.Parent = rightBody
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
		layout.Parent = scroll

		local assignTitle = Components.Label("Spielerzuweisungen", Theme.TextSize.Subheading, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
		assignTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
		assignTitle.Parent = scroll

		if #assignments == 0 then
			local empty = Components.Label("Keine Zuweisungen verfügbar.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
			empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
			empty.Parent = scroll
		else
			local max = math.min(#assignments, 30)
			for i = 1, max do
				local entry = assignments[i]
				if type(entry) == "table" then
					local uid = tostring(entry.userId or entry.UserId or "?")
					local rank = tostring(entry.rank or entry.Rank or "-")
					local line = Components.Label(string.format("UserId %s → %s", uid, rank), Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Text)
					line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
					line.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
					line.Parent = scroll
				end
			end
		end

		local actionTitle = Components.Label("Änderungen", Theme.TextSize.Subheading, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
		actionTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
		actionTitle.Parent = scroll

		local userIdInput = Components.TextInput("UserId …")
		userIdInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
		userIdInput.Parent = scroll

		local rankInput = Components.TextInput("Rangname (z. B. Moderator) …")
		rankInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
		rankInput.Parent = scroll

		local permInput = Components.TextInput("Permission (z. B. Player.Kick) …")
		permInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
		permInput.Parent = scroll

		local function runCommandText(text: string)
			setStatus(ctx, "Command wird ausgeführt …")
			task.spawn(function()
				local result = callCommand(ctx, text)
				if destroyed then return end
				if type(result) == "table" and result.success then
					notify(ctx, "success", "Berechtigungen", tostring(result.message or "Aktion erfolgreich ausgeführt."))
					loadData()
				else
					notify(ctx, "error", "Berechtigungen", type(result) == "table" and tostring(result.message or "Aktion fehlgeschlagen.") or "Aktion fehlgeschlagen.")
				end
			end)
		end

		local function makeActionButton(text: string, permission: string, variant: string, builder: () -> string?)
			local button = Components.Button(text, variant)
			button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
			button.Parent = scroll
			local allowed = has(ctx, permission)
			button.Active = allowed
			button.AutoButtonColor = allowed
			button.TextTransparency = allowed and 0 or 0.45
			button.BackgroundTransparency = allowed and 0 or 0.35
			if allowed then
				button.Activated:Connect(function()
					local cmd = builder()
					if not cmd or cmd == "" then
						notify(ctx, "warning", "Berechtigungen", "Bitte gültige Eingaben machen.")
						return
					end
					runCommandText(cmd)
				end)
			end
		end

		local function numericUserId(): number?
			local n = tonumber(userIdInput.Text)
			if not n or n < 1 or n % 1 ~= 0 then
				return nil
			end
			return n
		end

		makeActionButton("Rang setzen (setrank)", "Admin.ManageRanks", "primary", function()
			local uid = numericUserId()
			local rankName = string.gsub(rankInput.Text, "^%s+", "")
			rankName = string.gsub(rankName, "%s+$", "")
			if not uid or rankName == "" then
				return nil
			end
			return string.format("setrank %d %s", uid, escapeArg(ctx, rankName))
		end)

		makeActionButton("Rang entfernen (removerank)", "Admin.ManageRanks", "secondary", function()
			local uid = numericUserId()
			if not uid then return nil end
			return string.format("removerank %d", uid)
		end)

		makeActionButton("Permission gewähren (grantpermission)", "Admin.ManagePermissions", "secondary", function()
			local uid = numericUserId()
			local perm = string.gsub(permInput.Text, "^%s+", "")
			perm = string.gsub(perm, "%s+$", "")
			if not uid or perm == "" then return nil end
			return string.format("grantpermission %d %s", uid, escapeArg(ctx, perm))
		end)

		makeActionButton("Permission entziehen (revokepermission)", "Admin.ManagePermissions", "danger", function()
			local uid = numericUserId()
			local perm = string.gsub(permInput.Text, "^%s+", "")
			perm = string.gsub(perm, "%s+$", "")
			if not uid or perm == "" then return nil end
			return string.format("revokepermission %d %s", uid, escapeArg(ctx, perm))
		end)

		local hint = Components.Label("Änderungen werden serverseitig über Commands ausgeführt und geprüft.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
		hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
		hint.TextWrapped = true
		hint.Parent = scroll
	end

	loadData = function()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		setStatus(ctx, "Berechtigungen werden geladen …")
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetRoles")
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
				local message = tostring(data or "Berechtigungen konnten nicht geladen werden.")
				notify(ctx, "error", "Berechtigungen", message)
				leftBody:ClearAllChildren()
				Components.ErrorState(message, loadData).Parent = leftBody
				rightBody:ClearAllChildren()
				Components.EmptyState("Keine Daten.").Parent = rightBody
				return
			end
			table.clear(roles)
			for _, role in ipairs(toArray(data)) do
				if type(role) == "table" then
					table.insert(roles, role)
				end
			end
			table.clear(assignments)
			local as = data.assignments or data.Assignments
			if type(as) == "table" then
				for _, entry in ipairs(as) do
					if type(entry) == "table" then
						table.insert(assignments, entry)
					end
				end
			end
			renderMatrix()
			renderAssignmentsAndActions()
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("%d Rollen geladen.", #roles))
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(loadData)

	local api = {}
	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		loadData()
	end
	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end
	return api
end

return Page
```

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end

			return ctx:Has(permission)
		end)

end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Escape(value)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "string" then
			return result

	text = string.gsub(text, "\\", "\\\\")

end

local function buildCommand(ctx: any, name: string, userId: number, reason: string?): string
	if type(ctx.BuildCommand) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:BuildCommand(name, userId, reason)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "string" and result ~= "" then
			return result
		end
	end
	local text = string.format("%s %d", name, userId)
	if type(reason) == "string" and reason ~= "" then
		text ..= " " .. escapeArg(ctx, reason)
	end
	return text
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local t = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d.%02d.%04d %02d:%02d", t.day or 0, t.month or 0, t.year or 0, t.hour or 0, t.min or 0)
end

local function safeNumber(value: any, default: number): number
	local n = tonumber(value)
	if n == nil then
		return default
	end
	return n
end

local function asString(value: any, fallback: string?): string
	if value == nil then
		return fallback or "-"
	end
	local text = tostring(value)
	if text == "" then
		return fallback or "-"
	end
	return text
end

	local function runAction(commandName: string, permission: string, promptTitle: string, promptText: string, reasonRequired: boolean, extraBuilder: ((number, string) -> string?)?)
		if not selectedUserId then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Spieler", "Bitte zuerst einen Spieler auswählen.")
			return
		end
		if not has(ctx, permission) then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Berechtigung", "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung für diese Aktion.")
			return
		end
		local targetId = selectedUserId
		Components.Dialog(root, promptTitle, promptText, function(reason)
			local text
			if extraBuilder then
				text = extraBuilder(targetId, reason)
			else
				text = buildCommand(ctx, commandName, targetId, reason)
			end
			if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then
				notify(ctx, "error", "Aktion", "Der Command konnte nicht erstellt werden.")
				return
			end
			setStatus(ctx, "Aktion wird ausgeführt …")
			task.spawn(function()
				local result = callCommand(ctx, text)
				if destroyed then
					return
				end
				if type(result) == "table" and result.success == true then
					notify(ctx, "success", "Aktion", tostring(result.message or "Aktion erfolgreich ausgeführt."))
					setStatus(ctx, "Aktion erfolgreich ausgeführt.")
				else
					local message = type(result) == "table" and tostring(result.message or "Aktion fehlgeschlagen.") or "Aktion fehlgeschlagen."
					notify(ctx, "error", "Aktion", message)
					setStatus(ctx, "Aktion fehlgeschlagen.")
				end
			end)
		end, { reasonRequired = reasonRequired, danger = commandName ~= "teleport" and commandName ~= "freeze" and commandName ~= "unfreeze" })
	end

	local function runTeleportAction(mode: string)
		if not selectedUserId then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Teleport", "Bitte zuerst einen Spieler auswählen.")
			return
		end
		if not has(ctx, "Player.Teleport") then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Berechtigung", "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung Player.Teleport.")
			return
		end
		local targetId = selectedUserId
		if mode == "bring" then
			local text = string.format("bring %d", targetId)
			task.spawn(function()
				local result = callCommand(ctx, text)
				if destroyed then return end
				if type(result) == "table" and result.success then
					notify(ctx, "success", "Teleport", tostring(result.message or "Spieler wurde teleportiert."))
				else
					notify(ctx, "error", "Teleport", type(result) == "table" and tostring(result.message or "Teleport fehlgeschlagen.") or "Teleport fehlgeschlagen.")
				end
			end)
			return
		end
		if mode == "to" then
			local text = string.format("to %d", targetId)
			task.spawn(function()
				local result = callCommand(ctx, text)
				if destroyed then return end
				if type(result) == "table" and result.success then
					notify(ctx, "success", "Teleport", tostring(result.message or "Du wurdest teleportiert."))
				else
					notify(ctx, "error", "Teleport", type(result) == "table" and tostring(result.message or "Teleport fehlgeschlagen.") or "Teleport fehlgeschlagen.")
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	end

	local function loadProfile(userId: number)
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		detailLoading = true
		detailToken += 1
		local token = detailToken
		rightBody:ClearAllChildren()
		Components.Spinner("Profil wird geladen …").Parent = rightBody
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetPlayerProfile", { userId = userId })
			if destroyed or token ~= detailToken then

			end
			detailLoading = false
			rightBody:ClearAllChildren()
			if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then

				local err = Components.ErrorState(message, function()
					loadProfile(userId)

			end

			local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
			scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1

			scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
			scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 5
			scroll.Parent = rightBody
			local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
			layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
			layout.Parent = scroll

			local session = type(data.session) == "table" and data.session or selectedPlayer or {}
			local profileName = asString(session.name or session.Name or (selectedPlayer and selectedPlayer.name), "Unbekannt")
			local profileUserId = tonumber(session.userId or session.UserId or userId) or userId
			local rank = asString(session.rank or session.Rank or (selectedPlayer and selectedPlayer.rank), "Player")
			local risk = tonumber(data.riskScore or data.RiskScore or (selectedPlayer and selectedPlayer.risk) or 0) or 0

			header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
			header.Parent = scroll

			local meta = Components.Label(string.format("Rang: %s · Risiko: %d", rank, risk), Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
			meta.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
			meta.Parent = scroll

			local function infoLine(label: string, value: string)
				local line = Components.Label(label .. ": " .. value, Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Text)
				line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
				line.TextWrapped = true
				line.Parent = scroll
			end

			infoLine("Accountalter", tostring(session.accountAge or session.AccountAge or "-") .. " Tage")
			infoLine("Ping", session.ping and string.format("%d ms", math.floor(tonumber(session.ping) or 0)) or "-")
			infoLine("Stummgeschaltet", session.muted == true and "Ja" or "Nein")
			infoLine("Eingefroren", session.frozen == true and "Ja" or "Nein")

			local warnings = type(data.warnings) == "table" and data.warnings or {}
			local bans = type(data.bans) == "table" and data.bans or {}
			local history = type(data.history) == "table" and data.history or {}
			local detections = type(data.detections) == "table" and data.detections or {}

			infoLine("Warnungen", tostring(#warnings))
			infoLine("Bans/Einträge", tostring(#bans))
			infoLine("History", tostring(#history))
			infoLine("Erkennungen", tostring(#detections))

			local actionsTitle = Components.Label("Aktionen", Theme.TextSize.Subheading, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
			actionsTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
			actionsTitle.Parent = scroll

			local actionGrid = Components.Frame("Actions", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Color3.new())
			actionGrid.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			actionGrid.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			actionGrid.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
			actionGrid.Parent = scroll
			local gridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
			gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 0, 32)
			gridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
			gridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
			gridLayout.Parent = actionGrid

			local function addAction(text: string, permission: string, variant: string, callback: () -> ())
				local button = Components.Button(text, variant)
				button.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 0, 32)
				button.Parent = actionGrid
				local allowed = has(ctx, permission)
				button.Active = allowed
				button.AutoButtonColor = allowed
				button.TextTransparency = allowed and 0 or 0.45
				button.BackgroundTransparency = allowed and 0 or 0.35
				if allowed then

				end
			end

			addAction("Kick", "Player.Kick", "secondary", function()
				runAction("kick", "Player.Kick", "Spieler kicken", "Grund für den Kick eingeben …", true)

					local dur = duration or "10m"

				if not selectedUserId then return end

	local function applySelectedAfterRefresh()
		if not selectedUserId then
			renderDetailEmpty("Wähle einen Spieler aus, um Details zu sehen.")
			return
		end
		for _, item in ipairs(playersList) do
			if tonumber(item.userId) == selectedUserId then
				selectedPlayer = item
				loadProfile(selectedUserId)
				return
			end
		end
		selectedPlayer = nil
		renderDetailEmpty("Der ausgewählte Spieler ist nicht mehr online.")
	end

	-- Hook table selection to load profile
	local originalOnSelect = nil
	-- Recreate table with proper onSelect
	tableRoot:Destroy()
	tableRoot, renderTable, tableController = Components.Table(columns, {}, function(item)
		if type(item) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		selectedPlayer = item
		selectedUserId = tonumber(item.userId)
		if selectedUserId then
			loadProfile(selectedUserId)
		end
	end, { filter = true, pageSize = 100, emptyText = "Keine Spieler gefunden." })
	tableRoot.Parent = leftBody

	renderPlayers = function()
		renderTable(playersList)
	end

	local function loadPlayers()
		if destroyed or loading then
			return
		end
		loading = true
		setStatus(ctx, "Spielerliste wird geladen …")
		leftBody.Visible = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetPlayers")
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			loading = false
			if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
				local message = tostring(data or "Spielerliste konnte nicht geladen werden.")
				notify(ctx, "error", "Spieler", message)
				setStatus(ctx, "Spielerliste konnte nicht geladen werden.")
				leftBody:ClearAllChildren()
				local err = Components.ErrorState(message, function()
					loadPlayers()
				end)
				err.Parent = leftBody
				return
			end

			local list = data
			if type(data.players) == "table" then
				list = data.players
			elseif type(data.list) == "table" then
				list = data.list
			end
			table.clear(playersList)
			if type(list) == "table" then
				for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
					if type(entry) == "table" then
						local session = type(entry.session) == "table" and entry.session or entry
						local userId = tonumber(entry.userId or session.userId or session.UserId)
						local name = asString(entry.name or session.name or session.Name or entry.displayName, "Unbekannt")
						local rank = asString(entry.rank or session.rank or session.Rank, "Player")
						local risk = safeNumber(entry.riskScore or entry.risk or session.riskScore, 0)
						local ping = tonumber(entry.ping or session.ping)
						if userId then
							table.insert(playersList, {
								userId = userId,
								name = name,
								rank = rank,
								risk = math.floor(risk),
								ping = ping,
								raw = entry,
							})
						end
					end
				end
			end
			table.sort(playersList, function(a, b)
				return string.lower(tostring(a.name)) < string.lower(tostring(b.name))
			end)
			renderTable(playersList)
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("%d Spieler geladen.", #playersList))
			applySelectedAfterRefresh()
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(loadPlayers)

	renderDetailEmpty("Wähle einen Spieler aus, um Details zu sehen.")

	local refreshRunning = true
	maid:Give(function()
		refreshRunning = false
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while refreshRunning and not destroyed do
			task.wait(REFRESH_SECONDS)
			if refreshRunning and not destroyed and visible then
				loadPlayers()
			end
		end
	end)

	local api = {}
	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		if #playersList == 0 then
			loadPlayers()
		end
	end
	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		refreshRunning = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end
	return api
end

return Page
```

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Einstellungen: Framework-/Backend-Status und erlaubte Konfigurationsänderungen.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)

local Page = {}

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		return family ~= nil and perms[family .. ".*"] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

-- Erstes Argument, das nicht nil ist. Ersetzt "a ~= nil and a or b", das bei a == false fälschlich b liefert.
local function firstNonNil(a: any, b: any): any
	if a ~= nil then
		return a
	end
	return b
end

local function boolText(value: any): string
	if value == true then
		return "Ja"
	end
	if value == false then
		return "Nein"
	end
	return "-"
end

local function stringValue(value: any, fallback: string): string
	if value == nil then
		return fallback
	end
	local text = tostring(value)
	if text == "" then
		return fallback
	end
	return text
end

	local function renderSettings(data: any)
		clearSection(statusBody)
		clearSection(configBody)

		local version = stringValue(data.version or data.Version or ctx.Version, Constants.Version)
		addInfoLine(statusBody, "Framework-Version", version)

		-- Server (AdminRequests:_getSettings) liefert { framework = { status = { [Service] = "Ok" | "Failed" | "Disabled" } } }
		local frameworkStatus = (type(data.framework) == "table" and data.framework.status)
			or data.frameworkStatus or data.FrameworkStatus or data.status
		if type(frameworkStatus) == "table" then
			local okCount, failCount, disabledCount = 0, 0, 0
			for _, state in pairs(frameworkStatus) do
				if state == "Ok" then
					okCount += 1
				elseif state == "Failed" then
					failCount += 1
				elseif state == "Disabled" then
					disabledCount += 1
				end
			end
			addInfoLine(statusBody, "Services OK", tostring(okCount))
			addInfoLine(statusBody, "Services fehlgeschlagen", tostring(failCount))
			addInfoLine(statusBody, "Services deaktiviert", tostring(disabledCount))
		else
			addInfoLine(statusBody, "Framework-Status", stringValue(frameworkStatus, "Unbekannt"))
		end

		local antiCheat = data.antiCheat or data.AntiCheat or {}
		if type(antiCheat) ~= "table" then
			antiCheat = {}
		end
		addInfoLine(statusBody, "Anti-Cheat aktiviert", boolText(firstNonNil(antiCheat.enabled, antiCheat.Enabled)))
		addInfoLine(statusBody, "Anti-Cheat-Modus", stringValue(antiCheat.mode or antiCheat.Mode or antiCheat.detectionMode or antiCheat.DetectionMode, "-"))
		addInfoLine(statusBody, "Automatische Aktionen", boolText(firstNonNil(antiCheat.automaticActions, antiCheat.AutomaticActions)))

		local backend = data.backend or data.Backend or {}
		if type(backend) ~= "table" then
			backend = {}
		end
		addInfoLine(statusBody, "Backend verbunden", boolText(firstNonNil(backend.connected, backend.Connected)))
		addInfoLine(statusBody, "Letzter Erfolg", stringValue(backend.lastSuccess or backend.LastSuccess, "-"))
		addInfoLine(statusBody, "Letzter Fehler", stringValue(backend.lastError or backend.LastError, "-"))
		addInfoLine(statusBody, "Latenz", backend.latencyMs and (tostring(backend.latencyMs) .. " ms") or (backend.LatencyMs and (tostring(backend.LatencyMs) .. " ms") or "-"))
		addInfoLine(statusBody, "Circuit offen", boolText(firstNonNil(backend.circuitOpen, backend.CircuitOpen)))

		-- Config controls
		local acEnabled = antiCheat.enabled
		if acEnabled == nil then acEnabled = antiCheat.Enabled end
		local acEnabledBool = acEnabled == true
		local acMode = stringValue(antiCheat.mode or antiCheat.Mode or antiCheat.detectionMode or antiCheat.DetectionMode, "Monitor")
		local acAuto = antiCheat.automaticActions
		if acAuto == nil then acAuto = antiCheat.AutomaticActions end
		local acAutoBool = acAuto == true

		local enabledRow, setEnabled = Components.Toggle("Anti-Cheat aktiviert", acEnabledBool, function(value)
			updateSetting("AntiCheat.Enabled", value)
		end)
		enabledRow.Parent = configBody
		local enabledAllowed = canUpdatePath("AntiCheat.Enabled")
		enabledRow.BackgroundTransparency = enabledAllowed and 0 or 0.3

		local modeLabel = Components.Label("Anti-Cheat-Modus", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
		modeLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
		modeLabel.Parent = configBody
		local modeSelect = Components.Select({ "Monitor", "Enforce" }, acMode, function(value)
			updateSetting("AntiCheat.DetectionMode", value)
		end)
		modeSelect.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
		modeSelect.Parent = configBody
		local modeAllowed = canUpdatePath("AntiCheat.DetectionMode")
		modeSelect.Active = modeAllowed
		modeSelect.AutoButtonColor = modeAllowed
		modeSelect.TextTransparency = modeAllowed and 0 or 0.45

		local autoRow, setAuto = Components.Toggle("Automatische Aktionen", acAutoBool, function(value)
			updateSetting("AntiCheat.AutomaticActions", value)
		end)
		autoRow.Parent = configBody
		local autoAllowed = canUpdatePath("AntiCheat.AutomaticActions")
		autoRow.BackgroundTransparency = autoAllowed and 0 or 0.3

		local info = Components.Label("Nur whitelisted Einstellungen werden serverseitig akzeptiert. Berechtigungen werden serverseitig geprüft.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
		info.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
		info.TextWrapped = true
		info.Parent = configBody
	end

	loadSettings = function()
		if destroyed or loading then
			return
		end
		loading = true
		setStatus(ctx, "Einstellungen werden geladen …")
		clearSection(statusBody)
		clearSection(configBody)
		Components.Spinner("Einstellungen werden geladen …").Parent = statusBody
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetSettings")
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			loading = false
			if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
				local message = tostring(data or "Einstellungen konnten nicht geladen werden.")
				clearSection(statusBody)
				Components.ErrorState(message, loadSettings).Parent = statusBody
				clearSection(configBody)
				Components.EmptyState("Keine Konfiguration verfügbar.").Parent = configBody
				notify(ctx, "error", "Einstellungen", message)
				return
			end
			renderSettings(data)
			setStatus(ctx, "Einstellungen geladen.")
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(loadSettings)

	local api = {}
	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		loadSettings()
	end
	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end
	return api
end

return Page
```

`scripts/ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft/Client/ChatControl.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Schaltet die Chat-Oberfläche des lokalen Spielers ab, solange er gemutet ist, und stellt danach
-- exakt den vorherigen Zustand wieder her. Hatte das Spiel den Chat selbst deaktiviert, bleibt er aus.
-- Rein kosmetisch: Die Zustellung von Nachrichten blockiert der Server (MuteService), ein
-- manipulierter Client gewinnt durch erneutes Einschalten nichts.
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local ChatControl = {}
ChatControl.__index = ChatControl

local CORE_GUI_RETRIES = 10 -- SetCoreGuiEnabled schlägt fehl, solange die CoreScripts noch laden
local CORE_GUI_RETRY_DELAY = 0.5

local function isLegacyChat(): boolean
	local ok, version = pcall(function()
		return TextChatService.ChatVersion
	end)
	return ok and version == Enum.ChatVersion.LegacyChatService
end

local function setCoreChat(enabled: boolean)
	for _ = 1, CORE_GUI_RETRIES do
		if pcall(StarterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, StarterGui, Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, enabled) then
			return
		end
		task.wait(CORE_GUI_RETRY_DELAY)
	end
end

function ChatControl.new()
	return setmetatable({ _muted = false, _saved = nil }, ChatControl)
end

function ChatControl:SetMuted(muted: boolean)
	if muted == self._muted then
		return
	end
	self._muted = muted

	if muted then
		if isLegacyChat() then
			self._saved = { core = StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat) }
			task.spawn(setCoreChat, false)
		else
			self._saved = {
				window = TextChatService.ChatWindowConfiguration.Enabled,
				input = TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.Enabled,
			}
			TextChatService.ChatWindowConfiguration.Enabled = false
			TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.Enabled = false
		end
		return
	end

	local saved = self._saved
	self._saved = nil
	if not saved then
		return
	end
	if saved.core ~= nil then
		task.spawn(setCoreChat, saved.core)
	else
		TextChatService.ChatWindowConfiguration.Enabled = saved.window
		TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.Enabled = saved.input
	end
end

function ChatControl:IsMuted(): boolean
	return self._muted
end

function ChatControl:Destroy()
	self:SetMuted(false)
end

return ChatControl
```

`scripts/ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft/Client/CommandClient.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Clientseitiger Wrapper um die Headcraft-Remotes. Alle Eingaben werden begrenzt,
-- bevor sie den Server erreichen; der Server bleibt trotzdem autoritativ.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Signal = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Signal)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Util)
local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)

local CommandClient = {}
CommandClient.__index = CommandClient

local MAX_STRING = 500
local MAX_ENTRIES = 50
local MAX_DEPTH = 3
local DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 8
local MAX_PUSH_LISTENERS = 32
local REPORT_KINDS = {
	UiError = true,
	InputAnomaly = true,
	DetectionSeen = true,
}

local function finiteNumber(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
end

-- Kopiert nur wertebasierte, flache genug Strukturen. Zyklen werden abgewiesen.
local function sanitize(value: any, depth: number, seen: { [any]: boolean }): (boolean, any?, string?)
	if depth > MAX_DEPTH then
		return false, nil, "Daten sind zu tief verschachtelt."
	end
	if type(value) == "string" then
		if #value > MAX_STRING then
			return false, nil, "String ist zu lang."
		end
		return true, value
	elseif type(value) == "number" then
		if not finiteNumber(value) then
			return false, nil, "Ungültige Zahl."
		end
		return true, value
	elseif type(value) == "boolean" then
		return true, value
	elseif type(value) == "table" then
		if seen[value] then
			return false, nil, "Zyklische Daten sind nicht erlaubt."
		end
		seen[value] = true
		local count = 0
		local out = {}
		for key, child in pairs(value) do
			if type(key) ~= "string" and type(key) ~= "number" then
				seen[value] = nil
				return false, nil, "Ungültiger Tabellenschlüssel."
			end
			if finiteNumber(key) and (key < -1e12 or key > 1e12) then
				seen[value] = nil
				return false, nil, "Ungültiger Tabellenschlüssel."
			end
			count += 1
			if count > MAX_ENTRIES then
				seen[value] = nil
				return false, nil, "Tabelle ist zu groß."
			end
			local ok, cleaned, err = sanitize(child, depth + 1, seen)
			if not ok then
				seen[value] = nil
				return false, nil, err
			end
			out[key] = cleaned
		end
		seen[value] = nil
		return true, out
	end
	return false, nil, "Ungültiger Datentyp."
end

local function copyBounded(value: any, maxEntries: number, maxString: number, maxDepth: number): any?
	if type(value) ~= "table" or maxDepth <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local out = {}
	local count = 0
	for key, child in pairs(value) do
		if type(key) ~= "string" and type(key) ~= "number" then
			return nil
		end
		count += 1
		if count > maxEntries then
			return nil
		end
		if type(child) == "string" then
			if #child > maxString then
				return nil
			end
			out[key] = child
		elseif type(child) == "number" or type(child) == "boolean" then
			if not finiteNumber(child) and type(child) == "number" then
				return nil
			end
			out[key] = child
		elseif type(child) == "table" then
			local nested = copyBounded(child, maxEntries, maxString, maxDepth - 1)
			if nested == nil then
				return nil
			end
			out[key] = nested
		else
			return nil
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- RemoteFunctions können ohne Antwort hängen bleiben; der Aufruf wird daher
-- mit einem festen Zeitfenster abgesichert und nie mehrfach zurückgegeben.
local function invoke(remote: RemoteFunction, timeout: number, ...): (boolean, any?)
	local arguments = table.pack(...)
	local done = Signal.new()
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return remote:InvokeServer(table.unpack(arguments, 1, arguments.n))
		end)
		done:Fire(ok, result)
	end)
	local timer = task.delay(timeout, function()
		done:Fire(false, "Zeitüberschreitung beim Serveraufruf.")
	end)
	local ok, result = done:Wait()
	task.cancel(timer)
	done:DisconnectAll()
	return ok, result
end

function CommandClient.WaitForRemotes(timeout: number?, attempts: number?): Folder?
	local waitTime = timeout or 4
	local tries = math.clamp(attempts or 3, 1, 8)
	for _ = 1, tries do
		local headcraft = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Headcraft")
		if headcraft then
			local existingRemotes = headcraft:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
			if existingRemotes and existingRemotes:IsA("Folder")
				and existingRemotes:FindFirstChild(Constants.RemoteNames.Request)
				and existingRemotes:FindFirstChild(Constants.RemoteNames.Push) then
				return existingRemotes
			end
		end
		local ok, folder = pcall(function()
			local headcraftFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Headcraft", waitTime)
			return headcraftFolder:WaitForChild("Remotes", waitTime)
		end)
		if ok and folder and folder:IsA("Folder") then
			return folder
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function CommandClient.new(remotes: Folder): CommandClient?
	if not remotes or not remotes:IsA("Folder") then
		return nil
	end

	local names = Constants.RemoteNames
	local found = {}
	for _, name in pairs(names) do
		local remote = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
		if not remote then
			local ok, waited = pcall(function()
				return remotes:WaitForChild(name, 3)
			end)
			remote = ok and waited or nil
		end
		if not remote then
			return nil
		end
		found[name] = remote
	end

	local self = setmetatable({
		_remotes = remotes,
		_request = found[names.Request],
		_command = found[names.Command],
		_autocomplete = found[names.Autocomplete],
		_push = found[names.Push],
		_clientReport = found[names.ClientReport],
		_channels = {},
		_listenerCounts = {},
		_lastReport = -1e9,
	}, CommandClient)

	self._pushConnection = self._push.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(channel: any, payload: any)
		if type(channel) ~= "string" or #channel == 0 or #channel > 64 then
			return
		end
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local signal = self._channels[channel]
		if signal then
			signal:Fire(payload)
		end
	end)

	return self
end

function CommandClient:Request(action: string, args: table?, timeout: number?): (boolean, any?)
	if type(action) ~= "string" or #action == 0 or #action > 64 then
		return false, "Ungültige Request-Aktion."
	end
	local payload = {}
	if args ~= nil then
		local ok, cleaned, err = sanitize(args, 1, {})
		if not ok then
			return false, err or "Ungültige Request-Argumente."
		end
		payload = cleaned :: table
	end

	local ok, response = invoke(self._request, timeout or DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, action, payload)
	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(response)
	end
	if type(response) ~= "table" or type(response.ok) ~= "boolean" then
		return false, "Ungültige Antwort vom Server."
	end
	if response.ok then
		return true, response.data
	end
	return false, tostring(response.error or "Der Server hat die Anfrage abgelehnt.")
end

function CommandClient:Command(text: string): any
	if type(text) ~= "string" or #text == 0 or #text > MAX_STRING then
		return { success = false, message = "Ungültiger Command-Text." }
	end
	local ok, response = invoke(self._command, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, text)
	if not ok then
		return { success = false, message = tostring(response) }
	end
	if type(response) ~= "table" or type(response.success) ~= "boolean" then
		return { success = false, message = "Ungültige Command-Antwort vom Server." }
	end
	return {
		success = response.success,
		message = tostring(response.message or ""),
		data = response.data,
	}
end

function CommandClient:Autocomplete(text: string): { suggestions: { any } }
	if type(text) ~= "string" or #text > MAX_STRING then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	local ok, response = invoke(self._autocomplete, 4, text)
	if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" or type(response.suggestions) ~= "table" then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	local suggestions = {}
	for _, entry in pairs(response.suggestions) do
		if #suggestions >= MAX_ENTRIES then
			break
		end
		if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.text) == "string" and #entry.text <= MAX_STRING then
			table.insert(suggestions, {
				text = entry.text,
				display = type(entry.display) == "string" and Util.truncate(entry.display, MAX_STRING) or entry.text,
				description = type(entry.description) == "string" and Util.truncate(entry.description, MAX_STRING) or nil,
			})
		end
	end
	return { suggestions = suggestions }
end

function CommandClient:OnPush(channel: string, fn: (payload: table) -> ()): any
	if type(channel) ~= "string" or #channel == 0 or #channel > 64 or type(fn) ~= "function" then
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end
	if (self._listenerCounts[channel] or 0) >= MAX_PUSH_LISTENERS then
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end
	local signal = self._channels[channel]
	if not signal then
		signal = Signal.new()
		self._channels[channel] = signal
	end
	self._listenerCounts[channel] = (self._listenerCounts[channel] or 0) + 1
	local connection = signal:Connect(function(payload: table)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn, payload)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Headcraft] Push-Listener fehlgeschlagen:", tostring(err))
		end
	end)
	local count = self._listenerCounts[channel]
	return {
		Disconnect = function()
			if count ~= self._listenerCounts[channel] then
				return
			end
			connection:Disconnect()
			self._listenerCounts[channel] = math.max(0, (self._listenerCounts[channel] or 1) - 1)
		end,
	}
end

-- Nur Indizien, nie automatische Sanktionen. Maximal ein Report pro 30 Sekunden.
function CommandClient:Report(kind: string, data: table?): boolean
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or not REPORT_KINDS[kind] then
		return false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - self._lastReport < 30 then
		return false
	end
	local payload = data and copyBounded(data, 8, 120, 2) or {}
	if payload == nil then
		return false
	end
	self._lastReport = now
	pcall(function()
		self._clientReport:FireServer(kind, payload)
	end)
	return true
end

function CommandClient:Destroy()
	if self._pushConnection then
		self._pushConnection:Disconnect()
		self._pushConnection = nil
	end
	for _, signal in pairs(self._channels) do
		signal:DisconnectAll()
	end
	table.clear(self._channels)
	table.clear(self._listenerCounts)
end

return CommandClient
```

`scripts/ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft/Client/Console.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Headcraft-Konsole: Befehlszeile am oberen Bildschirmrand (Standard: F3).
-- • Vorschläge vom Server (Commands, Spieler, Ränge, Permissions, …) während der Eingabe
-- • Pfeil hoch/runter wählt einen Vorschlag, ohne Vorschläge blättert es durch die eigene History
-- • Tab übernimmt den markierten Vorschlag, Enter führt aus, Escape oder erneut F3 schließt
-- • Darunter: Signatur des aktuellen Commands mit hervorgehobenem Argument
-- Die Konsole ist reine Bedienoberfläche: Rechte, Parsing und Ausführung prüft ausschließlich der Server.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Theme = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Client.Interface.Theme)
local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local Console = {}
Console.__index = Console

local MAX_WIDTH = 760
local ROW_HEIGHT = 26
local MAX_VISIBLE_SUGGESTIONS = 8
local MAX_OUTPUT_LINES = 60
local OUTPUT_HEIGHT = 168
local MAX_HISTORY = 50
local AUTOCOMPLETE_DEBOUNCE = 0.12 -- hält die Anfragen unter dem Server-Limit (20 pro 5 s)
local MONO = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.RobotoMono)

local function richEscape(text: string): string
	return (string.gsub(text, "[<>&\"']", {
		["<"] = "&lt;", [">"] = "&gt;", ["&"] = "&amp;", ['"'] = "&quot;", ["'"] = "&apos;",
	}))
end

local function colorHex(color: Color3): string
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(color.R * 255), math.floor(color.G * 255), math.floor(color.B * 255))
end

-- Zerlegt die Eingabe wie der Server-Parser grob in Tokens (Anführungszeichen halten Leerzeichen zusammen).
local function tokenize(text: string): ({ string }, boolean)
	local tokens = {}
	local current, inQuote = "", false
	for _, char in utf8.codes(text) do
		local c = utf8.char(char)
		if c == '"' then
			inQuote = not inQuote
		elseif string.match(c, "%s") and not inQuote then
			if current ~= "" then
				table.insert(tokens, current)
				current = ""
			end
		else
			current ..= c
		end
	end
	if current ~= "" then
		table.insert(tokens, current)
	end
	local endsWithSpace = string.match(text, "%s$") ~= nil and not inQuote
	return tokens, endsWithSpace
end

local function label(props)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.FontFace = props.Font or Theme.Font
	l.TextSize = props.TextSize or Theme.TextSize.Body
	l.TextColor3 = props.Color or Theme.Colors.Text
	l.TextXAlignment = props.AlignX or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	l.RichText = props.Rich == true
	l.Text = props.Text or ""
	l.Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	l.Position = props.Position or UDim2.new()
	l.Name = props.Name or "Label"
	return l
end

function Console.new(client, options)
	options = options or {}
	local self = setmetatable({}, Console)
	self._client = client
	self._prefix = options.prefix or ";"
	self._toggleKey = Enum.KeyCode[options.toggleKey or "F3"] or Enum.KeyCode.F3
	self._maid = Maid.new()
	self._open = false
	self._suggestions = {}
	self._selected = 1
	self._history = {}
	self._historyIndex = 0
	self._requestId = 0
	self._commands = nil -- Name/Alias → Summary aus GetCommands (für die Signatur-Zeile)
	self._ignoreTextChange = false
	self:_build()
	self:_connect()
	return self
end

function Console:_build()
	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "HeadcraftConsole"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.DisplayOrder = 1000
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	gui.Enabled = false
	self._gui = gui
	self._maid:Give(gui)

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "Console"
	root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12)
	root.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 0)
	root.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	root.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.Surface
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 0.04
	root.Parent = gui
	Theme.corner(Theme.Radius.Medium).Parent = root
	Theme.stroke().Parent = root
	local constraint = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
	constraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(MAX_WIDTH, math.huge)
	constraint.Parent = root
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, Theme.Spacing.XS)
	layout.Parent = root
	Theme.padding(Theme.Spacing.S).Parent = root

	-- Ausgabe (letzte Ergebnisse)
	local output = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	output.Name = "Output"
	output.LayoutOrder = 1
	output.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	output.BorderSizePixel = 0
	output.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, OUTPUT_HEIGHT)
	output.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	output.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	output.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	output.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Colors.Border
	output.Visible = false
	output.Parent = root
	local outputLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	outputLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	outputLayout.Parent = output
	self._output = output
	self._outputCount = 0

	-- Eingabezeile
	local inputRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	inputRow.Name = "InputRow"
	inputRow.LayoutOrder = 2
	inputRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
	inputRow.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.Background
	inputRow.Parent = root
	Theme.corner(Theme.Radius.Small).Parent = inputRow
	self._inputStroke = Theme.stroke(Theme.Colors.Accent, 0.4)
	self._inputStroke.Parent = inputRow

	local promptLabel = label({ Text = "›", Font = MONO, TextSize = 18, Color = Theme.Colors.Accent,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 0), Name = "Prompt" })
	promptLabel.Parent = inputRow

	local input = Instance.new("TextBox")
	input.Name = "Input"
	input.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	input.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	input.FontFace = MONO
	input.TextSize = 15
	input.TextColor3 = Theme.Colors.Text
	input.PlaceholderText = "Command eingeben … (Tab ergänzt, ↑/↓ wählt, Enter führt aus)"
	input.PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.Colors.TextSecondary
	input.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	input.Text = ""
	input.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0)
	input.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 0)
	input.Parent = inputRow
	self._input = input

	-- Signatur des aktuellen Commands
	local hint = label({ Name = "Hint", Rich = true, Font = MONO, TextSize = Theme.TextSize.Small,
		Color = Theme.Colors.TextSecondary, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18) })
	hint.LayoutOrder = 3

	-- Vorschlagsliste

	list.Name = "Suggestions"

	list.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	list.Visible = false

	listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
	listLayout.Parent = list
	self._list = list
	self._rows = {}
	for index = 1, MAX_VISIBLE_SUGGESTIONS do
		local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
		row.Name = "Suggestion" .. index
		row.LayoutOrder = index
		row.AutoButtonColor = false
		row.Text = ""
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROW_HEIGHT)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised
		row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		row.Visible = false
		row.Parent = list
		Theme.corner(Theme.Radius.Small).Parent = row

			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0) })
		name.Parent = row
		local description = label({ Name = "Description", TextSize = Theme.TextSize.Small,
			Color = Theme.Colors.TextSecondary, Size = UDim2.new(0.55, -10, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.45, 0, 0, 0) })
		description.Parent = row
		self._maid:Give(row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			self:_select(index)
		end))
		self._maid:Give(row.Activated:Connect(function()
			self:_select(index)
			self:_accept()
			input:CaptureFocus()
		end))
		self._rows[index] = { button = row, display = name, description = description }
	end

	gui.Parent = playerGui
end

function Console:_connect()
	local input = self._input

	self._maid:Give(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(object: InputObject, processed: boolean)
		if object.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			return
		end
		local key = object.KeyCode
		if key == self._toggleKey then
			-- F-Tasten tippen nichts in TextBoxen, daher auch bei fokussierter Eingabe erlaubt;
			-- in fremden Textfeldern (Chat etc.) aber nicht öffnen.
			if not self._open and processed and UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil then
				return
			end
			self:Toggle()
			return
		end
		if not self._open or not input:IsFocused() then
			return
		end
		if key == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
			self:_accept()
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			self:_move(-1)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			self:_move(1)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			self:SetOpen(false)
		end
	end))

	self._maid:Give(input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		-- Tab fügt in TextBoxen ein Tabulatorzeichen ein: entfernen und als "Vorschlag übernehmen" werten.
		if string.find(input.Text, "\t", 1, true) then
			self._ignoreTextChange = true
			input.Text = string.gsub(input.Text, "\t", "")
			self._ignoreTextChange = false
			self:_accept()
			return
		end
		if self._ignoreTextChange then
			return
		end
		self._historyIndex = 0
		self:_updateHint()
		self:_requestSuggestions()
	end))

	self._maid:Give(input.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed: boolean)
		if not self._open then
			return
		end
		if enterPressed then
			self:_execute()
			task.defer(function()
				if self._open then
					input:CaptureFocus()
				end
			end)
		elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Escape) then
			-- Escape nimmt Roblox den Fokus, bevor InputBegan feuert – daher hier schließen.
			self:SetOpen(false)
		end
	end))
end

function Console:SetPrefix(prefix: string?)
	if type(prefix) == "string" and prefix ~= "" then
		self._prefix = prefix
	end
end

function Console:IsOpen(): boolean
	return self._open
end

function Console:Toggle()
	self:SetOpen(not self._open)
end

function Console:SetOpen(open: boolean)
	if open == self._open then
		return
	end
	self._open = open
	self._gui.Enabled = open
	if open then
		if self._commands == nil then
			task.spawn(function()
				self:_loadCommands()
			end)
		end
		-- Erst im nächsten Frame fokussieren, sonst landet das F3-Ereignis selbst noch im Textfeld.
		task.defer(function()
			if self._open then
				self._input:CaptureFocus()
				self._input.CursorPosition = #self._input.Text + 1
			end
		end)
	else
		self._input:ReleaseFocus()
		self:_setSuggestions({})
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
	end
end

function Console:_loadCommands()
	local ok, data = self._client:Request("GetCommands")
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local list = type(data.commands) == "table" and data.commands or data
	local map = {}
	for _, command in ipairs(list) do
		if type(command) == "table" and type(command.Name) == "string" then
			map[string.lower(command.Name)] = command
			for _, alias in ipairs(type(command.Aliases) == "table" and command.Aliases or {}) do
				if type(alias) == "string" then
					map[string.lower(alias)] = command
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self._commands = map
	self:_updateHint()
end

-- Text ohne optionalen Präfix, damit Vorschläge sowohl mit als auch ohne ";" funktionieren.
function Console:_stripPrefix(text: string): (string, string)
	local leading = string.match(text, "^%s*") or ""
	local rest = string.sub(text, #leading + 1)
	if string.sub(rest, 1, #self._prefix) == self._prefix then
		return self._prefix, string.sub(rest, #self._prefix + 1)
	end
	return "", rest
end

function Console:_updateHint()
	local _, body = self:_stripPrefix(self._input.Text)
	local tokens, endsWithSpace = tokenize(body)
	local command = tokens[1] and self._commands and self._commands[string.lower(tokens[1])]
	if not command then
		self._hint.Visible = false
		return
	end
	local current = #tokens - 1 + (endsWithSpace and 1 or 0) -- 0 = noch im Command-Namen
	local parts = { "<b>" .. richEscape(command.Name) .. "</b>" }
	local activeDescription = command.Description
	for index, arg in ipairs(type(command.Args) == "table" and command.Args or {}) do
		local text = string.format(arg.Required and "&lt;%s: %s&gt;" or "[%s: %s]", richEscape(tostring(arg.Name)), richEscape(tostring(arg.Type)))
		if index == current or (arg.Rest and current > index) then
			text = string.format('<font color="%s">%s</font>', colorHex(Theme.Colors.Accent), text)
			if type(arg.Description) == "string" and arg.Description ~= "" then
				activeDescription = arg.Description
			end
		end
		table.insert(parts, text)
	end
	local description = type(activeDescription) == "string" and activeDescription ~= ""
		and ("  —  " .. richEscape(activeDescription)) or ""
	self._hint.Text = table.concat(parts, " ") .. description
	self._hint.Visible = true
end

function Console:_requestSuggestions()
	self._requestId += 1
	local requestId = self._requestId
	local text = self._input.Text
	local _, body = self:_stripPrefix(text)
	if string.gsub(body, "%s", "") == "" then
		self:_setSuggestions({})
		return
	end
	task.delay(AUTOCOMPLETE_DEBOUNCE, function()
		if requestId ~= self._requestId or not self._open then
			return
		end
		local response = self._client:Autocomplete(text)
		-- Nur die Antwort auf die neueste Eingabe anzeigen
		if requestId ~= self._requestId or not self._open then
			return
		end
		self:_setSuggestions(type(response) == "table" and type(response.suggestions) == "table" and response.suggestions or {})
	end)
end

function Console:_setSuggestions(suggestions)
	local valid = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(suggestions) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.text) == "string" and #valid < MAX_VISIBLE_SUGGESTIONS then
			table.insert(valid, entry)
		end
	end
	self._suggestions = valid
	self._selected = 1
	for index, row in ipairs(self._rows) do
		local entry = valid[index]
		row.button.Visible = entry ~= nil
		if entry then
			row.display.Text = tostring(entry.display or entry.text)
			row.description.Text = type(entry.description) == "string" and entry.description or ""
		end
	end
	self._list.Visible = #valid > 0
	self:_paintSelection()
end

function Console:_paintSelection()
	for index, row in ipairs(self._rows) do
		local active = index == self._selected and row.button.Visible
		row.button.BackgroundTransparency = active and 0 or 1
		row.button.BackgroundColor3 = active and Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised or Theme.Colors.Surface
		row.display.TextColor3 = active and Theme.Colors.Accent or Theme.Colors.Text
	end
end

function Console:_select(index: number)
	if self._suggestions[index] then
		self._selected = index
		self:_paintSelection()
	end
end

-- Pfeiltasten: mit Vorschlägen durch die Liste, sonst durch die eigene Command-History.
function Console:_move(direction: number)
	local count = #self._suggestions
	if count > 0 then
		self._selected = ((self._selected - 1 + direction) % count) + 1
		self:_paintSelection()
		return
	end
	if #self._history == 0 then
		return
	end
	-- History: Index 0 = aktuelle Eingabe, 1 = letzter Command, …
	self._historyIndex = math.clamp(self._historyIndex - direction, 0, #self._history)
	local text = self._historyIndex == 0 and "" or self._history[#self._history - self._historyIndex + 1]
	self._ignoreTextChange = true
	self._input.Text = text
	self._input.CursorPosition = #text + 1
	self._ignoreTextChange = false
	self:_updateHint()
end

-- Übernimmt den markierten Vorschlag. Der Server liefert den kompletten Command bis einschließlich
-- des vorgeschlagenen Arguments; ein Leerzeichen dahinter, damit direkt das nächste Argument folgt.
function Console:_accept()
	-- Tab kommt je nach Plattform als InputBegan und/oder als "\t" im Text an – nur einmal übernehmen.
	local now = os.clock()
	if self._lastAccept and now - self._lastAccept < 0.15 then
		return
	end
	local entry = self._suggestions[self._selected]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	self._lastAccept = now
	local prefix = self:_stripPrefix(self._input.Text)
	local text = prefix .. entry.text .. " "
	self._input.Text = text -- löst die nächste Vorschlagsrunde aus (nächstes Argument)
	self._input.CursorPosition = #text + 1
end

function Console:_appendOutput(text: string, color: Color3)
	self._outputCount += 1
	local line = label({ Name = "Line", Font = MONO, TextSize = 13, Color = color, Text = text,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18) })
	line.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
	line.TextWrapped = true
	line.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	line.LayoutOrder = self._outputCount
	line.Parent = self._output
	local lines = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(self._output:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			table.insert(lines, child)
		end
	end
	if #lines > MAX_OUTPUT_LINES then
		table.sort(lines, function(a, b) return a.LayoutOrder < b.LayoutOrder end)
		for index = 1, #lines - MAX_OUTPUT_LINES do
			lines[index]:Destroy()
		end
	end
	self._output.Visible = true
	task.defer(function()
		self._output.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, self._output.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - self._output.AbsoluteSize.Y))
	end)
end

function Console:_execute()
	local text = string.gsub(self._input.Text, "^%s+", "")
	text = string.gsub(text, "%s+$", "")
	local _, body = self:_stripPrefix(text)
	if body == "" then
		return
	end
	if self._history[#self._history] ~= text then
		table.insert(self._history, text)
		if #self._history > MAX_HISTORY then
			table.remove(self._history, 1)
		end
	end
	self._historyIndex = 0
	self._ignoreTextChange = true
	self._input.Text = ""
	self._ignoreTextChange = false
	self:_setSuggestions({})
	self._hint.Visible = false

	self:_appendOutput("› " .. text, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
	local result = self._client:Command(body)
	local message = type(result) == "table" and tostring(result.message or "") or "Keine Antwort vom Server."
	local success = type(result) == "table" and result.success == true
	self:_appendOutput(message ~= "" and message or (success and "Ausgeführt." or "Fehlgeschlagen."),
		success and Theme.Colors.Success or Theme.Colors.Error)
end

function Console:Destroy()
	self._open = false
	self._maid:Clean()
end

return Console
```
