`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/Detections/Jump.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Jump
-- Infinite Jump: Hoehengewinn in der Luft ohne Bodenkontakt.
-- JumpPower/JumpHeight-Manipulation: beobachtete Sprunghoehe gegen erwartete Werte.

local Workspace = workspace

local Jump = {
	Name = "Jump",
	Category = "Jump",
}

local EXEMPT_STATES = {
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead] = true,
}

local function expectedJumpHeight(expected, gravity)
	if type(expected.JumpHeight) == "number" and expected.JumpHeight > 0 then
		return expected.JumpHeight
	end
	if type(expected.JumpPower) == "number" and expected.JumpPower > 0 and type(gravity) == "number" and gravity > 0 then
		return (expected.JumpPower * expected.JumpPower) / (2 * gravity)
	end
	return 7.2
end

function Jump:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Jump or {}
	local configSeverity = ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Jump
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or configSeverity or "Medium"
end

function Jump:OnCharacter(player, character)
end

function Jump:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	if cfg.Enabled == false then
		return
	end
	local player = state.Player
	local movement = ctx.MovementExceptions
	if movement and type(movement.IsExempt) == "function" and movement:IsExempt(player) then
		return
	end
	local character = state.Character
	local root = state.Root
	local humanoid = state.Humanoid
	if not character or not root or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end
	if humanoid.SeatPart then
		return
	end
	local hState = humanoid:GetState()
	if EXEMPT_STATES[hState] then
		return
	end

	local expected = state.ExpectedHumanoid or {}
	local gravity = Workspace.Gravity
	local expHeight = expectedJumpHeight(expected, gravity)
	local jumpTolerance = cfg.JumpHeightTolerance or 0.3
	local extraHeight = cfg.MaxExtraHeight or 1.5
	local landingLimit = expHeight * (1 + jumpTolerance) + 1
	local midAirLimit = expHeight * 2 + extraHeight

	local nowY = root.Position.Y
	local onGround = state.OnGround

	if onGround then
		if state._JumpWasInAir then
			-- Gerade gelandet: Ueberhoehte Sprunghoehe bei Rueckkehr auf Startniveau.
			local groundY = state._JumpGroundY or nowY
			local apex = state._JumpApexY or nowY
			local gained = apex - groundY
			if math.abs(nowY - groundY) <= 2.5 and gained > landingLimit then
				ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Jump", self._severity, 0.6, {
					Reason = "JumpPowerManipulation",
					GainedHeight = gained,
					Expected = expHeight,
				})
			end
		end
		state._JumpWasInAir = false
		state._JumpGroundY = nowY
		state._JumpApexY = nowY
	else
		if not state._JumpWasInAir then
			state._JumpWasInAir = true
			state._JumpGroundY = nowY
			state._JumpApexY = nowY
		end
		if nowY > (state._JumpApexY or nowY) then
			state._JumpApexY = nowY
		end
		local gained = nowY - (state._JumpGroundY or nowY)
		if gained > midAirLimit then
			ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Jump", self._severity, 0.65, {
				Reason = "InfiniteJump",
				GainedHeight = gained,
				Expected = expHeight,
			})
			state._JumpApexY = nowY
			state._JumpGroundY = nowY
		end
	end
end

return Jump
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/Detections/Noclip.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Noclip
-- Raycast zwischen letzter und aktueller Position gegen kollidierende Geometrie.
-- Ausgenommen: Character selbst und Teile mit Tag „HeadcraftNoclipIgnore“.

local Workspace = workspace

local Noclip = {
	Name = "Noclip",
	Category = "Noclip",
}

local function isIgnoredPart(part, character)
	if part:IsDescendantOf(character) then
		return true
	end
	if part:HasTag("HeadcraftNoclipIgnore") then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Noclip:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Noclip or {}
	local configSeverity = ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Noclip
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or configSeverity or "High"
end

function Noclip:OnCharacter(player, character)
end

function Noclip:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	if cfg.Enabled == false then
		return
	end
	local player = state.Player
	local movement = ctx.MovementExceptions
	if movement and type(movement.IsExempt) == "function" and movement:IsExempt(player) then
		return
	end
	local character = state.Character
	local root = state.Root
	if not character or not root then
		return
	end
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end
	if state.Humanoid and state.Humanoid.SeatPart then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local lastPos = state._NoclipLastPosition
	if not lastPos then
		state._NoclipLastPosition = root.Position
		state._NoclipLastTime = now
		return
	end

	local dir = root.Position - lastPos
	local dist = dir.Magnitude
	if dist <= 0.05 then
		state._NoclipLastTime = now
		return
	end
	if dist > (cfg.MaxCheckDistance or 14) then
		-- Zu weit für eine Geh-Prüfung; das Teleport-Modul ist zuständig.
		state._NoclipLastPosition = root.Position
		state._NoclipLastTime = now
		return
	end

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(lastPos, dir, params)

	if result then
		local part = result.Instance
		if not isIgnoredPart(part, character) then
			local solid = false
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				solid = part.CanCollide == true
			else
				solid = true -- Terrain ist immer kollidierend
			end
			if solid then
				local dirUnit = dir / dist
				local dot = math.abs(result.Normal:Dot(dirUnit))
				if dot < 0.55 then
					-- Seiten-Treffer (Wand). Kopfober-Treffer (Treppe/Aufzug) werden ignoriert.
					local confidence = math.clamp(0.5 + dist / 200, 0, 0.9)
					ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Noclip", self._severity, confidence, {
						Distance = dist,
						Hit = part:GetFullName(),
						Material = part:IsA("BasePart") and tostring(part.Material) or "Terrain",
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	state._NoclipLastPosition = root.Position
	state._NoclipLastTime = now
end

return Noclip

```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/Detections/Pattern.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Pattern
-- Statistische Auffälligkeit über Zeit: mehrere kleine, einzeln unauffällige
-- Verstöße aus unterschiedlichen Kategorien innerhalb eines Zeitfensters.
-- Die Quelle ist der Ringpuffer des DetectionManager; Pattern-Erkennungen und
-- Client-Indizien zählen nicht, damit keine Rückkopplung entsteht.
local Pattern = {
	Name = "Pattern",
	Category = "Pattern",
}

local DEFAULTS = {
	CheckInterval = 5,
	WindowSeconds = 90,
	Lookback = 200,
	MinViolations = 4,
	MinCategories = 2,
	MaxConfidence = 0.6,
	ReportInterval = 30,
}

function Pattern:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Pattern or {}
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or (ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Pattern) or "Low"
end

function Pattern:OnCharacter(_player, _character)
	-- Zeitbasierte Auswertung; kein eigener Character-Zustand nötig.
end

function Pattern:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, _dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	if cfg.Enabled == false then
		return
	end

	local player = state.Player
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end

	local nowClock = os.clock()
	local interval = math.max(tonumber(cfg.CheckInterval) or DEFAULTS.CheckInterval, 1)
	if nowClock - (state._PatternLastCheck or 0) < interval then
		return
	end
	state._PatternLastCheck = nowClock
	if nowClock - (state._PatternLastReport or 0) < math.max(tonumber(cfg.ReportInterval) or DEFAULTS.ReportInterval, 5) then
		return
	end

	local framework = ctx.Framework
	if not framework or type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local ok, manager = pcall(function()
		return framework:TryGetService("DetectionManager")
	end)
	if not ok or not manager or type(manager.GetRecent) ~= "function" then
		return
	end

	local lookback = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.Lookback) or DEFAULTS.Lookback), 10, 1000)
	local okList, list = pcall(function()
		return manager:GetRecent(lookback, player.UserId)
	end)
	if not okList or type(list) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local window = math.max(tonumber(cfg.WindowSeconds) or DEFAULTS.WindowSeconds, 10)
	local maxConfidence = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.MaxConfidence) or DEFAULTS.MaxConfidence, 0, 1)

	local count = 0
	local categories = {}
	for _, detection in ipairs(list) do
		if type(detection) == "table" and type(detection.Timestamp) == "number" then
			if detection.Category ~= "Pattern" and detection.Category ~= "ClientReport" then
				if now - detection.Timestamp >= 0 and now - detection.Timestamp <= window then
					local confidence = tonumber(detection.Confidence) or 1
					if confidence <= maxConfidence then
						count += 1
						categories[detection.Category] = (categories[detection.Category] or 0) + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local distinct = 0
	local top = {}
	for category, amount in pairs(categories) do
		distinct += 1
		table.insert(top, { Category = category, Count = amount })
		if #top > 32 then
			break
		end
	end
	table.sort(top, function(a, b)
		return a.Count > b.Count
	end)

	if count < math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.MinViolations) or DEFAULTS.MinViolations), 2, 100)
		or distinct < math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.MinCategories) or DEFAULTS.MinCategories), 1, 12) then
		return
	end

	state._PatternLastReport = nowClock
	ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Pattern", self._severity, 0.45, {
		WindowSeconds = window,
		Violations = count,
		Categories = distinct,
		Top = top,
	})
end

return Pattern

```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/Detections/Physics.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Physics
-- Wertet serverseitig beobachtbare Physik-Zustände aus: unplausible
-- Assembly-Geschwindigkeiten, Fling-Spitzen und missbrauchte Netzwerk-Ownership
-- an ungesicherten Teilen in der Nähe des Characters. Vom Client gesendete Werte
-- werden nicht verwendet; Ausnahmen laufen über MovementExceptions.
local Workspace = workspace

local Physics = {
	Name = "Physics",
	Category = "Physics",
}

local DEFAULTS = {
	MaxLinearSpeed = 120,
	MaxAngularSpeed = 25,
	SpeedSamples = 3,
	FlingDelta = 140,
	MinFlingSpeed = 60,
	NetworkRadius = 28,
	NetworkMaxParts = 8,
	NetworkMaxSpeed = 90,
	ScanInterval = 1,
	ReportInterval = 1.5,
}

local EXEMPT_STATES = {
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming] = true,
}

local function isSecured(part)
	if part:HasTag("HeadcraftNoclipIgnore") or part:HasTag("HeadcraftNetworkOwnerAllowed") then
		return true
	end
	if part:GetAttribute("HeadcraftServerOwned") == true or part:GetAttribute("HeadcraftServerInstance") == true then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Physics:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Physics or {}
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or (ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Physics) or "High"
end

function Physics:OnCharacter(_player, _character)
	-- Der Zustand liegt im DetectionManager; Samples werden im Heartbeat erneuert.
end

function Physics:_scanNetworkOwnership(ctx, state, player, root, character, cfg, now)
	local radius = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.NetworkRadius) or DEFAULTS.NetworkRadius, 4, 80)
	local maxParts = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.NetworkMaxParts) or DEFAULTS.NetworkMaxParts), 1, 32)
	local maxSpeed = math.max(tonumber(cfg.NetworkMaxSpeed) or DEFAULTS.NetworkMaxSpeed, 1)

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

	local ok, parts = pcall(function()
		return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, radius, params)
	end)
	if not ok or type(parts) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	local checked = 0
	for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
		if checked >= maxParts then
			break
		end
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Anchored and not part:IsDescendantOf(character) then
			checked += 1
			if not isSecured(part) then
				local ownerOk, owner = pcall(function()
					return part:GetNetworkOwner()
				end)
				if ownerOk and owner == player then
					local speedOk, speed = pcall(function()
						return part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
					end)
					if speedOk and type(speed) == "number" and speed > maxSpeed then
						local last = state._PhysicsNetworkReport or 0
						if now - last >= (tonumber(cfg.ReportInterval) or DEFAULTS.ReportInterval) then
							state._PhysicsNetworkReport = now
							ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Physics", self._severity, 0.65, {
								Reason = "NetworkOwnership",
								Part = part:GetFullName(),
								Speed = speed,
								Limit = maxSpeed,
							})
						end
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Physics:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, _dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	if cfg.Enabled == false then
		return
	end

	local player = state.Player
	local movement = ctx.MovementExceptions
	if movement and type(movement.IsExempt) == "function" and movement:IsExempt(player) then
		return
	end

	local character = state.Character
	local root = state.Root
	local humanoid = state.Humanoid
	if not character or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end
	if humanoid.SeatPart then
		return
	end
	local hState = humanoid:GetState()
	if EXEMPT_STATES[hState] then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local reportInterval = math.max(tonumber(cfg.ReportInterval) or DEFAULTS.ReportInterval, 0.2)

	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if state.OnGround and state.GroundPart and state.GroundPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		velocity = velocity - state.GroundPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	end
	local speed = velocity.Magnitude
	local angular = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude

	local expectedSpeed = 16
	if state.ExpectedHumanoid and type(state.ExpectedHumanoid.WalkSpeed) == "number" then
		expectedSpeed = state.ExpectedHumanoid.WalkSpeed
	end
	expectedSpeed = math.max(expectedSpeed, 0.1)

	local maxLinear = math.max(tonumber(cfg.MaxLinearSpeed) or DEFAULTS.MaxLinearSpeed, expectedSpeed * 3)
	local maxAngular = math.max(tonumber(cfg.MaxAngularSpeed) or DEFAULTS.MaxAngularSpeed, 1)

	if speed > maxLinear or angular > maxAngular then
		state._PhysicsSpeedSamples = (state._PhysicsSpeedSamples or 0) + 1
	else
		state._PhysicsSpeedSamples = 0
	end

	local needSamples = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.SpeedSamples) or DEFAULTS.SpeedSamples), 1, 20)
	if state._PhysicsSpeedSamples >= needSamples and now - (state._PhysicsReport or 0) >= reportInterval then
		state._PhysicsReport = now
		state._PhysicsSpeedSamples = 0
		ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Physics", self._severity, 0.6, {
			Reason = "ExcessiveVelocity",
			Speed = speed,
			AngularSpeed = angular,
			MaxLinear = maxLinear,
			MaxAngular = maxAngular,
		})
	end

	local previous = state._PhysicsLastVelocity
	if previous then
		local delta = (velocity - previous).Magnitude
		local flingDelta = math.max(tonumber(cfg.FlingDelta) or DEFAULTS.FlingDelta, 1)
		local minFling = math.max(tonumber(cfg.MinFlingSpeed) or DEFAULTS.MinFlingSpeed, 1)
		if delta > flingDelta and speed > minFling and now - (state._PhysicsFlingReport or 0) >= reportInterval then
			state._PhysicsFlingReport = now
			ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Physics", self._severity, 0.75, {
				Reason = "Fling",
				Delta = delta,
				Speed = speed,
				Ping = state.Ping,
			})
		end
	end
	state._PhysicsLastVelocity = velocity

	local scanInterval = math.max(tonumber(cfg.ScanInterval) or DEFAULTS.ScanInterval, 0.25)
	if now - (state._PhysicsLastScan or 0) >= scanInterval then
		state._PhysicsLastScan = now
		self:_scanNetworkOwnership(ctx, state, player, root, character, cfg, now)
	end
end

return Physics
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/Detections/Remote.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Remote
-- Beobachtet zwei Quellen: (1) SecurityAlert-Events des RemoteService bei
-- Ratenlimit-/Validierungsverstößen und (2) explizit registrierte Spiel-Remotes
-- über WatchRemote. Einzelmeldungen sind Indizien, erst die Häufung zählt.
-- Die Headcraft-eigenen Remotes werden nicht überschrieben.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Headcraft"):WaitForChild("Shared")
local RateLimiter = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Utilities"):WaitForChild("RateLimiter"))
local Util = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Utilities"):WaitForChild("Util"))

local Remote = {
	Name = "Remote",
	Category = "Remote",
}

local DEFAULTS = {
	AlertWindow = 10,
	AlertThreshold = 3,
	ReportInterval = 2,
	MaxArgs = 32,
	MaxAlerts = 200,
	RateLimit = { Limit = 30, Window = 10 },
}

local ALERT_KINDS = {
	RemoteAbuse = true,
	InvalidRemoteArguments = true,
	RemoteInvalidArguments = true,
}

function Remote:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Remote or {}
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or (ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Remote) or "Medium"
	self._alerts = {}
	self._watched = {}
	self._eventConnection = nil
	self._lastPrune = 0

	self._removeConnection = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self._alerts[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

function Remote:_report(userId, kind, count, metadata)
	local now = os.clock()
	local entry = self._alerts[userId]
	if not entry then
		entry = { Count = 0, First = now, Last = now, Reported = 0 }
		self._alerts[userId] = entry
	end
	entry.Count += 1
	entry.Last = now

	local window = math.max(tonumber(self._config.AlertWindow) or DEFAULTS.AlertWindow, 1)
	if now - entry.First > window then
		entry.Count = 1
		entry.First = now
	end

	local threshold = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(self._config.AlertThreshold) or DEFAULTS.AlertThreshold), 1, 50)
	if entry.Count < threshold then
		return
	end
	if now - entry.Reported < (tonumber(self._config.ReportInterval) or DEFAULTS.ReportInterval) then
		return
	end
	local events = count or entry.Count
	entry.Reported = now
	entry.Count = 0
	entry.First = now

	local info = {
		Reason = kind or "RemoteAbuse",
		Events = events,
		WindowSeconds = window,
		Threshold = threshold,
	}
	if type(metadata) == "table" then
		for key, value in pairs(metadata) do
			info[key] = value
		end
	end
	self._ctx.Report(userId, "Remote", self._severity, 0.65, info)
end

-- Wird von EventService ("SecurityAlert") und von Spielcode genutzt.
function Remote:ReportAbuse(playerOrUserId, kind, metadata)
	local userId
	if type(playerOrUserId) == "number" then
		userId = playerOrUserId
	elseif typeof(playerOrUserId) == "Instance" and playerOrUserId:IsA("Player") then
		userId = playerOrUserId.UserId
	end
	if type(userId) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or not ALERT_KINDS[kind] then
		kind = "RemoteAbuse"
	end
	self:_report(userId, kind, nil, metadata)
	return true
end

function Remote:_onAlert(payload)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local kind = payload.kind
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or not ALERT_KINDS[kind] then
		return
	end
	local userId = tonumber(payload.userId)
	if not userId or userId < 1 then
		return
	end
	self:_report(userId, kind, nil, { Detail = tostring(payload.message or ""):sub(1, 200) })
end

function Remote:OnHeartbeat(_ctx, _state, _dt)
	if self._config.Enabled == false then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - self._lastPrune >= 5 then
		self._lastPrune = now
		for userId, entry in pairs(self._alerts) do
			if now - entry.Last > 60 then
				self._alerts[userId] = nil
			end
		end
		local limit = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(self._config.MaxAlerts) or DEFAULTS.MaxAlerts), 10, 1000)
		while true do
			local count = 0
			for _ in pairs(self._alerts) do
				count += 1
			end
			if count <= limit then
				break
			end
			for userId in pairs(self._alerts) do
				self._alerts[userId] = nil
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if self._eventConnection then
		return
	end
	local framework = self._ctx.Framework
	if not framework or type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local ok, eventService = pcall(function()
		return framework:TryGetService("EventService")
	end)
	if not ok or not eventService or type(eventService.Connect) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	self._eventConnection = eventService:Connect("SecurityAlert", function(payload)
		self:_onAlert(payload)
	end)
end

function Remote:_inspect(player, remote, entry, args)
	local userId = player and player.UserId or nil
	if type(userId) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end

	if not entry.Limiter:Check(userId) then
		self._ctx.Report(userId, "Remote", self._severity, 0.7, {
			Reason = "RateLimit",
			Remote = remote:GetFullName(),
			Limit = entry.Limit,
			Window = entry.Window,
		})
		return false
	end

	local maxArgs = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(entry.MaxArgs) or DEFAULTS.MaxArgs), 0, DEFAULTS.MaxArgs)
	if #args > maxArgs then
		self._ctx.Report(userId, "Remote", self._severity, 0.6, {
			Reason = "TooManyArguments",
			Remote = remote:GetFullName(),
			Given = #args,
			Max = maxArgs,
		})
		return false
	end

	for index, arg in ipairs(args) do
		local field = entry.Schema[tostring(index)] or entry.Schema[index]
		if type(field) == "table" then
			local valid, err = Util.validate(arg, field)
			if not valid then
				self._ctx.Report(userId, "Remote", self._severity, 0.55, {
					Reason = "InvalidRemoteArguments",
					Remote = remote:GetFullName(),
					Argument = index,
					Error = tostring(err or "ungültig"):sub(1, 200),
				})
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Optional: Spiel-Remotes überwachen. Schema: { MaxArgs = n, [1] = {type="string", max=500}, ... }.
-- rateLimit: { Limit = 30, Window = 10 }. Bereits gesetzte OnServerInvoke-Handler
-- werden ausgeführt, aber nur bei gültigen Argumenten (Passthrough schaltet das ab).
function Remote:WatchRemote(remote, schema, rateLimit)
	if typeof(remote) ~= "Instance" or not (remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") or remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
		return false, "remote muss ein RemoteEvent oder RemoteFunction sein"
	end
	if self._watched[remote] then
		return false, "Remote wird bereits beobachtet"
	end

	local rate = type(rateLimit) == "table" and rateLimit or {}
	local limit = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(rate.Limit) or DEFAULTS.RateLimit.Limit), 1, 1000)
	local window = math.max(tonumber(rate.Window) or DEFAULTS.RateLimit.Window, 1)
	local entry = {
		Schema = type(schema) == "table" and schema or {},
		MaxArgs = type(schema) == "table" and tonumber(schema.MaxArgs) or nil,
		Limiter = RateLimiter.new(limit, window),
		Limit = limit,
		Window = window,
		Connections = {},
		PreviousInvoke = nil,
		Passthrough = rate.Passthrough == true,
	}

	if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		table.insert(entry.Connections, remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, ...)
			self:_inspect(player, remote, entry, { ... })
		end))
	else
		entry.PreviousInvoke = remote.OnServerInvoke
		entry.Handler = function(player, ...)
			local allowed = self:_inspect(player, remote, entry, { ... })
			if not allowed and not entry.Passthrough then
				return nil
			end
			if type(entry.PreviousInvoke) == "function" then
				return entry.PreviousInvoke(player, ...)
			end
			return nil
		end
		remote.OnServerInvoke = entry.Handler
	end

	self._watched[remote] = entry
	return true
end

function Remote:StopWatching(remote)
	local entry = self._watched[remote]
	if not entry then
		return false
	end
	for _, connection in ipairs(entry.Connections) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	if remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") and remote.OnServerInvoke == entry.Handler then
		remote.OnServerInvoke = entry.PreviousInvoke
	end
	self._watched[remote] = nil
	return true
end

function Remote:Destroy()
	if self._eventConnection then
		self._eventConnection:Disconnect()
		self._eventConnection = nil
	end
	if self._removeConnection then
		self._removeConnection:Disconnect()
		self._removeConnection = nil
	end
	for remote, entry in pairs(self._watched) do
		for _, connection in ipairs(entry.Connections) do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
		if remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") and remote.OnServerInvoke == entry.Handler then
			remote.OnServerInvoke = entry.PreviousInvoke
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._watched)
	table.clear(self._alerts)
end

return Remote
```

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Speed
-- Prueft horizontale Distanz pro Zeit gegen den erlaubten WalkSpeed plus Toleranz.
-- Die Erlaubnis kommt vom Server (ExpectedHumanoid / Defaults), nicht vom Client.

local Workspace = workspace

local Speed = {
	Name = "Speed",
	Category = "Speed",
}

local EXEMPT_STATES = {
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll] = true,
}

function Speed:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Speed or {}
	local configSeverity = ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Speed
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or configSeverity or "Medium"
end

function Speed:OnCharacter(player, character)
	-- Kein pro-Character-Zustand noetig; der State im DetectionManager traegt die Positionen.
end

function Speed:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	if cfg.Enabled == false then
		return
	end
	local player = state.Player
	local movement = ctx.MovementExceptions
	if movement and type(movement.IsExempt) == "function" and movement:IsExempt(player) then
		return
	end
	local character = state.Character
	local root = state.Root
	local humanoid = state.Humanoid
	if not character or not root or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end
	if humanoid.SeatPart then
		return
	end
	local hState = humanoid:GetState()
	if EXEMPT_STATES[hState] then
		return
	end
	if not state.LastPosition or not state.LastTime then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local dtReal = now - state.LastTime
	if dtReal <= 0 or dtReal > 2 then
		return
	end

	local pos = root.Position
	local dist = (pos - state.LastPosition).Magnitude

	-- Geschwindigkeit relativ zum Boden (Plattformen/Fahrzeuge werden abgezogen)
	local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	if state.GroundPart and state.GroundPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		vel = vel - state.GroundPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	end
	local horizontal = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude

	local expected = 16
	if state.ExpectedHumanoid and type(state.ExpectedHumanoid.WalkSpeed) == "number" then
		expected = state.ExpectedHumanoid.WalkSpeed
	end
	expected = math.max(expected, 0.1)

	local tolerance = (cfg.ToleranceStuds or 6) + expected * (cfg.ToleranceFactor or 0.12)
	local ping = type(state.Ping) == "number" and state.Ping or 0
	local pingStuds = expected * math.clamp(ping, 0, 1)
	local allowedPerTick = expected * dtReal + tolerance + pingStuds
	local maxSpeed = cfg.MaxSpeedStuds or 120

	local violated = false
	local info = {}

	if horizontal > maxSpeed then
		violated = true
		info.Reason = "MaxSpeed"
		info.ObservedSpeed = horizontal
		info.Limit = maxSpeed
	elseif dist > allowedPerTick and dist > 1 then
		violated = true
		info.Reason = "Speed"
		info.Distance = dist
		info.Allowed = allowedPerTick
		info.WalkSpeed = expected
		info.Ping = ping
	end

	if not violated then
		return
	end

	local confidence = math.clamp((self._ctx.Config.ConfidenceBase or 0.5), 0, (self._ctx.Config.ConfidenceMax or 0.95))
	ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Speed", self._severity, confidence, info)
end

return Speed

```

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Teleport
-- Sprung > X Studs in einem Sample ohne MovementException.

local Teleport = {
	Name = "Teleport",
	Category = "Teleport",
}

function Teleport:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Teleport or {}
	local configSeverity = ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Teleport
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or configSeverity or "High"
end

function Teleport:OnCharacter(player, character)
end

function Teleport:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	if cfg.Enabled == false then
		return
	end
	local player = state.Player
	local movement = ctx.MovementExceptions
	if movement and type(movement.IsExempt) == "function" and movement:IsExempt(player, "Teleport") then
		return
	end
	local character = state.Character
	local root = state.Root
	local humanoid = state.Humanoid
	if not character or not root or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end
	if humanoid.SeatPart then
		return
	end
	if not state.LastPosition or not state.LastTime then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local dtReal = now - state.LastTime
	if dtReal <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local dist = (root.Position - state.LastPosition).Magnitude
	local maxStuds = cfg.MaxStuds or 70
	if dist > maxStuds then
		local confidence = math.clamp(0.7 + (dist - maxStuds) / 300, 0, 0.99)
		ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Teleport", self._severity, confidence, {
			Distance = dist,
			Dt = dtReal,
			MaxStuds = maxStuds,
		})
	end
end

return Teleport
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/Detections/Tool.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Tool
-- Erkennt Tools im Character oder Backpack, die nicht vom Server vergeben wurden.
-- Der Server tagt vergebene Tools (Attribut/Tag) und kann Namen zusätzlich über
-- DetectionManager:AllowTool freigeben. Geprüft wird nur der Observed-Zustand.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Tool = {
	Name = "Tool",
	Category = "Tool",
}

local SERVER_ATTRIBUTE = "HeadcraftServerTool"
local OWNER_ATTRIBUTE = "HeadcraftServerToolOwner"
local SERVER_TAG = "HeadcraftServerTool"

local DEFAULTS = {
	CheckInterval = 1,
	MinAgeSeconds = 1.5,
	MaxTools = 32,
}

function Tool:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Tool or {}
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or (ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Tool) or "Medium"
	self._granted = {}
	self._removeConnection = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self._granted[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

-- Vergibt ein Tool serverseitig: wird getaggt und der Name freigeschaltet.
function Tool:Grant(player, tool)
	if not (typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player")) then
		return false, "ungültiger Spieler"
	end
	if typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then
		return false, "ungültiges Tool"
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		tool:SetAttribute(SERVER_ATTRIBUTE, true)
		tool:SetAttribute(OWNER_ATTRIBUTE, player.UserId)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, "Tool konnte nicht getaggt werden"
	end
	self:_allowName(player.UserId, tool.Name)
	return true
end

function Tool:Allow(player, toolName)
	if not (typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player")) then
		return false
	end
	if type(toolName) ~= "string" or #toolName == 0 or #toolName > 200 then
		return false
	end
	self:_allowName(player.UserId, toolName)
	return true
end

function Tool:_allowName(userId, toolName)
	self._granted[userId] = self._granted[userId] or {}
	self._granted[userId][toolName] = true
	local framework = self._ctx.Framework
	if framework and type(framework.TryGetService) == "function" then
		local ok, manager = pcall(function()
			return framework:TryGetService("DetectionManager")
		end)
		if ok and manager and type(manager.AllowTool) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				manager:AllowTool(self._ctx.Players and self._ctx.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId), toolName)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function Tool:_isAuthorized(tool, player)
	if tool:GetAttribute(SERVER_ATTRIBUTE) == true then
		return true
	end
	if tool:GetAttribute(OWNER_ATTRIBUTE) == player.UserId then
		return true
	end
	if tool:HasTag(SERVER_TAG) then
		return true
	end
	local granted = self._granted[player.UserId]
	if granted and granted[tool.Name] == true then
		return true
	end
	local names = self._config.AllowedNames
	if type(names) == "table" and names[tool.Name] == true then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Tool:OnCharacter(_player, _character)
	-- Pro-Character-Cache liegt im State und wird beim Wechsel zurückgesetzt.
end

function Tool:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, _dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	-- Opt-in: Clients können keine Tools erzeugen, die zum Server replizieren. Jedes Tool, das der Server
	-- sieht, stammt also vom Spiel (StarterPack, Shop, Pickup). Sinnvoll ist die Prüfung nur, wenn das
	-- Spiel alle Vergaben über Tool:Grant / DetectionManager:AllowTool meldet → Modules.Tool.Strict = true.
	if cfg.Enabled == false or cfg.Strict ~= true then
		return
	end

	local player = state.Player
	local character = state.Character
	local backpack = player.Backpack
	if not character or not backpack then
		return
	end
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local interval = math.max(tonumber(cfg.CheckInterval) or DEFAULTS.CheckInterval, 0.25)
	if now - (state._ToolLastCheck or 0) < interval then
		return
	end
	state._ToolLastCheck = now

	if state._ToolCharacter ~= character then
		state._ToolCharacter = character
		state._ToolSeen = {}
	end
	local seen = state._ToolSeen or {}
	state._ToolSeen = seen

	local maxTools = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.MaxTools) or DEFAULTS.MaxTools), 1, 128)
	local minAge = math.max(tonumber(cfg.MinAgeSeconds) or DEFAULTS.MinAgeSeconds, 0.1)
	local checked = 0

	local function examine(container, location)
		for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
			if checked >= maxTools then
				return
			end
			if child:IsA("Tool") then
				checked += 1
				if self:_isAuthorized(child, player) then
					seen[child] = nil
				else
					local record = seen[child]
					if not record then
						seen[child] = { Since = now }
					elseif now - record.Since >= minAge then
						record.Since = now
						ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Tool", self._severity, 0.5, {
							Reason = "UnauthorizedTool",
							Tool = child.Name,
							Class = child.ClassName,
							Location = location,
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	examine(character, "Character")
	examine(backpack, "Backpack")

	for tool in pairs(seen) do
		if tool.Parent ~= character and tool.Parent ~= backpack then
			seen[tool] = nil
		end
	end
end

function Tool:Destroy()
	if self._removeConnection then
		self._removeConnection:Disconnect()
		self._removeConnection = nil
	end
	table.clear(self._granted)
end

return Tool

```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/MovementExceptions.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Legitime Bewegungsänderungen werden ausschließlich serverseitig registriert.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local MovementExceptions = {
	Name = "MovementExceptions",
	Dependencies = {},
}

local VALID_KINDS = { Teleport = true, Launch = true, Vehicle = true, Knockback = true, Custom = true }

function MovementExceptions:Init(framework)
	self._framework = framework
	self._entries = {}
	self._connections = {}
	self._connections.playerRemoving = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self._entries[player] = nil
	end)
end

function MovementExceptions:Grant(player, kind, seconds, data)
	if not (typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player")) then
		return false, "Ungültiger Spieler"
	end
	if not VALID_KINDS[kind] then
		return false, "Ungültige Ausnahmeart"
	end
	if type(seconds) ~= "number" or seconds <= 0 or seconds > 120 then
		return false, "Ungültige Dauer"
	end
	local expiresAt = os.clock() + seconds
	local entries = self._entries[player] or {}
	entries[kind] = { expiresAt = expiresAt, data = data }
	self._entries[player] = entries
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		character:SetAttribute("HeadcraftMovementException", expiresAt)
	end
	return true
end

function MovementExceptions:IsExempt(player, kind)
	if not (typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player")) then
		return false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local attribute = character:GetAttribute("HeadcraftMovementException")
		if type(attribute) == "number" and attribute > now then
			return true
		end
	end
	local entries = self._entries[player]
	if not entries then
		return false
	end
	local found = false
	for entryKind, entry in entries do
		if entry.expiresAt <= now then
			entries[entryKind] = nil
		elseif kind == nil or kind == entryKind then
			found = true
		end
	end
	return found
end

function MovementExceptions:Teleport(player, cframe)
	if not (typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player")) or typeof(cframe) ~= "CFrame" then
		return false, "Ungültige Teleportdaten"
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return false, "Kein Character vorhanden"
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (root and root:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return false, "Kein HumanoidRootPart vorhanden"
	end
	self:Grant(player, "Teleport", 2, { destination = cframe.Position })
	root.CFrame = cframe
	return true
end

function MovementExceptions:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	table.clear(self._entries)
end

return MovementExceptions
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/RiskManager.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local RiskManager = {
	Name = "RiskManager",
	Dependencies = {},
}

local SEVERITY_SCORES = {
	Information = 1,
	Low = 3,
	Medium = 8,
	High = 18,
	Critical = 40,
}

function RiskManager:Init(framework)
	self._framework = framework
	self._scores = {}
	self._actionTimes = {}
	self._connections = {
		Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
			self._scores[player.UserId] = nil
			self._actionTimes[player.UserId] = nil
		end),
	}
end

function RiskManager:_decay(entry)
	local now = os.clock()
	local elapsedMinutes = math.max(0, now - entry.updatedAt) / 60
	local antiCheat = self._framework.Config.AntiCheat or {}
	local decay = tonumber(antiCheat.RiskDecayPerMinute) or 2
	entry.score = math.max(0, entry.score - elapsedMinutes * decay)
	entry.updatedAt = now
	return entry.score
end

function RiskManager:Add(userId, score)
	if type(userId) ~= "number" or type(score) ~= "number" or score <= 0 then
		return self:Get(userId)
	end
	local entry = self._scores[userId] or { score = 0, updatedAt = os.clock() }
	self:_decay(entry)
	entry.score = math.clamp(entry.score + score, 0, 10000)
	entry.updatedAt = os.clock()
	self._scores[userId] = entry
	return entry.score
end

function RiskManager:Get(userId)
	local entry = self._scores[userId]
	if not entry then
		return 0
	end
	return self:_decay(entry)
end

function RiskManager:Set(userId, score)
	if type(userId) ~= "number" or type(score) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	self._scores[userId] = { score = math.clamp(score, 0, 10000), updatedAt = os.clock() }
	return true
end

function RiskManager:Reset(userId)
	self._scores[userId] = nil
	self._actionTimes[userId] = nil
	return true
end

function RiskManager:GetAll()
	local result = {}
	for userId in self._scores do
		result[userId] = self:Get(userId)
	end
	return result
end

function RiskManager:ScoreFor(severity, confidence)
	return (SEVERITY_SCORES[severity] or 1) * math.clamp(tonumber(confidence) or 0, 0, 1)
end

function RiskManager:Evaluate(userId, detection, whitelisted)
	if whitelisted then
		return
	end
	local antiCheat = self._framework.Config.AntiCheat or {}
	if antiCheat.DetectionMode ~= "Enforce" or antiCheat.AutomaticActions ~= true then
		return
	end
	local thresholds = antiCheat.Thresholds or {}
	local actions = antiCheat.Actions or {}
	local score = self:Get(userId)
	local ordered = { "Ban", "TempBan", "Kick", "Warn", "NotifyAdmin", "Log" }
	for _, action in ordered do
		local threshold = tonumber(thresholds[action])
		if threshold and score >= threshold then
			self:_performAction(userId, action, detection, actions[action])
			break
		end
	end
end

function RiskManager:_performAction(userId, action, detection, actionConfig)
	local cooldown = type(actionConfig) == "table" and tonumber(actionConfig.CooldownSeconds) or 60
	cooldown = math.clamp(cooldown or 60, 5, 3600)
	local key = `{userId}:{action}`
	local now = os.clock()
	if (self._actionTimes[key] or 0) + cooldown > now then
		return
	end
	self._actionTimes[key] = now
	local reason = `AntiCheat: {detection.Category} erkannt`
	if action == "NotifyAdmin" then
		local remote = self._framework:TryGetService("RemoteService")
		if remote then remote:PushToPermission("AntiCheat.ViewDetections", "Detection", detection) end
	elseif action == "Warn" then
		local service = self._framework:TryGetService("WarnService")
		if service then service:Warn(0, userId, reason, "AntiCheat") end
	elseif action == "Kick" then
		local service = self._framework:TryGetService("KickService")
		if service then service:Kick(0, userId, reason, "AntiCheat") end
	elseif action == "TempBan" or action == "Ban" then
		local service = self._framework:TryGetService("BanService")
		if service then
			local duration = if action == "TempBan" then (type(actionConfig) == "table" and tonumber(actionConfig.DurationSeconds) or 86400) else nil
			service:Ban(0, userId, reason, duration, "AntiCheat")
		end
	end
end

function RiskManager:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self._connections do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	table.clear(self._scores)
	table.clear(self._actionTimes)
end

return RiskManager

```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Backend/APIClient.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Technische HTTP-Schicht zum Headcraft-Backend (hc-api, /api/roblox/v1).
-- Zuständig nur für URL, Header-Authentifizierung, Signatur, JSON, Retry, Circuit-Breaker und lokales
-- Rate-Limit – keine fachlichen Entscheidungen.
--
-- Authentifizierung je Request (siehe docs/BACKENDS_AND_HMAC_SCHEMA.md §3.3):
--   X-Project-Id, X-Api-Key, X-Timestamp (Unix-Sekunden), X-Nonce (≥ 12 Zeichen, pro Versuch neu),
--   optional X-Signature (HMAC-SHA256), Idempotency-Key für Schreibzugriffe (über Retries stabil).
-- Der API-Key kommt als Roblox-Secret-Objekt aus Authentication und wird nie gelesen oder geloggt.

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local RateLimiter = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.RateLimiter)
local Crypto = require(script.Parent.Crypto)

local APIClient = {
	Name = "APIClient",
	Dependencies = {},
}

local framework: any
local rateLimiter: any = RateLimiter.new(400, 60) -- Roblox erlaubt 500 HTTP-Requests pro Minute und Server

local baseURL = "https://api.headcraft.cloud/roblox/v1"
local signaturePathPrefix = "/api/roblox/v1" -- Pfad, den hc-api intern sieht (für X-Signature)
local consecutiveFailures = 0
local circuitOpenUntil = 0
local probePending = false
local inFlight = 0
local lastSuccess = 0
local lastError: string? = nil
local lastErrorCode: string? = nil
local lastLatencyMs = 0
local totalRequests = 0
local running = true

local ALLOWED_METHODS: { [string]: boolean } = { GET = true, POST = true, PATCH = true, PUT = true, DELETE = true }
local WRITE_METHODS: { [string]: boolean } = { POST = true, PATCH = true, PUT = true, DELETE = true }
local RETRYABLE_STATUS: { [number]: boolean } = { [408] = true, [429] = true, [500] = true, [502] = true, [503] = true, [504] = true }
local CIRCUIT_FAILURES = 5
local CIRCUIT_OPEN_SECONDS = 60

local function clampNumber(value: any, fallback: number, minimum: number, maximum: number): number
	local number = tonumber(value)
	if number == nil or number ~= number or math.abs(number) == math.huge then
		return fallback
	end
	return math.clamp(number, minimum, maximum)
end

local function truncate(value: any, limit: number): string
	local text = value == nil and "" or tostring(value)
	if #text <= limit then
		return text
	end
	return string.sub(text, 1, math.max(0, limit - 1)) .. "…"
end

local function httpEnabled(): boolean
	local ok, enabled = pcall(function()
		return HttpService.HttpEnabled
	end)
	return ok and enabled == true
end

local function newNonce(): string
	return (string.gsub(HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), "-", ""))
end

local function validPath(path: any): boolean
	return type(path) == "string" and path ~= "" and #path <= 512 and string.sub(path, 1, 1) == "/"
		and not string.find(path, "%c") and not string.find(path, "..", 1, true)
end

-- RequestAsync in eigenem Thread mit hartem Timeout: Ein hängender Endpunkt blockiert nie den Server.
local function requestWithTimeout(options: any, timeout: number): (boolean, any)
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	local settled = false
	local function finish(ok: boolean, value: any)
		if settled then
			return
		end
		settled = true
		if coroutine.status(thread) == "suspended" then
			task.spawn(thread, ok, value)
		end
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, response = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:RequestAsync(options)
		end)
		finish(ok, response)
	end)
	task.delay(timeout, function()
		finish(false, "Timeout nach " .. tostring(timeout) .. " Sekunden")
	end)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

local function decodeBody(body: any): any
	if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then
		return {}
	end
	local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(body)
	end)
	return ok and decoded or nil
end

local function headerValue(headers: any, name: string): string?
	if type(headers) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	for key, value in pairs(headers) do
		if type(key) == "string" and string.lower(key) == name then
			return tostring(value)
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function backoffSeconds(attempt: number): number
	return math.clamp(math.min(8, 0.5 * (2 ^ math.max(0, attempt - 1))) + math.random() * 0.25, 0.1, 8)
end

local function recordFailure(path: string, reason: string, code: string?)
	consecutiveFailures += 1
	lastError = truncate(reason, 300)
	lastErrorCode = code
	if framework then
		framework.Log:Warn("APIClient", "Backend-Anfrage fehlgeschlagen", { path = path, reason = lastError, code = code })
	end
	if consecutiveFailures >= CIRCUIT_FAILURES and circuitOpenUntil <= os.clock() then
		circuitOpenUntil = os.clock() + CIRCUIT_OPEN_SECONDS
		probePending = false
		if framework then
			framework.Log:Error("APIClient", "Circuit-Breaker geöffnet", { seconds = CIRCUIT_OPEN_SECONDS, failures = consecutiveFailures })
		end
	end
end

local function recordSuccess()
	consecutiveFailures = 0
	circuitOpenUntil = 0
	probePending = false
	lastSuccess = os.time()
	lastError = nil
	lastErrorCode = nil
end

local function circuitState(): string
	if circuitOpenUntil <= os.clock() then
		return "closed"
	end
	if probePending then
		return "open"
	end
	probePending = true
	return "half"
end

function APIClient:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	local backend = type(currentFramework.Config) == "table" and type(currentFramework.Config.Backend) == "table"
		and currentFramework.Config.Backend or {}
	-- Altes Format: BaseURL ".../roblox" + Version "v1"; neues Format: BaseURL bereits inkl. "/v1".
	local base = type(backend.BaseURL) == "string" and backend.BaseURL or baseURL
	base = string.gsub(base, "/+$", "")
	if type(backend.Version) == "string" and backend.Version ~= "" and not string.find(base, "/v%d+$") then
		base ..= "/" .. string.gsub(backend.Version, "^/+", "")
	end
	baseURL = base
	if type(backend.SignaturePathPrefix) == "string" and string.sub(backend.SignaturePathPrefix, 1, 1) == "/" then
		signaturePathPrefix = string.gsub(backend.SignaturePathPrefix, "/+$", "")
	end
end

function APIClient:Start()
	if not httpEnabled() then
		if framework then
			framework.Log:Error("APIClient", "HttpService.HttpEnabled ist false – Backend bleibt deaktiviert, das Spiel läuft weiter.")
			framework:SetServiceStatus(self.Name, "Disabled")
		end
		return
	end
	if framework then
		framework.Log:Info("APIClient", "HTTP-Schicht bereit", { base = baseURL })
	end
end

function APIClient:GetBaseURL(): string
	return baseURL
end

-- Pfad eines projektbezogenen Endpunkts, z. B. ProjectPath("/servers/heartbeat").
function APIClient:ProjectPath(suffix: string): string
	local projectId = framework and framework.Config and framework.Config.ProjectId or ""
	return "/projects/" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(tostring(projectId)) .. suffix
end

-- method: GET/POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE · path: relativ zur Basis-URL (".../roblox/v1"), darf "?query" enthalten
-- body: Tabelle oder nil · options: { noAuth?, timeoutOverride?, idempotencyKey?, maxRetries? }
-- Rückgabe: ok, data (dekodierte Antwort oder Fehlertext), statusCode, errorCode (Backend-Fehlercode)
function APIClient:Request(method: any, path: any, body: any?, optionsAny: any?): (boolean, any, number, string?)
	if not running then
		return false, "APIClient wurde beendet", 0, "STOPPED"
	end
	if not httpEnabled() then
		return false, "HTTP Requests sind in diesem Experience deaktiviert", 0, "HTTP_DISABLED"
	end
	local options: any = type(optionsAny) == "table" and optionsAny or {}
	local httpMethod = type(method) == "string" and string.upper(method) or ""
	if not ALLOWED_METHODS[httpMethod] then
		return false, "HTTP-Methode nicht erlaubt: " .. httpMethod, 0, "INVALID_METHOD"
	end
	if not validPath(path) then
		return false, "Ungültiger API-Pfad", 0, "INVALID_PATH"
	end
	if body ~= nil and type(body) ~= "table" then
		return false, "Request-Body muss eine Tabelle sein", 0, "INVALID_BODY"
	end

	if not rateLimiter:Check("global") then
		return false, "Lokales Rate-Limit (400/min) erreicht", 429, "LOCAL_RATE_LIMIT"
	end
	local circuit = circuitState()
	if circuit == "open" or (circuit == "half" and inFlight > 0) then
		return false, "Circuit-Breaker ist offen", 503, "CIRCUIT_OPEN"
	end

	-- Credentials (nicht-yieldend; das Secret-Objekt verlässt diese Funktion nur als Header-Wert)
	local apiKey: any = nil
	local signingSecret: string? = nil
	local projectId = tostring(framework and framework.Config and framework.Config.ProjectId or "")
	if options.noAuth ~= true then
		local authentication = framework and framework:TryGetService("Authentication")
		if authentication and type(authentication.GetApiKey) == "function" then
			local ok, value = pcall(authentication.GetApiKey, authentication)
			apiKey = ok and value or nil
		end
		if authentication and type(authentication.GetSigningSecret) == "function" then
			local ok, value = pcall(authentication.GetSigningSecret, authentication)
			signingSecret = ok and type(value) == "string" and value or nil
		end
		if apiKey == nil then
			return false, "Kein API-Key verfügbar", 401, "NO_CREDENTIALS"
		end
		if not string.match(projectId, "^prj_%x+$") then
			return false, "ServerConfig.ProjectId ist nicht gesetzt", 0, "NO_PROJECT_ID"
		end
	end

	local bodyText = body ~= nil and Crypto.canonicalJson(body) or ""
	local idempotencyKey: string? = nil
	if WRITE_METHODS[httpMethod] then
		idempotencyKey = type(options.idempotencyKey) == "string" and options.idempotencyKey or HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	end
	local cleanPath = signaturePathPrefix .. (string.split(path, "?")[1])

	local backend = type(framework and framework.Config and framework.Config.Backend) == "table" and framework.Config.Backend or {}
	local timeout = clampNumber(options.timeoutOverride or backend.TimeoutSeconds, 10, 1, 30)
	local maxRetries = math.floor(clampNumber(options.maxRetries or backend.MaxRetries, 3, 0, 5))

	local attempt = 0
	while attempt <= maxRetries do
		attempt += 1
		-- Timestamp und Nonce pro Versuch neu (Replay-Schutz: dieselbe Nonce wird mit 409 abgelehnt)
		local timestamp = tostring(math.floor(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
		local nonce = newNonce()
		local headers: { [string]: any } = {}
		if bodyText ~= "" then
			headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
		end
		if options.noAuth ~= true then
			headers["X-Project-Id"] = projectId
			headers["X-Api-Key"] = apiKey
			headers["X-Timestamp"] = timestamp
			headers["X-Nonce"] = nonce
			if signingSecret then
				headers["X-Signature"] = Crypto.signRequest(signingSecret, timestamp, nonce, httpMethod, cleanPath, bodyText)
			end
		end
		if idempotencyKey then
			headers["Idempotency-Key"] = idempotencyKey
		end

		local startedAt = os.clock()
		inFlight += 1
		local ok, response = requestWithTimeout({
			Url = baseURL .. path,
			Method = httpMethod,
			Headers = headers,
			Body = bodyText ~= "" and bodyText or nil,
		}, timeout)
		inFlight -= 1
		lastLatencyMs = math.floor((os.clock() - startedAt) * 1000 + 0.5)
		totalRequests += 1

		if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" then
			recordFailure(path, tostring(response), "NETWORK")
			if attempt > maxRetries then
				return false, tostring(response), 0, "NETWORK"
			end
			task.wait(backoffSeconds(attempt))
			continue
		end

		local status = math.floor(clampNumber(response.StatusCode, 0, 0, 599))
		local data = decodeBody(response.Body)
		if response.Success == true and status >= 200 and status < 300 then
			if data == nil then
				recordFailure(path, "Antwort ist kein gültiges JSON", "INVALID_RESPONSE")
				return false, "Antwort ist kein gültiges JSON", status, "INVALID_RESPONSE"
			end
			recordSuccess()
			return true, data, status, nil
		end

		-- Fehler-Envelope: { ok = false, error = { code, message, retryable }, requestId }
		local errorInfo = type(data) == "table" and type(data.error) == "table" and data.error or {}
		local code = type(errorInfo.code) == "string" and errorInfo.code or ("HTTP_" .. status)
		local message = type(errorInfo.message) == "string" and errorInfo.message or truncate(response.StatusMessage, 120)
		local reason = string.format("HTTP %d %s: %s", status, code, message)
		recordFailure(path, reason, code)

		-- 409 NONCE_REPLAY: mit neuer Nonce sofort erneut versuchen (passiert nur bei Uhr-/Retry-Kollisionen)
		local retryable = RETRYABLE_STATUS[status] == true or errorInfo.retryable == true or code == "NONCE_REPLAY"
		if not retryable or attempt > maxRetries then
			if (status == 401 or status == 403) and framework then
				local authentication = framework:TryGetService("Authentication")
				if authentication and type(authentication.ReportRejected) == "function" then
					pcall(authentication.ReportRejected, authentication, code, message)
				end
			end
			return false, reason, status, code
		end
		local retryAfter = tonumber(headerValue(response.Headers, "retry-after"))
		task.wait(retryAfter and math.clamp(retryAfter, 0, 60) or backoffSeconds(attempt))
	end
	return false, "Anfrage fehlgeschlagen", 0, "EXHAUSTED"
end

function APIClient:GetDiagnostics(): { [string]: any }
	return {
		circuitOpen = circuitOpenUntil > os.clock(),
		consecutiveFailures = consecutiveFailures,
		lastSuccess = lastSuccess,
		lastError = lastError,
		lastErrorCode = lastErrorCode,
		latencyMs = lastLatencyMs,
		totalRequests = totalRequests,
		baseURL = baseURL,
	}
end

function APIClient:IsCircuitOpen(): boolean
	return circuitOpenUntil > os.clock()
end

function APIClient:Destroy()
	running = false
	framework = nil
end

return APIClient
```

```lua
--!strict
-- Credentials und Verbindungsprüfung für das Headcraft-Backend.
--   • API-Key: Roblox Secrets Store (HttpService:GetSecret(Credentials.SecretName)). Das Secret-Objekt wird
--     direkt als Header-Wert genutzt; sein Inhalt ist für Luau nicht lesbar und wird nie geloggt.
--     Nur in Studio: optional Credentials.FallbackApiKey (nie in veröffentlichten Places verwenden).
--   • Signing Secret (optional, nur nötig bei config.security.requireSignature = true): Credentials.SigningSecret.
--     Ein Roblox-Secret kann dafür nicht genutzt werden, weil HMAC den Klartext braucht – der Wert liegt daher
--     ausschließlich in der Server-Konfiguration (ServerScriptService, wird nie repliziert).
--   • Verbindungsprüfung: POST /auth/verify. Es gibt keinen Session-Token; jeder Request authentifiziert sich selbst.

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Authentication = {
	Name = "Authentication",
	Dependencies = { "APIClient" },
}

local REJECTED_RETRY_SECONDS = 300 -- falscher/widerrufener Key: selten erneut prüfen statt das Backend zu fluten
local MAX_RETRY_SECONDS = 120

local framework: any
local credentials: { [string]: any } = {}
local apiKey: any = nil
local serverId = ""
local connected = false
local state = "Idle"
local lastSuccess = 0
local lastError: string? = nil
local failures = 0
local retryAt = 0
local running = true
local verifying = false
local missingLogged = false

local function httpEnabled(): boolean
	local ok, enabled = pcall(function()
		return HttpService.HttpEnabled
	end)
	return ok and enabled == true
end

local function resolveApiKey(): any
	if apiKey ~= nil then
		return apiKey
	end
	local secretName = type(credentials.SecretName) == "string" and credentials.SecretName or "headcraft_api_key"
	local ok, secret = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:GetSecret(secretName)
	end)
	if ok and secret ~= nil then
		apiKey = secret
		return apiKey
	end
	if RunService:IsStudio() and type(credentials.FallbackApiKey) == "string"
		and string.match(credentials.FallbackApiKey, "^hcr_%x+_%x+$") then
		apiKey = credentials.FallbackApiKey
		if framework then
			framework.Log:Warn("Authentication", "Studio-Fallback-API-Key aktiv – vor dem Veröffentlichen entfernen und den Secrets Store nutzen.")
		end
		return apiKey
	end
	if framework and not missingLogged then
		missingLogged = true
		framework.Log:Error("Authentication", "Kein API-Key im Secrets Store – Backend deaktiviert, das Spiel läuft weiter.", { secretName = secretName })
	end
	return nil
end

function Authentication:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	local config = type(currentFramework.Config) == "table" and currentFramework.Config or {}
	credentials = type(config.Credentials) == "table" and config.Credentials or {}
	serverId = game.JobId ~= "" and game.JobId or ("studio-" .. HttpService:GenerateGUID(false))
end

function Authentication:Start()
	if not httpEnabled() then
		state = "HttpDisabled"
		lastError = "HTTP Requests sind in diesem Experience deaktiviert"
		if framework then
			framework.Log:Error("Authentication", "HttpService.HttpEnabled ist false – Backend bleibt aus.")
			framework:SetServiceStatus(self.Name, "Disabled")
		end
		return
	end
	if resolveApiKey() == nil then
		state = "NoCredentials"
		lastError = "Kein API-Key vorhanden"
		if framework then
			framework:SetServiceStatus(self.Name, "Disabled")
		end
		return
	end
	while running do
		if not connected and os.clock() >= retryAt and not verifying then
			self:Verify()
		end
		task.wait(connected and 30 or math.clamp(retryAt - os.clock(), 1, 30))
	end
end

-- Für APIClient (nicht yieldend): Secret-Objekt bzw. Studio-Fallback-String
function Authentication:GetApiKey(): any
	return resolveApiKey()
end

function Authentication:GetSigningSecret(): string?
	local secret = credentials.SigningSecret
	if type(secret) == "string" and string.match(secret, "^hcs_%x+$") then
		return secret
	end
	return nil
end

function Authentication:GetServerId(): string
	return serverId
end

function Authentication:IsConnected(): boolean
	return connected
end

-- Prüft Credentials, Timestamp, Nonce, Signatur und Projektstatus beim Backend.
function Authentication:Verify(): boolean
	local client = framework and framework:TryGetService("APIClient")
	if not client then
		state = "Failed"
		lastError = "APIClient ist nicht verfügbar"
		retryAt = os.clock() + 10
		return false
	end
	verifying = true
	state = "Verifying"
	local ok, data, status, code = client:Request("POST", "/auth/verify", {
		serverId = serverId,
		placeId = tostring(game.PlaceId),
		universeId = tostring(game.GameId),
		isStudio = RunService:IsStudio(),
		frameworkVersion = framework and framework.Version or "1.0.0",
	})
	verifying = false

	if ok then
		connected = true
		state = "Connected"
		failures = 0
		lastSuccess = os.time()
		lastError = nil
		if framework then
			framework:SetServiceStatus(self.Name, "Ok")
			framework.Log:Info("Authentication", "Backend-Verbindung bestätigt", { status = status, serverId = serverId })
			local eventService = framework:TryGetService("EventService")
			if eventService then
				eventService:Fire("BackendConnected", { serverId = serverId })
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	connected = false
	failures += 1
	lastError = tostring(data)
	if status == 401 or status == 403 then
		state = "Rejected"
		retryAt = os.clock() + REJECTED_RETRY_SECONDS
	else
		state = "Failed"
		retryAt = os.clock() + math.min(MAX_RETRY_SECONDS, 2 ^ math.min(failures, 7))
	end
	if framework then
		framework.Log:Warn("Authentication", "Backend-Verbindung fehlgeschlagen", {
			status = status, code = code, reason = lastError, retryIn = math.floor(retryAt - os.clock()),
		})
	end
	return false
end

-- Wird vom APIClient bei 401/403 gemeldet (Key widerrufen/rotiert, Projekt pausiert).
function Authentication:ReportRejected(code: string?, message: string?)
	if not connected and state == "Rejected" then
		return
	end
	connected = false
	state = "Rejected"
	lastError = string.format("%s: %s", tostring(code), tostring(message))
	retryAt = os.clock() + REJECTED_RETRY_SECONDS
	if framework then
		framework.Log:Error("Authentication", "Backend lehnt die Zugangsdaten ab", { code = code })
	end
end

function Authentication:GetAuthStatus(): { [string]: any }
	return {
		state = state,
		connected = connected,
		serverId = serverId,
		lastSuccess = lastSuccess,
		lastError = lastError,
		failures = failures,
		signing = self:GetSigningSecret() ~= nil,
	}
end

function Authentication:Destroy()
	running = false
	apiKey = nil
	connected = false
	state = "Destroyed"
	framework = nil
end

return Authentication
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Backend/Crypto.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Kryptographie für das Headcraft-Backend (nur Server, liegt in ServerScriptService):
--   • SHA-256 und HMAC-SHA256 in reinem Luau (Roblox bietet kein natives HMAC)
--   • canonicalJson(): exakt das Kanonisierungsschema des Backends (@hc/shared → canonicalizeJson):
--       - Objekte: Keys alphabetisch sortiert, keine Leerzeichen
--       - Arrays: Elemente in Reihenfolge
--       - Primitive wie JSON.stringify
--     Der Request-Body wird als genau dieser Text gesendet. Der Server parst ihn, kanonisiert erneut und
--     erhält denselben Text – deshalb ist die Signatur auch hinter dem JSON-umschreibenden Proxy stabil.
-- Kein Service (keine Init-Funktion): Der ModuleLoader überspringt dieses Modul.

local Crypto = {}

local MOD = 4294967296 -- 2^32

local K = {
	0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
	0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
	0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
	0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
	0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
	0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
	0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
	0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
}

local band, bor, bxor, bnot, rrotate, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bxor, bit32.bnot, bit32.rrotate, bit32.rshift

-- Liefert den SHA-256-Digest als 32-Byte-Binärstring.
local function sha256Raw(message: string): string
	local length = #message
	local padding = 64 - ((length + 9) % 64)
	if padding == 64 then
		padding = 0
	end
	local bitLength = length * 8
	local padded = message .. "\128" .. string.rep("\0", padding)
		.. string.pack(">I4I4", math.floor(bitLength / MOD), bitLength % MOD)

	local h0, h1, h2, h3 = 0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a
	local h4, h5, h6, h7 = 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19
	local w = table.create(64, 0)

	for chunk = 1, #padded, 64 do
		for i = 1, 16 do
			w[i] = string.unpack(">I4", padded, chunk + (i - 1) * 4)
		end
		for i = 17, 64 do
			local v15, v2 = w[i - 15], w[i - 2]
			local s0 = bxor(rrotate(v15, 7), rrotate(v15, 18), rshift(v15, 3))
			local s1 = bxor(rrotate(v2, 17), rrotate(v2, 19), rshift(v2, 10))
			w[i] = (w[i - 16] + s0 + w[i - 7] + s1) % MOD
		end

		local a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h = h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7
		for i = 1, 64 do
			local S1 = bxor(rrotate(e, 6), rrotate(e, 11), rrotate(e, 25))
			local ch = bxor(band(e, f), band(bnot(e), g))
			local temp1 = (h + S1 + ch + K[i] + w[i]) % MOD
			local S0 = bxor(rrotate(a, 2), rrotate(a, 13), rrotate(a, 22))
			local maj = bxor(band(a, b), band(a, c), band(b, c))
			local temp2 = (S0 + maj) % MOD
			h, g, f, e = g, f, e, (d + temp1) % MOD
			d, c, b, a = c, b, a, (temp1 + temp2) % MOD
		end

		h0, h1, h2, h3 = (h0 + a) % MOD, (h1 + b) % MOD, (h2 + c) % MOD, (h3 + d) % MOD
		h4, h5, h6, h7 = (h4 + e) % MOD, (h5 + f) % MOD, (h6 + g) % MOD, (h7 + h) % MOD
	end

	return string.pack(">I4I4I4I4I4I4I4I4", h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7)
end

local function toHex(raw: string): string
	return (string.gsub(raw, ".", function(char)
		return string.format("%02x", string.byte(char))
	end))
end

function Crypto.sha256Hex(message: string): string
	return toHex(sha256Raw(message))
end

function Crypto.hmacSha256Hex(key: string, message: string): string
	if #key > 64 then
		key = sha256Raw(key)
	end
	key ..= string.rep("\0", 64 - #key)
	local inner = string.gsub(key, ".", function(char)
		return string.char(bxor(string.byte(char), 0x36))
	end)
	local outer = string.gsub(key, ".", function(char)
		return string.char(bxor(string.byte(char), 0x5c))
	end)
	return toHex(sha256Raw(outer .. sha256Raw(inner .. message)))
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- kanonisches JSON

local ESCAPES = { ['"'] = '\\"', ["\\"] = "\\\\", ["\b"] = "\\b", ["\f"] = "\\f", ["\n"] = "\\n", ["\r"] = "\\r", ["\t"] = "\\t" }

-- Wie JSON.stringify: nur ", \ und Steuerzeichen < 0x20 werden escaped, Unicode bleibt roh (UTF-8).
local function encodeString(value: string): string
	if utf8.len(value) == nil then
		-- Ungültiges UTF-8 würde der Server beim Parsen ersetzen → Signatur passt nicht mehr. Nur ASCII behalten.
		value = string.gsub(value, "[\128-\255]", "?")
	end
	return '"' .. string.gsub(value, '[%c"\\]', function(char)
		local escaped = ESCAPES[char]
		if escaped then
			return escaped
		end
		local byte = string.byte(char)
		if byte < 0x20 then
			return string.format("\\u%04x", byte)
		end
		return char -- 0x7F (DEL) lässt JSON.stringify unverändert
	end) .. '"'
end

-- Zahlen so ausgeben, wie JSON.stringify denselben Wert ausgeben würde (der Server parst unseren Text
-- und kanonisiert ihn erneut – beide Texte müssen identisch sein).
local function encodeNumber(value: number): string
	if value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
		return "null" -- JSON.stringify(NaN/Infinity) = null
	end
	if value == math.floor(value) and math.abs(value) < 1e15 then
		return string.format("%d", value)
	end
	if math.abs(value) >= 1e15 then
		return string.format("%d", math.floor(value))
	end
	-- Nachkommazahlen auf 6 Stellen runden, Nullen am Ende entfernen (0.9 → "0.9", nie Exponentschreibweise)
	local text = string.format("%.6f", value)
	text = string.gsub(text, "0+$", "")
	text = string.gsub(text, "%.$", "")
	if text == "-0" then
		text = "0"
	end
	return text
end

local function isArray(value: { [any]: any }): boolean
	local count = 0
	for key in value do
		if type(key) ~= "number" or key < 1 or key % 1 ~= 0 then
			return false
		end
		count += 1
	end
	return count == #value
end

local function encode(value: any, depth: number): string
	if depth > 32 then
		error("canonicalJson: zu tief verschachtelt")
	end
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "nil" then
		return "null"
	elseif kind == "boolean" then
		return value and "true" or "false"
	elseif kind == "number" then
		return encodeNumber(value)
	elseif kind == "string" then
		return encodeString(value)
	elseif kind == "table" then
		-- Leere Tabellen werden (wie HttpService:JSONEncode) als [] ausgegeben.
		if next(value) == nil or isArray(value) then
			local parts = table.create(#value)
			for index = 1, #value do
				parts[index] = encode(value[index], depth + 1)
			end
			return "[" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "]"
		end
		local keys = {}
		for key in value do
			table.insert(keys, tostring(key))
		end
		table.sort(keys)
		local parts = table.create(#keys)
		for index, key in ipairs(keys) do
			local item = value[key]
			if item == nil then
				item = value[tonumber(key)]
			end
			parts[index] = encodeString(key) .. ":" .. encode(item, depth + 1)
		end
		return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}"
	end
	error("canonicalJson: nicht unterstützter Typ " .. kind)
end

-- Body-Text für Requests und Signatur. nil bzw. leere Tabelle → "" (wie das Backend für leere Bodies).
function Crypto.canonicalJson(value: any): string
	if value == nil or (type(value) == "table" and next(value) == nil) or value == "" then
		return ""
	end
	return encode(value, 0)
end

-- X-Signature = hex(HMAC-SHA256(signingSecret, "${timestamp}.${nonce}.${METHOD}.${cleanPath}.${sha256(body)}"))
function Crypto.signRequest(signingSecret: string, timestamp: string, nonce: string, method: string, cleanPath: string, body: string): string
	local payload = table.concat({ timestamp, nonce, string.upper(method), cleanPath, Crypto.sha256Hex(body) }, ".")
	return Crypto.hmacSha256Hex(signingSecret, payload)
end

return Crypto
```
