`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Core/DataService.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local sharedRoot = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Headcraft")
local sharedInstance = sharedRoot and sharedRoot:FindFirstChild("Shared")
if not sharedInstance then
	error("Headcraft.Shared wurde nicht gefunden.")
end
local sharedFolder: Instance = sharedInstance

local function requireShared(name: string): any
	local moduleScript: Instance? = sharedFolder
	for segment in string.gmatch(name, "[^/]+") do
		moduleScript = moduleScript and moduleScript:FindFirstChild(segment)
	end
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		error("Shared-Modul fehlt: " .. name)
	end
	return require(moduleScript)
end

local Util = requireShared("Utilities/Util")

local DataService = {
	Name = "DataService",
	Dependencies = {},
}

local framework: any
local stores: { [string]: any } = {}
local cache: { [string]: { value: any } } = {}
local memory: { [string]: { [string]: any } } = {}
local memoryMode = false

local MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 64
local MAX_KEY_LENGTH = 64
local MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
local MAX_TABLE_ENTRIES = 5000
local MAX_DEPTH = 8

local function enableMemoryMode(reason: any)
	if memoryMode then
		return
	end
	memoryMode = true
	if framework then
		framework.Log:Warn("DataService", "DataStore nicht verfügbar – In-Memory-Fallback ist aktiv", { reason = tostring(reason) })
	end
end

local function normalizeKey(storeName: any, key: any): (boolean, any)
	if type(storeName) ~= "string" or storeName == "" or #storeName > MAX_NAME_LENGTH then
		return false, "Ungültiger Store-Name"
	end
	if type(key) == "number" and key >= 0 and key % 1 == 0 then
		key = tostring(key)
	end
	if type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" or #key > MAX_KEY_LENGTH then
		return false, "Ungültiger Schlüssel"
	end
	return true, key
end

local function cacheKey(storeName: string, key: string): string
	return storeName .. "\0" .. key
end

local function ensureBucket(storeName: string): { [string]: any }
	local bucket = memory[storeName]
	if not bucket then
		bucket = {}
		memory[storeName] = bucket
	end
	return bucket
end

local function memoryGet(storeName: string, key: string): any
	local bucket = memory[storeName]
	if not bucket then
		return nil
	end
	return bucket[key]
end

local function memorySet(storeName: string, key: string, value: any)
	ensureBucket(storeName)[key] = value
end

local function validateValue(value: any, depth: number?, seen: { [any]: boolean }): (boolean, string?)
	depth = depth or 0
	if depth > MAX_DEPTH then
		return false, "Wert ist zu tief verschachtelt"
	end
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "nil" or kind == "boolean" then
		return true
	end
	if kind == "number" then
		if value ~= value or math.abs(value) == math.huge then
			return false, "Ungültige Zahl im Wert"
		end
		return true
	end
	if kind == "string" then
		if #value > 1000000 then
			return false, "String im Wert ist zu lang"
		end
		return true
	end
	if kind ~= "table" then
		return false, "Nicht unterstützter Wertstyp: " .. kind
	end
	if seen[value] then
		return false, "Zyklische Tabelle im Wert"
	end
	seen[value] = true
	local count = 0
	for key, child in value do
		count += 1
		if count > MAX_TABLE_ENTRIES then
			seen[value] = nil
			return false, "Tabelle im Wert ist zu groß"
		end
		if type(key) ~= "string" and type(key) ~= "number" then
			seen[value] = nil
			return false, "Ungültiger Tabellenschlüssel im Wert"
		end
		local ok, err = validateValue(child, depth + 1, seen)
		if not ok then
			seen[value] = nil
			return false, err
		end
	end
	seen[value] = nil
	return true
end

local function getStore(storeName: string): any?
	if memoryMode then
		return nil
	end
	local store = stores[storeName]
	if store then
		return store
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(storeName)
	end)
	if not ok then
		enableMemoryMode(result)
		return nil
	end
	stores[storeName] = result
	return result
end

local function hasBudget(kind: string): boolean
	if memoryMode then
		return true
	end
	local requestType = if kind == "Get"
		then Enum.DataStoreRequestType.GetAsync
		else Enum.DataStoreRequestType.SetIncrementAsync
	local ok, budget = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetRequestBudgetForRequestType(requestType)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return true
	end
	return type(budget) ~= "number" or budget > 0
end

local function callWithRetry(label: string, storeName: string, kind: string, operation: () -> any, stop: (() -> boolean)?): (boolean, any, boolean)
	local lastError: any = "Unbekannter DataStore-Fehler"
	local sawApiError = false

	for attempt = 1, MAX_ATTEMPTS do
		if not hasBudget(kind) then
			lastError = "DataStore-Budget erschöpft"
			task.wait(math.min(0.5 * attempt, 2))
			continue
		end

		local packed: { any } = table.pack(pcall(operation))
		if packed[1] == true then
			return true, packed[2], false
		end

		sawApiError = true
		lastError = packed[2]
		if stop and stop() then
			return false, packed[2], false
		end
		if attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS then
			task.wait(math.min(0.25 * (2 ^ (attempt - 1)) + math.random() * 0.1, 2))
		end
	end

	if framework then
		framework.Log:Error("DataService", label .. " fehlgeschlagen", { store = storeName, error = tostring(lastError) })
	end
	return false, lastError, sawApiError
end

function DataService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
end

function DataService:Get(storeName: string, key: string): (boolean, any)
	local valid, normalized = normalizeKey(storeName, key)
	if not valid then
		return false, normalized
	end
	local name = storeName :: string
	local normalizedKey = normalized :: string
	local identifier = cacheKey(name, normalizedKey)

	local cached = cache[identifier]
	if cached ~= nil then
		return true, Util.deepCopy(cached.value)
	end
	if memoryMode then
		return true, Util.deepCopy(memoryGet(name, normalizedKey))
	end

	local store = getStore(name)
	if not store then
		return true, Util.deepCopy(memoryGet(name, normalizedKey))
	end

	local ok, value, apiFailed = callWithRetry("Get", name, "Get", function()
		return store:GetAsync(normalizedKey)
	end)
	if not ok then
		if apiFailed then
			enableMemoryMode(value)
			return true, Util.deepCopy(memoryGet(name, normalizedKey))
		end
		return false, value
	end

	cache[identifier] = { value = Util.deepCopy(value) }
	return true, Util.deepCopy(value)
end

function DataService:Set(storeName: string, key: string, value: any): boolean
	local valid, normalized = normalizeKey(storeName, key)
	if not valid then
		return false
	end
	if value == nil then
		return false
	end
	local valueOk, valueError = validateValue(value, 0, {})
	if not valueOk then
		if framework then
			framework.Log:Warn("DataService", "Wert wurde nicht gespeichert", { reason = valueError })
		end
		return false
	end

	local name = storeName :: string
	local normalizedKey = normalized :: string
	local identifier = cacheKey(name, normalizedKey)
	local storedValue = Util.deepCopy(value)

	if memoryMode then
		memorySet(name, normalizedKey, storedValue)
		cache[identifier] = { value = Util.deepCopy(storedValue) }
		return true
	end

	local store = getStore(name)
	if not store then
		memorySet(name, normalizedKey, storedValue)
		cache[identifier] = { value = Util.deepCopy(storedValue) }
		return true
	end

	local ok, result, apiFailed = callWithRetry("Set", name, "Set", function()
		store:SetAsync(normalizedKey, storedValue)
	end)
	if not ok then
		if apiFailed then
			enableMemoryMode(result)
			memorySet(name, normalizedKey, storedValue)
			cache[identifier] = { value = Util.deepCopy(storedValue) }
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	cache[identifier] = { value = Util.deepCopy(storedValue) }
	return true
end

function DataService:Update(storeName: string, key: string, transform: (any) -> any): (boolean, any)
	local valid, normalized = normalizeKey(storeName, key)
	if not valid then
		return false, normalized
	end
	if type(transform) ~= "function" then
		return false, "Update erwartet eine Funktion"
	end

	local name = storeName :: string
	local normalizedKey = normalized :: string
	local identifier = cacheKey(name, normalizedKey)

	local function applyTransform(old: any): (boolean, any)
		local ok, result = pcall(transform, Util.deepCopy(old))
		if not ok then
			return false, result
		end
		if result == nil then
			return false, "Update-Funktion darf nil nicht zurückgeben"
		end
		local valueOk, valueError = validateValue(result, 0, {})
		if not valueOk then
			return false, valueError
		end
		return true, Util.deepCopy(result)
	end

	if memoryMode then
		local ok, result = applyTransform(memoryGet(name, normalizedKey))
		if not ok then
			return false, result
		end
		memorySet(name, normalizedKey, result)
		cache[identifier] = { value = Util.deepCopy(result) }
		return true, Util.deepCopy(result)
	end

	local store = getStore(name)
	if not store then
		local ok, result = applyTransform(memoryGet(name, normalizedKey))
		if not ok then
			return false, result
		end
		memorySet(name, normalizedKey, result)
		cache[identifier] = { value = Util.deepCopy(result) }
		return true, Util.deepCopy(result)
	end

	local transformFailed = false
	local transformError: any
	local ok, result, apiFailed = callWithRetry("Update", name, "Set", function()
		return store:UpdateAsync(normalizedKey, function(old: any)
			local applied, newValue = applyTransform(old)
			if not applied then
				transformFailed = true
				transformError = newValue
				error(newValue, 0)
			end
			return newValue
		end)
	end, function()
		return transformFailed
	end)

	if transformFailed then
		return false, tostring(transformError)
	end
	if not ok then
		if apiFailed then
			enableMemoryMode(result)
			local applied, newValue = applyTransform(memoryGet(name, normalizedKey))
			if not applied then
				return false, newValue
			end
			memorySet(name, normalizedKey, newValue)
			cache[identifier] = { value = Util.deepCopy(newValue) }
			return true, Util.deepCopy(newValue)
		end
		return false, result
	end

	cache[identifier] = { value = Util.deepCopy(result) }
	return true, Util.deepCopy(result)
end

function DataService:Remove(storeName: string, key: string): boolean
	local valid, normalized = normalizeKey(storeName, key)
	if not valid then
		return false
	end
	local name = storeName :: string
	local normalizedKey = normalized :: string
	local identifier = cacheKey(name, normalizedKey)

	if memoryMode then
		memorySet(name, normalizedKey, nil)
		cache[identifier] = { value = nil }
		return true
	end

	local store = getStore(name)
	if not store then
		memorySet(name, normalizedKey, nil)
		cache[identifier] = { value = nil }
		return true
	end

	local ok, result, apiFailed = callWithRetry("Remove", name, "Set", function()
		store:RemoveAsync(normalizedKey)
	end)
	if not ok then
		if apiFailed then
			enableMemoryMode(result)
			memorySet(name, normalizedKey, nil)
			cache[identifier] = { value = nil }
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	cache[identifier] = { value = nil }
	return true
end

function DataService:IsMemoryMode(): boolean
	return memoryMode
end

function DataService:GetCacheSize(): number
	local count = 0
	for _ in cache do
		count += 1
	end
	return count
end

function DataService:ClearCache(storeName: string?)
	if type(storeName) == "string" then
		local prefix = storeName .. "\0"
		for identifier in cache do
			if string.sub(identifier, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
				cache[identifier] = nil
			end
		end
		return
	end
	table.clear(cache)
end

function DataService:Destroy()
	table.clear(stores)
	table.clear(cache)
	table.clear(memory)
	framework = nil
end

return DataService

```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Core/EventService.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local sharedRoot = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Headcraft")
local sharedInstance = sharedRoot and sharedRoot:FindFirstChild("Shared")
if not sharedInstance then
	error("Headcraft.Shared wurde nicht gefunden.")
end
local sharedFolder: Instance = sharedInstance

local function requireShared(name: string): any
	local moduleScript: Instance? = sharedFolder
	for segment in string.gmatch(name, "[^/]+") do
		moduleScript = moduleScript and moduleScript:FindFirstChild(segment)
	end
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		error("Shared-Modul fehlt: " .. name)
	end
	return require(moduleScript)
end

local Constants = requireShared("Constants")
local Signal = requireShared("Utilities/Signal")
local Ring = requireShared("Utilities/Ring")
local Util = requireShared("Utilities/Util")

local EventService = {
	Name = "EventService",
	Dependencies = {},
}

local framework: any
local signals: { [string]: any } = {}
local connections: { any } = {}
local activity = Ring.new(200)

local DISCORD_EVENTS = {
	[Constants.Events.PlayerJoined] = true,
	[Constants.Events.PlayerLeft] = true,
	[Constants.Events.Detection] = true,
	[Constants.Events.ModerationAction] = true,
	[Constants.Events.CommandExecuted] = true,
	[Constants.Events.ServerEvent] = true,
	[Constants.Events.SecurityAlert] = true,
}

local ACTIVITY_EVENTS = {
	[Constants.Events.PlayerJoined] = true,
	[Constants.Events.PlayerLeft] = true,
	[Constants.Events.ModerationAction] = true,
	[Constants.Events.Detection] = true,
	[Constants.Events.CommandExecuted] = true,
}

local function newId(): string
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	end)
	if ok and type(value) == "string" then
		return value
	end
	return string.format("activity-%d-%d", os.time(), math.random(1, 1000000000))
end

local function severityValue(value: any): number
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return value
	end
	if type(value) == "string" then
		return (Constants.Severity :: { [string]: number })[value] or -1
	end
	return -1
end

local function makeActivityItem(eventName: string, payload: { [string]: any }): any?
	local kind: string
	local message: string
	local userId: number?

	if eventName == Constants.Events.PlayerJoined then
		kind = "Join"
		userId = tonumber(payload.userId)
		message = tostring(payload.name or payload.userId or "Unbekannt") .. " ist beigetreten."
	elseif eventName == Constants.Events.PlayerLeft then
		kind = "Leave"
		userId = tonumber(payload.userId)
		message = tostring(payload.name or payload.userId or "Unbekannt") .. " hat den Server verlassen."
	elseif eventName == Constants.Events.ModerationAction then
		local record = type(payload.action) == "table" and payload.action or {}
		kind = "ModerationAction"
		userId = tonumber(record.UserId)
		message = "Moderation: " .. tostring(record.Type or "Aktion") .. " gegen " .. tostring(record.UserId or "?") .. "."
	elseif eventName == Constants.Events.Detection then
		local detection = type(payload.detection) == "table" and payload.detection or {}
		kind = "Detection"
		userId = tonumber(detection.UserId)
		message = "Anti-Cheat: " .. tostring(detection.Category or "Erkennung") .. " bei " .. tostring(detection.UserId or "?") .. "."
	elseif eventName == Constants.Events.CommandExecuted then
		kind = "CommandExecuted"
		userId = tonumber(payload.userId)
		message = "Command " .. tostring(payload.commandName or "?") .. (payload.success == true and " ausgeführt." or " fehlgeschlagen.")
	else
		return nil
	end

	return {
		Id = newId(),
		Kind = kind,
		Message = Util.truncate(message, 160),
		Timestamp = os.time(),
		UserId = userId,
	}
end

local function pushActivity(item: any)
	if not framework then
		return
	end
	local remoteService = framework:TryGetService("RemoteService")
	if remoteService and type(remoteService.PushToPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(remoteService.PushToPermission, remoteService, Constants.Permissions.AdminPanel, Constants.Channels.Activity, item)
		if not ok then
			framework.Log:Warn("EventService", "Aktivitäts-Push fehlgeschlagen", { error = tostring(err) })
		end
	end
end

local function forwardToDiscord(eventName: string, payload: { [string]: any })
	if not framework or not DISCORD_EVENTS[eventName] then
		return
	end
	if eventName == Constants.Events.Detection then
		local detection = type(payload.detection) == "table" and payload.detection or {}
		if severityValue(detection.Severity) < Constants.Severity.Medium then
			return
		end
	end

	local syncManager = framework:TryGetService("SyncManager")
	if syncManager and type(syncManager.QueueEvent) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(syncManager.QueueEvent, syncManager, eventName, Util.deepCopy(payload))
		if not ok then
			framework.Log:Warn("EventService", "Discord-Event konnte nicht eingereiht werden", { event = eventName, error = tostring(err) })
		end
	end
end

function EventService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
end

function EventService:Start()
	framework.Log:Info("EventService", "Event-Bus bereit", { activityCapacity = 200 })
end

function EventService:Fire(eventName: string, payload: any): boolean
	if type(eventName) ~= "string" or eventName == "" or #eventName > 64 then
		if framework then
			framework.Log:Warn("EventService", "Ungültiger Eventname verworfen", { event = tostring(eventName) })
		end
		return false
	end
	if type(payload) ~= "table" then
		if framework then
			framework.Log:Warn("EventService", "Event-Payload muss eine Tabelle sein", { event = eventName })
		end
		return false
	end

	local signal = signals[eventName]
	if not signal then
		signal = Signal.new()
		signals[eventName] = signal
	end

	if eventName == Constants.Events.SecurityAlert and framework then
		framework.Log:Write("Security", "Warn", "EventService", tostring(payload.message or "Sicherheitswarnung"), payload)
	end

	if ACTIVITY_EVENTS[eventName] then
		local item = makeActivityItem(eventName, payload)
		if item then
			activity:Push(item)
			pushActivity(item)
		end
	end

	forwardToDiscord(eventName, payload)
	signal:Fire(payload)
	return true
end

function EventService:Connect(eventName: string, fn: (payload: any) -> ()): any
	if type(eventName) ~= "string" or eventName == "" or #eventName > 64 or type(fn) ~= "function" then
		if framework then
			framework.Log:Warn("EventService", "Ungültige Event-Verbindung verworfen", { event = tostring(eventName) })
		end
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end

	local signal = signals[eventName]
	if not signal then
		signal = Signal.new()
		signals[eventName] = signal
	end

	local listenerCount = 0
	for _ in pairs(signal._listeners) do
		listenerCount += 1
	end
	if listenerCount >= 128 then
		if framework then
			framework.Log:Warn("EventService", "Maximale Anzahl an Zuhörern erreicht", { event = eventName })
		end
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end

	local inner = signal:Connect(fn)
	local wrapper: any = {}
	function wrapper:Disconnect()
		inner:Disconnect()
		for index, candidate in connections do
			if candidate == wrapper then
				table.remove(connections, index)
				break
			end
		end
	end

	table.insert(connections, wrapper)
	return wrapper
end

function EventService:GetActivity(limit: number?): { any }
	local values = activity:ToArray(true)
	if type(limit) == "number" then
		local count = math.clamp(math.floor(limit), 0, 200)
		while #values > count do
			table.remove(values)
		end
	end
	return values
end

function EventService:GetRecentActivity(limit: number?): { any }
	return self:GetActivity(limit)
end

function EventService:Destroy()
	for _, connection in table.clone(connections) do
		local ok, err = pcall(connection.Disconnect, connection)
		if not ok and framework then
			framework.Log:Warn("EventService", "Verbindung konnte nicht getrennt werden", { error = tostring(err) })
		end
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	table.clear(signals)
	activity:Clear()
	framework = nil
end

return EventService
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Core/Framework.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local root = script.Parent.Parent
local sharedRoot = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Headcraft")
local sharedInstance = sharedRoot and sharedRoot:FindFirstChild("Shared")
if not sharedInstance then
	error("Headcraft.Shared wurde nicht gefunden. Bitte das Rojo-Projekt synchronisieren.")
end
local shared: Instance = sharedInstance

local function requireShared(name: string): any
	local moduleScript: Instance? = shared
	for segment in string.gmatch(name, "[^/]+") do
		moduleScript = moduleScript and moduleScript:FindFirstChild(segment)
	end
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		error("Shared-Modul fehlt: " .. name)
	end
	return require(moduleScript)
end

local Constants = requireShared("Constants")
local Util = requireShared("Utilities/Util")
local LogModule = requireShared("Utilities/Log")

local configModule = root:FindFirstChild("Configuration")
if not configModule or not configModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
	error("Server-Konfiguration fehlt: ServerScriptService.Headcraft.Configuration")
end

local ServerConfig = require(configModule)
local ClientConfig = requireShared("Configuration")
local Config = Util.deepMerge(ClientConfig, ServerConfig)

local maxEntries = 1000
if type(Config.Logging) == "table" and type(Config.Logging.MaxEntries) == "number" then
	maxEntries = math.clamp(math.floor(Config.Logging.MaxEntries), 1, 10000)
end

local Framework: any = {
	Version = Constants.Version,
	Started = false,
	Config = Config,
	Log = LogModule.new(maxEntries),
	_services = {},
	_status = {},
	_groups = {},
	_loader = nil,
}

function Framework:GetService(name: string): any
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		error("GetService erwartet einen nicht leeren Service-Namen.")
	end
	local service = self._services[name]
	if service == nil then
		error("Unbekannter Service: " .. name)
	end
	return service
end

function Framework:TryGetService(name: string): any?
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return nil
	end
	return self._services[name]
end

function Framework:RegisterService(name: string, service: any, group: string?)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or type(service) ~= "table" then
		error("RegisterService erwartet einen Namen und eine Service-Tabelle.")
	end
	self._services[name] = service
	if type(group) == "string" then
		self._groups[name] = group
	end
	if self._status[name] == nil then
		self._status[name] = "Ok"
	end
end

function Framework:SetServiceStatus(name: string, status: string)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return
	end
	local allowed = { Ok = true, Failed = true, Disabled = true }
	if allowed[status] ~= true then
		return
	end
	self._status[name] = status
end

function Framework:GetStatus(): { [string]: any }
	local result: { [string]: any } = {}
	for name, status in pairs(self._status) do
		result[name] = status
	end
	for name, service in pairs(self._services) do
		if self._groups[name] == "Backend" and type(service.GetStatus) == "function" then
			local ok, status = pcall(service.GetStatus, service)
			if ok and type(status) == "table" then
				result.Backend = Util.deepMerge(result.Backend or {}, status)
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

function Framework:_notifyConfigChanged(path: string, value: any)
	local eventService = self:TryGetService("EventService")
	if eventService and type(eventService.Fire) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(eventService.Fire, eventService, "ConfigChanged", { path = path, value = value })
		if not ok then
			self.Log:Warn("Framework", "ConfigChanged konnte nicht gefeuert werden", { error = tostring(err) })
		end
	end
end

local ALLOWED_THRESHOLDS = { Ban = true, TempBan = true, Kick = true, Warn = true, NotifyAdmin = true, Log = true }
local ALLOWED_ACTIONS = ALLOWED_THRESHOLDS
local ALLOWED_MODULES = {
	Speed = true, Fly = true, Noclip = true, Teleport = true, Jump = true, Humanoid = true,
	Physics = true, Remote = true, Tool = true, Character = true, Pattern = true, Instance = true,
}

function Framework:ApplyRemoteConfig(partial: any): boolean
	if type(partial) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	local changed = 0

	local function applyAntiCheat(values: any)
		if type(values) ~= "table" or type(Config.AntiCheat) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local target = Config.AntiCheat
		if type(values.Enabled) == "boolean" then
			target.Enabled = values.Enabled
			changed += 1
			self:_notifyConfigChanged("AntiCheat.Enabled", values.Enabled)
		end
		if values.DetectionMode == "Monitor" or values.DetectionMode == "Enforce" then
			target.DetectionMode = values.DetectionMode
			changed += 1
			self:_notifyConfigChanged("AntiCheat.DetectionMode", values.DetectionMode)
		end
		if type(values.AutomaticActions) == "boolean" then
			target.AutomaticActions = values.AutomaticActions
			changed += 1
			self:_notifyConfigChanged("AntiCheat.AutomaticActions", values.AutomaticActions)
		end
		if type(values.RiskDecayPerMinute) == "number" and values.RiskDecayPerMinute >= 0 and values.RiskDecayPerMinute <= 100 then
			target.RiskDecayPerMinute = values.RiskDecayPerMinute
			changed += 1
			self:_notifyConfigChanged("AntiCheat.RiskDecayPerMinute", values.RiskDecayPerMinute)
		end
		if type(values.Thresholds) == "table" and type(target.Thresholds) == "table" then
			for key, value in pairs(values.Thresholds) do
				if ALLOWED_THRESHOLDS[key] == true and type(value) == "number" and value >= 0 and value <= 100000 then
					target.Thresholds[key] = value
					changed += 1
					self:_notifyConfigChanged("AntiCheat.Thresholds." .. key, value)
				end
			end
		end
		if type(values.Actions) == "table" and type(target.Actions) == "table" then
			for key, action in pairs(values.Actions) do
				if ALLOWED_ACTIONS[key] == true and type(action) == "table" and type(target.Actions[key]) == "table" then
					local destination = target.Actions[key]
					if type(action.CooldownSeconds) == "number" and action.CooldownSeconds >= 5 and action.CooldownSeconds <= 3600 then
						destination.CooldownSeconds = action.CooldownSeconds
						changed += 1
						self:_notifyConfigChanged("AntiCheat.Actions." .. key .. ".CooldownSeconds", action.CooldownSeconds)
					end
					if type(action.DurationSeconds) == "number" and action.DurationSeconds >= 60 and action.DurationSeconds <= 2592000 then
						destination.DurationSeconds = action.DurationSeconds
						changed += 1
						self:_notifyConfigChanged("AntiCheat.Actions." .. key .. ".DurationSeconds", action.DurationSeconds)
					end
					if type(action.Enabled) == "boolean" then
						destination.Enabled = action.Enabled
						changed += 1
						self:_notifyConfigChanged("AntiCheat.Actions." .. key .. ".Enabled", action.Enabled)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if type(values.Modules) == "table" and type(target.Modules) == "table" then
			for key, moduleConfig in pairs(values.Modules) do
				if ALLOWED_MODULES[key] == true and type(moduleConfig) == "table" and type(moduleConfig.Enabled) == "boolean" then
					if type(target.Modules[key]) ~= "table" then
						target.Modules[key] = {}
					end
					target.Modules[key].Enabled = moduleConfig.Enabled
					changed += 1
					self:_notifyConfigChanged("AntiCheat.Modules." .. key .. ".Enabled", moduleConfig.Enabled)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function applyAdmin(values: any)
		if type(values) ~= "table" or type(Config.Admin) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		if type(values.Enabled) == "boolean" then
			Config.Admin.Enabled = values.Enabled
			changed += 1
			self:_notifyConfigChanged("Admin.Enabled", values.Enabled)
		end
		if type(values.Prefix) == "string" and #values.Prefix >= 1 and #values.Prefix <= 8 then
			Config.Admin.Prefix = values.Prefix
			changed += 1
			self:_notifyConfigChanged("Admin.Prefix", values.Prefix)
		end
	end

	local function applyInterface(values: any)
		if type(values) ~= "table" or type(Config.Interface) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		if type(values.Enabled) == "boolean" then
			Config.Interface.Enabled = values.Enabled
			changed += 1
			self:_notifyConfigChanged("Interface.Enabled", values.Enabled)
		end
		if type(values.Theme) == "string" and #values.Theme >= 1 and #values.Theme <= 32 then
			Config.Interface.Theme = values.Theme
			changed += 1
			self:_notifyConfigChanged("Interface.Theme", values.Theme)
		end
	end

	applyAntiCheat(partial.antiCheat)
	applyAdmin(partial.admin)
	applyInterface(partial.interface)

	if changed > 0 then
		self.Log:Info("Framework", "Ferngesteuerte Konfiguration übernommen", { changes = changed })
	end
	return changed > 0
end

function Framework:Start()
	if self.Started then
		self.Log:Warn("Framework", "Start wurde mehrfach aufgerufen – zweiter Aufruf ignoriert.")
		return
	end
	self.Started = true
	local ok, loaderOrError = pcall(require, script.Parent.ModuleLoader)
	if not ok then
		self.Log:Error("Framework", "ModuleLoader konnte nicht geladen werden", { error = tostring(loaderOrError) })
		return
	end
	self._loader = loaderOrError
	local loadOk, loadError = pcall(loaderOrError.Load, loaderOrError, self)
	if not loadOk then
		self.Log:Error("Framework", "Service-Laden ist fehlgeschlagen", { error = tostring(loadError) })
	end
	self:_createDebugHook()
end

-- Debug-Schnittstelle für Studio-Werkzeuge und Tests. Liegt in ServerScriptService (wird nie repliziert),
-- daher können Clients sie weder sehen noch aufrufen. Plugins/Befehlsleiste haben einen eigenen
-- require-Cache und erreichen die laufende Instanz nur über diesen Weg.
function Framework:_createDebugHook()
	local hook = root:FindFirstChild("HeadcraftDebug")
	if hook then
		hook:Destroy()
	end
	local bindable = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
	bindable.Name = "HeadcraftDebug"
	bindable.OnInvoke = function(action: any, args: any)
		if action == "status" then
			return { started = self.Started, version = self.Version, services = self:GetStatus() }
		elseif action == "logs" then
			local category = type(args) == "table" and args.category or nil
			local limit = type(args) == "table" and tonumber(args.limit) or 100
			return self.Log:Get(category, limit)
		elseif action == "service" and type(args) == "table" and type(args.name) == "string" and type(args.method) == "string" then
			-- Ruft eine Service-Methode auf (nur für Tests in Studio)
			local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
			if not RunService:IsStudio() then
				return { ok = false, error = "Nur in Studio verfügbar" }
			end
			local service = self:TryGetService(args.name)
			local method = service and service[args.method]
			if type(method) ~= "function" then
				return { ok = false, error = "Unbekannte Methode" }
			end
			local results = table.pack(pcall(method, service, table.unpack(args.args or {})))
			return { ok = results[1], results = { table.unpack(results, 2, results.n) } }
		end
		return { ok = false, error = "Unbekannte Debug-Aktion" }
	end
	bindable.Parent = root
end

function Framework:Destroy()
	if self._loader then
		local order = self._loader:GetOrder()
		for index = #order, 1, -1 do
			local service = self._services[order[index]]
			if service and type(service.Destroy) == "function" then
				local ok, err = pcall(service.Destroy, service)
				if not ok then
					self.Log:Warn("Framework", "Destroy eines Services ist fehlgeschlagen", { service = order[index], error = tostring(err) })
				end
			end
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._services)
	table.clear(self._status)
	table.clear(self._groups)
	self._loader = nil
	self.Started = false
end

return Framework
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Core/ModuleLoader.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
local root = script.Parent.Parent
local FOLDERS = { "Core", "Backend", "Commands", "Moderation", "AntiCheat" }
local MAX_DEPENDENCIES = 32

local ModuleLoader = { _loaded = false, _order = {} }

local function fail(framework, name: string, message: string)
	framework:SetServiceStatus(name, "Failed")
	framework.Log:Error("ModuleLoader", message, { service = name })
end

local function isDisabled(framework, service: any, group: string): boolean
	if service.Disabled == true then
		return true
	end
	local servicesConfig = framework.Config and framework.Config.Services
	if type(servicesConfig) == "table" and servicesConfig[service.Name] == false then
		return true
	end
	if group == "AntiCheat" then
		local antiCheat = framework.Config and framework.Config.AntiCheat
		if type(antiCheat) == "table" and antiCheat.Enabled == false then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function collectNodes(framework): { [string]: any }
	local nodes: { [string]: any } = {}

	for _, folderName in FOLDERS do
		local folder = root:FindFirstChild(folderName)
		if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") then
			framework.Log:Debug("ModuleLoader", "Ordner nicht vorhanden – wird übersprungen", { folder = folderName })
			continue
		end

		for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do
			if not child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				continue
			end
			if folderName == "Core" and (child.Name == "Framework" or child.Name == "ModuleLoader") then
				continue
			end

			local ok, service = pcall(require, child)
			if not ok then
				fail(framework, child.Name, "Service konnte nicht geladen werden: " .. tostring(service))
				continue
			end
			if type(service) ~= "table" or type(service.Name) ~= "string" or service.Name == "" or type(service.Init) ~= "function" then
				framework.Log:Debug("ModuleLoader", "Kein Service – wird übersprungen", { module = child.Name })
				continue
			end
			if service.Name ~= child.Name then
				fail(framework, child.Name, "Service-Name entspricht nicht dem Dateinamen: " .. tostring(service.Name))
				continue
			end
			if nodes[service.Name] then
				fail(framework, service.Name, "Doppelter Service-Name")
				continue
			end

			local dependencies: { string } = {}
			if type(service.Dependencies) == "table" then
				for _, dependency in service.Dependencies do
					if type(dependency) == "string" and dependency ~= "" then
						if #dependencies >= MAX_DEPENDENCIES then
							framework.Log:Warn("ModuleLoader", "Zu viele Abhängigkeiten – weitere ignoriert", { service = service.Name })
							break
						end
						table.insert(dependencies, dependency)
					else
						framework.Log:Warn("ModuleLoader", "Ungültige Abhängigkeit ignoriert", { service = service.Name })
					end
				end
			end

			if isDisabled(framework, service, folderName) then
				framework:SetServiceStatus(service.Name, "Disabled")
				framework.Log:Info("ModuleLoader", "Service ist deaktiviert", { service = service.Name })
				continue
			end

			nodes[service.Name] = {
				name = service.Name,
				service = service,
				dependencies = dependencies,
				group = folderName,
			}
		end
	end

	return nodes
end

local function topologicalOrder(framework, nodes: { [string]: any }): { string }
	local visiting: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local visited: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local cycleNodes: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local order: { string } = {}

	local function visit(name: string, stack: { string })
		if visited[name] then
			return
		end
		if visiting[name] then
			local cycle: { string } = {}
			local started = false
			for _, entry in stack do
				if entry == name then
					started = true
				end
				if started then
					table.insert(cycle, entry)
				end
			end
			table.insert(cycle, name)
			for _, entry in cycle do
				cycleNodes[entry] = true
			end
			framework.Log:Error("ModuleLoader", "Abhängigkeitszyklus erkannt: " .. table.concat(cycle, " -> "))
			return
		end

		visiting[name] = true
		table.insert(stack, name)

		local dependencies: { string } = {}
		for _, dependency in nodes[name].dependencies do
			if nodes[dependency] then
				table.insert(dependencies, dependency)
			else
				framework.Log:Debug("ModuleLoader", "Optionale Abhängigkeit nicht vorhanden", { service = name, dependency = dependency })
			end
		end
		table.sort(dependencies)
		for _, dependency in dependencies do
			visit(dependency, stack)
		end

		table.remove(stack)
		visiting[name] = nil
		visited[name] = true
		table.insert(order, name)
	end

	local names: { string } = {}
	for name in nodes do
		table.insert(names, name)
	end
	table.sort(names)
	for _, name in names do
		visit(name, {})
	end

	local result: { string } = {}
	for _, name in order do
		if not cycleNodes[name] then
			table.insert(result, name)
		end
	end
	for name in cycleNodes do
		fail(framework, name, "Service wurde wegen eines Abhängigkeitszyklus nicht gestartet")
	end
	return result
end

function ModuleLoader:Load(framework: any): { string }
	if self._loaded then
		framework.Log:Warn("ModuleLoader", "Load wurde mehrfach aufgerufen – zweiter Aufruf ignoriert.")
		return table.clone(self._order)
	end
	self._loaded = true

	local nodes = collectNodes(framework)
	local order = topologicalOrder(framework, nodes)
	self._order = order

	for _, name in order do
		local node = nodes[name]
		local ok, result = pcall(node.service.Init, node.service, framework)
		if not ok or result == false then
			local reason = if ok then "Init lieferte false" else tostring(result)
			fail(framework, name, "Init fehlgeschlagen: " .. reason)
		else
			framework:RegisterService(name, node.service, node.group)
			framework:SetServiceStatus(name, "Ok")
		end
	end

	for _, name in order do
		if framework:GetStatus()[name] == "Ok" then
			local node = nodes[name]
			if type(node.service.Start) == "function" then
				task.spawn(function()
					local ok, err = pcall(node.service.Start, node.service)
					if not ok then
						fail(framework, name, "Start fehlgeschlagen: " .. tostring(err))
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	framework.Log:Info("ModuleLoader", "Services initialisiert", { count = #order })
	return table.clone(order)
end

function ModuleLoader:GetOrder(): { string }
	return table.clone(self._order)
end

return ModuleLoader
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Core/PermissionService.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- PermissionService: Rangauflösung, Rechteprüfung und Verwaltung von Rollen.
-- Quellen (absteigende Priorität): Backend-Sync, DataStore (Headcraft_Ranks),
-- Configuration/Ranks.luau (UserIds und Gruppen-Ränge). Der Platzbesitzer ist
-- immer Owner. Individuelle Grants/Revokes überschreiben Rollenrechte,
-- dabei gilt: Revoke > Grant > Rolle.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Signal = require(Shared.Utilities.Signal)
local Maid = require(Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)
local RanksConfig = require(script.Parent.Parent.Configuration.Ranks)

local STORE = "Headcraft_Ranks"
local KEY_ASSIGNMENTS = "Assignments"
local KEY_CUSTOM_ROLES = "CustomRoles"

local GROUP_CACHE_SECONDS = 60
local USER_CACHE_SECONDS = 30
local OWNER_CACHE_SECONDS = 60

local PermissionService = {
	Name = "PermissionService",
	Dependencies = {},
	Changed = Signal.new(),
}

local framework: any
local maid: any

-- Aufgelöste, konkrete Permissions (ohne Wildcards) für die Expansion.
local CONCRETE_PERMISSIONS: { string } = {}

local function buildConcretePermissions()
	local list = {}
	for _, value in pairs(Constants.Permissions) do
		if type(value) == "string" and value ~= "*" and string.sub(value, -2) ~= ".*" then
			table.insert(list, value)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return list
end

local function patternMatches(pattern: string, permission: string): boolean
	if pattern == "*" then
		return true
	end
	if pattern == permission then
		return true
	end
	if string.sub(pattern, -2) == ".*" then
		local prefix = string.sub(pattern, 1, #pattern - 1)
		return string.sub(permission, 1, #prefix) == prefix
	end
	return false
end

local function copyList(values: any): { string }
	local result = {}
	if type(values) ~= "table" then
		return result
	end
	for _, value in ipairs(values) do
		if type(value) == "string" then
			table.insert(result, value)
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function copyRole(role: any): any
	return {
		Name = role.Name,
		Priority = role.Priority,
		Inherits = copyList(role.Inherits),
		Permissions = copyList(role.Permissions),
		Color = role.Color,
	}
end

local function isValidPermission(value: any): boolean
	if type(value) ~= "string" or #value == 0 or #value > 100 then
		return false
	end
	if value == "*" then
		return true
	end
	return string.match(value, "^[%w_]+%.[%w_%.%*]+$") ~= nil
end

local function normalizeUserId(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		return value.UserId
	end
	if type(value) == "number" and value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

function PermissionService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	maid = Maid.new()

	self._roles = {}
	self._roleIndex = {}
	self._customRoles = {}
	self._assignments = {}
	self._backendAssignments = {}
	self._groupCache = {}
	self._ownerCache = {}
	self._userCache = {}
	self._rolePermissionCache = {}
	self._version = 1
	self._loaded = false

	CONCRETE_PERMISSIONS = buildConcretePermissions()

	for name, role in pairs(Constants.DefaultRoles) do
		self._roles[name] = copyRole(role)
	end

	-- Optionale Start-Rollen aus der Serverkonfiguration.
	if type(RanksConfig.Roles) == "table" then
		for name, role in pairs(RanksConfig.Roles) do
			local normalized = self:_normalizeRole(role, { [name] = true })
			if normalized ~= nil then
				self._roles[normalized.Name] = normalized
				self._customRoles[normalized.Name] = true
			elseif framework ~= nil then
				framework.Log:Warn("PermissionService", "Ungültige Rolle in Ranks.luau verworfen: " .. tostring(name))
			end
		end
	end

	self:_rebuildRoleIndex()

	maid:Give(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		self._groupCache[player.UserId] = nil
		self._ownerCache[player.UserId] = nil
		self._userCache[player.UserId] = nil
	end))
end

function PermissionService:Start()
	self:_loadPersisted()
end

function PermissionService:_rebuildRoleIndex()
	local index = {}
	for name in pairs(self._roles) do
		index[string.lower(name)] = name
	end
	self._roleIndex = index
end

function PermissionService:_findRole(name: any): any?
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local direct = self._roles[name]
	if direct ~= nil then
		return direct
	end
	local canonical = self._roleIndex[string.lower(name)]
	if canonical ~= nil then
		return self._roles[canonical]
	end
	return nil
end

function PermissionService:_normalizeRole(role: any, knownNames: { [string]: boolean }?, allowReserved: boolean?): (any?, string?)
	if type(role) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Rolle muss eine Tabelle sein."
	end
	if type(role.Name) ~= "string" or #role.Name == 0 or #role.Name > 32 or not string.match(role.Name, "^[%a][%w_]*$") then
		return nil, "Ungültiger Rollenname."
	end
	local minPriority = allowReserved == true and 0 or 1
	local maxPriority = allowReserved == true and 100 or 99
	if type(role.Priority) ~= "number" or role.Priority % 1 ~= 0 or role.Priority < minPriority or role.Priority > maxPriority then
		return nil, string.format("Priorität muss eine ganze Zahl zwischen %d und %d sein.", minPriority, maxPriority)
	end

	local permissions = {}
	if type(role.Permissions) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "Permissions muss eine Liste sein."
	end
	for _, permission in ipairs(role.Permissions) do
		if not isValidPermission(permission) then
			return nil, "Ungültige Permission: " .. tostring(permission)
		end
		table.insert(permissions, permission)
	end

	local inherits = {}
	if type(role.Inherits) == "table" then
		for _, parent in ipairs(role.Inherits) do
			if type(parent) ~= "string" then
				return nil, "Ungültige Vererbung."
			end
			local exists = (knownNames ~= nil and knownNames[parent] == true)
				or self._roles[parent] ~= nil
				or self._roleIndex[string.lower(parent)] ~= nil
			if not exists and parent ~= role.Name then
				return nil, "Unbekannte geerbte Rolle: " .. parent
			end
			table.insert(inherits, parent)
		end
	end

	local color = role.Color
	if type(color) ~= "string" or not string.match(color, "^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then
		color = "#9CA3AF"
	end

	return {
		Name = role.Name,
		Priority = role.Priority,
		Inherits = inherits,
		Permissions = permissions,
		Color = color,
	}, nil
end

function PermissionService:_loadPersisted()
	local dataService = framework and framework:TryGetService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		self._loaded = true
		return
	end

	local rolesOk, rolesSuccess, storedRoles = pcall(function()
		return dataService:Get(STORE, KEY_CUSTOM_ROLES)
	end)
	if rolesOk and rolesSuccess and type(storedRoles) == "table" then
		for name, role in pairs(storedRoles) do
			local normalized = self:_normalizeRole(role, nil)
			if normalized ~= nil and normalized.Name == name then
				self._roles[normalized.Name] = normalized
				self._customRoles[normalized.Name] = true
			end
		end
		self:_rebuildRoleIndex()
	elseif not rolesOk and framework ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Warn("PermissionService", "Benutzerdefinierte Rollen konnten nicht geladen werden.")
	end

	local assignmentsOk, assignmentsSuccess, storedAssignments = pcall(function()
		return dataService:Get(STORE, KEY_ASSIGNMENTS)
	end)
	if assignmentsOk and assignmentsSuccess and type(storedAssignments) == "table" then
		for key, entry in pairs(storedAssignments) do
			local userId = tonumber(key)
			if userId ~= nil and userId % 1 == 0 and type(entry) == "table" then
				local rank = nil
				if type(entry.rank) == "string" and self:_findRole(entry.rank) ~= nil then
					rank = self:_findRole(entry.rank).Name
				end
				self._assignments[userId] = {
					rank = rank,
					grants = copyList(entry.grants),
					revokes = copyList(entry.revokes),
				}
			end
		end
	elseif not assignmentsOk and framework ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Warn("PermissionService", "Rangzuweisungen konnten nicht geladen werden.")
	end

	self._version += 1
	self._userCache = {}
	self._rolePermissionCache = {}
	self._loaded = true
end

function PermissionService:_saveAssignments()
	local dataService = framework and framework:TryGetService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return
	end
	local payload = {}
	for userId, entry in pairs(self._assignments) do
		payload[tostring(userId)] = {
			rank = entry.rank,
			grants = copyList(entry.grants),
			revokes = copyList(entry.revokes),
		}
	end
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return dataService:Set(STORE, KEY_ASSIGNMENTS, payload)
	end)
	if (not success or result ~= true) and framework ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Warn("PermissionService", "Rangzuweisungen konnten nicht gespeichert werden.")
	end
end

function PermissionService:_saveRoles()
	local dataService = framework and framework:TryGetService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return
	end
	local payload = {}
	for name in pairs(self._customRoles) do
		local role = self._roles[name]
		if role ~= nil then
			payload[name] = copyRole(role)
		end
	end
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		return dataService:Set(STORE, KEY_CUSTOM_ROLES, payload)
	end)
	if (not success or result ~= true) and framework ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Warn("PermissionService", "Benutzerdefinierte Rollen konnten nicht gespeichert werden.")
	end
end

function PermissionService:_isPlaceOwner(userId: number): boolean
	local cached = self._ownerCache[userId]
	local now = os.clock()
	if cached ~= nil and cached.expires > now then
		return cached.value
	end

	local value = false
	if game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.User then
		value = game.CreatorId == userId
	elseif game.CreatorType == Enum.CreatorType.Group then
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if player ~= nil then
			local success, rank = pcall(function()
				return player:GetRankInGroup(game.CreatorId)
			end)
			value = success and type(rank) == "number" and rank >= 255
		end
	end

	self._ownerCache[userId] = { value = value, expires = now + OWNER_CACHE_SECONDS }
	return value
end

function PermissionService:_getGroupRank(userId: number): string?
	local groups = RanksConfig.Groups
	if type(groups) ~= "table" or #groups == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if player == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local cached = self._groupCache[userId]
	local now = os.clock()
	if cached ~= nil and cached.expires > now then
		return cached.rankName
	end

	local bestName = nil
	local bestPriority = -math.huge
	for _, entry in ipairs(groups) do
		if type(entry) == "table"
			and type(entry.GroupId) == "number"
			and type(entry.MinRank) == "number"
			and type(entry.Rank) == "string" then
			local success, rank = pcall(function()
				return player:GetRankInGroup(entry.GroupId)
			end)
			if success and type(rank) == "number" and rank >= entry.MinRank then
				local role = self:_findRole(entry.Rank)
				local priority = role ~= nil and role.Priority or 0
				if priority > bestPriority then
					bestPriority = priority
					bestName = role ~= nil and role.Name or entry.Rank
				end
			end
		end
	end

	self._groupCache[userId] = { expires = now + GROUP_CACHE_SECONDS, rankName = bestName }
	return bestName
end

function PermissionService:_resolveRankName(userId: number): string
	if self:_isPlaceOwner(userId) then
		return "Owner"
	end

	local backend = self._backendAssignments[userId]
	if backend ~= nil and type(backend.rank) == "string" and self:_findRole(backend.rank) ~= nil then
		return self:_findRole(backend.rank).Name
	end

	local localEntry = self._assignments[userId]
	if localEntry ~= nil and type(localEntry.rank) == "string" and self:_findRole(localEntry.rank) ~= nil then
		return self:_findRole(localEntry.rank).Name
	end

	local configured = nil
	if type(RanksConfig.UserIds) == "table" then
		configured = RanksConfig.UserIds[userId] or RanksConfig.UserIds[tostring(userId)]
	end
	if type(configured) == "string" and self:_findRole(configured) ~= nil then
		return self:_findRole(configured).Name
	end

	local groupRank = self:_getGroupRank(userId)
	if groupRank ~= nil then
		return groupRank
	end

	return "Player"
end

function PermissionService:_getOverrides(userId: number): ({ string }, { string })
	local grants = {}
	local revokes = {}
	local grantSeen = {}
	local revokeSeen = {}

	local function addGrant(value: string)
		if not grantSeen[value] then
			grantSeen[value] = true
			table.insert(grants, value)
		end
	end

	local function addRevoke(value: string)
		if not revokeSeen[value] then
			revokeSeen[value] = true
			table.insert(revokes, value)
		end
	end

	local localEntry = self._assignments[userId]
	if localEntry ~= nil then
		for _, value in ipairs(copyList(localEntry.grants)) do
			addGrant(value)
		end
		for _, value in ipairs(copyList(localEntry.revokes)) do
			addRevoke(value)
		end
	end

	local backend = self._backendAssignments[userId]
	if backend ~= nil then
		for _, value in ipairs(copyList(backend.grants)) do
			addGrant(value)
		end
		for _, value in ipairs(copyList(backend.revokes)) do
			addRevoke(value)
		end
	end

	return grants, revokes
end

function PermissionService:_getRolePermissionSet(roleName: string): { [string]: boolean }
	local cached = self._rolePermissionCache[roleName]
	if cached ~= nil then
		return cached
	end

	local result: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local visited: { [string]: boolean } = {}

	local function collect(name: string)
		if visited[name] then
			return
		end
		visited[name] = true
		local role = self:_findRole(name)
		if role == nil then
			return
		end
		for _, permission in ipairs(copyList(role.Permissions)) do
			result[permission] = true
		end
		for _, parent in ipairs(copyList(role.Inherits)) do
			collect(parent)
		end
	end

	collect(roleName)
	self._rolePermissionCache[roleName] = result
	return result
end

function PermissionService:_getUserState(userId: number): any
	local cached = self._userCache[userId]
	local now = os.clock()
	if cached ~= nil and cached.version == self._version and cached.expires > now then
		return cached
	end

	local grants, revokes = self:_getOverrides(userId)
	local state = {
		version = self._version,
		expires = now + USER_CACHE_SECONDS,
		roleName = self:_resolveRankName(userId),
		grants = grants,
		revokes = revokes,
	}
	self._userCache[userId] = state
	return state
end

function PermissionService:Has(playerOrUserId: any, permission: string): boolean
	local userId = normalizeUserId(playerOrUserId)
	if userId == nil or type(permission) ~= "string" or permission == "" then
		return false
	end

	local state = self:_getUserState(userId)

	for _, pattern in ipairs(state.revokes) do
		if patternMatches(pattern, permission) then
			return false
		end
	end
	for _, pattern in ipairs(state.grants) do
		if patternMatches(pattern, permission) then
			return true
		end
	end

	local rolePermissions = self:_getRolePermissionSet(state.roleName)
	for pattern in pairs(rolePermissions) do
		if patternMatches(pattern, permission) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function PermissionService:GetRank(playerOrUserId: any): any
	local userId = normalizeUserId(playerOrUserId)
	local roleName = "Player"
	if userId ~= nil then
		roleName = self:_getUserState(userId).roleName
	end
	local role = self:_findRole(roleName) or self._roles.Player
	return copyRole(role)
end

function PermissionService:GetPermissions(playerOrUserId: any): { string }
	local userId = normalizeUserId(playerOrUserId)
	if userId == nil then
		return {}
	end

	local state = self:_getUserState(userId)
	local patterns = {}
	local seen = {}

	local function addPattern(value: string)
		if not seen[value] then
			seen[value] = true
			table.insert(patterns, value)
		end
	end

	for pattern in pairs(self:_getRolePermissionSet(state.roleName)) do
		addPattern(pattern)
	end
	for _, pattern in ipairs(state.grants) do
		addPattern(pattern)
	end

	local result = {}
	local resultSeen = {}
	local function addConcrete(value: string)
		if resultSeen[value] then
			return
		end
		for _, revoke in ipairs(state.revokes) do
			if patternMatches(revoke, value) then
				return
			end
		end
		resultSeen[value] = true
		table.insert(result, value)
	end

	for _, pattern in ipairs(patterns) do
		if pattern == "*" then
			for _, concrete in ipairs(CONCRETE_PERMISSIONS) do
				addConcrete(concrete)
			end
		elseif string.sub(pattern, -2) == ".*" then
			local prefix = string.sub(pattern, 1, #pattern - 1)
			for _, concrete in ipairs(CONCRETE_PERMISSIONS) do
				if string.sub(concrete, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
					addConcrete(concrete)
				end
			end
		elseif pattern ~= "" then
			addConcrete(pattern)
		end
	end

	table.sort(result)
	return result
end

function PermissionService:CanTarget(executorId: any, targetId: any): boolean
	local sourceId = normalizeUserId(executorId)
	local destinationId = normalizeUserId(targetId)
	if sourceId == nil or destinationId == nil then
		return false
	end
	if sourceId == destinationId then
		return true
	end
	local executorRank = self:GetRank(sourceId)
	local targetRank = self:GetRank(destinationId)
	if executorRank.Priority >= 100 then
		return true
	end
	return executorRank.Priority > targetRank.Priority
end

function PermissionService:_notifyChanged(userId: number)
	self.Changed:Fire(userId)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if player == nil then
		return
	end
	local remote = framework and framework:TryGetService("RemoteService")
	if remote == nil then
		return
	end
	remote:Push(player, Constants.Channels.PermissionsChanged, {
		permissions = self:GetPermissions(userId),
		rank = self:GetRank(userId).Name,
	})
end

function PermissionService:_fireRankChanged(userId: number, rankName: string, by: number?)
	local eventService = framework and framework:TryGetService("EventService")
	if eventService ~= nil then
		eventService:Fire(Constants.Events.RankChanged, { userId = userId, rank = rankName, by = by })
	end
end

function PermissionService:SetRank(executorId: any, targetId: any, rankName: string): (boolean, string?)
	local sourceId = normalizeUserId(executorId)
	local destinationId = normalizeUserId(targetId)
	if sourceId == nil or destinationId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Spieler-ID."
	end
	if not self:Has(sourceId, Constants.Permissions.AdminManageRanks) then
		return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung Admin.ManageRanks."
	end
	if sourceId == destinationId then
		return false, "Du kannst deinen eigenen Rang nicht ändern."
	end
	if self._backendAssignments[destinationId] ~= nil and self._backendAssignments[destinationId].rank ~= nil then
		return false, "Dieser Rang wird vom Backend verwaltet."
	end

	local role = self:_findRole(rankName)
	if role == nil then
		return false, "Unbekannter Rang."
	end

	local executorRank = self:GetRank(sourceId)
	if role.Priority >= executorRank.Priority then
		return false, "Du kannst keinen Rang vergeben, der mindestens so hoch ist wie dein eigener."
	end
	if not self:CanTarget(sourceId, destinationId) then
		return false, "Du kannst kein Mitglied mit gleicher oder höherer Priorität bearbeiten."
	end

	local entry = self._assignments[destinationId]
	if entry == nil then
		entry = { rank = nil, grants = {}, revokes = {} }
		self._assignments[destinationId] = entry
	end
	entry.rank = role.Name

	self._version += 1
	self:_saveAssignments()
	self:_fireRankChanged(destinationId, role.Name, sourceId)
	self:_notifyChanged(destinationId)
	return true
end

function PermissionService:RemoveRank(executorId: any, targetId: any): (boolean, string?)
	local sourceId = normalizeUserId(executorId)
	local destinationId = normalizeUserId(targetId)
	if sourceId == nil or destinationId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Spieler-ID."
	end
	if not self:Has(sourceId, Constants.Permissions.AdminManageRanks) then
		return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung Admin.ManageRanks."
	end
	if sourceId == destinationId then
		return false, "Du kannst deinen eigenen Rang nicht entfernen."
	end
	if self._backendAssignments[destinationId] ~= nil and self._backendAssignments[destinationId].rank ~= nil then
		return false, "Dieser Rang wird vom Backend verwaltet."
	end

	local entry = self._assignments[destinationId]
	if entry == nil or entry.rank == nil then
		return false, "Dieser Spieler hat keinen zugewiesenen Rang."
	end
	if not self:CanTarget(sourceId, destinationId) then
		return false, "Du kannst kein Mitglied mit gleicher oder höherer Priorität bearbeiten."
	end

	entry.rank = nil
	self._version += 1
	self:_saveAssignments()
	self:_fireRankChanged(destinationId, self:_resolveRankName(destinationId), sourceId)
	self:_notifyChanged(destinationId)
	return true
end

function PermissionService:_updateOverrides(executorId: any, targetId: any, permission: string, isGrant: boolean): (boolean, string?)
	local sourceId = normalizeUserId(executorId)
	local destinationId = normalizeUserId(targetId)
	if sourceId == nil or destinationId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Spieler-ID."
	end
	if not self:Has(sourceId, Constants.Permissions.AdminManagePermissions) then
		return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung Admin.ManagePermissions."
	end
	if not isValidPermission(permission) then
		return false, "Ungültige Permission."
	end
	if not self:CanTarget(sourceId, destinationId) then
		return false, "Du kannst kein Mitglied mit gleicher oder höherer Priorität bearbeiten."
	end
	if isGrant and not self:Has(sourceId, permission) then
		return false, "Du kannst keine Berechtigung vergeben, die du selbst nicht besitzt."
	end

	local entry = self._assignments[destinationId]
	if entry == nil then
		entry = { rank = nil, grants = {}, revokes = {} }
		self._assignments[destinationId] = entry
	end
	entry.grants = copyList(entry.grants)
	entry.revokes = copyList(entry.revokes)

	local function removeFrom(list: { string }, value: string)
		for index = #list, 1, -1 do
			if list[index] == value then
				table.remove(list, index)
			end
		end
	end

	if isGrant then
		removeFrom(entry.revokes, permission)
		if not table.find(entry.grants, permission) then
			table.insert(entry.grants, permission)
		end
	else
		removeFrom(entry.grants, permission)
		if not table.find(entry.revokes, permission) then
			table.insert(entry.revokes, permission)
		end
	end

	self._version += 1
	self:_saveAssignments()
	self:_notifyChanged(destinationId)
	return true
end

function PermissionService:Grant(executorId: any, targetId: any, permission: string): (boolean, string?)
	return self:_updateOverrides(executorId, targetId, permission, true)
end

function PermissionService:Revoke(executorId: any, targetId: any, permission: string): (boolean, string?)
	return self:_updateOverrides(executorId, targetId, permission, false)
end

function PermissionService:GetRoles(): { any }
	local result = {}
	for _, role in pairs(self._roles) do
		table.insert(result, copyRole(role))
	end
	table.sort(result, function(left, right)
		if left.Priority ~= right.Priority then
			return left.Priority > right.Priority
		end
		return left.Name < right.Name
	end)
	return result
end

function PermissionService:CreateRole(executorId: any, role: any): (boolean, string?)
	local sourceId = normalizeUserId(executorId)
	if sourceId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Spieler-ID."
	end
	if not self:Has(sourceId, Constants.Permissions.AdminManagePermissions) then
		return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung Admin.ManagePermissions."
	end

	local knownNames = {}
	for name in pairs(self._roles) do
		knownNames[name] = true
	end
	if type(role) == "table" and type(role.Name) == "string" then
		knownNames[role.Name] = true
	end

	local normalized, err = self:_normalizeRole(role, knownNames)
	if normalized == nil then
		return false, err or "Ungültige Rolle."
	end
	if self._roles[normalized.Name] ~= nil then
		return false, "Eine Rolle mit diesem Namen existiert bereits."
	end

	local executorRank = self:GetRank(sourceId)
	if normalized.Priority >= executorRank.Priority then
		return false, "Du kannst keine Rolle mit gleicher oder höherer Priorität erstellen."
	end

	self._roles[normalized.Name] = normalized
	self._customRoles[normalized.Name] = true
	self._version += 1
	self._rolePermissionCache = {}
	self:_rebuildRoleIndex()
	self:_saveRoles()
	return true
end

function PermissionService:DeleteRole(executorId: any, name: string): (boolean, string?)
	local sourceId = normalizeUserId(executorId)
	if sourceId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Spieler-ID."
	end
	if not self:Has(sourceId, Constants.Permissions.AdminManagePermissions) then
		return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung Admin.ManagePermissions."
	end
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		return false, "Ungültiger Rollenname."
	end
	if Constants.DefaultRoles[name] ~= nil then
		return false, "Standardrollen können nicht gelöscht werden."
	end
	local role = self:_findRole(name)
	if role == nil then
		return false, "Unbekannte Rolle."
	end
	local executorRank = self:GetRank(sourceId)
	if role.Priority >= executorRank.Priority then
		return false, "Du kannst keine Rolle mit gleicher oder höherer Priorität löschen."
	end

	for _, entry in pairs(self._assignments) do
		if entry.rank == role.Name then
			return false, "Die Rolle wird noch verwendet."
		end
	end
	for _, entry in pairs(self._backendAssignments) do
		if entry.rank == role.Name then
			return false, "Die Rolle wird noch verwendet."
		end
	end

	self._roles[role.Name] = nil
	self._customRoles[role.Name] = nil
	self._version += 1
	self._rolePermissionCache = {}
	self:_rebuildRoleIndex()
	self:_saveRoles()
	return true
end

function PermissionService:GetAssignments(): { any }
	local byUser: { [number]: any } = {}

	for userId, entry in pairs(self._assignments) do
		byUser[userId] = {
			userId = userId,
			rank = entry.rank,
			grants = copyList(entry.grants),
			revokes = copyList(entry.revokes),
			source = "Local",
		}
	end

	for userId, entry in pairs(self._backendAssignments) do
		local merged = byUser[userId]
		if merged == nil then
			merged = { userId = userId, rank = nil, grants = {}, revokes = {}, source = "Backend" }
			byUser[userId] = merged
		end
		if type(entry.rank) == "string" then
			merged.rank = entry.rank
			merged.source = "Backend"
		end
		for _, permission in ipairs(copyList(entry.grants)) do
			if not table.find(merged.grants, permission) then
				table.insert(merged.grants, permission)
			end
		end
		for _, permission in ipairs(copyList(entry.revokes)) do
			if not table.find(merged.revokes, permission) then
				table.insert(merged.revokes, permission)
			end
		end
	end

	local result = {}
	for _, entry in pairs(byUser) do
		if entry.rank ~= nil or #entry.grants > 0 or #entry.revokes > 0 then
			table.insert(result, entry)
		end
	end
	table.sort(result, function(left, right)
		return left.userId < right.userId
	end)
	return result
end

-- Merge der Backend-Antwort von GET /permissions. Rollen werden übernommen,
-- Rangzuweisungen aus dem Backend haben Vorrang vor DataStore und Konfiguration.
function PermissionService:ApplyBackendSync(payload: any): (boolean, string?)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" then
		return false, "Ungültige Synchronisationsdaten."
	end

	local affected: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	local changed = false

	if type(payload.roles) == "table" then
		local knownNames = {}
		for name in pairs(self._roles) do
			knownNames[name] = true
		end
		for _, role in ipairs(payload.roles) do
			if type(role) == "table" and type(role.Name) == "string" then
				knownNames[role.Name] = true
			end
		end
		for _, role in ipairs(payload.roles) do
			local normalized, err = self:_normalizeRole(role, knownNames, true)
			if normalized ~= nil then
				self._roles[normalized.Name] = normalized
				self._customRoles[normalized.Name] = true
				changed = true
			elseif framework ~= nil then
				framework.Log:Warn("PermissionService", "Backend-Rolle verworfen: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end

	if type(payload.assignments) == "table" then
		for _, assignment in ipairs(payload.assignments) do
			if type(assignment) == "table" then
				local userId = tonumber(assignment.userId)
				if userId ~= nil and userId % 1 == 0 and userId > 0 then
					local rank = nil
					if type(assignment.rank) == "string" then
						local role = self:_findRole(assignment.rank)
						if role ~= nil then
							rank = role.Name
						end
					end
					self._backendAssignments[userId] = {
						rank = rank,
						grants = copyList(assignment.grants),
						revokes = copyList(assignment.revokes),
					}
					affected[userId] = true
					changed = true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if changed then
		self._version += 1
		self._rolePermissionCache = {}
		self:_rebuildRoleIndex()
		if type(payload.roles) == "table" then
			self:_saveRoles()
		end
		for userId in pairs(affected) do
			self:_notifyChanged(userId)
		end
	end

	return true
end

PermissionService.SyncFromBackend = PermissionService.ApplyBackendSync

function PermissionService:Destroy()
	if maid ~= nil then
		maid:Clean()
	end
	self._userCache = {}
	self._groupCache = {}
	self._ownerCache = {}
	self._rolePermissionCache = {}
	self.Changed:DisconnectAll()
end

return PermissionService
```

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- PlayerService: Sitzungsdaten, Join/Leave-Lebenszyklus, Bancheck und
-- Spielerauswahl für Commands und UI. Kein Loop pro Spieler.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Maid = require(Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local PlayerService = {
	Name = "PlayerService",
	Dependencies = {},
}

local framework: any
local maid: any

local function normalizeExecutorId(executor: any): number?
	if typeof(executor) == "Instance" and executor:IsA("Player") then
		return executor.UserId
	end
	if type(executor) == "number" and executor % 1 == 0 and executor > 0 then
		return executor
	end
	return nil
end

local function copySession(session: any): any
	return {
		userId = session.userId,
		name = session.name,
		displayName = session.displayName,
		joinedAt = session.joinedAt,
		accountAge = session.accountAge,
		ping = session.ping,
		frozen = session.frozen,
		muted = session.muted,
	}
end

function PlayerService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	maid = Maid.new()
	self._sessions = {}
end

function PlayerService:Start()
	maid:Give(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		self:_onPlayerAdded(player)
	end))
	maid:Give(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		self:_onPlayerRemoving(player)
	end))

	-- Spieler, die vor dem Start des Services bereits verbunden waren.
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(function()
			self:_onPlayerAdded(player)
		end)
	end
end

function PlayerService:_isBanned(player: Player): any?
	local banService = framework and framework:TryGetService("BanService")
	if banService == nil or type(banService.CheckBan) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local success, record = pcall(function()
		return banService:CheckBan(player.UserId)
	end)
	if success and type(record) == "table" then
		return record
	end
	return nil
end

function PlayerService:_onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	if self._sessions[player.UserId] ~= nil then
		return
	end

	local record = self:_isBanned(player)
	if record ~= nil then
		local reason = type(record.Reason) == "string" and record.Reason ~= "" and record.Reason or "Kein Grund angegeben."
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Write("Security", "Warn", "PlayerService", "Gebannter Spieler abgewiesen.", {
				userId = player.UserId,
				name = player.Name,
				reason = reason,
			})
		end
		if player.Parent ~= nil then
			player:Kick("Du bist von diesem Server gebannt.\nGrund: " .. Util.truncate(reason, 200))
		end
		return
	end
	self._sessions[player.UserId] = {
		userId = player.UserId,
		name = player.Name,
		displayName = player.DisplayName,
		joinedAt = os.time(),
		accountAge = player.AccountAge,
		ping = 0,
		frozen = false,
		muted = false,
	}

	local eventService = framework and framework:TryGetService("EventService")
	if eventService ~= nil then
		eventService:Fire(Constants.Events.PlayerJoined, { userId = player.UserId, name = player.Name })
	end
end

function PlayerService:_onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local session = self._sessions[player.UserId]
	if session == nil then
		return
	end
	self._sessions[player.UserId] = nil

	local sessionSeconds = math.max(0, os.time() - (tonumber(session.joinedAt) or os.time()))
	local eventService = framework and framework:TryGetService("EventService")
	if eventService ~= nil then
		eventService:Fire(Constants.Events.PlayerLeft, {
			userId = player.UserId,
			name = player.Name,
			sessionSeconds = sessionSeconds,
		})
	end
end

function PlayerService:_isMuted(userId: number): boolean
	local muteService = framework and framework:TryGetService("MuteService")
	if muteService == nil or type(muteService.IsMuted) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local success, muted = pcall(function()
		return muteService:IsMuted(userId)
	end)
	return success and muted == true
end

function PlayerService:GetSession(userId: number): any?
	if type(userId) ~= "number" then
		return nil
	end
	local session = self._sessions[userId]
	if session == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if player ~= nil then
		local success, ping = pcall(function()
			return player:GetNetworkPing()
		end)
		if success and type(ping) == "number" then
			session.ping = math.floor(ping * 1000 + 0.5)
		end
		session.muted = self:_isMuted(userId)
	end
	return copySession(session)
end

function PlayerService:GetSessions(): { any }
	local result = {}
	for _, session in pairs(self._sessions) do
		table.insert(result, self:GetSession(session.userId) or copySession(session))
	end
	table.sort(result, function(left, right)
		return (left.joinedAt or 0) < (right.joinedAt or 0)
	end)
	return result
end

function PlayerService:SetFrozen(userId: number, frozen: boolean): boolean
	local session = self._sessions[userId]
	if session == nil then
		return false
	end
	session.frozen = frozen == true
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local remote = framework and framework:TryGetService("RemoteService")
	if player ~= nil and remote ~= nil then
		remote:Push(player, Constants.Channels.Freeze, { frozen = session.frozen })
	end
	return true
end

function PlayerService:IsFrozen(userId: number): boolean
	local session = self._sessions[userId]
	return session ~= nil and session.frozen == true
end

function PlayerService:_hasAdminPanel(userId: number): boolean
	local permissionService = framework and framework:TryGetService("PermissionService")
	if permissionService == nil then
		return false
	end
	local success, allowed = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:Has(userId, Constants.Permissions.AdminPanel)
	end)
	return success and allowed == true
end

function PlayerService:_addUnique(list: { Player }, seen: { [number]: boolean }, player: Player?)
	if player == nil or seen[player.UserId] then
		return
	end
	seen[player.UserId] = true
	table.insert(list, player)
end

function PlayerService:_resolveToken(token: string, executorId: number?, list: { Player }, seen: { [number]: boolean })
	local trimmed = string.gsub(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
	if trimmed == "" then
		return
	end
	local lower = string.lower(trimmed)

	if lower == "me" then
		if executorId ~= nil then
			self:_addUnique(list, seen, Players:GetPlayerByUserId(executorId))
		end
		return
	elseif lower == "all" then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			self:_addUnique(list, seen, player)
		end
		return
	elseif lower == "others" then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player.UserId ~= executorId then
				self:_addUnique(list, seen, player)
			end
		end
		return
	elseif lower == "random" then
		local candidates = {}
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player.UserId ~= executorId then
				table.insert(candidates, player)
			end
		end
		if #candidates == 0 then
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				table.insert(candidates, player)
			end
		end
		if #candidates > 0 then
			self:_addUnique(list, seen, candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)])
		end
		return
	elseif lower == "admins" or lower == "nonadmins" then
		local wantAdmins = lower == "admins"
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if self:_hasAdminPanel(player.UserId) == wantAdmins then
				self:_addUnique(list, seen, player)
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if string.sub(trimmed, 1, 1) == "@" then
		local partial = string.lower(string.sub(trimmed, 2))
		if partial == "" then
			return
		end
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if string.sub(string.lower(player.DisplayName), 1, #partial) == partial then
				self:_addUnique(list, seen, player)
			end
		end
		return
	end

	local asNumber = tonumber(trimmed)
	if asNumber ~= nil and asNumber % 1 == 0 and asNumber > 0 then
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(asNumber)
		if player ~= nil then
			self:_addUnique(list, seen, player)
			return
		end
		for _, candidate in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if candidate.UserId == asNumber then
				self:_addUnique(list, seen, candidate)
				return
			end
		end
	end

	local partial = lower
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if string.sub(string.lower(player.Name), 1, #partial) == partial
			or string.sub(string.lower(player.DisplayName), 1, #partial) == partial then
			self:_addUnique(list, seen, player)
		end
	end
end

function PlayerService:FindPlayers(query: string, executor: any): { Player }
	local list: { Player } = {}
	local seen: { [number]: boolean } = {}
	if type(query) ~= "string" or query == "" then
		return list
	end
	local executorId = normalizeExecutorId(executor)

	local tokens = string.split(query, ",")
	if #tokens > 1 then
		for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do
			self:_resolveToken(token, executorId, list, seen)
		end
		return list
	end

	self:_resolveToken(query, executorId, list, seen)
	return list
end

function PlayerService:Destroy()
	if maid ~= nil then
		maid:Clean()
	end
	self._sessions = {}
end

return PlayerService
```
