`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Core/RemoteService.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- RemoteService: einzige Schnittstelle zwischen Client und Server.
-- Jeder Eingang wird typgeprüft, größenbegrenzt, ratenbegrenzt und – falls
-- gefordert – serverseitig gegen eine Permission geprüft. Alles, was vom
-- Client kommt, gilt als nicht vertrauenswürdig.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local RateLimiter = require(Shared.Utilities.RateLimiter)
local Maid = require(Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local RemoteService = {
	Name = "RemoteService",
	Dependencies = {},
}

-- Grenzen für Client-Eingaben laut Vertrag (§3).
local INPUT_LIMITS = {
	maxString = 500,
	maxEntries = 50,
	maxDepth = 3,
}

-- Grenzen für Server-Pushes (etwas großzügiger, aber weiterhin begrenzt).
local PUSH_LIMITS = {
	maxString = 4000,
	maxEntries = 200,
	maxDepth = 6,
	maxBytes = 60000,
}

-- Ratenbegrenzung pro Spieler.
local RATE_LIMITS = {
	Command = { limit = 10, window = 10 },
	Request = { limit = 30, window = 10 },
	Autocomplete = { limit = 20, window = 5 },
	ClientReport = { limit = 20, window = 10 },
}

local ALLOWED_CHANNELS: { [string]: boolean } = {}
for _, channel in pairs(Constants.Channels) do
	ALLOWED_CHANNELS[channel] = true
end

local framework: any
local maid: any

local function validateValue(value: any, depth: number, limits: any): (boolean, string?)
	local valueType = type(value)
	if valueType == "nil" then
		return true
	elseif valueType == "string" then
		if #value > limits.maxString then
			return false, "Text überschreitet das Größenlimit."
		end
	elseif valueType == "number" or valueType == "boolean" then
		return true
	elseif valueType == "table" then
		if depth >= limits.maxDepth then
			return false, "Tabelle ist zu tief verschachtelt."
		end
		local count = 0
		for key, child in pairs(value) do
			count += 1
			if count > limits.maxEntries then
				return false, "Tabelle enthält zu viele Einträge."
			end
			local keyType = type(key)
			if keyType ~= "string" and keyType ~= "number" then
				return false, "Ungültiger Tabellenschlüssel."
			end
			local ok, err = validateValue(child, depth + 1, limits)
			if not ok then
				return false, err
			end
		end
	else
		return false, "Nicht unterstützter Datentyp."
	end
	return true
end

function RemoteService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	maid = Maid.new()

	self._requests = {}
	self._commandHandler = nil
	self._autocompleteHandler = nil
	self._clientReportHandler = nil

	self._limiters = {}
	for name, settings in pairs(RATE_LIMITS) do
		self._limiters[name] = RateLimiter.new(settings.limit, settings.window)
	end

	local headcraft = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Headcraft")
	if headcraft == nil then
		headcraft = Instance.new("Folder")
		headcraft.Name = "Headcraft"
		headcraft.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end

	local remotes = headcraft:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if remotes == nil then
		remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
		remotes.Name = "Remotes"
		remotes.Parent = headcraft
	end
	self._remotes = remotes

	local function ensure(className: string, name: string)
		local instance = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
		if instance ~= nil and not instance:IsA(className) then
			instance:Destroy()
			instance = nil
		end
		if instance == nil then
			instance = Instance.new(className)
			instance.Name = name
			instance.Parent = remotes
		end
		return instance
	end

	self._commandRemote = ensure("RemoteFunction", Constants.RemoteNames.Command)
	self._requestRemote = ensure("RemoteFunction", Constants.RemoteNames.Request)
	self._autocompleteRemote = ensure("RemoteFunction", Constants.RemoteNames.Autocomplete)
	self._pushRemote = ensure("RemoteEvent", Constants.RemoteNames.Push)
	self._clientReportRemote = ensure("RemoteEvent", Constants.RemoteNames.ClientReport)

	self:_bindRemotes()

	maid:Give(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		for _, limiter in pairs(self._limiters) do
			limiter:Reset(player.UserId)
		end
	end))
end

function RemoteService:_bindRemotes()
	local self_ = self

	self._requestRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, action: any, args: any)
		return self_:_handleRequest(player, action, args)
	end

	self._commandRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, text: any)
		return self_:_handleCommand(player, text)
	end

	self._autocompleteRemote.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, text: any)
		return self_:_handleAutocomplete(player, text)
	end

	maid:Give(self._clientReportRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, kind: any, data: any)
		self_:_handleClientReport(player, kind, data)
	end))
end

function RemoteService:_reportAbuse(player: Player, kind: string, detail: string?)
	if framework == nil then
		return
	end
	local eventService = framework:TryGetService("EventService")
	if eventService ~= nil then
		eventService:Fire(Constants.Events.SecurityAlert, {
			userId = player.UserId,
			kind = "RemoteAbuse",
			message = "Client hat das Limit für " .. kind .. " überschritten.",
			data = { remote = kind, detail = detail },
		})
	end
	local detectionManager = framework:TryGetService("DetectionManager")
	if detectionManager ~= nil and type(detectionManager.Report) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			detectionManager:Report(player.UserId, "Remote", "Low", 0.3, {
				Remote = kind,
				Detail = detail or "Rate-Limit",
			})
		end)
	end
end

function RemoteService:_checkRate(kind: string, player: Player): boolean
	local limiter = self._limiters[kind]
	if limiter == nil then
		return true
	end
	if not limiter:Check(player.UserId) then
		self:_reportAbuse(player, kind, "Rate-Limit")
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function RemoteService:OnRequest(action: string, permission: string?, handler: (Player, any) -> any): boolean
	if type(action) ~= "string" or #action == 0 or #action > 64 or not string.match(action, "^[%w_]+$") then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "Ungültiger Aktionsname für OnRequest abgelehnt.")
		end
		return false
	end
	if type(handler) ~= "function" then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "OnRequest benötigt eine Handler-Funktion.")
		end
		return false
	end
	if permission ~= nil and (type(permission) ~= "string" or #permission == 0) then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "Ungültige Permission für OnRequest abgelehnt.")
		end
		return false
	end
	if self._requests[action] ~= nil and framework ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "Aktion " .. action .. " wird überschrieben.")
	end
	self._requests[action] = { permission = permission, handler = handler }
	return true
end

function RemoteService:OnCommand(handler: (Player, string) -> any)
	if type(handler) ~= "function" then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "OnCommand benötigt eine Handler-Funktion.")
		end
		return false
	end
	self._commandHandler = handler
	return true
end

function RemoteService:OnAutocomplete(handler: (Player, string) -> any)
	if type(handler) ~= "function" then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "OnAutocomplete benötigt eine Handler-Funktion.")
		end
		return false
	end
	self._autocompleteHandler = handler
	return true
end

function RemoteService:OnClientReport(handler: (Player, string, any) -> ())
	if type(handler) ~= "function" then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "OnClientReport benötigt eine Handler-Funktion.")
		end
		return false
	end
	self._clientReportHandler = handler
	return true
end

function RemoteService:_handleRequest(player: Player, action: any, args: any)
	if not self:_checkRate("Request", player) then
		return { ok = false, error = "Zu viele Anfragen. Bitte warte einen Moment." }
	end
	if type(action) ~= "string" or #action == 0 or #action > 64 then
		return { ok = false, error = "Ungültige Aktion." }
	end
	if args ~= nil then
		if type(args) ~= "table" then
			self:_reportAbuse(player, "Request", "Ungültiges Argumentformat")
			return { ok = false, error = "Ungültige Argumente." }
		end
		local ok, err = validateValue(args, 0, INPUT_LIMITS)
		if not ok then
			self:_reportAbuse(player, "Request", err)
			return { ok = false, error = err or "Ungültige Argumente." }
		end
	end

	local entry = self._requests[action]
	if entry == nil then
		return { ok = false, error = "Unbekannte Aktion." }
	end

	if entry.permission ~= nil then
		local permissionService = framework and framework:TryGetService("PermissionService")
		if permissionService == nil then
			return { ok = false, error = "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar." }
		end
		local allowed = false
		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return permissionService:Has(player, entry.permission)
		end)
		if success then
			allowed = result == true
		end
		if not allowed then
			if framework ~= nil then
				framework.Log:Write("Security", "Warn", "RemoteService", "Permission verweigert: " .. action, {
					userId = player.UserId,
					permission = entry.permission,
				})
			end
			return { ok = false, error = "Keine Berechtigung." }
		end
	end

	local success, result = pcall(entry.handler, player, args)
	if not success then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Error("RemoteService", "Handler für " .. action .. " fehlgeschlagen: " .. tostring(result))
		end
		return { ok = false, error = "Anfrage fehlgeschlagen." }
	end

	-- Handler dürfen einen bereits geformten Fehler zurückgeben.
	if type(result) == "table" and result.ok == false and type(result.error) == "string" then
		return result
	end

	local encoded, encodeErr = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONEncode({ data = result })
	end)
	if not encoded then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Error("RemoteService", "Antwort für " .. action .. " ist nicht serialisierbar: " .. tostring(encodeErr))
		end
		return { ok = false, error = "Antwort konnte nicht übertragen werden." }
	end

	return { ok = true, data = result }
end

function RemoteService:_handleCommand(player: Player, text: any)
	if not self:_checkRate("Command", player) then
		return { success = false, message = "Zu viele Befehle. Bitte warte einen Moment." }
	end
	if type(text) ~= "string" or #text == 0 or #text > INPUT_LIMITS.maxString then
		self:_reportAbuse(player, "Command", "Ungültiger Befehlstext")
		return { success = false, message = "Der Befehl ist ungültig oder zu lang." }
	end
	local handler = self._commandHandler
	if handler == nil then
		return { success = false, message = "Das Befehlssystem ist noch nicht bereit." }
	end

	local success, result = pcall(handler, player, text)
	if not success then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Error("RemoteService", "Command-Handler fehlgeschlagen: " .. tostring(result))
		end
		return { success = false, message = "Der Befehl konnte nicht ausgeführt werden." }
	end
	if type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.success) ~= "boolean" or type(result.message) ~= "string" then
		return { success = false, message = "Ungültige Antwort des Befehlssystems." }
	end
	return result
end

function RemoteService:_handleAutocomplete(player: Player, text: any)
	if not self:_checkRate("Autocomplete", player) then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	if type(text) ~= "string" or #text > INPUT_LIMITS.maxString then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	local handler = self._autocompleteHandler
	if handler == nil then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end

	local success, result = pcall(handler, player, text)
	if not success then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "Autocomplete-Handler fehlgeschlagen: " .. tostring(result))
		end
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	if type(result) ~= "table" or type(result.suggestions) ~= "table" then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end

	local suggestions = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(result.suggestions) do
		if #suggestions >= 50 then
			break
		end
		if type(item) == "table" and type(item.text) == "string" and type(item.display) == "string" then
			if #item.text <= 200 and #item.display <= 200 then
				local description = nil
				if type(item.description) == "string" then
					description = string.sub(item.description, 1, 200)
				end
				table.insert(suggestions, { text = item.text, display = item.display, description = description })
			end
		end
	end
	return { suggestions = suggestions }
end

function RemoteService:_handleClientReport(player: Player, kind: any, data: any)
	if not self:_checkRate("ClientReport", player) then
		return
	end
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or #kind == 0 or #kind > 64 then
		self:_reportAbuse(player, "ClientReport", "Ungültiger Meldungstyp")
		return
	end
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		self:_reportAbuse(player, "ClientReport", "Ungültige Meldedaten")
		return
	end
	local ok, err = validateValue(data, 0, INPUT_LIMITS)
	if not ok then
		self:_reportAbuse(player, "ClientReport", err)
		return
	end
	local handler = self._clientReportHandler
	if handler == nil then
		return
	end
	local success, handlerErr = pcall(handler, player, kind, data)
	if not success and framework ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "ClientReport-Handler fehlgeschlagen: " .. tostring(handlerErr))
	end
end

function RemoteService:_validatePushPayload(channel: string, payload: any): boolean
	if not ALLOWED_CHANNELS[channel] then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "Unbekannter Push-Kanal abgelehnt: " .. tostring(channel))
		end
		return false
	end
	if type(payload) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, err = validateValue(payload, 0, PUSH_LIMITS)
	if not ok then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "Push-Payload für " .. channel .. " abgelehnt: " .. tostring(err))
		end
		return false
	end
	local encoded, json = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:JSONEncode(payload)
	end)
	if not encoded or type(json) ~= "string" or #json > PUSH_LIMITS.maxBytes then
		if framework ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("RemoteService", "Push-Payload für " .. channel .. " ist zu groß.")
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function RemoteService:Push(player: Player, channel: string, payload: any)
	if player == nil or not player:IsA("Player") then
		return
	end
	if player.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	if type(channel) ~= "string" or not self:_validatePushPayload(channel, payload) then
		return
	end
	self._pushRemote:FireClient(player, channel, payload)
end

function RemoteService:PushToPermission(permission: string, channel: string, payload: any)
	if type(permission) ~= "string" or #permission == 0 then
		return
	end
	if type(channel) ~= "string" or not self:_validatePushPayload(channel, payload) then
		return
	end
	local permissionService = framework and framework:TryGetService("PermissionService")
	if permissionService == nil then
		return
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local allowed = false
		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return permissionService:Has(player, permission)
		end)
		if success then
			allowed = result == true
		end
		if allowed then
			self._pushRemote:FireClient(player, channel, payload)
		end
	end
end

function RemoteService:PushAll(channel: string, payload: any)
	if type(channel) ~= "string" or not self:_validatePushPayload(channel, payload) then
		return
	end
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		self._pushRemote:FireClient(player, channel, payload)
	end
end

function RemoteService:Destroy()
	if maid ~= nil then
		maid:Clean()
	end
	if self._requestRemote ~= nil then
		self._requestRemote.OnServerInvoke = nil
	end
	if self._commandRemote ~= nil then
		self._commandRemote.OnServerInvoke = nil
	end
	if self._autocompleteRemote ~= nil then
		self._autocompleteRemote.OnServerInvoke = nil
	end
	self._requests = {}
	self._commandHandler = nil
	self._autocompleteHandler = nil
	self._clientReportHandler = nil
end

return RemoteService
```

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- BanService: persistente Bans über DataService und zusätzlich über die
-- Roblox-Ban-API. CheckBan wird von PlayerService beim Join verwendet.
-- Alle Aktionen erzeugen einen ModerationRecord, landen in der History und
-- feuern das ModerationAction-Event.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Ring = require(Shared.Utilities.Ring)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local BanService = {
	Name = "BanService",
	Dependencies = { "DataService", "EventService" },
}

local STORE = "Headcraft_Bans"
local MAX_ACTIVE_CACHE = 500
local MAX_REASON = 500
local MAX_API_REASON = 200
local MAX_DURATION = 315360000 -- 10 Jahre; gröbere Werte sind Eingabefehler.

local framework: any
local activeRing = Ring.new(MAX_ACTIVE_CACHE)
local activeByUser: { [number]: any } = {}

local function getService(name: string): any?
	if framework == nil or type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function newId(): string
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	end)
	if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
		return value
	end
	return string.format("ban-%d-%d", os.time(), math.random(1, 0x7FFFFFFF))
end

local function normalizeUserId(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
		return nil
	end
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then
		if value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 and value < 1e15 then
			return value
		end
		return nil
	end
	if kind == "string" and value ~= "" and #value <= 64 then
		local number = tonumber(value)
		if number ~= nil and number % 1 == 0 and number > 0 and number < 1e15 then
			return number
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Offline-Ziele dürfen zusätzlich als Name übergeben werden (Auflösung serverseitig).
local function resolveUserId(value: any): number?
	local direct = normalizeUserId(value)
	if direct ~= nil then
		return direct
	end
	if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" or #value > 50 then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, id = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(value)
	end)
	if ok and type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
		return id
	end
	return nil
end

local function normalizeModeratorId(value: any): number?
	if value == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return normalizeUserId(value)
end

local ALLOWED_SOURCE = {
	Command = true, AntiCheat = true, Backend = true, UI = true,
}

local function normalizeSource(value: any): string
	if type(value) == "string" and ALLOWED_SOURCE[value] then
		return value
	end
	return "Command"
end

local function makeRecord(recordType: string, userId: number, moderatorId: number,
	reason: any, expiresAt: number?, source: any): any
	local text = type(reason) == "string" and reason or "Kein Grund angegeben."
	if text == "" then
		text = "Kein Grund angegeben."
	end
	return {
		Id = newId(),
		Type = recordType,
		UserId = userId,
		ModeratorId = moderatorId,
		Reason = Util.truncate(text, MAX_REASON),
		Timestamp = os.time(),
		ExpiresAt = expiresAt,
		Source = normalizeSource(source),
	}
end

local function copyRecord(record: any): any
	if type(record) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return Util.deepCopy(record)
end

local function isValidStoredRecord(record: any, userId: number): boolean
	return type(record) == "table"
		and (record.Type == "Ban" or record.Type == "TempBan")
		and type(record.UserId) == "number" and record.UserId == userId
		and type(record.Timestamp) == "number"
end

local function isExpired(record: any): boolean
	return type(record.ExpiresAt) == "number" and record.ExpiresAt <= os.time()
end

local function publish(record: any)
	local eventService = getService("EventService")
	if eventService ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			eventService:Fire(Constants.Events.ModerationAction, { action = record })
		end)
	end
	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Write("Admin", "Info", "BanService",
			string.format("%s gegen UserId %d: %s", tostring(record.Type), record.UserId, tostring(record.Reason)),
			{ userId = record.UserId, moderatorId = record.ModeratorId, source = record.Source })
	end
end

local function canTarget(moderatorId: number, userId: number, permission: string): (boolean, string?)
	if moderatorId == 0 then
		return true -- Systemaktion (Backend/AntiCheat) läuft ohne Spieler-Kontext.
	end
	local permissionService = getService("PermissionService")
	if permissionService == nil then
		return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local okPermission, allowed = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:Has(moderatorId, permission)
	end)
	if not okPermission or allowed ~= true then
		return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung " .. permission .. "."
	end
	local okTarget, canHit = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:CanTarget(moderatorId, userId)
	end)
	if not okTarget or canHit ~= true then
		return false, "Du darfst dieses Ziel nicht bearbeiten."
	end
	return true
end

local function addHistory(record: any)
	local history = getService("HistoryService")
	if history ~= nil and type(history.Add) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			history:Add(record)
		end)
	end
end

local function notifyPlayer(userId: number, record: any)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if player == nil or player.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	if record.Type == "Unban" then
		return
	end
	local reason = Util.truncate(record.Reason, 200)
	local message = record.Type == "TempBan"
		and ("Du bist temporär gebannt.\nGrund: " .. reason)
		or ("Du bist von diesem Server gebannt.\nGrund: " .. reason)
	pcall(function()
		player:Kick(message)
	end)
end

local function callRobloxBan(userId: number, duration: number?, reason: string): (boolean, string?)
	if type(Players.BanAsync) ~= "function" then
		return true, "Die Roblox-Ban-API ist auf dieser Experience nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local params = {
		UserIds = { userId },
		ApplyToUniverse = true,
		Duration = (type(duration) == "number" and duration > 0) and math.floor(duration) or -1, -- -1 = permanent (Roblox Ban API)
		DisplayReason = Util.truncate(reason, MAX_API_REASON),
		PrivateReason = Util.truncate(reason, MAX_API_REASON),
		ExcludeAltAccounts = false,
	}
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		return Players:BanAsync(params)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end
	return true, nil
end

local function callRobloxUnban(userId: number): (boolean, string?)
	if type(Players.UnbanAsync) ~= "function" then
		return true, "Die Roblox-Ban-API ist auf dieser Experience nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		return Players:UnbanAsync({ UserIds = { userId }, ApplyToUniverse = true })
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end
	return true, nil
end

function BanService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	activeRing = Ring.new(MAX_ACTIVE_CACHE)
	activeByUser = {}
end

function BanService:Start()
	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Info("BanService", "Ban-Speicher bereit", { store = STORE, cache = MAX_ACTIVE_CACHE })
	end
end

-- Gibt den aktiven Ban zurück. Abgelaufene TempBans gelten als nicht aktiv.
function BanService:CheckBan(userId: number): any?
	local id = normalizeUserId(userId)
	if id == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local cached = activeByUser[id]
	if cached ~= nil then
		if isExpired(cached) then
			activeByUser[id] = nil
			return nil
		end
		return copyRecord(cached)
	end

	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("BanService", "DataService fehlt – Bancheck übersprungen", { userId = id })
		end
		return nil
	end

	local ok, okFetched, stored = pcall(function()
		return dataService:Get(STORE, tostring(id))
	end)
	-- DataService:Get liefert (erfolgreich, wert)
	ok = ok and okFetched == true
	if not ok then
		if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("BanService", "Bancheck fehlgeschlagen", { userId = id, error = tostring(stored) })
		end
		return nil
	end
	if not isValidStoredRecord(stored, id) or isExpired(stored) then
		return nil
	end

	activeByUser[id] = stored
	activeRing:Push(stored)
	return copyRecord(stored)
end

-- Alle in dieser Session bekannten, noch aktiven Bans (neueste zuerst).
function BanService:GetActiveBans(): { any }
	local result = {}
	local seen = {}
	for _, record in ipairs(activeRing:ToArray(true)) do
		local id = type(record.UserId) == "number" and record.UserId or nil
		if id ~= nil and not seen[id] and isValidStoredRecord(record, id) and not isExpired(record) then
			seen[id] = true
			local copy = copyRecord(record)
			if copy ~= nil then
				table.insert(result, copy)
			end
		end
		if #result >= MAX_ACTIVE_CACHE then
			break
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- Bekannte Ban-Einträge eines Users aus dem Session-Cache (neueste zuerst).
function BanService:GetBans(userId: number): { any }
	local id = normalizeUserId(userId)
	if id == nil then
		return {}
	end
	local record = activeByUser[id]
	if record == nil or isExpired(record) then
		return {}
	end
	local copy = copyRecord(record)
	return copy ~= nil and { copy } or {}
end

function BanService:Ban(moderatorId: any, userId: any, reason: any,
	durationSeconds: number?, source: any): (boolean, string)
	local targetId = resolveUserId(userId)
	if targetId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültiges Ziel."
	end
	local modId = normalizeModeratorId(moderatorId)
	if modId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Moderator-ID."
	end

	local duration: number? = nil
	if durationSeconds ~= nil then
		if type(durationSeconds) ~= "number" or durationSeconds ~= durationSeconds
			or durationSeconds <= 0 or durationSeconds > MAX_DURATION then
			return false, "Ungültige Ban-Dauer."
		end
		duration = math.floor(durationSeconds)
	end

	if modId == targetId then
		return false, "Du kannst dich nicht selbst bannen."
	end
	local allowed, denyReason = canTarget(modId, targetId, Constants.Permissions.PlayerBan)
	if not allowed then
		return false, denyReason or "Keine Berechtigung."
	end

	local now = os.time()
	local expiresAt = duration ~= nil and now + duration or nil
	local record = makeRecord(duration ~= nil and "TempBan" or "Ban", targetId, modId, reason, expiresAt, source)

	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return false, "Der Datenspeicher ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local saved = false
	pcall(function()
		saved = dataService:Set(STORE, tostring(targetId), record)
	end)
	if saved ~= true then
		if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Error("BanService", "Ban konnte nicht gespeichert werden", { userId = targetId })
		end
		return false, "Der Ban konnte nicht gespeichert werden."
	end

	activeByUser[targetId] = record
	activeRing:Push(record)

	local apiOk, apiError = callRobloxBan(targetId, duration, record.Reason)
	if not apiOk and framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Warn("BanService", "Roblox-Ban-API abgelehnt – lokaler Ban bleibt aktiv", {
			userId = targetId, error = apiError,
		})
	end

	addHistory(record)
	publish(record)
	notifyPlayer(targetId, record)

	local label = duration ~= nil and ("Temporär gebannt (" .. Util.formatDuration(duration) .. ")") or "Permanent gebannt"
	return true, label .. ": UserId " .. tostring(targetId) .. "."
end

function BanService:Unban(moderatorId: any, userId: any, reason: any, source: any): (boolean, string)
	local targetId = resolveUserId(userId)
	if targetId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültiges Ziel."
	end
	local modId = normalizeModeratorId(moderatorId)
	if modId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Moderator-ID."
	end
	local allowed, denyReason = canTarget(modId, targetId, Constants.Permissions.PlayerBan)
	if not allowed then
		return false, denyReason or "Keine Berechtigung."
	end
	-- Nicht gebannt: trotzdem bei Roblox aufheben (Ban kann im Creator Hub gesetzt worden sein),
	-- aber ehrlich melden, dass Headcraft keinen aktiven Ban kannte.
	if self:CheckBan(targetId) == nil then
		local apiOk = callRobloxUnban(targetId)
		return false, "Spieler " .. tostring(targetId) .. " ist nicht gebannt"
			.. (apiOk and " (ein eventueller Roblox-Ban wurde trotzdem aufgehoben)." or ".")
	end

	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return false, "Der Datenspeicher ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local removed = false
	pcall(function()
		removed = dataService:Remove(STORE, tostring(targetId))
	end)
	if removed ~= true then
		return false, "Der Ban konnte nicht entfernt werden."
	end

	activeByUser[targetId] = nil

	local apiOk, apiError = callRobloxUnban(targetId)
	if not apiOk and framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Warn("BanService", "Roblox-Unban-API abgelehnt", { userId = targetId, error = apiError })
	end

	local record = makeRecord("Unban", targetId, modId, reason, nil, source)
	addHistory(record)
	publish(record)
	return true, "Ban für UserId " .. tostring(targetId) .. " aufgehoben."
end

function BanService:Destroy()
	activeRing:Clear()
	table.clear(activeByUser)
	framework = nil
end

return BanService
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Moderation/HistoryService.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- HistoryService: zentraler, begrenzter Verlauf aller Moderationsaktionen.
-- Registriert zusätzlich die Request-Aktionen GetPlayerProfile und
-- GetModeration für die Admin-Oberfläche. Client-Argumente werden hier
-- erneut geprüft, auch wenn RemoteService schon validiert und Rechte prüft.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Ring = require(Shared.Utilities.Ring)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local HistoryService = {
	Name = "HistoryService",
	Dependencies = { "DataService", "EventService" },
}

local STORE = "Headcraft_History"
local KEY_RECENT = "Recent"
local CAPACITY = 1000
local DISK_CAPACITY = 500
local DEFAULT_LIMIT = 100
local MAX_LIMIT = 500
local MAX_REASON = 500

local framework: any
local ring = Ring.new(CAPACITY)

local ALLOWED_TYPES = {
	Ban = true, TempBan = true, Unban = true,
	Warn = true, Kick = true, Mute = true, Unmute = true,
}
local ALLOWED_SOURCE = { Command = true, AntiCheat = true, Backend = true, UI = true }
local ALLOWED_KINDS = { Bans = true, Warnings = true, Mutes = true, History = true }

local function getService(name: string): any?
	if framework == nil or type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function newId(): string
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	end)
	if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
		return value
	end
	return string.format("history-%d-%d", os.time(), math.random(1, 0x7FFFFFFF))
end

local function normalizeUserId(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
		return nil
	end
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then
		if value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 and value < 1e15 then
			return value
		end
		return nil
	end
	if kind == "string" and value ~= "" and #value <= 64 then
		local number = tonumber(value)
		if number ~= nil and number % 1 == 0 and number > 0 and number < 1e15 then
			return number
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveUserId(value: any): number?
	local direct = normalizeUserId(value)
	if direct ~= nil then
		return direct
	end
	if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" or #value > 50 then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, id = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(value)
	end)
	if ok and type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
		return id
	end
	return nil
end

local function normalizeSource(value: any): string
	if type(value) == "string" and ALLOWED_SOURCE[value] then
		return value
	end
	return "Command"
end

local function sanitizeRecord(record: any): any?
	if type(record) ~= "table" or not ALLOWED_TYPES[record.Type] then
		return nil
	end
	local userId = normalizeUserId(record.UserId)
	local moderatorId = record.ModeratorId
	if userId == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if type(moderatorId) ~= "number" or moderatorId < 0 or moderatorId % 1 ~= 0 then
		moderatorId = 0
	end
	local timestamp = type(record.Timestamp) == "number" and record.Timestamp or os.time()
	local expiresAt = type(record.ExpiresAt) == "number" and record.ExpiresAt or nil
	local reason = type(record.Reason) == "string" and record.Reason or "Kein Grund angegeben."
	return {
		Id = type(record.Id) == "string" and record.Id or newId(),
		Type = record.Type,
		UserId = userId,
		ModeratorId = moderatorId,
		Reason = Util.truncate(reason, MAX_REASON),
		Timestamp = timestamp,
		ExpiresAt = expiresAt,
		Source = normalizeSource(record.Source),
	}
end

local function clampLimit(limit: any): number
	if type(limit) ~= "number" or limit ~= limit then
		return DEFAULT_LIMIT
	end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(limit), 1, MAX_LIMIT)
end

function HistoryService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	ring = Ring.new(CAPACITY)
end

function HistoryService:Start()
	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService ~= nil then
		local ok, okFetched, stored = pcall(function()
			return dataService:Get(STORE, KEY_RECENT)
		end)
		-- DataService:Get liefert (erfolgreich, wert)
		ok = ok and okFetched == true
		if ok and type(stored) == "table" then
			local starting = math.max(0, #stored - CAPACITY + 1)
			for index = starting, #stored do
				local record = sanitizeRecord(stored[index])
				if record ~= nil then
					ring:Push(record)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local remote = getService("RemoteService")
	if remote == nil then
		if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("HistoryService", "RemoteService fehlt – Moderations-Requests sind deaktiviert.")
		end
		return
	end

	remote:OnRequest("GetPlayerProfile", Constants.Permissions.AdminPanel, function(player: Player, args: any)
		return self:_getPlayerProfile(player, args)
	end)
	remote:OnRequest("GetModeration", Constants.Permissions.ModerationViewHistory, function(player: Player, args: any)
		return self:_getModeration(player, args)
	end)

	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Info("HistoryService", "Moderations-Requests registriert", { store = STORE, capacity = CAPACITY })
	end
end

function HistoryService:Add(record: any): boolean
	local clean = sanitizeRecord(record)
	if clean == nil then
		return false
	end
	ring:Push(clean)

	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			dataService:Update(STORE, KEY_RECENT, function(old: any)
				local list = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
				local result = {}
				for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
					local existing = sanitizeRecord(entry)
					if existing ~= nil then
						table.insert(result, existing)
					end
				end
				table.insert(result, clean)
				while #result > DISK_CAPACITY do
					table.remove(result, 1)
				end
				return result
			end)
		end)
	end
	return true
end

function HistoryService:Get(userId: any, limit: any): { any }
	local id = normalizeUserId(userId)
	if id == nil then
		return {}
	end
	local max = clampLimit(limit)
	local result = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(ring:ToArray(true)) do
		if entry.UserId == id then
			table.insert(result, Util.deepCopy(entry))
			if #result >= max then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

function HistoryService:GetRecent(limit: any): { any }
	local max = clampLimit(limit)
	local result = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(ring:ToArray(true)) do
		table.insert(result, Util.deepCopy(entry))
		if #result >= max then
			break
		end
	end
	return result
end

function HistoryService:Clear(moderatorId: any): boolean
	local modId = normalizeUserId(moderatorId)
	if moderatorId ~= 0 and modId == nil then
		return false
	end
	if modId ~= nil and modId > 0 then
		local permissionService = getService("PermissionService")
		if permissionService == nil then
			return false
		end
		local ok, allowed = pcall(function()
			return permissionService:Has(modId, Constants.Permissions.LogsManage)
		end)
		if not ok or allowed ~= true then
			return false
		end
	end

	ring:Clear()
	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			dataService:Remove(STORE, KEY_RECENT)
		end)
	end
	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Write("Admin", "Info", "HistoryService", "Moderationsverlauf wurde geleert.", {
			moderatorId = modId or 0,
		})
	end
	return true
end

local function errorResult(message: string): any
	return { ok = false, error = message }
end

function HistoryService:_getPlayerProfile(_player: Player, args: any): any
	if type(args) ~= "table" then
		return errorResult("Ungültige Argumente.")
	end
	local userId = resolveUserId(args.userId)
	if userId == nil then
		return errorResult("Ungültige UserId.")
	end

	local session = nil
	local playerService = getService("PlayerService")
	if playerService ~= nil and type(playerService.GetSession) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return playerService:GetSession(userId)
		end)
		if ok and type(value) == "table" then
			session = value
		end
	end
	if session == nil then
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		local name = player ~= nil and player.Name or nil
		if name == nil then
			local okName, value = pcall(function()
				return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
			end)
			if okName and type(value) == "string" then
				name = value
			end
		end
		session = {
			userId = userId,
			name = name or ("UserId " .. tostring(userId)),
			displayName = player ~= nil and player.DisplayName or name or "Unbekannt",
			joinedAt = nil,
			accountAge = player ~= nil and player.AccountAge or nil,
			ping = nil,
			frozen = false,
			muted = false,
		}
	end

	local muteService = getService("MuteService")
	if muteService ~= nil and type(muteService.IsMuted) == "function" then
		local okMuted, value = pcall(function()
			return muteService:IsMuted(userId)
		end)
		if okMuted then
			session.muted = value == true
		end
	end

	local rank = "Player"
	local permissionService = getService("PermissionService")
	if permissionService ~= nil then
		local okRank, value = pcall(function()
			return permissionService:GetRank(userId)
		end)
		if okRank and type(value) == "table" and type(value.Name) == "string" then
			rank = value.Name
		end
	end
	session.rank = rank

	local warnings = {}
	local warnService = getService("WarnService")
	if warnService ~= nil and type(warnService.GetWarnings) == "function" then
		local okWarnings, value = pcall(function()
			return warnService:GetWarnings(userId)
		end)
		if okWarnings and type(value) == "table" then
			warnings = value
		end
	end

	local bans = {}
	local banService = getService("BanService")
	if banService ~= nil and type(banService.CheckBan) == "function" then
		local okBan, value = pcall(function()
			return banService:CheckBan(userId)
		end)
		if okBan and type(value) == "table" then
			table.insert(bans, value)
		end
	end

	local detections = {}
	local detectionManager = getService("DetectionManager")
	if detectionManager ~= nil and type(detectionManager.GetRecent) == "function" then
		local okDetections, value = pcall(function()
			return detectionManager:GetRecent(50, userId)
		end)
		if okDetections and type(value) == "table" then
			for _, detection in ipairs(value) do
				if type(detection) == "table" and detection.UserId == userId then
					table.insert(detections, detection)
					if #detections >= 50 then
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local riskScore = 0
	local riskManager = getService("RiskManager")
	if riskManager ~= nil and type(riskManager.Get) == "function" then
		local okRisk, value = pcall(function()
			return riskManager:Get(userId)
		end)
		if okRisk and type(value) == "number" then
			riskScore = value
		end
	end

	return {
		session = session,
		rank = rank,
		warnings = warnings,
		bans = bans,
		history = self:Get(userId, 50),
		detections = detections,
		riskScore = riskScore,
		muted = session.muted == true,
	}
end

function HistoryService:_getModeration(_player: Player, args: any): any
	if type(args) ~= "table" or type(args.kind) ~= "string" or not ALLOWED_KINDS[args.kind] then
		return errorResult("Unbekannte Moderationskategorie.")
	end
	local kind = args.kind
	local source = {}

	if kind == "Bans" then
		local banService = getService("BanService")
		if banService ~= nil and type(banService.GetActiveBans) == "function" then
			local ok, value = pcall(function()
				return banService:GetActiveBans()
			end)
			if ok and type(value) == "table" then
				source = value
			end
		end
	elseif kind == "Warnings" then
		local warnService = getService("WarnService")
		if warnService ~= nil and type(warnService.GetAllWarnings) == "function" then
			local ok, value = pcall(function()
				return warnService:GetAllWarnings()
			end)
			if ok and type(value) == "table" then
				source = value
			end
		end
	elseif kind == "Mutes" then
		local muteService = getService("MuteService")
		if muteService ~= nil and type(muteService.GetMutes) == "function" then
			local ok, value = pcall(function()
				return muteService:GetMutes()
			end)
			if ok and type(value) == "table" then
				source = value
			end
		end
	else
		source = self:GetRecent(200)
	end

	local records = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(source) do
		if type(entry) == "table" then
			table.insert(records, Util.deepCopy(entry))
			if #records >= MAX_LIMIT then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(records, function(left, right)
		return (tonumber(left.Timestamp) or 0) > (tonumber(right.Timestamp) or 0)
	end)
	return { kind = kind, records = records }
end

function HistoryService:Destroy()
	ring:Clear()
	framework = nil
end

return HistoryService
```

```lua
	if ok and type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
		return id
	end
	return nil
end

local function normalizeModeratorId(value: any): number?
	if value == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return normalizeUserId(value)
end

local ALLOWED_SOURCE = { Command = true, AntiCheat = true, Backend = true, UI = true }

local function normalizeSource(value: any): string
	if type(value) == "string" and ALLOWED_SOURCE[value] then
		return value
	end
	return "Command"
end

local function canTarget(moderatorId: number, userId: number): (boolean, string?)
	if moderatorId == 0 then
		return true
	end
	local permissionService = getService("PermissionService")
	if permissionService == nil then
		return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local okPermission, allowed = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:Has(moderatorId, Constants.Permissions.PlayerKick)
	end)
	if not okPermission or allowed ~= true then
		return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung " .. Constants.Permissions.PlayerKick .. "."
	end
	local okTarget, canHit = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:CanTarget(moderatorId, userId)
	end)
	if not okTarget or canHit ~= true then
		return false, "Du darfst dieses Ziel nicht bearbeiten."
	end
	return true
end

local function addHistory(record: any)
	local history = getService("HistoryService")
	if history ~= nil and type(history.Add) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			history:Add(record)
		end)
	end
end

function KickService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
end

function KickService:Start()
	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Info("KickService", "Kick-Service bereit")
	end
end

function KickService:Kick(moderatorId: any, userId: any, reason: any, source: any): (boolean, string)
	local targetId = resolveUserId(userId)
	if targetId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültiges Ziel."
	end
	local modId = normalizeModeratorId(moderatorId)
	if modId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Moderator-ID."
	end

	local allowed, denyReason = canTarget(modId, targetId)
	if not allowed then
		return false, denyReason or "Keine Berechtigung."
	end

	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetId)
	if player == nil or player.Parent == nil then
		return false, "Der Spieler ist nicht mehr auf dem Server."
	end

	local text = type(reason) == "string" and reason or "Kein Grund angegeben."
	if text == "" then
		text = "Kein Grund angegeben."
	end
	local record = {
		Id = newId(),
		Type = "Kick",
		UserId = targetId,
		ModeratorId = modId,
		Reason = Util.truncate(text, MAX_REASON),
		Timestamp = os.time(),
		ExpiresAt = nil,
		Source = normalizeSource(source),
	}

	addHistory(record)

	local eventService = getService("EventService")
	if eventService ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			eventService:Fire(Constants.Events.ModerationAction, { action = record })
		end)
	end
	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Write("Admin", "Info", "KickService",
			string.format("Kick gegen %s (UserId %d): %s", player.Name, targetId, record.Reason),
			{ userId = targetId, moderatorId = modId, source = record.Source })
	end

	local prefix = modId == 0 and "Du wurdest vom System gekickt." or "Du wurdest von einem Administrator gekickt."
	pcall(function()
		player:Kick(Util.truncate(prefix .. "\nGrund: " .. record.Reason, MAX_KICK_MESSAGE))
	end)
	return true, "Spieler " .. player.Name .. " wurde gekickt."
end

function KickService:Destroy()
	framework = nil
end

return KickService

```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Moderation/MuteService.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- MuteService: Stummschaltung über TextChatService.ShouldDeliverCallback.
-- Der Callback wird auf allen bestehenden und später erstellten TextChannels
-- installiert. Bei Legacy-Chat bleibt nur ein serverseitiger Beobachtungs-
-- Pfad (Legacy-ChatService stellt keinen Zustell-Hook bereit).
-- Aktive Mutes werden im DataStore gespeichert, damit sie einen Serverwechsel
-- überstehen.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Maid = require(Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local MuteService = {
	Name = "MuteService",
	Dependencies = { "DataService", "EventService" },
}

local STORE = "Headcraft_Settings"
local KEY_MUTES = "Mutes"
local MAX_MUTES = 200
local MAX_REASON = 500
local MAX_DURATION = 315360000 -- 10 Jahre.
local LEGACY_NOTICE_COOLDOWN = 5

local framework: any
local maid: any
local muted: { [number]: number } = {} -- UserId → Ablaufzeit (math.huge = permanent)
local installedChannels: { [any]: boolean } = {}
local previousCallbacks: { [any]: any } = {}
local chatConnections: { [number]: any } = {}
local lastLegacyNotice: { [number]: number } = {}

local function getService(name: string): any?
	if framework == nil or type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function newId(): string
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	end)
	if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
		return value
	end
	return string.format("mute-%d-%d", os.time(), math.random(1, 0x7FFFFFFF))
end

local function normalizeUserId(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
		return nil
	end
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then
		if value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 and value < 1e15 then
			return value
		end
		return nil
	end
	if kind == "string" and value ~= "" and #value <= 64 then
		local number = tonumber(value)
		if number ~= nil and number % 1 == 0 and number > 0 and number < 1e15 then
			return number
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveUserId(value: any): number?
	local direct = normalizeUserId(value)
	if direct ~= nil then
		return direct
	end
	if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" or #value > 50 then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, id = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(value)
	end)
	if ok and type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
		return id
	end
	return nil
end

local function normalizeModeratorId(value: any): number?
	if value == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return normalizeUserId(value)
end

local ALLOWED_SOURCE = { Command = true, AntiCheat = true, Backend = true, UI = true }

local function normalizeSource(value: any): string
	if type(value) == "string" and ALLOWED_SOURCE[value] then
		return value
	end
	return "Command"
end

local function makeRecord(recordType: string, userId: number, moderatorId: number,
	reason: any, expiresAt: number?, source: any): any
	local text = type(reason) == "string" and reason or "Kein Grund angegeben."
	if text == "" then
		text = "Kein Grund angegeben."
	end
	return {
		Id = newId(),
		Type = recordType,
		UserId = userId,
		ModeratorId = moderatorId,
		Reason = Util.truncate(text, MAX_REASON),
		Timestamp = os.time(),
		ExpiresAt = expiresAt,
		Source = normalizeSource(source),
	}
end

local function isValidRecord(record: any, userId: number): boolean
	return type(record) == "table"
		and (record.Type == "Mute" or record.Type == "Unmute")
		and type(record.UserId) == "number" and record.UserId == userId
		and type(record.Timestamp) == "number"
end

local function isActive(record: any): boolean
	if type(record) ~= "table" or record.Type ~= "Mute" then
		return false
	end
	return type(record.ExpiresAt) ~= "number" or record.ExpiresAt > os.time()
end

local function currentPrefix(): string
	local config = framework ~= nil and framework.Config or nil
	local admin = type(config) == "table" and config.Admin or nil
	local prefix = type(admin) == "table" and admin.Prefix or nil
	if type(prefix) ~= "string" or prefix == "" then
		return ";"
	end
	return prefix
end

local function hasAdminPanel(userId: number): boolean
	local permissionService = getService("PermissionService")
	if permissionService == nil then
		return false
	end
	local ok, allowed = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:Has(userId, Constants.Permissions.AdminPanel)
	end)
	return ok and allowed == true
end

local function canTarget(moderatorId: number, userId: number): (boolean, string?)
	if moderatorId == 0 then
		return true
	end
	local permissionService = getService("PermissionService")
	if permissionService == nil then
		return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local okPermission, allowed = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:Has(moderatorId, Constants.Permissions.ModerationMute)
	end)
	if not okPermission or allowed ~= true then
		return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung " .. Constants.Permissions.ModerationMute .. "."
	end
	local okTarget, canHit = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:CanTarget(moderatorId, userId)
	end)
	if not okTarget or canHit ~= true then
		return false, "Du darfst dieses Ziel nicht bearbeiten."
	end
	return true
end

local function publish(record: any)
	local eventService = getService("EventService")
	if eventService ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			eventService:Fire(Constants.Events.ModerationAction, { action = record })
		end)
	end
	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Write("Admin", "Info", "MuteService",
			string.format("%s gegen UserId %d: %s", tostring(record.Type), record.UserId, tostring(record.Reason)),
			{ userId = record.UserId, moderatorId = record.ModeratorId, source = record.Source })
	end
end

local function addHistory(record: any)
	local history = getService("HistoryService")
	if history ~= nil and type(history.Add) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			history:Add(record)
		end)
	end
end

local function notifyTarget(userId: number, title: string, message: string)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local remote = getService("RemoteService")
	if player ~= nil and player.Parent ~= nil and remote ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			remote:Push(player, Constants.Channels.Toast, {
				kind = "warning", title = title, message = Util.truncate(message, 300),
			})
		end)
	end
end

-- Teilt dem betroffenen Spieler den Mute-Zustand mit, damit sein Client die Chat-Oberfläche
-- ab- bzw. wieder einschaltet. Rein kosmetisch: Die Zustellung blockiert der Server unabhängig davon
-- über ShouldDeliverCallback, ein manipulierter Client kann also trotzdem nicht chatten.
local function pushMuteState(userId: number)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local remote = getService("RemoteService")
	if player == nil or player.Parent == nil or remote == nil then
		return
	end
	local expires = muted[userId]
	local active = expires ~= nil and expires > os.time()
	pcall(function()
		remote:Push(player, Constants.Channels.Mute, {
			muted = active,
			-- Restlaufzeit statt Zeitstempel: Client-Uhren sind nicht verlässlich. -1 = dauerhaft.
			remainingSeconds = active and (expires == math.huge and -1 or math.max(0, expires - os.time())) or 0,
		})
	end)
end

-- Plant das automatische Aufheben eines zeitlich begrenzten Mutes. Greift nur, wenn der Mute in der
-- Zwischenzeit nicht verlängert, ersetzt oder aufgehoben wurde (Vergleich der Ablaufzeit).
local function scheduleExpiry(userId: number, expiresAt: number)
	if expiresAt == math.huge then
		return
	end
	task.delay(math.max(0, expiresAt - os.time()) + 0.5, function()
		if muted[userId] == expiresAt then
			muted[userId] = nil
			pushMuteState(userId)
			notifyTarget(userId, "Stummschaltung abgelaufen", "Du kannst wieder am Chat teilnehmen.")
		end
	end)
end

local function field(message: any, name: string): any
	if message == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		if name == "UserId" then
			-- TextChatMessage trägt den Absender in TextSource (TextSource.UserId), nicht direkt.
			local source = message.TextSource
			return source and source.UserId or nil
		elseif name == "Text" then
			return message.Text
		end
		return nil
	end)
	if ok then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

function MuteService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	maid = Maid.new()
	muted = {}
	installedChannels = {}
	previousCallbacks = {}
	chatConnections = {}
	lastLegacyNotice = {}
end

function MuteService:Start()
	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService ~= nil then
		local ok, okFetched, stored = pcall(function()
			return dataService:Get(STORE, KEY_MUTES)
		end)
		-- DataService:Get liefert (erfolgreich, wert)
		ok = ok and okFetched == true
		if ok and type(stored) == "table" then
			for _, record in ipairs(stored) do
				if type(record) == "table" and type(record.UserId) == "number" and isActive(record) then
					muted[record.UserId] = type(record.ExpiresAt) == "number" and record.ExpiresAt or math.huge
					scheduleExpiry(record.UserId, muted[record.UserId])
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Gemutete Spieler bekommen beim Betreten (und bereits anwesende sofort) den Zustand gepusht.
	-- Kurze Verzögerung, damit der Client seinen Push-Empfänger verbunden hat.
	maid:Give(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		if self:IsMuted(player.UserId) then
			task.delay(3, pushMuteState, player.UserId)
		end
	end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if self:IsMuted(player.UserId) then
			task.delay(3, pushMuteState, player.UserId)
		end
	end

	-- TextChannels legt TextChatService beim Serverstart selbst an – kurz darauf warten, sonst würde
	-- fälschlich der Legacy-Modus gewählt. Bei LegacyChatService existiert der Ordner nie.
	local success, channels = pcall(function()
		if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.LegacyChatService then
			return nil
		end
		return TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels", 10)
	end)
	if success and typeof(channels) == "Instance" then
		maid:Give(channels.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
			self:_installChannel(child)
		end))
		maid:Give(channels.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child: Instance)
			installedChannels[child] = nil
			previousCallbacks[child] = nil
		end))
		for _, child in ipairs(channels:GetChildren()) do
			self:_installChannel(child)
		end
	end

	local legacy = not success or typeof(channels) ~= "Instance"
	if not legacy then
		local okVersion, version = pcall(function()
			return TextChatService.ChatVersion
		end)
		if okVersion and Enum.ChatVersion ~= nil and version == Enum.ChatVersion.LegacyChatService then
			legacy = true
		end
	end
	if legacy then
		self:_startLegacyFallback()
	end

	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Info("MuteService", "Chat-Filter installiert", { legacyFallback = legacy })
	end
end

function MuteService:_installChannel(channel: Instance)
	if typeof(channel) ~= "Instance" or not channel:IsA("TextChannel") then
		return
	end
	if installedChannels[channel] then
		return
	end

	local previous = nil
	local okRead, value = pcall(function()
		return channel.ShouldDeliverCallback
	end)
	if okRead and type(value) == "function" then
		previous = value
	end

	local selfRef = self
	local callback = function(textChatMessage: any, targetTextChannel: any): boolean
		if previous ~= nil then
			local okPrevious, previousResult = pcall(previous, textChatMessage, targetTextChannel)
			if okPrevious and previousResult == false then
				return false
			end
		end
		return selfRef:_shouldDeliver(textChatMessage)
	end

	local okSet, err = pcall(function()
		channel.ShouldDeliverCallback = callback
	end)
	if not okSet then
		if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
			framework.Log:Warn("MuteService", "ShouldDeliverCallback konnte nicht gesetzt werden", {
				channel = channel.Name, error = tostring(err),
			})
		end
		return
	end

	installedChannels[channel] = true
	previousCallbacks[channel] = previous or false
end

function MuteService:_shouldDeliver(textChatMessage: any): boolean
	local userId = field(textChatMessage, "UserId")
	if type(userId) ~= "number" or userId <= 0 then
		return true
	end
	if self:IsMuted(userId) then
		return false
	end

	local text = field(textChatMessage, "Text")
	if type(text) ~= "string" then
		return true
	end
	local trimmed = string.gsub(text, "^%s+", "")
	local prefix = currentPrefix()
	local isCommand = string.sub(text, 1, #prefix) == prefix
		or string.sub(trimmed, 1, #prefix) == prefix
	if isCommand and hasAdminPanel(userId) then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function MuteService:_startLegacyFallback()
	maid:Give(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		self:_watchPlayer(player)
	end))
	maid:Give(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local connection = chatConnections[player.UserId]
		if connection ~= nil then
			connection:Disconnect()
			chatConnections[player.UserId] = nil
		end
		lastLegacyNotice[player.UserId] = nil
	end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		self:_watchPlayer(player)
	end
end

function MuteService:_watchPlayer(player: Player)
	if chatConnections[player.UserId] ~= nil then
		return
	end
	chatConnections[player.UserId] = player.Chatted:Connect(function(message: string)
		self:_observeLegacyChat(player.UserId, message)
	end)
end

function MuteService:_observeLegacyChat(userId: number, message: string)
	if type(message) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local hidden = self:IsMuted(userId)
	if not hidden then
		local trimmed = string.gsub(message, "^%s+", "")
		local prefix = currentPrefix()
		if (string.sub(message, 1, #prefix) == prefix or string.sub(trimmed, 1, #prefix) == prefix)
			and hasAdminPanel(userId) then
			hidden = true
		end
	end
	if not hidden then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if (lastLegacyNotice[userId] or 0) + LEGACY_NOTICE_COOLDOWN > now then
		return
	end
	lastLegacyNotice[userId] = now

	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Write("Admin", "Warn", "MuteService",
			"Legacy-Chat: Nachricht eines stummen/admins MIT Admin.Panel konnte nicht serverseitig unterdrückt werden.",
			{ userId = userId, message = Util.truncate(message, 120) })
	end
	local remote = getService("RemoteService")
	if remote ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			remote:PushToPermission(Constants.Permissions.AdminPanel, Constants.Channels.Toast, {
				kind = "warning",
				title = "Legacy-Chat",
				message = "UserId " .. tostring(userId) .. " hat eine Nachricht gesendet, die nicht zur Steuerung zugestellt werden konnte.",
			})
		end)
	end
end

function MuteService:IsMuted(userId: number): boolean
	local id = normalizeUserId(userId)
	if id == nil then
		return false
	end
	local expires = muted[id]
	if expires == nil then
		return false
	end
	if expires <= os.time() then
		muted[id] = nil
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function MuteService:GetMutes(): { any }
	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return {}
	end
	local ok, okFetched, stored = pcall(function()
		return dataService:Get(STORE, KEY_MUTES)
	end)
	-- DataService:Get liefert (erfolgreich, wert)
	ok = ok and okFetched == true
	if not ok or type(stored) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	local result = {}
	for _, record in ipairs(stored) do
		if isValidRecord(record, record.UserId) and isActive(record) then
			table.insert(result, Util.deepCopy(record))
		end
		if #result >= MAX_MUTES then
			break
		end
	end
	return result
end

function MuteService:Mute(moderatorId: any, userId: any, durationSeconds: any,
	reason: any, source: any): (boolean, string)
	-- Ohne Dauerangabe gilt der erste Text als Grund („mute <Ziel> <Grund>“).
	if type(durationSeconds) == "string" and reason == nil then
		reason = durationSeconds
		durationSeconds = nil
	end
	local targetId = resolveUserId(userId)
	if targetId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültiges Ziel."
	end
	local modId = normalizeModeratorId(moderatorId)
	if modId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Moderator-ID."
	end

	local duration: number? = nil
	if durationSeconds ~= nil then
		if type(durationSeconds) ~= "number" or durationSeconds ~= durationSeconds
			or durationSeconds <= 0 or durationSeconds > MAX_DURATION then
			return false, "Ungültige Mute-Dauer."
		end
		duration = math.floor(durationSeconds)
	end

	local allowed, denyReason = canTarget(modId, targetId)
	if not allowed then
		return false, denyReason or "Keine Berechtigung."
	end

	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return false, "Der Datenspeicher ist nicht verfügbar."
	end

	local now = os.time()
	local expiresAt = duration ~= nil and now + duration or nil
	local record = makeRecord("Mute", targetId, modId, reason, expiresAt, source)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local updated, updateError = dataService:Update(STORE, KEY_MUTES, function(old: any)
			local list = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
			local clean = {}
			for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
				if isValidRecord(entry, entry.UserId) and entry.UserId ~= targetId and isActive(entry) then
					table.insert(clean, Util.deepCopy(entry))
				end
			end
			table.insert(clean, record)
			while #clean > MAX_MUTES do
				table.remove(clean, 1)
			end
			return clean
		end)
		if not updated then
			error(updateError, 0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, "Mute konnte nicht gespeichert werden: " .. tostring(err)
	end

	muted[targetId] = expiresAt or math.huge
	scheduleExpiry(targetId, muted[targetId])
	addHistory(record)
	publish(record)
	pushMuteState(targetId)
	local label = duration ~= nil and (" für " .. Util.formatDuration(duration)) or " dauerhaft"
	notifyTarget(targetId, "Stummschaltung", "Du wurdest" .. label .. " stummgeschaltet. Grund: " .. record.Reason)
	return true, "Spieler " .. tostring(targetId) .. label .. " stummgeschaltet."
end

function MuteService:Unmute(moderatorId: any, userId: any, reason: any, source: any): (boolean, string)
	local targetId = resolveUserId(userId)
	if targetId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültiges Ziel."
	end
	local modId = normalizeModeratorId(moderatorId)
	if modId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Moderator-ID."
	end
	local allowed, denyReason = canTarget(modId, targetId)
	if not allowed then
		return false, denyReason or "Keine Berechtigung."
	end
	if not self:IsMuted(targetId) then
		return false, "Spieler " .. tostring(targetId) .. " ist nicht stummgeschaltet."
	end

	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return false, "Der Datenspeicher ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local updated, updateError = dataService:Update(STORE, KEY_MUTES, function(old: any)
			local list = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
			local clean = {}
			for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
				if isValidRecord(entry, entry.UserId) and entry.UserId ~= targetId and isActive(entry) then
					table.insert(clean, Util.deepCopy(entry))
				end
			end
			return clean
		end)
		if not updated then
			error(updateError, 0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, "Unmute konnte nicht gespeichert werden: " .. tostring(err)
	end

	muted[targetId] = nil
	local record = makeRecord("Unmute", targetId, modId, reason, nil, source)
	addHistory(record)
	publish(record)
	pushMuteState(targetId)
	notifyTarget(targetId, "Stummschaltung aufgehoben", "Du kannst wieder am Chat teilnehmen.")
	return true, "Stummschaltung für UserId " .. tostring(targetId) .. " aufgehoben."
end

function MuteService:Destroy()
	if maid ~= nil then
		maid:Clean()
	end
	for channel, previous in pairs(previousCallbacks) do
		pcall(function()
			if previous == false then
				channel.ShouldDeliverCallback = nil
			else
				channel.ShouldDeliverCallback = previous
			end
		end)
	end
	table.clear(installedChannels)
	table.clear(previousCallbacks)
	table.clear(chatConnections)
	table.clear(lastLegacyNotice)
	table.clear(muted)
	framework = nil
end

return MuteService
```

`scripts/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Moderation/WarnService.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- WarnService: Verwarnungen pro UserId im DataStore, mit History-Eintrag
-- und ModerationAction-Event. Offline-Ziele (UserId oder Name) sind erlaubt.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local WarnService = {
	Name = "WarnService",
	Dependencies = { "DataService", "EventService" },
}

local STORE = "Headcraft_Warnings"
local MAX_WARNINGS_PER_USER = 200
local MAX_KNOWN_USERS = 1000
local MAX_REASON = 500

local framework: any
local knownUsers: { [number]: boolean } = {}

local function getService(name: string): any?
	if framework == nil or type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function newId(): string
	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	end)
	if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
		return value
	end
	return string.format("warn-%d-%d", os.time(), math.random(1, 0x7FFFFFFF))
end

local function normalizeUserId(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
		return nil
	end
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "number" then
		if value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 and value < 1e15 then
			return value
		end
		return nil
	end
	if kind == "string" and value ~= "" and #value <= 64 then
		local number = tonumber(value)
		if number ~= nil and number % 1 == 0 and number > 0 and number < 1e15 then
			return number
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveUserId(value: any): number?
	local direct = normalizeUserId(value)
	if direct ~= nil then
		return direct
	end
	if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" or #value > 50 then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, id = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(value)
	end)
	if ok and type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
		return id
	end
	return nil
end

local function normalizeModeratorId(value: any): number?
	if value == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return normalizeUserId(value)
end

local ALLOWED_SOURCE = { Command = true, AntiCheat = true, Backend = true, UI = true }

local function normalizeSource(value: any): string
	if type(value) == "string" and ALLOWED_SOURCE[value] then
		return value
	end
	return "Command"
end

local function makeRecord(recordType: string, userId: number, moderatorId: number,
	reason: any, source: any): any
	local text = type(reason) == "string" and reason or "Kein Grund angegeben."
	if text == "" then
		text = "Kein Grund angegeben."
	end
	return {
		Id = newId(),
		Type = recordType,
		UserId = userId,
		ModeratorId = moderatorId,
		Reason = Util.truncate(text, MAX_REASON),
		Timestamp = os.time(),
		ExpiresAt = nil,
		Source = normalizeSource(source),
	}
end

local function isValidRecord(record: any, userId: number): boolean
	return type(record) == "table"
		and record.Type == "Warn"
		and type(record.UserId) == "number" and record.UserId == userId
		and type(record.Timestamp) == "number"
		and type(record.Reason) == "string"
end

local function publish(record: any)
	local eventService = getService("EventService")
	if eventService ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			eventService:Fire(Constants.Events.ModerationAction, { action = record })
		end)
	end
	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Write("Admin", "Info", "WarnService",
			string.format("Verwarnung gegen UserId %d: %s", record.UserId, record.Reason),
			{ userId = record.UserId, moderatorId = record.ModeratorId, source = record.Source })
	end
end

local function canTarget(moderatorId: number, userId: number, permission: string): (boolean, string?)
	if moderatorId == 0 then
		return true
	end
	local permissionService = getService("PermissionService")
	if permissionService == nil then
		return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local okPermission, allowed = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:Has(moderatorId, permission)
	end)
	if not okPermission or allowed ~= true then
		return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung " .. permission .. "."
	end
	local okTarget, canHit = pcall(function()
		return permissionService:CanTarget(moderatorId, userId)
	end)
	if not okTarget or canHit ~= true then
		return false, "Du darfst dieses Ziel nicht bearbeiten."
	end
	return true
end

local function addHistory(record: any)
	local history = getService("HistoryService")
	if history ~= nil and type(history.Add) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			history:Add(record)
		end)
	end
end

local function rememberUser(userId: number)
	if knownUsers[userId] then
		return
	end
	local count = 0
	for _ in pairs(knownUsers) do
		count += 1
	end
	if count >= MAX_KNOWN_USERS then
		return
	end
	knownUsers[userId] = true
end

local function notifyPlayer(userId: number, reason: string)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local remote = getService("RemoteService")
	if player ~= nil and player.Parent ~= nil and remote ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			remote:Push(player, Constants.Channels.Toast, {
				kind = "warning",
				title = "Verwarnung",
				message = Util.truncate(reason, 300),
			})
		end)
	end
end

function WarnService:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	knownUsers = {}
end

function WarnService:Start()
	if framework ~= nil and framework.Log ~= nil then
		framework.Log:Info("WarnService", "Warnungsspeicher bereit", { store = STORE })
	end
end

function WarnService:Warn(moderatorId: any, userId: any, reason: any, source: any): (boolean, string)
	local targetId = resolveUserId(userId)
	if targetId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültiges Ziel."
	end
	local modId = normalizeModeratorId(moderatorId)
	if modId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Moderator-ID."
	end
	local allowed, denyReason = canTarget(modId, targetId, Constants.Permissions.ModerationWarn)
	if not allowed then
		return false, denyReason or "Keine Berechtigung."
	end

	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return false, "Der Datenspeicher ist nicht verfügbar."
	end

	local record = makeRecord("Warn", targetId, modId, reason, source)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		return dataService:Update(STORE, tostring(targetId), function(old: any)
			local list = type(old) == "table" and old or {}
			local clean = {}
			for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
				if isValidRecord(entry, targetId) then
					table.insert(clean, Util.deepCopy(entry))
				end
			end
			table.insert(clean, record)
			while #clean > MAX_WARNINGS_PER_USER do
				table.remove(clean, 1)
			end
			return clean
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, "Verwarnung konnte nicht gespeichert werden: " .. tostring(err)
	end

	rememberUser(targetId)
	addHistory(record)
	publish(record)
	notifyPlayer(targetId, record.Reason)
	return true, "Verwarnung gespeichert für UserId " .. tostring(targetId) .. "."
end

function WarnService:GetWarnings(userId: any): { any }
	local targetId = normalizeUserId(userId)
	if targetId == nil then
		return {}
	end
	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return {}
	end
	local ok, okFetched, stored = pcall(function()
		return dataService:Get(STORE, tostring(targetId))
	end)
	-- DataService:Get liefert (erfolgreich, wert)
	ok = ok and okFetched == true
	if not ok or type(stored) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	local result = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(stored) do
		if isValidRecord(entry, targetId) then
			table.insert(result, Util.deepCopy(entry))
		end
		if #result >= MAX_WARNINGS_PER_USER then
			break
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- Verwarnte UserIds dieser Session (für GetModeration "Warnings").
function WarnService:GetWarnedUsers(): { number }
	local result = {}
	for userId in pairs(knownUsers) do
		table.insert(result, userId)
	end
	table.sort(result)
	return result
end

-- Aggregierte Warnungen aller in dieser Session bekannten Nutzer.
function WarnService:GetAllWarnings(): { any }
	local result = {}
	for _, userId in ipairs(self:GetWarnedUsers()) do
		for _, record in ipairs(self:GetWarnings(userId)) do
			table.insert(result, record)
			if #result >= 500 then
				return result
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(result, function(left, right)
		return (tonumber(left.Timestamp) or 0) > (tonumber(right.Timestamp) or 0)
	end)
	return result
end

function WarnService:ClearWarnings(moderatorId: any, userId: any, source: any): (boolean, string)
	local targetId = resolveUserId(userId)
	if targetId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültiges Ziel."
	end
	local modId = normalizeModeratorId(moderatorId)
	if modId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Moderator-ID."
	end
	local allowed, denyReason = canTarget(modId, targetId, Constants.Permissions.ModerationWarn)
	if not allowed then
		return false, denyReason or "Keine Berechtigung."
	end

	local dataService = getService("DataService")
	if dataService == nil then
		return false, "Der Datenspeicher ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local removed = false
	pcall(function()
		removed = dataService:Remove(STORE, tostring(targetId))
	end)
	if removed ~= true then
		return false, "Die Verwarnungen konnten nicht gelöscht werden."
	end
	knownUsers[targetId] = nil

	local record = makeRecord("Warn", targetId, modId, "Verwarnungen wurden zurückgesetzt.", source)
	addHistory(record)
	publish(record)
	return true, "Verwarnungen für UserId " .. tostring(targetId) .. " gelöscht."
end

function WarnService:Destroy()
	table.clear(knownUsers)
	framework = nil
end

return WarnService
```
