-- Madonox
-- 2025

--// INTERNAL IDENTITY

local BIT_INTERNAL_ID = 0

--//

--[=[
	@class BitAntiCheat
	Primary anticheat singleton class
]=]
local BitAntiCheat = {
	functions = {};
	configuration = {};
}

--[=[
	@prop functions {[string]: PatchFunction}
	@within BitAntiCheat
	A table of patchable functions.  It contains functions like onCheaterCaught and onPlayerStriked.
]=]

BitAntiCheat.__index = BitAntiCheat

local Log = require(script:WaitForChild("Log"))
local Patch = require(script:WaitForChild("Patch"))
local BitPlayer = require(script:WaitForChild("BitPlayer"))

type BitAntiCheatProperties = {
	functions: {
		onCheaterCaught: Patch.PatchFunction;
		onPlayerStriked: Patch.PatchFunction;
	};
}
export type BitAntiCheat = typeof(setmetatable({} :: BitAntiCheatProperties, BitAntiCheat))

local BitInstance; -- checks if metatable has been set or not
local BitActive = false;

--[=[
	@within BitAntiCheat
	Returns the anticheat instance
	@return BitAntiCheat

	Basic initialization script:
	```lua
	local BitAntiCheat = require(path.to.BitAntiCheat)
	BitAntiCheat:instance():safeLoad({
		initIdentity = 0;

		configuration = {
			silentLog = false;
			clientEnabled = true;
			strikesNeeded = 10; -- how many strikes a player needs before getting kicked

			disabledChecks = {};
		};
	})
	```
]=]
function BitAntiCheat:instance(): BitAntiCheat
	if BitInstance then
		return BitInstance
	end

	-- construct anticheat

	setmetatable(BitAntiCheat, BitAntiCheat)
	setmetatable(BitPlayer, self)

	local checks = {}
	for _, module in script:WaitForChild("Checks"):GetChildren() do
		local req = require(module)
		checks[module.Name] = req

		if req.init then
			req:init()
		end
		Patch.newTable(req)
	end
	table.freeze(checks)
	self.checks = checks

	self.functions.onCheaterCaught = Patch.newFunction(function(player:Player, reason:string)
		player:Kick("Unstable connection.  Please get a better connection before rejoining.") -- TODO: use config kick reason
	end)

	local logFormat = "[BitAntiCheat]: %s"
	local log = Log.new(function(message:string, ...)
		return string.format(logFormat, string.format(message, ...))
	end)
	self.logger = log

	self.functions.onPlayerStriked = Patch.newFunction(function(player:Player, reason:string, weight:number)
		log:print("Player %s striked for %s with weighting %i", player.Name, reason, weight)
	end)

	BitInstance = BitAntiCheat
	table.freeze(BitAntiCheat)

	-- anti-tamper
	local originalScriptParent = script.Parent

	local function pcallParent(object, newParent)
		object.Parent = newParent
	end

	script.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if script.Parent ~= originalScriptParent then
			local success, _ = pcall(pcallParent, script, originalScriptParent)
			log:warn("A component of BitAntiCheat is being tampered with by a server script!  This could be a serious vulnurability!  Component: %s;  Restore success: %*", script:GetFullName(), success)
		end
	end)
	for _, inst in script:GetDescendants() do
		local originalInstParent = inst.Parent
		inst.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			if inst.Parent ~= originalInstParent then
				local success, _ = pcall(pcallParent, script, originalScriptParent)
				log:warn("A component of BitAntiCheat is being tampered with by a server script!  This could be a serious vulnurability!  Component: %s;  Restore success: %*", inst:GetFullName(), success)
			end
		end)
	end

	return BitInstance -- keeps type checking from complaining
end

--[=[
	@within BitAntiCheat
	Used to initialize a safe load
	@param token The current loader token and configuration table
]=]
function BitAntiCheat:safeLoad(token)
	if BitActive then
		self.logger:warn("Cannot start BitAntiCheat!  An instance is already running!")
		return
	end

	self:instance() -- safety call
	if token and token.initIdentity == BIT_INTERNAL_ID then -- checks to make sure the loader is up-to-date
		local configuration = token.configuration
		local selfConfiguration = self.configuration -- since the anticheat root is frozen we manually copy values
		for k, v in configuration do
			selfConfiguration[k] = v
		end

		if configuration.silentLog then -- disables all logging
			local function nullFunction()
				
			end
			self.logger.print += nullFunction
			self.logger.warn += nullFunction
			self.logger.error += nullFunction
		end

		if configuration.disabledChecks then
			for _, check in configuration.disabledChecks do
				self.checks[check].disabled = true
			end
		end

		BitPlayer:init()
		return
	end

	self.logger:error("Invalid BitAntiCheat loader.  Please install a new one.  BitAntiCheat is NOT running.")
end

--[=[
	@within BitAntiCheat
	Method to directly fetch a BitPlayer from a regular Player instance.
	@param player Player -- The target player
	@return BitPlayer
]=]
function BitAntiCheat:player(player:Player)
	self:instance() -- safety call
	if BitActive then
		return (BitPlayer :: {[any]: any}).players[player] -- quick typecast to fix issues
	end

	self.logger:error("Cannot fetch BitPlayer for player %s.  BitAntiCheat is not running!", player.Name)
	return nil
end

return BitAntiCheat

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/BitAntiCheat/BitPlayer.lua`:

```lua
-- Madonox
-- 2025

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ClientRuntime = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Client")

local function CountStrikes(dict:{[string]: number})
	local tc = 0
	for _, c in dict do
		tc += c
	end

	return tc
end

--[=[
	@class BitPlayer
	Class wrapper for players.  Handles timings, tracking, and more.
]=]
local BitPlayer = {}
BitPlayer.__index = BitPlayer

function BitPlayer:init()
	local players = {}
	self.players = players

	local function newPlayer(player:Player)
		if not players[player] then
			players[player] = self:new(player)
		end
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(newPlayer)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player:Player)
		local class = players[player]
		if class then
			class:dispose()
		end
	end)

	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		newPlayer(player)
	end

	if self.configuration.clientEnabled then
		local commsEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		commsEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, mode)
			local class = players[player]
			if class then
				if mode == 1 then
					class.lastPing = os.time()
				elseif mode == 2 then
					class:strike(math.huge, "Client Exploit")
				end
			end
		end)
		commsEvent:AddTag("BACTag0x0")
		local repStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
		commsEvent.Parent = repStorage

		-- anti-tamper

		local function pcallParent(object, newParent)
			object.Parent = newParent
		end
		commsEvent.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			if commsEvent.Parent ~= repStorage then
				local success, _ = pcall(pcallParent, commsEvent, repStorage)
				self.logger:warn("A component of BitAntiCheat is being tampered with by a server script!  This could be a serious vulnurability!  Component: %s;  Restore success: %*", commsEvent:GetFullName(), success)
			end
		end)
		local collectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
		collectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("BACTag0x0"):Connect(function(item)
			if item == commsEvent then
				self.logger:warn("A component of BitAntiCheat is being tampered with by a server script!  This could be a serious vulnurability!  Component: %s;  Restoring component...", commsEvent:GetFullName())
				commsEvent:AddTag("BACTag0x0")
			end
		end)

		collectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("BACTag0x0"):Connect(function(item)
			if item ~= commsEvent then
				self.logger:warn("A server-script is attempting to tamper with BitAntiCheat functionality by adding non-BitAntiCheat instances to guarded tags!  This could be a serious vulnurability!  External instance: %s;  Removing intrusion...", item:GetFullName())
				item:RemoveTag("BACTag0x0")
			end
		end)

		local taggedItems = collectionService:GetTagged("BACTag0x0")
		if taggedItems[1] ~= commsEvent or rawlen(taggedItems) > 1 then
			local removedList = ""
			for _, v in taggedItems do
				if v ~= commsEvent then
					v:RemoveTag("BACTag0x0")
					removedList ..= "\n" .. v:GetFullName()
				end
			end

			self.logger:warn("Multiple instances using a reserved BitAntiCheat tag!  Removed the following instances from reserved tag:%s", removedList)
		end
	end
end

function BitPlayer:new(player:Player)
	local object = setmetatable({
		player = player;
		strikes = {};
		checkQueue = {};
		lastPing = os.time();
		memory = {};
	}, BitPlayer)

	if self.configuration.clientEnabled then
		ClientRuntime:Clone().Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") -- safest cloning location as games almost always never destroy this
	end

	object.characterAdded = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		for _, check in self.checks do
			if check.characterAdded and not check.disabled then
				check:characterAdded(object, character)
			end
		end
	end)

	object.taskThread = coroutine.create(function()
		local resumptionPool = {}
		local checks = self.checks
		for id, check in checks do
			if check.checkPlayer and not check.disabled then
				resumptionPool[id] = 0
			end
		end

		-- algorithm to select the task that will run as soon as possible, wait it's delay, subtract the time from other tasks, then select again (keeps thread use down and has relatively little performance impact)
		while object.taskThread ~= nil do
			local minimumTime = 9999
			local callTask = nil

			for id, resumeTime in resumptionPool do
				if resumeTime < minimumTime then
					minimumTime = resumeTime
					callTask = id
				end
			end

			for id, _ in resumptionPool do
				if id ~= callTask then
					resumptionPool[id] -= minimumTime
				end
			end

			task.wait(minimumTime)

			resumptionPool[callTask] = checks[callTask]:checkPlayer(object)
		end

		table.clear(resumptionPool)
	end)
	coroutine.resume(object.taskThread)

	return object
end

--[=[
	@within BitPlayer
	Used to pause the checks on a player.
]=]
function BitPlayer:pauseChecks()
	local status = coroutine.status(self.taskThread)
	if status ~= "suspended" and status ~= "dead" then
		local success, _ = pcall(coroutine.yield, self.taskThread)
		if not success then
			self.logger:error("Failed to pause checks for player %s", self.player.Name)
		end
		return
	end
	self.logger:error("Failed to pause checks for player %s", self.player.Name)
end

--[=[
	@within BitPlayer
	Used to resume the checks on a player.
]=]
function BitPlayer:unpauseChecks()
	if coroutine.status(self.taskThread) == "suspended" then
		local success, _ = pcall(coroutine.resume, self.taskThread)
		if not success then
			self.logger:error("Failed to resume checks for player %s", self.player.Name)
		end
		return
	end
	self.logger:error("Failed to resume checks for player %s", self.player.Name)
end

--[=[
	@within BitPlayer
	Checks if the player is permitted to exist on this plane of existence (checks number of strikes and kicks them if they've reached the maximum).
]=]
function BitPlayer:validateExistence()
	local strikes = self.strikes
	local config = self.configuration
	if CountStrikes(strikes) >= config.strikesNeeded then
		local currentKey = nil
		local maxStrikes = 0

		for k, v in strikes do
			if v > maxStrikes then
				maxStrikes = v
				currentKey = k
			end
		end

		self.functions.onCheaterCaught(self.player, currentKey)
		return
	end

	if os.time() - self.lastPing > 5 and config.clientEnabled then -- used to check if the client might've disabled the client-sided anticheat (only processed )
		self.functions.onCheaterCaught(self.player, "No Client Ping")
	end
end

--[=[
	@within BitPlayer
	Adds x number of strikes to a player for a specific reason.

	@param count number -- The number of strikes to add
	@param reason string -- The strike reason
]=]
function BitPlayer:strike(count:number, reason:string)
	local strikes = self.strikes
	self.functions.onPlayerStriked(self.player, reason, count)

	if strikes[reason] then
		strikes[reason] += count
		self:validateExistence()
		return
	end

	strikes[reason] = count
	self:validateExistence()
end

--[=[
	@within BitPlayer
	Removes x number of strikes from a player.

	@param count number -- The number of strikes to remove
	@param reason string -- The strike id to remove from
]=]
function BitPlayer:removeStrike(count:number, reason:string)
	local strikes = self.strikes
	if strikes[reason] then
		strikes[reason] = math.min(0, strikes[reason] - count)
	end
end

function BitPlayer:dispose()
	local success, e = pcall(coroutine.close, self.taskThread)
	self.taskThread = nil -- will trigger a loop termination (prevents an infinite, undead thread)
	if not success then
		self.logger:warn("Failed to close thread for player %s.  Error: %s", self.player.Name, e)
	end
	self.characterAdded:Disconnect()
	table.clear(self.strikes)
	table.clear(self.checkQueue)
	table.clear(self.memory)
	table.clear(self)
	setmetatable(self, nil)
end

return BitPlayer
```

local RotationCheck = {}

function RotationCheck:checkPlayer(bitPlayer)
	local char = bitPlayer.player.Character
	if char and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and char.PrimaryPart then
		local root:BasePart = char.PrimaryPart

		if root and root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 72 then
			bitPlayer:strike(1, "High Angular Velocity")
			root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			return 1
		end
	end

	bitPlayer:removeStrike(1, "High Angular Velocity")
	return 3
end

-- Madonox
-- 2025

local StateCheck = {}

local function MaxVectorComponent(vector:Vector3)
	return math.max(vector.X, math.max(vector.Y, vector.Z))
end

local function RemoveStun(humanoid)
	humanoid.PlatformStand = false
end

local XZVector = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
local Rotation180 = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)

local NewStateChecks = {
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing] = function(bitPlayer, character:Model, humanoid:Humanoid, old:Enum.HumanoidStateType, queryParams:OverlapParams)
		local cf, size = character:GetBoundingBox()
		local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(cf.Position, MaxVectorComponent(size * XZVector) * 1.1, queryParams)

		-- checks for ladders (trusses + user made ladders)
		for _, part in parts do
			if part:IsA("TrussPart") then
				return
			end

			for _, otherPart in parts do
				if math.abs(otherPart.Position.Y - part.Position.Y) <= 1 then
					return
				end
			end

			table.remove(parts, table.find(parts, part)) -- has been checked against all other parts, remove to improve performance of algorithm
		end

		-- no suitable ladder found, stun the player and rotate 180 to prevent climbing
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		character:PivotTo(cf * Rotation180) -- teleport backwards to prevent infinite cycle
		bitPlayer:strike(1, "Climbing Without Ladder")
		task.delay(1, RemoveStun, humanoid)
	end;

	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated] = function(bitPlayer, character:Model, humanoid:Humanoid, old:Enum.HumanoidStateType, queryParams:OverlapParams)
		local cf, size = character:GetBoundingBox()
		local parts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(cf.Position, MaxVectorComponent(size * XZVector) * 1.1, queryParams)

		for _, part in parts do
			if part:IsA("Seat") then
				return
			end
		end

		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		character:PivotTo(cf * Rotation180)
		bitPlayer:strike(1, "Sitting Without Seat")
	end;
}

function StateCheck:characterAdded(bitPlayer, character:Model)
	local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	overlapParams.MaxParts = 100
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
	overlapParams.RespectCanCollide = true

	humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(old:Enum.HumanoidStateType, new:Enum.HumanoidStateType)
		if old == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
			bitPlayer:strike(1, "Dead State Change")
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
			return
		end

		local newStateCheck = NewStateChecks[new]
		if newStateCheck then
			newStateCheck(bitPlayer, character, humanoid, old, overlapParams)
		end
	end)
end

return StateCheck

-- 2025

local ToolCheck = {}

function ToolCheck:characterAdded(bitPlayer, character:Model)
	local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	local normalEquips = 0
	character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child:BackpackItem|Instance)
		if child:IsA("BackpackItem") then
			for _, otherChild in character:GetChildren() do
				if otherChild ~= child and otherChild:IsA("BackpackItem") then
					humanoid:UnequipTools()
					bitPlayer:strike(1, "Multiple Tools")
					return
				end
			end

			normalEquips += 1
			if normalEquips > 3 then -- strikes can false-positive in high ping situations / if someone mashes their keyboard
				normalEquips = 0
				bitPlayer:removeStrike(1, "Multiple Tools")
			end
		elseif child:IsA("Humanoid") then
			humanoid = child
		end
	end)
end

return ToolCheck

-- Madonox
-- 2025

local VelocityCheck = {}

local XZ_Normal = Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
local SpeedEpsilon = 1.02

local SpeedStates = {
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running;
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics;
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.StrafingNoPhysics;
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming;
	Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall;
}

function VelocityCheck:checkPlayer(bitPlayer)
	local character = bitPlayer.player.Character
	if character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and character.PrimaryPart then
		local root = character.PrimaryPart
		local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
		if (root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * XZ_Normal).Magnitude > (humanoid.WalkSpeed + SpeedEpsilon) and table.find(SpeedStates, humanoid:GetState()) then
			bitPlayer:strike(1, "High Velocity")
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero

			local lastPos = bitPlayer.memory.lastPosition
			if lastPos then
				root.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastPos)
			end
			return 1
		end

		bitPlayer.memory.lastPosition = root.CFrame.Position
		return 1.5 -- slightly more delay as the player passed the velocity check
	end

	bitPlayer.memory.lastPosition = nil
	return 1
end

return VelocityCheck

-- Madonox
-- 2025

-- BitAntiCheat client runtime
-- All operations are in one script to help make indexing more difficult

script.Parent = nil
script.Name = "\0" -- C string terminator (messes with indexes)

local RE:RemoteEvent = game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("BACTag0x0")[1]
RE:RemoveTag("BACTag0x0")

local RNG = Random.new()

local function CFunction(yielder: (...any) -> any)
	return select(2, xpcall(yielder, function()
		return debug.info(2, "f")
	end))
end

--[[

local function ShuffleTable(t:{any}, n:number)
	local tLen = rawlen(t)
	for _ = 1, n do
		local i0, i1 = RNG:NextInteger(1, tLen), RNG:NextInteger(1, tLen)
		local v0 = t[i0]
		local v1 = t[i1]
		if v0 ~= v1 then -- done this way so we don't swap equal values
			t[i1] = v0
			t[i0] = v1
		end
	end

	return t
end

]]

local function RandomSecureString(len:number)
	local str = ""
	for i = 1, 100 do
		str ..= utf8.char(RNG:NextInteger(33, 126))
	end
	str ..= string.rep("\000", RNG:NextInteger(1, 8)) -- messes with indexes

	return str
end

local function StringTable(t:{any})
	for i = 1, #t do
		t[i] = tostring(t[i])
	end

	return t
end

local function Pipebomb()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.spawn(Pipebomb)
			while true do
				Instance.new("BloomEffect", workspace)
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Ping

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(.5) do
		RE:FireServer(1)
	end
end)

-- Services / forbidden access points
task.spawn(function()
	if game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio() then -- studio safety lock
		print("[BitAntiCheat]: Service hook is disabled to prevent studio false flagging.")
		Pipebomb = function()
			warn("[BitAntiCheat]: Client detection function triggered in studio!")
		end
		return
	end

	local services = {
		"UGCValidationService";
	}

	while task.wait() do
		for _, s in services do
			if game:FindService(s) then
				RE:FireServer(2)
				Pipebomb()
				break
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- C function monitoring
task.spawn(function()
	local function cFetch()
		return workspace[RandomSecureString(100)]
	end

	local function nFetch()
		return workspace:__________()
	end

	local function iFetch()
		game.________ = nil
	end

	local c_index = CFunction(cFetch)
	local c_ncall = CFunction(nFetch)
	local c_icall = CFunction(iFetch)

	while task.wait(.1) do
		if c_index ~= CFunction(cFetch) or c_ncall ~= CFunction(nFetch) or c_icall ~= CFunction(iFetch) then
			RE:FireServer(2)
			Pipebomb()
		end
	end
end)

-- Check table functionality equality
task.spawn(function()
	local tClone = StringTable({debug.info(table.clone, "slnaf")})

	local function compareDebugTable(t1, t2)
		for i, v0 in t1 do
			if t2[i] ~= v0 then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	while task.wait(.1) do
		if compareDebugTable(tClone, StringTable({debug.info(table.clone, "slnaf")})) then
			RE:FireServer(2)
			Pipebomb()
		end
	end
end)

-- Madonox
-- 2025

-- Log class

local Patch = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Patch"))

--[=[
	@class Log
	Logger class.
]=]
local Log = {}
Log.__index = Log

export type Log = typeof(setmetatable({}, Log))

--[=[
	@within Log
	@param processor (...any) -> ...any -- The message processing function for logs.
	@return Log
]=]
function Log.new(processor:(...any) -> ...any): Log
	local logger = setmetatable({processor = Patch.newFunction(processor)}, Log)

	return logger
end

--[=[
	@within Log
	Prints out the processed arguments supplied to it.
]=]
function Log:print(...:any)
	print(self.processor(...))
end

--[=[
	@within Log
	Warns the processed arguments supplied to it.
]=]
function Log:warn(...:any)
	warn(self.processor(...))
end

--[=[
	@within Log
	Errors the processed arguments supplied to it.
]=]
function Log:error(...:any)
	error(self.processor(...))
end

Patch.newTable(Log)

return Log
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/BitAntiCheat/Patch.lua`:

```lua
-- Madonox
-- 2025

--[=[
	@class PatchFunction
	A function that can be patched.  The final patch executed generates the return value.
]=]
local PatchFunction = {}
PatchFunction.__index = PatchFunction

function PatchFunction.__call(pFunc:PatchFunction, ...)
	local binds = pFunc.binds
	if #binds > 0 then
		local out
		for _, func in pFunc.binds do
			out = func(pFunc, ...)
		end
		return out
	end

	return pFunc:func()(...)
end

--[=[
	@within PatchFunction
	Allows you to add a patch.
	@param patch (PatchFunction, ...any) -> any -- The function to add.
	@return PatchFunction -- Returns the same patch function (enables += functionality)

	```lua
	local myPatch = PatchFunction.newFunction(function(message)
		print(`Hello, {message}`)
	end)

	myPatch += function(patch, message)
		print(`Got argument {message}, forwarding to original function`)
		patch:func()(message) -- calls the original function
	end

	myPatch("world") -- outputs "Got argument world, forwarding to original function" and "Hello, world"
	```
]=]
function PatchFunction.__add(pFunc:PatchFunction, patch:(PatchFunction, ...any) -> any)
	if not table.find(pFunc.binds, patch) then
		table.insert(pFunc.binds, patch)
	end
	return pFunc -- += stores, so we return self
end

--[=[
	@within PatchFunction
	Allows you to remove a patch.
	@param patch (PatchFunction, ...any) -> any -- The function to remove.
	@return PatchFunction -- Returns the same patch function (enables -= functionality)

	```lua
	local myPatch = PatchFunction.newFunction(function(message)
		print(`Hello, {message}`)
	end)
	local function otherFunction(patch, message)
		print(`Got argument {message}, forwarding to original function`)
		patch:func()(message) -- calls the original function
	end

	myPatch += otherFunction

	myPatch("world") -- outputs "Got argument world, forwarding to original function" and "Hello, world"

	myPatch -= otherFunction

	myPatch("world") -- outputs "Hello, world"
	```
]=]
function PatchFunction.__sub(pFunc:PatchFunction, patch:(PatchFunction, ...any) -> any)
	local ref = table.find(pFunc.binds, patch)
	if ref then
		table.remove(pFunc.binds, ref)
	end
	return pFunc -- += stores, so we return self
end

--[=[
	@within PatchFunction
	Returns the embedded function.
]=]
function PatchFunction:func()
	return self._func
end

export type PatchFunction = typeof(setmetatable({}, PatchFunction))

local Patch = {}

--[=[
	@within PatchFunction
	Returns a new patchable function.
	@param func (...any) -> any -- The function to wrap.
]=]
function Patch.newFunction(func:(...any) -> any)
	local patchFunction = setmetatable({_func = func, binds = {}}, PatchFunction)
	return patchFunction
end

--[=[
	@within PatchFunction
	Makes all functions in a table into patch functions
	@param funcTable {[any]: (...any) -> any} -- The table containing functions to patch.
]=]
function Patch.newTable(funcTable:{[any]: (...any) -> any})
	for k, func in funcTable do
		if typeof(func) == "function" then
			funcTable[k] = Patch.newFunction(func)
		end
	end
end

return Patch
```

local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local RANKS      = { Player=0, Mod=1, Admin=2, Owner=3 }

-- ================================================================
--  EVENTS SECTION

local EVENTS = {
	{ name="Taco Rain",       model="TacoRain",       desc="Tacos fall from the sky!",           duration=60 },
	{ name="Lightning Storm", model="LightningStorm", desc="A fierce lightning storm rolls in!", duration=60 },

local bannedPlayers  = {}

local chatLogs       = {}

	local f = Instance.new("RemoteFunction"); f.Name=n; f.Parent=remotes; return f

local function getRank(userId)
	if playerRanks[userId] then return playerRanks[userId] end
	local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	if p and p.Name == CONFIG.OWNER then return RANKS.Owner end
	return RANKS.Player
end

local function hasPerm(player, rank)
	return getRank(player.UserId) >= rank
end

	RE_Feedback:FireClient(player, msg, isErr or false)
end

local function logCmd(player, cmd)
	table.insert(commandLogs, {player=player.Name, cmd=cmd, time=os.date("%H:%M:%S")})
	if #commandLogs > 200 then table.remove(commandLogs, 1) end
end

local function findPlayers(name, sender)
	name = name:lower()
	if name == "all"    then return Players:GetPlayers() end
	if name == "me"     then return {sender} end
	if name == "others" then
		local t = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= sender then table.insert(t, p) end
		end
		return t
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Name:lower():find(name,1,true) or p.DisplayName:lower():find(name,1,true) then
			return {p}
		end
	end
	return {}
end

local function findOne(name, sender)
	return findPlayers(name, sender)[1]
end

local function checkCooldown(player)
	local now = tick()
	if (cooldowns[player.UserId] or 0) + CONFIG.COOLDOWN > now then return false end
	cooldowns[player.UserId] = now
	return true
end

local function rankCheck(sender, target)
	return getRank(target.UserId) >= getRank(sender.UserId) and target ~= sender
end

-- ================================================================
--  COMMANDS

local CMD = {}

-- ── MODERATION ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
CMD["kick"] = { rank=RANKS.Mod, exec=function(s,a)
	local reason = table.concat(a," ",2) or "No reason"
	for _,p in ipairs(findPlayers(a[1] or "",s)) do
		if rankCheck(s,p) then fb(s,"Cannot kick "..p.Name.." (equal/higher rank).",true)
		else p:Kick("Kicked by "..s.Name..": "..reason); logCmd(s,"kick "..p.Name) end
	end
	fb(s,"✅ Kicked.")
end}

CMD["ban"] = { rank=RANKS.Admin, exec=function(s,a)
	local p = findOne(a[1] or "",s)
	if not p then return fb(s,"Player not found.",true) end
	if rankCheck(s,p) then return fb(s,"Cannot ban equal/higher rank.",true) end
	local reason = table.concat(a," ",2) or "No reason"
	bannedPlayers[p.UserId] = {reason=reason,by=s.Name,permanent=true}
	logCmd(s,"ban "..p.Name); p:Kick("Permanently banned: "..reason)
	fb(s,"🚫 Banned "..p.Name..".")
end}

CMD["tempban"] = { rank=RANKS.Admin, exec=function(s,a)
	local p = findOne(a[1] or "",s)
	if not p then return fb(s,"Player not found.",true) end
	local dur = tonumber(a[2]) or 3600
	local reason = table.concat(a," ",3) or "No reason"
	bannedPlayers[p.UserId] = {reason=reason,by=s.Name,expires=os.time()+dur}
	logCmd(s,"tempban "..p.Name)
	p:Kick("Temp banned for "..dur.."s: "..reason)
	fb(s,"⏱️ Temp banned "..p.Name.." for "..dur.."s.")
end}

CMD["unban"] = { rank=RANKS.Admin, exec=function(s,a)
	local name = (a[1] or ""):lower()
	for uid,_ in pairs(bannedPlayers) do
		local ok,n = pcall(function() return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(uid) end)
		if ok and n:lower():find(name,1,true) then
			bannedPlayers[uid]=nil; logCmd(s,"unban "..n)
			return fb(s,"✅ Unbanned "..n..".")
		end
	end
	fb(s,"Player not in ban list.",true)
end}

CMD["mute"] = { rank=RANKS.Mod, exec=function(s,a)
	for _,p in ipairs(findPlayers(a[1] or "",s)) do
		mutedPlayers[p.UserId]=true; logCmd(s,"mute "..p.Name)
		fb(p,"🔇 You have been muted by "..s.Name..".",true)
	end
	fb(s,"🔇 Muted.")
end}

CMD["unmute"] = { rank=RANKS.Mod, exec=function(s,a)
	for _,p in ipairs(findPlayers(a[1] or "",s)) do
		mutedPlayers[p.UserId]=nil; logCmd(s,"unmute "..p.Name)
		fb(p,"🔊 You have been unmuted.",false)
	end
	fb(s,"🔊 Unmuted.")
end}

CMD["warn"] = { rank=RANKS.Mod, exec=function(s,a)
	local p = findOne(a[1] or "",s)
	if not p then return fb(s,"Player not found.",true) end
	local reason = table.concat(a," ",2) or "No reason"
	playerWarnings[p.UserId] = playerWarnings[p.UserId] or {}
	table.insert(playerWarnings[p.UserId],{reason=reason,by=s.Name,time=os.date("%H:%M")})
	local total = #playerWarnings[p.UserId]
	logCmd(s,"warn "..p.Name)
	fb(p,"⚠️ Warning "..total..": "..reason.." (by "..s.Name..")",true)

end}

CMD["warnings"] = { rank=RANKS.Mod, exec=function(s,a)
	local p = findOne(a[1] or "",s)
	if not p then return fb(s,"Player not found.",true) end

	if #w==0 then return fb(s,p.Name.." has no warnings.") end
	local msg = p.Name.." has "..#w.." warning(s):\n"
	for i,wn in ipairs(w) do msg=msg.."["..i.."] "..wn.reason.." — by "..wn.by.." at "..wn.time.."\n" end

end}

	local msg="=== COMMAND LOGS (last 20) ===\n"
	for i=math.max(1,#commandLogs-19),#commandLogs do
		local l=commandLogs[i]; msg=msg.."["..l.time.."] "..l.player..": "..l.cmd.."\n"
	end
	fb(s,msg)
end}

-- ── TELEPORT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CMD["bring"] = { rank=RANKS.Mod, exec=function(s,a)
	if not s.Character then return fb(s,"No character.",true) end
	local pos=s.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
	for i,p in ipairs(findPlayers(a[1] or "",s)) do
		if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=pos*CFrame.new(i*3,0,0) end
		logCmd(s,"bring "..p.Name)
	end; fb(s,"📍 Brought.")
end}

CMD["goto"] = { rank=RANKS.Mod, exec=function(s,a)
	local p=findOne(a[1] or "",s)
	if not p then return fb(s,"Player not found.",true) end
	if not s.Character then return fb(s,"No character.",true) end
	if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		s.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame*CFrame.new(3,0,0) end
	logCmd(s,"goto "..p.Name); fb(s,"🚀 Went to "..p.Name..".")
end}

CMD["teleport"] = { rank=RANKS.Admin, exec=function(s,a)
	local p1=findOne(a[1] or "",s); local p2=findOne(a[2] or "",s)
	if not p1 or not p2 then return fb(s,"Player(s) not found.",true) end
	if p1.Character and p2.Character
		and p1.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		and p2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		p1.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=p2.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame*CFrame.new(3,0,0) end
	logCmd(s,"tp "..p1.Name.." -> "..p2.Name); fb(s,"Teleported.")
end}

CMD["tpall"] = { rank=RANKS.Admin, exec=function(s,a)
	if not s.Character then return fb(s,"No character.",true) end
	local pos=s.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
	for i,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p~=s and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame=pos*CFrame.new(i*3,0,0) end
	end
	logCmd(s,"tpall"); fb(s,"🌐 Teleported everyone to you.")
end}

	game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(id,s)

end}

	if not tool then return fb(s,"Tool '"..toolName.."' not in ReplicatedStorage.",true) end
	for _,p in ipairs(findPlayers(a[1] or "",s)) do
		if p.Backpack then tool:Clone().Parent=p.Backpack end
		logCmd(s,"give "..p.Name.." "..toolName)
	end; fb(s,"🎁 Gave "..toolName..".")
end}

-- ── EVENT (typed command: !event global Taco Rain) ───────────────
CMD["event"] = { rank=RANKS.Admin, exec=function(s,a)
	if #a < 2 then
		return fb(s,"Usage: event <global|server> <event name>\nEx: !event global Taco Rain",true)
	end

	local scope = nil
	local nameParts = {}

	if a[1]:lower()=="global" or a[1]:lower()=="server" then
		scope = a[1]:lower()=="global" and "Global" or "Server"
		for i=2,#a do table.insert(nameParts,a[i]) end
	elseif a[#a]:lower()=="global" or a[#a]:lower()=="server" then
		scope = a[#a]:lower()=="global" and "Global" or "Server"
		for i=1,#a-1 do table.insert(nameParts,a[i]) end
	else
		return fb(s,"Specify 'global' or 'server'.\nEx: !event global Taco Rain",true)
	end

	local evtName = table.concat(nameParts," ")
	local evtData
	for _,e in ipairs(EVENTS) do
		if e.name:lower()==evtName:lower() then evtData=e; break end
	end
	if not evtData then
		for _,e in ipairs(EVENTS) do
			if e.name:lower():find(evtName:lower(),1,true) then evtData=e; break end
		end
	end
	if not evtData then
		local list="Available events:\n"
		for _,e in ipairs(EVENTS) do list=list.."  • "..e.name.."\n" end
		return fb(s,"Event '"..evtName.."' not found.\n"..list,true)
	end

	local model=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(evtData.model)
	if not model then
		return fb(s,"Model '"..evtData.model.."' not in ReplicatedStorage!",true)
	end
	local clone=model:Clone(); clone.Parent=game.Workspace
	Debris:AddItem(clone,evtData.duration)
	logCmd(s,"event: "..evtData.name.." ["..scope.."]")
	if scope=="Global" then
		for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			RE_Feedback:FireClient(p,"🎉 EVENT: "..evtData.name.."!",false)
		end
	else
		fb(s,"🎉 Event '"..evtData.name.."' started (server only)!",false)
	end
end}

-- ── SMART HELP (OWNER ONLY) ──────────────────────────────────────
CMD["help"] = { rank=RANKS.Owner, exec=function(s,a)
	local query = table.concat(a," "):lower():gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")

	local DETAILS = {
		kick="kick <player> <reason>\nKicks a player from the server.\nRank: Mod+",
		ban="ban <player> <reason>\nPermanently bans a player.\nRank: Admin+",
		tempban="tempban <player> <seconds> <reason>\nBans for set seconds.\nEx: !tempban Player1 3600 reason\nRank: Admin+",
		unban="unban <player>\nRemoves player from ban list.\nRank: Admin+",
		mute="mute <player>\nPrevents player from chatting.\nRank: Mod+",
		unmute="unmute <player>\nRestores player chat.\nRank: Mod+",
		warn="warn <player> <reason>\nIssues a warning. Auto-kicks at "..CONFIG.MAX_WARNINGS..".\nRank: Mod+",
		warnings="warnings <player>\nLists all warnings for a player.\nRank: Mod+",
		clearwarnings="clearwarnings <player>\nClears all warnings.\nRank: Admin+",
		logs="logs\nShows last 20 admin commands.\nRank: Admin+",
		chatlogs="chatlogs\nShows last 20 chat messages.\nRank: Admin+",
		kill="kill <player>\nSets player health to 0.\nRank: Mod+",

		giveall="giveall <tool>\nGives tool to every player.\nRank: Admin+",

		sparkles="sparkles <player>\nAdds sparkle effect.\nRank: Mod+",
		unsparkles="unsparkles <player>\nRemoves sparkles.\nRank: Mod+",
		fire="fire <player>\nAdds fire effect.\nRank: Mod+",
		unfire="unfire <player>\nRemoves fire effect.\nRank: Mod+",
		explode="explode <player>\nCreates explosion at player.\nRank: Admin+",
		dance="dance <player>\nPlays dance animation.\nRank: Mod+",
		admin="admin <player>\nPromotes player to Admin.\nRank: Owner only",
		unadmin="unadmin <player>\nDemotes Admin to Player.\nRank: Owner only",
		mod="mod <player>\nPromotes player to Mod.\nRank: Admin+",
		unmod="unmod <player>\nDemotes Mod to Player.\nRank: Admin+",
		owner="owner <player>\nGrants Owner rank.\nRank: Owner only",
		unowner="unowner <player>\nRemoves Owner rank.\nRank: Owner only",
		rank="rank <player> <0-3>\n0=Player 1=Mod 2=Admin 3=Owner\nRank: Owner only",
		perms="perms <player>\nShows player's current rank.\nRank: Mod+",
		events="events\nOpens the events panel.\nRank: Mod+",
		event="event <global|server> <name>\nStarts a named event directly.\nEx: !event global Taco Rain\nRank: Admin+",
		help="help [command]\nShows help or details for a command.\nEx: !help kick\nRank: Owner only",
	}

	if query ~= "" then
		local detail = DETAILS[query]
		if detail then
			return fb(s,"=== !"..query:upper().." ===\n"..detail)
		end
		-- Fuzzy match
		local suggestions = {}
		for k,_ in pairs(DETAILS) do
			if k:find(query,1,true) then table.insert(suggestions,k) end
		end
		if #suggestions > 0 then
			table.sort(suggestions)
			return fb(s,"No exact match for '"..query.."'.\nDid you mean: "..table.concat(suggestions,", ").."?",true)
		else
			return fb(s,"No command found matching '"..query.."'.\nType !help for full list.",true)
		end
	end

	fb(s,[[
╔══ ADMIN PANEL HELP ══╗
  Owner: unknowPerson_237
  Prefix: ! or :
  Targets: me / all / others / name
  Tip: !help <command> for details
╚═══════════════════════╝
 
[MOD]     kick ban tempban unban
          mute unmute warn warnings
          clearwarnings logs chatlogs
 
[PLAYER]  kill respawn heal damage
          god ungod freeze unfreeze
          speed jump sit unsit
 
[TELEPORT] bring goto teleport tpall tpto
 
[SERVER]  shutdown restart rejoin
          lockserver unlockserver
          announce hint time day night gravity
 
[ITEMS]   give giveall removetools
          forcefield unforcefield
 
[FUN]     fly unfly invisible visible
          sparkles unsparkles fire unfire
          explode dance
 
[ADMIN]   admin unadmin mod unmod
          owner unowner rank perms
 
[EVENTS]  events
          event <global|server> <name>
 
!help <command> for detailed usage.]])
end}

-- ================================================================
--  COMMAND EXECUTOR
-- ================================================================
local function runCommand(sender, raw)
	if type(raw)~="string" or #raw>300 then return end
	raw=raw:gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
	if raw=="" then return end
	if not checkCooldown(sender) then
		return fb(sender,"⏱️ Please wait before running another command.",true)
	end
	local parts=raw:split(" ")
	local name=parts[1]:lower()
	table.remove(parts,1)
	local cmd=CMD[name]
	if not cmd then return fb(sender,"❌ Unknown: "..name..". Try !help",true) end
	if not hasPerm(sender,cmd.rank) then
		return fb(sender,"🚫 No permission. Need: "..RANK_NAMES[cmd.rank],true)
	end
	local ok,err=pcall(cmd.exec,sender,parts)
	if not ok then
		fb(sender,"⚠️ Error: "..tostring(err),true)
		warn("[Admin] '"..name.."': "..tostring(err))
	end
end

-- ================================================================
--  REMOTE HANDLERS
-- ================================================================
RE_Execute.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, cmd)
	runCommand(player, cmd)
end)

RF_GetRank.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	return getRank(player.UserId)
end

RF_GetEvents.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	if not hasPerm(player, RANKS.Mod) then return {} end
	return EVENTS
end

RE_Event.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, evtName, scope)
	if not hasPerm(player, RANKS.Admin) then
		return fb(player,"Need Admin rank to start events.",true)
	end
	if type(evtName)~="string" or type(scope)~="string" then return end
	local evtData
	for _,e in ipairs(EVENTS) do
		if e.name==evtName then evtData=e; break end
	end
	if not evtData then return fb(player,"Event not found.",true) end
	local model=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(evtData.model)
	if not model then
		return fb(player,"Model '"..evtData.model.."' not in ReplicatedStorage!",true)
	end
	local clone=model:Clone(); clone.Parent=game.Workspace
	Debris:AddItem(clone,evtData.duration)
	logCmd(player,"event: "..evtName.." ["..scope.."]")
	if scope=="Global" then
		for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			RE_Feedback:FireClient(p,"🎉 EVENT: "..evtName.."!",false)
		end
	else
		fb(player,"🎉 Event '"..evtName.."' started (server only)!",false)
	end
end)

-- ================================================================
--  PLAYER JOIN / LEAVE
-- ================================================================
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	if player.Name==CONFIG.OWNER then
		playerRanks[player.UserId]=RANKS.Owner
	end
	task.wait(0.5)

	local ban=bannedPlayers[player.UserId]
	if ban then
		if ban.permanent then
			player:Kick("Permanently banned: "..ban.reason); return
		elseif ban.expires and os.time()<ban.expires then
			player:Kick("Temp banned for "..(ban.expires-os.time()).."s more."); return
		else
			bannedPlayers[player.UserId]=nil
		end
	end

	if serverLocked and getRank(player.UserId)<RANKS.Mod then
		player:Kick("Server is locked."); return
	end

	player.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
		table.insert(chatLogs,{player=player.Name,msg=msg,time=os.date("%H:%M:%S")})
		if #chatLogs>500 then table.remove(chatLogs,1) end
		if mutedPlayers[player.UserId] then
			RE_Feedback:FireClient(player,"🔇 You are muted.",true)
		end
		local prefix=msg:sub(1,1)
		if prefix==CONFIG.PREFIX or prefix==CONFIG.ALT_PREFIX then
			runCommand(player, msg:sub(2))
		end
	end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	cooldowns[player.UserId]=nil
end)

print("[AdminPanel] ✅ Loaded. Owner: "..CONFIG.OWNER)
```

	item.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		tw(item,{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(22,22,30)},0.1):Play()
	end)
	item.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		tw(item,{BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,10,14)},0.1):Play()
	end)
	dropItems[i] = item

	h.Size              = UDim2.new(0.55,0,1,0)

	h.TextXAlignment    = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	h.TextTruncate      = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	h.Text              = ""
	h.Parent            = item
	hintLabels[i]       = h
end

local function updateDropdown(query)
	query = query:lower():gsub("^%s+","")
	local matches = {}
	if query ~= "" then
		for _, cmd in ipairs(ALL_CMDS) do
			if cmd:sub(1,#query)==query or cmd:find(query,1,true) then
				table.insert(matches, cmd)
				if #matches >= MAX_SUG then break end
			end
		end
	end
	for i = 1, MAX_SUG do
		if matches[i] then
			dropItems[i].Text    = "  "..matches[i]
			hintLabels[i].Text   = CMD_HINTS[matches[i]] or ""
			dropItems[i].Visible = true
		else
			dropItems[i].Text    = ""
			dropItems[i].Visible = false
		end
	end
	local count = #matches
	if count > 0 then
		dropdown.Visible = true
		tw(dropdown,{Size=UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,count*32+8)},0.15):Play()
	else
		tw(dropdown,{Size=UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,0)},0.12):Play()
		task.delay(0.12, function() dropdown.Visible=false end)
	end
end

for i = 1, MAX_SUG do
	local idx = i
	dropItems[i].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local cmd = dropItems[idx].Text:gsub("^%s+","")
		cmdInput.Text = cmd.." "
		cmdInput:CaptureFocus()
		playSound(SFX.click)
		tw(dropdown,{Size=UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,0)},0.12):Play()
		task.delay(0.12, function() dropdown.Visible=false end)
	end)
end

cmdInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	local txt = cmdInput.Text
	local firstWord = txt:match("^(%S+)")
	if firstWord and #txt > 0 then
		updateDropdown(firstWord)
	else
		tw(dropdown,{Size=UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,0)},0.1):Play()
		task.delay(0.1, function() dropdown.Visible=false end)
	end
end)

local function showToast(msg, isErr)
	local toast = Instance.new("Frame")
	toast.AnchorPoint      = Vector2.new(1,0)
	toast.Size             = UDim2.new(0,260,0,46)
	toast.Position         = UDim2.new(1,280,0,56)
	toast.BackgroundColor3 = isErr and Color3.fromRGB(140,22,22) or Color3.fromRGB(14,110,55)
	toast.BorderSizePixel  = 0
	toast.ZIndex           = 15
	toast.Parent           = sg
	corner(toast,9)
	stroke(toast, isErr and Color3.fromRGB(200,40,40) or Color3.fromRGB(30,180,80), 1)

	local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	icon.Size=UDim2.new(0,30,1,0); icon.BackgroundTransparency=1
	icon.Text=isErr and "✕" or "✓"
	icon.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	icon.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; icon.TextSize=14
	icon.ZIndex=16; icon.Parent=toast

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.Size=UDim2.new(1,-38,1,0); lbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,32,0,0)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency=1
	lbl.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
	lbl.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; lbl.TextSize=11
	lbl.TextWrapped=true; lbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	lbl.Text=msg:sub(1,120); lbl.ZIndex=16; lbl.Parent=toast

	tw(toast,{Position=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,56)},0.25,Enum.EasingStyle.Back):Play()
	task.wait(3)
	tw(toast,{Position=UDim2.new(1,280,0,56)},0.2):Play()
	task.wait(0.2); toast:Destroy()
end

local function populateEvents()
	for _,c in ipairs(evtScroll:GetChildren()) do
		if not c:IsA("UILayout") and not c:IsA("UIPadding") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local evts = RF_GetEvts:InvokeServer()
	if not evts or #evts==0 then
		local none=Instance.new("TextLabel")
		none.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40); none.BackgroundTransparency=1
		none.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(100,100,115)
		none.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; none.TextSize=12
		none.Text="No events configured."; none.Parent=evtScroll; return
	end
	for i,e in ipairs(evts) do
		local row=Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,50)
		row.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(16,16,22)
		row.BorderSizePixel=0; row.LayoutOrder=i; row.Parent=evtScroll
		corner(row,8)

		local nameL=Instance.new("TextLabel")
		nameL.Size=UDim2.new(1,-80,0,20); nameL.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,6)
		nameL.BackgroundTransparency=1; nameL.Text=e.name
		nameL.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,220,230)
		nameL.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; nameL.TextSize=12
		nameL.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; nameL.Parent=row

		local descL=Instance.new("TextLabel")
		descL.Size=UDim2.new(1,-80,0,16); descL.Position=UDim2.new(0,10,0,26)
		descL.BackgroundTransparency=1
		descL.Text=e.desc.."  · "..e.duration.."s"
		descL.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(90,90,110)
		descL.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; descL.TextSize=10
		descL.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		descL.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd; descL.Parent=row

		local startB=Instance.new("TextButton")
		startB.Size=UDim2.new(0,62,0,32); startB.Position=UDim2.new(1,-70,0.5,-16)
		startB.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(180,50,130)
		startB.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255); startB.Text="▶ Start"
		startB.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; startB.TextSize=11
		startB.BorderSizePixel=0; startB.Parent=row
		corner(startB,7)
		startB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			playSound(SFX.click); evtPanel.Visible=false; openScope(e.name)
		end)
	end
end

-- ================================================================
--  FLY SYSTEM
-- ================================================================
local flying  = false
local flyBody = nil
local flyGyro = nil

local function enableFly()
	if flying then return end
	flying=true
	local char=player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hrp=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end

	flyBody=Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	flyBody.Velocity=Vector3.zero; flyBody.MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5)
	flyBody.Parent=hrp

	flyGyro=Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	flyGyro.MaxTorque=Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5); flyGyro.D=100; flyGyro.Parent=hrp

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not flying then
			if flyBody and flyBody.Parent then flyBody:Destroy() end
			if flyGyro and flyGyro.Parent then flyGyro:Destroy() end
			return
		end
		local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
		local v=Vector3.zero; local spd=40
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then v=v+cam.CFrame.LookVector*spd end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then v=v-cam.CFrame.LookVector*spd end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then v=v-cam.CFrame.RightVector*spd end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then v=v+cam.CFrame.RightVector*spd end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then v=v+Vector3.new(0,spd,0) end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then v=v-Vector3.new(0,spd,0) end
		if flyBody and flyBody.Parent then flyBody.Velocity=v end
	end)
end

local function disableFly()
	flying=false
end

-- ================================================================
--  OPEN / CLOSE BAR
-- ================================================================
local barOpen=false

local function openBar()
	barOpen=true
	barContainer.Visible=true; trayContainer.Visible=true
	barContainer.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,0,38)
	tw(barContainer,{Size=UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,38)},0.22,
	Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out):Play()
	playSound(SFX.open)
	task.wait(0.1); cmdInput:CaptureFocus()
end

local function closeBar()
	barOpen=false
	dropdown.Visible=false; evtPanel.Visible=false; scopePicker.Visible=false
	tw(barContainer,{Size=UDim2.new(0,0,0,38)},0.18):Play()
	task.delay(0.18,function()
		barContainer.Visible=false; trayContainer.Visible=false
	end)
end

toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if barOpen then closeBar() else openBar() end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp,gp)
	if gp then return end
	if inp.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape and barOpen then closeBar() end
end)

-- ================================================================
--  SEND COMMAND
-- ================================================================
local function sendCmd()
	local txt=cmdInput.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if txt=="" then return end
	playSound(SFX.click)
	RE_Execute:FireServer(txt)
	cmdInput.Text=""
	dropdown.Visible=false
end

runBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(sendCmd)
cmdInput.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
	if enter then sendCmd() end
end)

-- ================================================================
--  FEEDBACK HANDLER
-- ================================================================
RE_Feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(msg, isErr)
	if msg=="FLY_ENABLE"  then enableFly();  showToast("✈️ Fly enabled!",false); return end
	if msg=="FLY_DISABLE" then disableFly(); showToast("Fly disabled.",false);   return end
	if msg=="OPEN_EVENTS" then
		populateEvents(); evtPanel.Visible=true; return
	end
	playSound(isErr and SFX.error_ or SFX.success)
	showToast(msg, isErr)
end)

-- ================================================================
--  DRAGGABLE BAR
-- ================================================================
local dragging,dragStart,startPos=false,nil,nil
barContainer.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
	if inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging=true; dragStart=inp.Position; startPos=barContainer.Position
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
	if dragging and (inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta=inp.Position-dragStart
		barContainer.Position=UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset+delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset+delta.Y)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
	if inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging=false
	end
end)

print("[AdminClient] ✅ Loaded · "..player.Name.." · "..(RANK_NAMES[myRank] or "Player"))
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/How to use.lua`:

```lua
--[[

	╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
	║                  CMDR ADMIN SYSTEM — HOW TO USE                  ║
	╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

	This folder is a ready-to-use Cmdr admin command package.
	Copy it into another game and follow the steps below.

	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	  STEP 1 — INSTALLATION
	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	This folder mirrors the Roblox DataModel. Move each item from this
	folder into the matching service in your game:

	  1.  Move  ServerStorage > RoleConfig
	      into  game.ServerStorage

	  2.  Move  ServerScriptService > CmdrServer
	      into  game.ServerScriptService

	  3.  Move  ReplicatedStorage > Cmdr  (the whole folder + ModuleScript)
	      into  game.ReplicatedStorage

	  4.  Move  StarterPlayerScripts > CmdrClient
	      into  game.StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

	  5.  Delete this "How to use" script — it is just documentation.

	  6.  Delete the empty Cmdr folder from Workspace when done.

	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	  STEP 2 — CONFIGURE ROLES
	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	Open  ServerStorage.RoleConfig  (a ModuleScript).

	You will see three lists. Add Roblox UserIds (numbers) to each:

		Owners = {
			1,           -- Roblox (default example)
			9856230796,  -- WOKKY_Alex
		},

		Admins = {
			-- 123456789,
		},

		AllowedUsers = {
			-- 987654321,
		},

	  • Owners   — full command access, console shows  username@Owner$
	  • Admins   — same power as Owner, console shows   username@Admin$
	  • Allowed  — same power, console shows              username@Allowed$

	All three roles have the SAME command power.
	The only difference is the title shown in the console prompt.

	HOW TO FIND A USER'S ID:
	  Go to their Roblox profile page. The URL looks like:
	  roblox.com/users/123456789/profile
	  The number 123456789 is their UserId.

	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	  STEP 3 — GAME CREATOR AUTO-OWNER
	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	The CmdrServer script automatically detects the game creator.

	  • If the game is owned by a USER:
	    Their UserId is pulled from game.CreatorId and they are
	    automatically given the Owner role. You do NOT need to add
	    yourself to the Owners list.

	  • If the game is owned by a GROUP:
	    game.CreatorId returns the group Id, not a player UserId.
	    You must manually add the group owner's UserId to the
	    Owners list in RoleConfig.

	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	  STEP 4 — USING THE CONSOLE IN-GAME
	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	  • Press F2 to open/close the command console.

	  • If you are whitelisted, the console opens and shows your role
	    in the prompt, for example:

	      WOKKY_Alex@Owner$

	  • If you are NOT whitelisted, pressing F2 does nothing.
	    The console is completely disabled for non-whitelisted users.

	  • Type a command and press Enter to run it.
	  • Type  help  to see all available commands.

	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	  STEP 5 — AVAILABLE COMMANDS
	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	Cmdr includes built-in commands in three categories:

	  ADMIN COMMANDS:
	    announce    — send a message to all players
	    kick        — kick a player from the server
	    kill        — kill a player's character
	    respawn     — respawn a player's character
	    teleport    — teleport one player to another
	    gotoPlace   — take all players to a different place

	  DEBUG COMMANDS:
	    blink       — teleport forward through walls
	    fetch       — pull a player to your position
	    position    — print your current position
	    thru        — walk through walls
	    uptime      — show server uptime
	    version     — show Cmdr version

	  UTILITY COMMANDS:
	    alias       — create command shortcuts
	    bind        — bind a command to a key
	    clear       — clear the console
	    echo        — print text to the console
	    edit        — edit a variable
	    help        — list all commands
	    history     — show command history
	    math        — evaluate a math expression
	    var         — manage variables

	  Type  help <command>  in the console for details on any command.

	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	  SECURITY
	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	This system has TWO layers of protection:

	  Layer 1 (Client): Non-whitelisted players cannot open the
	    console at all — F2 does nothing for them.

	  Layer 2 (Server): The BeforeRun hook on the server blocks
	    any command from a non-whitelisted player, even if they
	    somehow bypass the client-side lock.

	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	  TROUBLESHOOTING
	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	  Problem: Console won't open when I press F2.
	    → Make sure your UserId is in RoleConfig (or you are the
	      game creator). Check the server output for the line:
	      "[Cmdr Role Manager] Loaded with..."

	  Problem: Console opens but says "You are not authorized."
	    → This should not happen if your UserId is listed.
	      Double-check the UserId number is correct.

	  Problem: Group-owned game, creator is not auto-owner.
	    → This is expected. Add the group owner's UserId to the
	      Owners list in RoleConfig manually.

	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	  FILE OVERVIEW
	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	  ServerStorage.RoleConfig      → Edit this to add UserIds
	  ServerScriptService.CmdrServer → Server logic (roles + security)
	  ReplicatedStorage.Cmdr        → The Cmdr engine (don't edit)
	  StarterPlayerScripts.CmdrClient → Client console (F2 key)

]]

print("[Cmdr] This 'How to use' script is documentation only. Read it, then delete it after setup.")

```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr.lua`:

```lua
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Util = require(script.Shared:WaitForChild("Util"))

if RunService:IsServer() == false then
	error("Cmdr server module is somehow running on a client!")
end

local Cmdr do
	Cmdr = setmetatable({
		ReplicatedRoot = nil;
		RemoteFunction = nil;
		RemoteEvent = nil;
		Util = Util;
		DefaultCommandsFolder = script.BuiltInCommands;
	}, {
		__index = function (self, k)
			local r = self.Registry[k]
			if r and type(r) == "function" then
				return function (_, ...)
					return r(self.Registry, ...)
				end
			end
		end
	})

	Cmdr.Registry = require(script.Shared.Registry)(Cmdr)
	Cmdr.Dispatcher = require(script.Shared.Dispatcher)(Cmdr)

	require(script.Initialize)(Cmdr)
end

-- Handle command invocations from the clients.
Cmdr.RemoteFunction.OnServerInvoke = function (player, text, options)
	if #text > 100_000 then
		return "Input too long"
	end

	return Cmdr.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(text, player, options)
end

return Cmdr
```

```lua
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Chat = game:GetService("Chat")

return function (context, text)
	local filterResult = TextService:FilterStringAsync(text, context.Executor.UserId, Enum.TextFilterContext.PublicChat)

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if Chat:CanUsersChatAsync(context.Executor.UserId, player.UserId) then
			context:SendEvent(player, "Message", filterResult:GetChatForUserAsync(player.UserId), context.Executor)
		end
	end

	return "Created announcement."
end

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/gotoPlaceServer.lua`:

```lua
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

return function(context, players, placeId, jobId)
	players = players or { context.Executor }

	if placeId <= 0 then
		return "Invalid place ID"
	elseif jobId == "-" then
		return "Invalid job ID"
	end

	context:Reply("Commencing teleport...")

	if jobId then
		for _, player in ipairs(players) do
			TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, jobId, player)
		end
	else
		TeleportService:TeleportAsync(placeId, players)
	end

	return "Teleported."
end

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/teleportServer.lua`:

```lua
return function (_, fromPlayers, destination)
	local cframe

	if typeof(destination) == "Instance" then
		if destination.Character and destination.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			cframe = destination.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
		else
			return "Target player has no character."
		end
	elseif typeof(destination) == "Vector3" then
		cframe = CFrame.new(destination)
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(fromPlayers) do
		if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = cframe
		end
	end

	return ("Teleported %d players."):format(#fromPlayers)
end

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Debug/getPlayerPlaceInstanceServer.lua`:

```lua
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

return function (_, playerId, format)
	format = format or "PlaceIdJobId"

	local ok, _, errorText, placeId, jobId = pcall(function()
		return TeleportService:GetPlayerPlaceInstanceAsync(playerId)
	end)

	if not ok or (errorText and #errorText > 0) then
		if format == "PlaceIdJobId" then
			return "0" .. " -"
		elseif format == "PlaceId" then
			return "0"
		elseif format == "JobId" then
			return "-"
		end
	end

	if format == "PlaceIdJobId" then
		return placeId .. " " .. jobId
	elseif format == "PlaceId" then
		return tostring(placeId)
	elseif format == "JobId" then
		return tostring(jobId)
	end
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Debug/thru.lua`:

```lua
return {
	Name = "thru";
	Aliases = {"t", "through"};
	Description = "Teleports you through whatever your mouse is hovering over, placing you equidistantly from the wall.";
	Group = "DefaultDebug";
	Args = {
		{
			Type = "number";
			Name = "Extra distance";
			Description = "Go through the wall an additional X studs.";
			Default = 0;
		}
	};

	ClientRun = function(context, extra)
		-- We implement this here because player position is owned by the client.
		-- No reason to bother the server for this!

		local mouse = context.Executor:GetMouse()
		local character = context.Executor.Character

		if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			return "You don't have a character."
		end

		local pos = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
		local diff = (mouse.Hit.p - pos)

		character:MoveTo((diff * 2) + (diff.unit * extra) + pos)

		return "Blinked!"
	end
}

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Utility/bind.lua`:

```lua
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

return {
	Name = "bind";
	Aliases = {};
	Description = "Binds a command string to a key or mouse input.";
	Group = "DefaultUtil";
	Args = {
		{
			Type = "userInput ! bindableResource @ player";
			Name = "Input";
			Description = "The key or input type you'd like to bind the command to."
		},
		{
			Type = "command";
			Name = "Command";
			Description = "The command you want to run on this input"
		},
		{
			Type = "string";
			Name = "Arguments";
			Description = "The arguments for the command";
			Default = "";
		}
	};

	ClientRun = function(context, bind, command, arguments)
		local binds = context:GetStore("CMDR_Binds")

		command = command .. " " .. arguments

		if binds[bind] then
			binds[bind]:Disconnect()
		end

		local bindType = context:GetArgument(1).Type.Name

		if bindType == "userInput" then
			binds[bind] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
				if gameProcessed then
					return
				end

				if input.UserInputType == bind or input.KeyCode == bind then
					context:Reply(context.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(context.Cmdr.Util.RunEmbeddedCommands(context.Dispatcher, command)))
				end
			end)
		elseif bindType == "bindableResource" then
			return "Unimplemented..."
		elseif bindType == "player" then
			binds[bind] = bind.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
				local args = { message }
				local chatCommand = context.Cmdr.Util.RunEmbeddedCommands(context.Dispatcher, context.Cmdr.Util.SubstituteArgs(command, args))
				context:Reply(("%s $ %s : %s"):format(
					bind.Name,
					chatCommand,
					context.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(chatCommand)
				), Color3.fromRGB(244, 92, 66))
			end)
		end


		return "Bound command to input."
	end
}
```

return {
	Name = "clear",
	Aliases = {},
	Description = "Clear all lines above the entry line of the Cmdr window.",
	Group = "DefaultUtil",
	Args = {},
	ClientRun = function()
		local player = Players.LocalPlayer
		local gui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("Cmdr")

		if gui and frame then
			for _, child in pairs(frame:GetChildren()) do

					child:Destroy()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local TEXT_BOX_PROPERTIES = {
	AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 17),
	BackgroundTransparency = 0.05,
	BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 17),
	BorderSizePixel = 20,
	ClearTextOnFocus = false,
	MultiLine = true,
	Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.4, 0),
	Font = Enum.Font.Code,
	TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(241, 241, 241),
	TextWrapped = true,
	TextSize = 18,
	TextXAlignment = "Left",
	TextYAlignment = "Top",
	AutoLocalize = false,
	PlaceholderText = "Right click to exit",
}

local lock

return {
	Name = "edit";
	Aliases = {};
	Description = "Edit text in a TextBox";
	Group = "DefaultUtil";
	Args = {
		{
			Type = "string";
			Name = "Input text";
			Description = "The text you wish to edit";
			Default = "";
		},
		{
			Type = "string";
			Name = "Delimiter";
			Description = "The character that separates each line";
			Default = ",";
		}
	};

	ClientRun = function(context, text, delimeter)
		lock = lock or context.Cmdr.Util.Mutex()

		local unlock = lock()

		context:Reply("Right-click on the text area to exit.", Color3.fromRGB(158, 158, 158))

		local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		screenGui.Name = "CmdrEditBox"
		screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

		local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox")

		for key, value in pairs(TEXT_BOX_PROPERTIES) do
			textBox[key] = value
		end

		textBox.Text = text:gsub(delimeter, "\n")
		textBox.Parent = screenGui

		screenGui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

		local thread = coroutine.running()

		textBox.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
				coroutine.resume(thread, textBox.Text:gsub("\n", delimeter))
				screenGui:Destroy()
				unlock()
			end
		end)

		return coroutine.yield()
	end
}

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Utility/runLines.lua`:

```lua
return {
	Name = "run-lines";
	Aliases = {};
	Description = "Splits input by newlines and runs each line as its own command. This is used by the init-run command.";
	Group = "DefaultUtil";
	Args = {
		{
			Type = "string";
			Name = "Script";
			Description = "The script to parse.";
			Default = "";
		}
	};

	ClientRun = function(context, text)
		if #text == 0 then
			return ""
		end

		local shouldPrintOutput = context.Dispatcher:Run("var", "INIT_PRINT_OUTPUT") ~= ""

		local commands = text:gsub("\n+", "\n"):split("\n")

		for _, command in ipairs(commands) do
			if command:sub(1, 1) == "#" then
				continue
			end

			local output = context.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(command)

			if shouldPrintOutput then
				context:Reply(output)
			end
		end

		return ""
	end
}

```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Utility/runif.lua`:

```lua
local conditions = {
	startsWith = function (text, arg)
		if text:sub(1, #arg) == arg then
			return text:sub(#arg + 1)
		end
	end
}

return {
	Name = "runif";
	Aliases = {};
	Description = "Runs a given command string if a certain condition is met.";
	Group = "DefaultUtil";
	Args = {
		{
			Type = "conditionFunction";
			Name = "Condition";
			Description = "The condition function"
		},
		{
			Type = "string";
			Name = "Argument";
			Description = "The argument to the condition function"
		},
		{
			Type = "string";
			Name = "Test against";
			Description = "The text to test against."
		},
		{
			Type = "string";
			Name = "Command";
			Description = "The command string to run if requirements are met. If omitted, return value from condition function is used.";
			Optional = true;
		},
	};

	Run = function(context, condition, arg, testAgainst, command)
		local conditionFunc = conditions[condition]

		if not conditionFunc then
			return ("Condition %q is not valid."):format(condition)
		end

		local text = conditionFunc(testAgainst, arg)

		if text then
			return context.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(context.Cmdr.Util.RunEmbeddedCommands(context.Dispatcher, command or text))
		end

		return ""
	end
}

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Utility/varServer.lua`:

```lua
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local queue = {}
local DataStoresActive, DataStore
task.spawn(function()
	DataStoresActive, DataStore = pcall(function()
		local DataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("_package/eryn.io/Cmdr")
		DataStore:GetAsync("test_key")
		return DataStore
	end)

	while #queue > 0 do
		coroutine.resume(table.remove(queue, 1))
	end
end)

return function (context, key)
	if DataStoresActive == nil then
		table.insert(queue, coroutine.running())
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local gameWide = false
	local saved = true

	if key:sub(1, 1) == "$" then
		key = key:sub(2)
		gameWide = true
	end

	if key:sub(1, 1) == "." then
		key = key:sub(2)
		saved = false
	end

	if saved and not DataStoresActive then
		return "# You must publish this place to the web to use saved keys."
	end

	local namespace = "var_" .. (gameWide and "global" or tostring(context.Executor.UserId))

	if saved then
		local keyPath = namespace .. "_" .. key
		local value = DataStore:GetAsync(keyPath) or ""
		if type(value) == "table" then
			return table.concat(value, ",") or ""
		end
		return value
	else
		local store = context:GetStore(namespace)

		local value = store[key] or ""

		if type(value) == "table" then
			return table.concat(value, ",") or ""
		end

		return value
	end
end

```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/help.lua`:

```lua
local ARGUMENT_SHORTHANDS = [[
Argument Shorthands
-------------------
.   Me/Self
*   All/Everyone
**  Others
?   Random
?N  List of N random values
]]

local TIPS = [[
Tips
----
• Utilize the Tab key to automatically complete commands
• Easily select and copy command output
]]

return {
	Name = "help";
	Description = "Displays a list of all commands, or inspects one command.";
	Group = "Help";
	Args = {
		{
			Type = "command";
			Name = "Command";
			Description = "The command to view information on";
			Optional = true;
		},
	};

	ClientRun = function (context, commandName)
		if commandName then
			local command = context.Cmdr.Registry:GetCommand(commandName)
			context:Reply(`Command: {command.Name}`, Color3.fromRGB(230, 126, 34))
			if command.Aliases and #command.Aliases > 0 then
				context:Reply(`Aliases: {table.concat(command.Aliases, ", ")}`, Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230))
			end
			context:Reply(command.Description, Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230))
			for i, arg in ipairs(command.Args) do
				context:Reply(
					`#{i} {arg.Name}{if arg.Optional == true then "?" else ""}: {arg.Type} - {arg.Description}`
				)
			end
		else
			context:Reply(ARGUMENT_SHORTHANDS)
			context:Reply(TIPS)

			local commands = context.Cmdr.Registry:GetCommands()
			table.sort(commands, function(a, b)
				return if a.Group and b.Group then a.Group < b.Group else a.Group
			end)
			local lastGroup
			for _, command in ipairs(commands) do
				command.Group = command.Group or "No Group"
				if lastGroup ~= command.Group then
					context:Reply(`\n{command.Group}\n{string.rep("-", #command.Group)}`)
					lastGroup = command.Group
				end
				context:Reply(if command.Description then `{command.Name} - {command.Description}` else command.Name)
			end
		end
		return ""
	end;
}

```

```lua
local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Util)

local color3Type = Util.MakeSequenceType({
	Prefixes = "# hexColor3 ! brickColor3";
	ValidateEach = function(value, i)
		if value == nil then
			return false, ("Invalid or missing number at position %d in Color3 type."):format(i)
		elseif value < 0 or value > 255 then
			return false, ("Number out of acceptable range 0-255 at position %d in Color3 type."):format(i)
		elseif value % 1 ~= 0 then
			return false, ("Number is not an integer at position %d in Color3 type."):format(i)
		end

		return true
	end;
	TransformEach = tonumber;
	Constructor = Color3.fromRGB;
	Length = 3;
})

local function parseHexDigit(x)
	if #x == 1 then
		x = x .. x
	end

	return tonumber(x, 16)
end

local hexColor3Type = {
	Transform = function(text)
		local r, g, b = text:match("^#?(%x%x?)(%x%x?)(%x%x?)$")
		return Util.Each(parseHexDigit, r, g, b)
	end;

	Validate = function(r, g, b)
		return r ~= nil and g ~= nil and b ~= nil, "Invalid hex color"
	end;

	Parse = function(...)
		return Color3.fromRGB(...)
	end;
}

return function (cmdr)
	cmdr:RegisterType("color3", color3Type)
	cmdr:RegisterType("color3s", Util.MakeListableType(color3Type, {
		Prefixes = "# hexColor3s ! brickColor3s"
	}))

	cmdr:RegisterType("hexColor3", hexColor3Type)
	cmdr:RegisterType("hexColor3s", Util.MakeListableType(hexColor3Type))
end

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/ReplicatedStorage/Cmdr/BuiltInTypes/Duration.lua`:

```lua
local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Util)

local unitTable = {
    Years = 31556926,
    Months = 2629744,
    Weeks = 604800,
    Days = 86400,
    Hours = 3600,
    Minutes = 60,
    Seconds = 1
}

local searchKeyTable = {}
for key, _ in pairs(unitTable) do
    table.insert(searchKeyTable, key)
end
local unitFinder = Util.MakeFuzzyFinder(searchKeyTable)

local function stringToSecondDuration(stringDuration)
    -- The duration cannot be null or an empty string.
    if stringDuration == nil or stringDuration == "" then
        return nil
    end
    -- Allow 0 by itself (without a unit) to indicate 0 seconds
    local durationNum = tonumber(stringDuration)
    if durationNum and durationNum == 0 then
        return 0, 0, true
    end
    -- The duration must end with a unit,
    -- if it doesn't then return true as the fourth value to indicate the need to offer autocomplete for units.
    local endOnlyString = stringDuration:gsub("-?%d+%a+", "")
    local endNumber = endOnlyString:match("-?%d+")
    if endNumber then
        return nil, tonumber(endNumber), true
    end
    local seconds = nil
    local rawNum, rawUnit
    for rawComponent in stringDuration:gmatch("-?%d+%a+") do
        rawNum, rawUnit = rawComponent:match("(-?%d+)(%a+)")
        local unitNames = unitFinder(rawUnit)
        -- There were no matching units, it's invalid. Return the parsed number to be used for autocomplete
        if #unitNames == 0 then
            return nil, tonumber(rawNum)
        end
        if seconds == nil then seconds = 0 end
        -- While it was already defaulting to use minutes when using just "m", this does it without worrying
        -- about any consistency between list ordering.
        seconds = seconds + (rawUnit:lower() == "m" and 60 or unitTable[unitNames[1]]) * tonumber(rawNum)
    end
    -- If no durations were provided, return nil.
    if seconds == nil then
        return nil
    else
        return seconds, tonumber(rawNum)
    end
end

local function mapUnits(units, rawText, lastNumber, subStart)
    subStart = subStart or 1
    local returnTable = {}
    for i, unit in pairs(units) do
        if lastNumber == 1 then
            returnTable[i] = rawText .. unit:sub(subStart, #unit - 1)
        else
            returnTable[i] = rawText .. unit:sub(subStart)
        end
    end
    return returnTable
end

local durationType = {
    Transform = function(text)
        return text, stringToSecondDuration(text)
    end;

    Validate = function(_, duration)
        return duration ~= nil
    end;

    Autocomplete = function(rawText, duration, lastNumber, isUnitMissing, matchedUnits)
        local returnTable = {}
        if isUnitMissing or matchedUnits then
            local unitsTable = isUnitMissing == true and unitFinder("") or matchedUnits
            if isUnitMissing == true then
                -- Concat the entire unit name to existing text.
                returnTable = mapUnits(unitsTable, rawText, lastNumber)
            else
                -- Concat the rest of the unit based on what already exists of the unit name.
                local existingUnitLength = rawText:match("^.*(%a+)$"):len()
                returnTable = mapUnits(unitsTable, rawText, existingUnitLength + 1)
            end
        elseif duration ~= nil then
            local endingUnit = rawText:match("^.*-?%d+(%a+)%s?$")
            -- Assume there is a singular match at this point
            local fuzzyUnits = unitFinder(endingUnit)
            -- List all possible fuzzy matches. This is for the Minutes/Months ambiguity case.
            returnTable = mapUnits(fuzzyUnits, rawText, lastNumber, #endingUnit + 1)
            -- Sort alphabetically in the Minutes/Months case, so Minutes are displayed on top.
            table.sort(returnTable)
        end
        return returnTable
    end;

    Parse = function(_, duration)
        return duration
    end;
}

return function(registry)
    registry:RegisterType("duration", durationType)
    registry:RegisterType("durations", Util.MakeListableType(durationType))
end

```

local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Util)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local nameCache = {}
local function getUserId(name)
	if nameCache[name] then
		return nameCache[name]
	elseif Players:FindFirstChild(name) then
		nameCache[name] = Players[name].UserId
		return Players[name].UserId
	else
		local ok, userid = pcall(Players.GetUserIdFromNameAsync, Players, name)

		if not ok then
			return nil
		end

		nameCache[name] = userid
		return userid
	end
end

local playerIdType = {
	DisplayName = "Full Player Name";
	Prefixes = "# integer";

	Transform = function (text)
		local findPlayer = Util.MakeFuzzyFinder(Players:GetPlayers())

		return text, findPlayer(text)
	end;

	ValidateOnce = function (text)
		return getUserId(text) ~= nil, "No player with that name could be found."
	end;

	Autocomplete = function (_, players)
		return Util.GetNames(players)
	end;

	Parse = function (text)
		return getUserId(text)
	end;

	Default = function(player)
		return player.Name
	end;

	ArgumentOperatorAliases = {
		me = ".";
		all = "*";
		others = "**";
		random = "?";
	};
}

return function (cmdr)
	cmdr:RegisterType("playerId", playerIdType)
	cmdr:RegisterType("playerIds", Util.MakeListableType(playerIdType, {
		Prefixes = "# integers"
	}))
end
