```lua
		local ok,n = pcall(function() return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(uid) end)
		if ok and n:lower():find(name,1,true) then
			bannedPlayers[uid]=nil; logCmd(s,"unban "..n)
			return fb(s,"✅ Unbanned "..n..".")
		end
	end
	fb(s,"Player not in ban list.",true)
end}

-- ── EVENT (typed command: !event global Taco Rain) ───────────────
CMD["event"] = { rank=RANKS.Admin, exec=function(s,a)
	if #a < 2 then
		return fb(s,"Usage: event <global|server> <event name>\nEx: !event global Taco Rain",true)
	end

	local scope = nil
	local nameParts = {}

	if a[1]:lower()=="global" or a[1]:lower()=="server" then
		scope = a[1]:lower()=="global" and "Global" or "Server"
		for i=2,#a do table.insert(nameParts,a[i]) end
	elseif a[#a]:lower()=="global" or a[#a]:lower()=="server" then
		scope = a[#a]:lower()=="global" and "Global" or "Server"
		for i=1,#a-1 do table.insert(nameParts,a[i]) end
	else
		return fb(s,"Specify 'global' or 'server'.\nEx: !event global Taco Rain",true)
	end

	local evtName = table.concat(nameParts," ")
	local evtData
	for _,e in ipairs(EVENTS) do
		if e.name:lower()==evtName:lower() then evtData=e; break end
	end
	if not evtData then
		for _,e in ipairs(EVENTS) do
			if e.name:lower():find(evtName:lower(),1,true) then evtData=e; break end
		end
	end
	if not evtData then
		local list="Available events:\n"
		for _,e in ipairs(EVENTS) do list=list.."  • "..e.name.."\n" end
		return fb(s,"Event '"..evtName.."' not found.\n"..list,true)
	end

	local model=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(evtData.model)
	if not model then
		return fb(s,"Model '"..evtData.model.."' not in ReplicatedStorage!",true)
	end
	local clone=model:Clone(); clone.Parent=game.Workspace
	Debris:AddItem(clone,evtData.duration)
	logCmd(s,"event: "..evtData.name.." ["..scope.."]")
	if scope=="Global" then
		for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			RE_Feedback:FireClient(p,"🎉 EVENT: "..evtData.name.."!",false)
		end
	else
		fb(s,"🎉 Event '"..evtData.name.."' started (server only)!",false)
	end
end}

		heal="heal <player>\nFully restores player health.\nRank: Mod+",
		damage="damage <player> <amount>\nDeals damage to player.\nRank: Mod+",
		god="god <player>\nMakes player invincible.\nRank: Admin+",
		ungod="ungod <player>\nRemoves god mode.\nRank: Admin+",
		freeze="freeze <player>\nAnchors all player body parts.\nRank: Mod+",

		hint="hint <message>\nShows a Roblox hint bar.\nRank: Mod+",
		time="time <0-24>\nSets Lighting clock time.\nRank: Mod+",
		day="day\nSets time to 14 (daytime).\nRank: Mod+",
		night="night\nSets time to 0 (midnight).\nRank: Mod+",

		unfly="unfly <player>\nDisables fly mode.\nRank: Admin+",
		invisible="invisible <player>\nMakes player transparent.\nRank: Admin+",
		visible="visible <player>\nRestores player visibility.\nRank: Admin+",
		sparkles="sparkles <player>\nAdds sparkle effect.\nRank: Mod+",
		unsparkles="unsparkles <player>\nRemoves sparkles.\nRank: Mod+",
		fire="fire <player>\nAdds fire effect.\nRank: Mod+",
		unfire="unfire <player>\nRemoves fire effect.\nRank: Mod+",
		explode="explode <player>\nCreates explosion at player.\nRank: Admin+",
		dance="dance <player>\nPlays dance animation.\nRank: Mod+",
		admin="admin <player>\nPromotes player to Admin.\nRank: Owner only",

		mod="mod <player>\nPromotes player to Mod.\nRank: Admin+",
		unmod="unmod <player>\nDemotes Mod to Player.\nRank: Admin+",

		help="help [command]\nShows help or details for a command.\nEx: !help kick\nRank: Owner only",
	}

	if query ~= "" then
		local detail = DETAILS[query]
		if detail then
			return fb(s,"=== !"..query:upper().." ===\n"..detail)
		end
		-- Fuzzy match
		local suggestions = {}
		for k,_ in pairs(DETAILS) do
			if k:find(query,1,true) then table.insert(suggestions,k) end
		end
		if #suggestions > 0 then
			table.sort(suggestions)
			return fb(s,"No exact match for '"..query.."'.\nDid you mean: "..table.concat(suggestions,", ").."?",true)

			return fb(s,"No command found matching '"..query.."'.\nType !help for full list.",true)

	end

╔══ ADMIN PANEL HELP ══╗
  Owner: unknowPerson_237

  Targets: me / all / others / name

          explode dance

[ADMIN]   admin unadmin mod unmod
          owner unowner rank perms

[EVENTS]  events
          event <global|server> <name>

!help <command> for detailed usage.]])
end}

-- ================================================================
--  COMMAND EXECUTOR
-- ================================================================
local function runCommand(sender, raw)
	if type(raw)~="string" or #raw>300 then return end
	raw=raw:gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
	if raw=="" then return end
	if not checkCooldown(sender) then
		return fb(sender,"⏱️ Please wait before running another command.",true)
	end
	local parts=raw:split(" ")
	local name=parts[1]:lower()
	table.remove(parts,1)
	local cmd=CMD[name]
	if not cmd then return fb(sender,"❌ Unknown: "..name..". Try !help",true) end
	if not hasPerm(sender,cmd.rank) then
		return fb(sender,"🚫 No permission. Need: "..RANK_NAMES[cmd.rank],true)
	end
	local ok,err=pcall(cmd.exec,sender,parts)
	if not ok then
		fb(sender,"⚠️ Error: "..tostring(err),true)
		warn("[Admin] '"..name.."': "..tostring(err))
	end
end

-- ================================================================
--  REMOTE HANDLERS
-- ================================================================
RE_Execute.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, cmd)
	runCommand(player, cmd)
end)

RF_GetRank.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	return getRank(player.UserId)
end

RF_GetEvents.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	if not hasPerm(player, RANKS.Mod) then return {} end
	return EVENTS
end

RE_Event.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, evtName, scope)
	if not hasPerm(player, RANKS.Admin) then
		return fb(player,"Need Admin rank to start events.",true)
	end
	if type(evtName)~="string" or type(scope)~="string" then return end
	local evtData
	for _,e in ipairs(EVENTS) do
		if e.name==evtName then evtData=e; break end
	end
	if not evtData then return fb(player,"Event not found.",true) end
	local model=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(evtData.model)
	if not model then
		return fb(player,"Model '"..evtData.model.."' not in ReplicatedStorage!",true)
	end
	local clone=model:Clone(); clone.Parent=game.Workspace
	Debris:AddItem(clone,evtData.duration)
	logCmd(player,"event: "..evtName.." ["..scope.."]")
	if scope=="Global" then
		for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			RE_Feedback:FireClient(p,"🎉 EVENT: "..evtName.."!",false)
		end
	else
		fb(player,"🎉 Event '"..evtName.."' started (server only)!",false)
	end
end)

-- ================================================================
--  PLAYER JOIN / LEAVE
-- ================================================================
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	if player.Name==CONFIG.OWNER then
		playerRanks[player.UserId]=RANKS.Owner
	end
	task.wait(0.5)

	local ban=bannedPlayers[player.UserId]
	if ban then
		if ban.permanent then
			player:Kick("Permanently banned: "..ban.reason); return
		elseif ban.expires and os.time()<ban.expires then
			player:Kick("Temp banned for "..(ban.expires-os.time()).."s more."); return
		else
			bannedPlayers[player.UserId]=nil
		end
	end

	if serverLocked and getRank(player.UserId)<RANKS.Mod then
		player:Kick("Server is locked."); return
	end

	player.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
		table.insert(chatLogs,{player=player.Name,msg=msg,time=os.date("%H:%M:%S")})
		if #chatLogs>500 then table.remove(chatLogs,1) end
		if mutedPlayers[player.UserId] then
			RE_Feedback:FireClient(player,"🔇 You are muted.",true)
		end
		local prefix=msg:sub(1,1)
		if prefix==CONFIG.PREFIX or prefix==CONFIG.ALT_PREFIX then
			runCommand(player, msg:sub(2))
		end
	end)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	cooldowns[player.UserId]=nil
end)

print("[AdminPanel] ✅ Loaded. Owner: "..CONFIG.OWNER)
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Cmdr/StarterPlayerScripts/CmdrClient.lua`:

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- CmdrClient is moved to ReplicatedStorage by the server's Initialize script
local CmdrClient = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("CmdrClient"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Update the console based on the player's role
-- Whitelisted players see their role in the prompt; non-whitelisted players can't open the console at all
local function updateAccess()
	local role = player:GetAttribute("CmdrRole")
	if role and role ~= "" then
		CmdrClient:SetEnabled(true)
		CmdrClient:SetPlaceName(role)
	else
		CmdrClient:SetEnabled(false)
		CmdrClient:Hide()
	end
end

-- Apply now and update whenever the server sets/changes the role attribute
updateAccess()
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CmdrRole"):Connect(updateAccess)

-- Set the activation key to F2
CmdrClient:SetActivationKeys({Enum.KeyCode.F2})

```

```lua
local function updateDropdown(query)
	query = query:lower():gsub("^%s+","")
	local matches = {}
	if query ~= "" then
		for _, cmd in ipairs(ALL_CMDS) do
			if cmd:sub(1,#query)==query or cmd:find(query,1,true) then
				table.insert(matches, cmd)
				if #matches >= MAX_SUG then break end
			end
		end
	end
	for i = 1, MAX_SUG do
		if matches[i] then
			dropItems[i].Text    = "  "..matches[i]
			hintLabels[i].Text   = CMD_HINTS[matches[i]] or ""
			dropItems[i].Visible = true
		else
			dropItems[i].Text    = ""
			dropItems[i].Visible = false
		end
	end
	local count = #matches
	if count > 0 then
		dropdown.Visible = true
		tw(dropdown,{Size=UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,count*32+8)},0.15):Play()
	else
		tw(dropdown,{Size=UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,0)},0.12):Play()
		task.delay(0.12, function() dropdown.Visible=false end)
	end
end

for i = 1, MAX_SUG do
	local idx = i
	dropItems[i].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local cmd = dropItems[idx].Text:gsub("^%s+","")
		cmdInput.Text = cmd.." "
		cmdInput:CaptureFocus()
		playSound(SFX.click)
		tw(dropdown,{Size=UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,0)},0.12):Play()
		task.delay(0.12, function() dropdown.Visible=false end)
	end)
end

cmdInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	local txt = cmdInput.Text
	local firstWord = txt:match("^(%S+)")
	if firstWord and #txt > 0 then
		updateDropdown(firstWord)
	else
		tw(dropdown,{Size=UDim2.new(0,BAR_W,0,0)},0.1):Play()
		task.delay(0.1, function() dropdown.Visible=false end)
	end
end)

local function populateEvents()
	for _,c in ipairs(evtScroll:GetChildren()) do
		if not c:IsA("UILayout") and not c:IsA("UIPadding") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local evts = RF_GetEvts:InvokeServer()
	if not evts or #evts==0 then
		local none=Instance.new("TextLabel")
		none.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,40); none.BackgroundTransparency=1
		none.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(100,100,115)
		none.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; none.TextSize=12
		none.Text="No events configured."; none.Parent=evtScroll; return
	end
	for i,e in ipairs(evts) do
		local row=Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,50)
		row.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(16,16,22)

		nameL.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; nameL.TextSize=12
		nameL.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; nameL.Parent=row

		local descL=Instance.new("TextLabel")

		descL.BackgroundTransparency=1

-- ================================================================
--  FLY SYSTEM
-- ================================================================
local flying  = false
local flyBody = nil
local flyGyro = nil

local function enableFly()
	if flying then return end
	flying=true
	local char=player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hrp=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end

	flyBody=Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	flyBody.Velocity=Vector3.zero; flyBody.MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5)
	flyBody.Parent=hrp

	flyGyro=Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	flyGyro.MaxTorque=Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5); flyGyro.D=100; flyGyro.Parent=hrp

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not flying then
			if flyBody and flyBody.Parent then flyBody:Destroy() end
			if flyGyro and flyGyro.Parent then flyGyro:Destroy() end
			return
		end
		local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
		local v=Vector3.zero; local spd=40
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then v=v+cam.CFrame.LookVector*spd end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then v=v-cam.CFrame.LookVector*spd end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then v=v-cam.CFrame.RightVector*spd end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then v=v+cam.CFrame.RightVector*spd end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)       then v=v+Vector3.new(0,spd,0) end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then v=v-Vector3.new(0,spd,0) end
		if flyBody and flyBody.Parent then flyBody.Velocity=v end
	end)
end

local function disableFly()
	flying=false
end

	playSound(isErr and SFX.error_ or SFX.success)

end)

		or inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then

		barContainer.Position=UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset+delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset+delta.Y)
	end
end)

	if inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging=false
	end
end)
```

```lua
-- Madonox
-- 2023

-- Server API for the anticheat.  Contains most, if not all of the methods that can be interacted with outside the anticheat environment.

local Entry = {
	Environment = {
		Settings = {};
		Services = {};
	}
}

function Entry.OverrideSettings(settingsPackage)
	Entry.Environment.Settings = settingsPackage
end

function Entry.ServiceCall(serviceName,method,...)
	local env = Entry.Environment
	local serviceRef = env.Services[serviceName]
	local wrapped = {...}
	local success,out = pcall(function()
		return serviceRef[method](serviceRef,table.unpack(wrapped))
	end)
	if not success then
		warn("API ServiceCall error: "..out)
		return
	end
	
	if env.Settings.SupressNotifications ~= true then
		warn("ServiceCall is a high-level method.  Please ensure you know what you're doing when using it.  To hide this message, set the configuration attribute [SupressNotifications] to true.")
	end
	
	return out
end

function Entry.DumpService(serviceName,requestedTable)
	warn(`Creating service dump of service {serviceName} into table {requestedTable}.`)
	return setmetatable(requestedTable,{
		__index = Entry.Environment.Services[serviceName]
	})
end

return table.freeze(setmetatable(Entry,{
	__newindex = {};
	__tostring = function()
		return "API"
	end,
}))
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/MainModule/AnticheatPackage/Bootloader.lua`:

```lua
-- Madonox
-- 2023

-- Main entry point, starts whole system and maintains table protection.

local Bootloader = {
	ModificationEnvironment = {
		Started = false;
		Services = {};
		API = nil;
	};
}

-- See post https://devforum.roblox.com/t/be-careful-when-using-assert-and-why/1289175, assert has issues.
local function safeAssert(value,response)
	if value == false then
		warn("Bootloader error: "..response)
		error("") -- Message is a warning, use error to stop execution.
	end
end

function Bootloader.Start(configuration,pluginDirectory)
	local gameCode = game.JobId.."-BitAntiCheat"
	safeAssert(shared[gameCode] ~= true,"You can only have one instance of the BitAntiCheat in your game!")
	safeAssert(Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.Started ~= true,"You can only start the bootloader once!")
	safeAssert(#Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.Services == 0,"WARNING: service table modification detected!  This may result in security vulnurabilities!")
	
	shared[gameCode] = true
	Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.Started = true
	
	-- Load anticheat.
	local immuneUsers = configuration.WhitelistedUsers or {}
	local detectedModules = {}
	for _,service in script.Parent:WaitForChild("Services"):GetDescendants() do
		if service:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local module = require(service)
			
			if tostring(module) == "AnticheatService" then
				detectedModules[service.Name] = setmetatable({
					Services = detectedModules;
					Environment = Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment;
					WhitelistedUsers = immuneUsers;
				},{
					__metatable = "Locked.";
					__index = module;
					--__newindex = {};
				})
				if module.Initialize then
					module:Initialize()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	table.freeze(detectedModules)
	Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.Services = detectedModules
	--table.freeze(Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.Services)
	
	for name,service in Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.Services do
		if service.Start then
			service:Start(configuration.Services[name])
		end
	end
	
	Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.API = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("API"):WaitForChild("Entry"))
	Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.API.Environment.Services = Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.Services
	
	-- Freezes the environment once loading is done.
	table.freeze(Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment)
	
	-- Used to log about configuration changes.
	if configuration.Configuration_Version ~= 1.1 then
		warn("WARNING: your BitAntiCheat configuration/loader is out-of-date!  Please update it ASAP.")
	end
	
	-- Start plugins.
	for _,object in pluginDirectory:GetDescendants() do
		if object:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local req = require(object)
			if typeof(req) == "function" then
				req(detectedModules)
				continue
			end
			warn(string.format("WARNING: Cannot start BitAntiCheat plugin %s!  Plugin does not return a function.",object.Name))
		end
	end
end

function Bootloader.StreamAPI()
	assert(Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.Started == true,"You can only call the API once the bootloader has started!")
	return Bootloader.ModificationEnvironment.API
end

return table.freeze(Bootloader)
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/MainModule/AnticheatPackage/Services/Detection/CharacterService.lua`:

```lua
-- Madonox
-- 2023

-- Primary system for listening to character events, and validating certain changes.

local CharacterService = setmetatable({},{__tostring=function()
	return "AnticheatService"
end})
local QueryService;
local FlagService;
local ThreadEventService;

function CharacterService:Start(configurationPackage)
	self.Config = configurationPackage
	QueryService = self.Services.QueryService
	FlagService = self.Services.FlagService
	ThreadEventService = self.Services.ThreadEventService
end

function CharacterService:NewCharacter(owner,model)
	if model:GetAttribute("MoveManagerLoaded") ~= true then
		model:SetAttribute("MoveManagerLoaded",true)
		local thread = ThreadEventService:MakeEventThread()
		
		local humanoid = model:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
		
		humanoid.Died:Once(function()
			thread.Cancel()
		end)
		humanoid.Destroying:Once(function()
			thread.Cancel()
		end)
		model.Destroying:Once(function()
			thread.Cancel()
		end)
		
		local defaultIgnore = {model}
		
		-- State change checks (defined locally to use local variables):
		if self.Config.DisableStateCheck ~= true then
			local humanoidStateCallbacks = {
				[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing] = function() -- Prevent any fake ladders from being made to climb.
					local activePositions = {}
					local charPos,size = model:GetBoundingBox()
					charPos = charPos.Position -- Originally a CFrame

					for _,part:Instance in QueryService:PartsInRange(charPos,5,defaultIgnore) do
						if part:IsA("TrussPart") then
							return
						elseif part:IsA("BasePart") then
							table.insert(activePositions,part.Position)
						end
					end

					-- Check for custom ladders.
					for _,activePos in activePositions do
						local activeY = activePos.Y
						for _,otherPos in activePositions do
							if otherPos ~= activePos then
								if math.abs(activeY-otherPos.Y) <= 1.5 then
									return
								end
							end
						end
					end

					-- If the thread keeps executing, then the player should now be punished.
					model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(QueryService:RaycastDistance(charPos,Vector3.new(0,-1,0),500,defaultIgnore).Position+Vector3.new(0,size.Y/2,0)))
					model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
					task.wait(1)
					model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
					
					FlagService:Flag(owner)
				end,
				[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated] = function() -- Prevent using sitting to fly / other weird glitches.
					local charPos,size = model:GetBoundingBox()
					charPos = charPos.Position -- Originally a CFrame

					for _,part:Instance in QueryService:PartsInRange(charPos,5,defaultIgnore) do
						if part:IsA("Seat") or part:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
							return
						end
					end

					-- Found exploiting, punish.
					humanoid.Sit = false
					humanoid.Jump = true
					model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
					model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(QueryService:RaycastDistance(charPos,Vector3.new(0,-1,0),500,defaultIgnore).Position+Vector3.new(0,size.Y/2,0)))
					task.wait(1)
					model.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
					
					FlagService:Flag(owner)
				end,
			}

			humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(old,new)
				local stateCallback = humanoidStateCallbacks[new]
				if stateCallback then
					stateCallback(old,new)
				end
			end)
		end
		
		local rootPart = model:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
		
		-- Teleportation / speed hack checks (harsher, most likely disabled):
		if self.Config.DisableTeleportCheck ~= true then
			local averageVelocity = 0
			local maxVelocity = humanoid.WalkSpeed
			local lastPosition = rootPart.Position

			humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
				maxVelocity = math.max(maxVelocity,humanoid.WalkSpeed) -- TODO: implement better practices.
			end)
			
			thread.Bind(.75,function()
				local newPos = rootPart.Position
				averageVelocity = (averageVelocity + (newPos - lastPosition).Magnitude) / 2
				if averageVelocity > maxVelocity then
					model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(lastPosition))
				else
					lastPosition = newPos
				end
			end)
		end
		
		if self.Config.DisableVelocityCheck ~= true then
			local ignoreStates = {
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding,
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics,
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall,
				--Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
			}
			
			thread.Bind(.1,function()
				-- Ignore the check if the humanoid is in a specific state.
				if not table.find(ignoreStates,humanoid:GetState()) then
					local currentVelocity = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
					-- Use math.max to check if the player's falling.  If they're going up, then start checking.
					if Vector3.new(currentVelocity.X,math.max(0,currentVelocity.Y-humanoid.JumpHeight),currentVelocity.Z).Magnitude >= humanoid.WalkSpeed*2 then
						rootPart.Anchored = true
						rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new()
						task.wait(1)
						rootPart.Anchored = false

						FlagService:Flag(owner)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		
		if self.Config.DisableRotationCheck ~= true then
			local ignoreStates = {
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding,
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics,
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,
			}
			
			local averageRotation = Vector3.new()
			thread.Bind(.1,function()
				if not table.find(ignoreStates,humanoid:GetState()) then
					averageRotation = (rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity + averageRotation) / 2
					if averageRotation.Magnitude >= 50 then
						rootPart.Anchored = true
						rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new()
						task.wait(1)
						rootPart.Anchored = false

						FlagService:Flag(owner)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		
		if self.Config.DisableJumpCheck ~= true then
			local _,size = model:GetBoundingBox()
			local postFlightStates = {
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall;
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying;
				Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping;
			}
			
			humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(old,new)
				if new == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
					if table.find(postFlightStates,old) then -- Goes from a flying state to another flying state...  Flying loop.
						rootPart.Anchored = true
						rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new()
						model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(QueryService:RaycastDistance(rootPart.Position,Vector3.new(0,-1,0),1000,defaultIgnore).Position+Vector3.new(0,size.Y/2,0)))
						task.wait(1)
						rootPart.Anchored = false

						FlagService:Flag(owner)
						return
					end
					task.wait(.1) -- Wait so the velocity can actually be applied.
					if rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y > humanoid.JumpHeight * 1.25 + humanoid.WalkSpeed then
						rootPart.Anchored = true
						rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new()
						model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(QueryService:RaycastDistance(rootPart.Position,Vector3.new(0,-1,0),1000,defaultIgnore).Position+Vector3.new(0,size.Y/2,0)))
						task.wait(1)
						rootPart.Anchored = false
						-- No flag due to possible false-positives.
					end
				end
			end)
		end
		
		-- Multiple tools at once prevention.
		-- This is NOT flagged because lag can occur here, causing errors.
		if self.Config.DisableToolCheck ~= true then
			model.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				local toolCount = 0
				for _,tool in model:GetChildren() do
					if tool:IsA("Tool") then
						toolCount += 1
						if toolCount > 1 then
							task.wait() -- If we don't yield for one step you get a "something unexpectedly tried to set the parent of x..."
							humanoid:UnequipTools()
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

return CharacterService
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/MainModule/AnticheatPackage/Services/Detection/FlagService.lua`:

```lua
-- Madonox
-- 2023

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local FlagService = setmetatable({
	Punishments = {
		{
			TotalStrikes = 10;
			Action = "kick";
			Parameters = {"You have been kicked for suspected exploiting!"};
		},
	};
},{__tostring=function()
	return "AnticheatService"
end})

function FlagService:Start(configuration)
	if configuration then
		if configuration.Punishments then
			self.Punishments = configuration.Punishments
		end
	end
	
	self.FlagData = {}
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		if self.FlagData[player] then
			self.FlagData[player] = nil
		end
	end)
end

function FlagService:CheckRegistry(player)
	if self.FlagData[player] == nil then
		self.FlagData[player] = 0
	end
end

function FlagService:HandleAction(player,package)
	if package.Action == "kick" then
		player:Kick(table.unpack(package.Parameters))
	end
end

function FlagService:Flag(player)
	self:CheckRegistry(player)
	self.FlagData[player] += 1
	
	local totalStrikes = self.FlagData[player]
	for _,punishment in self.Punishments do
		if punishment.TotalStrikes <= totalStrikes then
			self:HandleAction(player,punishment)
		end
	end
end

return FlagService
```

```lua
-- Madonox

-- Keeps track of and manages player data.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PlayerManagerService = setmetatable({},{__tostring=function()
	return "AnticheatService"
end})

function PlayerManagerService:Start()
	local CharacterService = self.Services.CharacterService
	
	local immunePlayers = self.WhitelistedUsers
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		if player:GetAttribute("DataPackageLoaded") ~= true and not table.find(immunePlayers,player.UserId) then
			player:SetAttribute("DataPackageLoaded",true)
			CharacterService:NewCharacter(player,player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait())

			player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
				CharacterService:NewCharacter(player,player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait())
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	-- If the game has a long load time, this ensures players will properly load.
	for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player:GetAttribute("DataPackageLoaded") ~= true and not table.find(immunePlayers,player.UserId) then
			player:SetAttribute("DataPackageLoaded",true)
			CharacterService:NewCharacter(player,player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait())

			player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
				CharacterService:NewCharacter(player,player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait())
			end)
		end
	end
end

return PlayerManagerService
```

```lua
-- Madonox
-- 2023

-- Basic service used for world queries.

local QueryService = setmetatable({},{__tostring=function()
	return "AnticheatService"
end})

local Params = OverlapParams.new()
Params.MaxParts = 500
Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist

local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
RayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist

function QueryService:PartsInRange(origin:Vector3,radius:number,customIgnore)
	Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = customIgnore
	return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(origin,radius,Params)
end

function QueryService:RaycastDistance(origin:Vector3,direction:Vector3,distance:number,customIgnore)
	local unit = direction.Unit
	RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = customIgnore
	return workspace:Raycast(origin,direction*distance,RayParams) or {
		Position = origin+unit*distance
	}
end

return QueryService
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/MainModule/AnticheatPackage/Services/Util/ThreadEventService.lua`:

```lua
-- Madonox
-- 2023

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local ThreadEventService = setmetatable({},{
	__tostring = function()
		return "AnticheatService"
	end
})

function ThreadEventService:MakeEventThread()
	local memory = {}
	
	local thread = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		for _,connection in memory do
			local newElapsed = connection.Elapsed + deltaTime
			local interval = connection.Interval
			if newElapsed > interval then
				newElapsed = newElapsed - deltaTime - interval
				connection.Callback()
			end
			
			connection.Elapsed = newElapsed
		end
	end)
	
	local function cancel()
		thread:Disconnect()
		thread = nil
		for _,connection in memory do
			table.clear(connection)
		end
		table.clear(memory)
	end
	local function createRuntime(interval,callback)
		local newPackage = {
			Callback = callback;
			Interval = interval;
			Elapsed = 0;
		}
		
		table.insert(memory,newPackage)
	end
	
	return {
		Thread = thread;
		Cancel = cancel;
		Bind = createRuntime;
	}
end

return ThreadEventService
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open _ Abrir/Ungroup In Admin/announceglobalServer.lua`:

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local function showGlobalMessage(targetPlayer, messageText)
	local playerGui = targetPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui then return end

	-- Evita que se dupliquen mensajes viejos en pantalla
	local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("GlobalAnnounceGui")
	if oldGui then oldGui:Destroy() end

	-- Crear el ScreenGui principal
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "GlobalAnnounceGui"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.DisplayOrder = 1000 -- Prioridad alta para que se lea sobre cualquier GUI

	-- Crear la etiqueta de texto arriba en el centro
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 50) -- Ancho largo, alto de 50 pixeles
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.05, 0) -- Centrado horizontalmente, a un 5% del borde superior
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0) -- Punto de anclaje en el centro para el alineamiento perfecto
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1 -- Fondo invisible para que sea solo el texto limpio
	label.Text = messageText
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) -- Texto Blanco
	label.TextSize = 28 -- Tamaño de letra grande y legible
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold -- Fuente moderna y gruesa
	label.TextTransparency = 1 -- Empezamos invisible para la animación
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.Parent = gui

	-- Añadir sombra o borde negro al texto para que sea legible en cualquier mapa
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) -- Contorno negro
	stroke.Thickness = 2.5
	stroke.Transparency = 1 -- Empezamos invisible
	stroke.Parent = label

	gui.Parent = playerGui

	-- Animación: Aparece -> Se queda 4 segundos -> Desaparece
	task.spawn(function()
		local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

		-- Fade In (Aparece)
		TweenService:Create(label, tweenInfo, {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(stroke, tweenInfo, {Transparency = 0}):Play()

		task.wait(4) -- Tiempo que el mensaje se queda arriba en el centro de la pantalla

		-- Fade Out (Se desvanece)
		local fadeOut = TweenService:Create(label, tweenInfo, {TextTransparency = 1})
		TweenService:Create(stroke, tweenInfo, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		fadeOut:Play()

		fadeOut.Completed:Wait()
		gui:Destroy() -- Borra el objeto por completo al terminar
	end)
end

return function (context, message)
	if not message or message == "" then
		return "Escribe un mensaje para anunciar globalmente."
	end

	-- Envía el texto arriba al centro de cada jugador en el servidor
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		showGlobalMessage(player, message)
	end

	return ("Mensaje global enviado correctamente.")
end
```

```lua
	Cmdr:Toggle()

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Return or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter then
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ReplicatedStorage/CmdrFlyClient.lua`:

```lua
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local character = script.Parent
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
if not rootPart then return end

local velocity = rootPart:WaitForChild("CmdrFlyVelocity", 5)
local align = rootPart:WaitForChild("CmdrFlyAlign", 5)
if not velocity or not align then return end

-- ServerScript에서 전달받은 속도값 사용 (기본값 50)
local speed = script:GetAttribute("FlySpeed") or 50

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

	local moveDir = Vector3.zero
	local lookCFrame = camera.CFrame

	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir = moveDir + lookCFrame.LookVector end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir = moveDir - lookCFrame.LookVector end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir = moveDir - lookCFrame.RightVector end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir = moveDir + lookCFrame.RightVector end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

	if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
		moveDir = moveDir.Unit
	end

	velocity.VectorVelocity = moveDir * speed
	align.CFrame = lookCFrame
end)

script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
end)
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr.lua`:

```lua
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Util = require(script.Shared:WaitForChild("Util"))

if RunService:IsServer() == false then
	error("Cmdr server module is somehow running on a client!")
end

local Cmdr do
	Cmdr = setmetatable({
		ReplicatedRoot = nil;
		RemoteFunction = nil;
		RemoteEvent = nil;
		Util = Util;
		DefaultCommandsFolder = script.BuiltInCommands;
	}, {
		__index = function (self, k)
			local r = self.Registry[k]
			if r and type(r) == "function" then
				return function (_, ...)
					return r(self.Registry, ...)
				end
			end
		end
	})

	Cmdr.Registry = require(script.Shared.Registry)(Cmdr)
	Cmdr.Dispatcher = require(script.Shared.Dispatcher)(Cmdr)

	require(script.Initialize)(Cmdr)
end

-- Handle command invocations from the clients.
Cmdr.RemoteFunction.OnServerInvoke = function (player, text, options)
	return Cmdr.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(text, player, options)
end

return Cmdr
```

```lua
return {
```

```lua
return function (context, message)
	if not message or message == "" then
		return "Please write a message to announce."
	end

		showAnnouncement(player, sender, message)
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/banServer.lua`:

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function parseBanType(str)
	if not str then return "perm", -1 end
	local lower = str:lower()

	if lower == "server" or lower == "sv" or lower == "0" or lower == "kick" then
		return "server", 0
	end

	if lower == "perm" or lower == "permanent" or lower == "-1" then
		return "perm", -1
	end

	local num, unit = lower:match("^(%d+)([smhd])$")
	if not num or not unit then
		local plainNum = tonumber(str)
		if plainNum then return "time", plainNum * 60 end
		return nil, nil
	end

	num = tonumber(num)
	if unit == "s" then return "time", num
	elseif unit == "m" then return "time", num * 60
	elseif unit == "h" then return "time", num * 3600
	elseif unit == "d" then return "time", num * 86400
	end

	return nil, nil
end

return function(context, players, typeOrDuration, reason)
	local banCategory, seconds = parseBanType(typeOrDuration)
	if not banCategory then
		return "Invalid type or duration! Use 'perm', 'server', or duration like '30m', '2h', '1d'."
	end

	local count = 0

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		-- 1. 스튜디오 가상 유저 (UserId < 0) 또는 서버 밴일 경우 -> 즉시 Kick
		if player.UserId < 0 or banCategory == "server" then
			player:Kick(string.format("\n[%s Banned]\nReason: %s", banCategory:upper(), reason))
			count = count + 1
		else
			-- 2. 실제 플레이어 (UserId > 0) -> Roblox BanAsync DB 적용
			local success, err = pcall(function()
				Players:BanAsync({
					UserIds = { player.UserId },
					Duration = seconds,
					DisplayReason = reason,
					Reason = reason,
					ApplyToAnyPlace = true,
					ExcludeAltAccounts = false
				})
			end)

			if success then
				count = count + 1
			else
				warn("Ban failed for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end

	local displayType = (banCategory == "perm") and "Permanently" or ((banCategory == "server") and "Server" or string.format("Temporarily (%s)", typeOrDuration))
	return string.format("%s banned %d player(s). (Reason: %s)", displayType, count, reason)
end
```

```lua
return function(context, players, statName, newValue)
	local successCount = 0
	local failedPlayers = {}

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		if leaderstats then
			local stat = leaderstats:FindFirstChild(statName)
			if stat and (stat:IsA("IntValue") or stat:IsA("NumberValue") or stat:IsA("StringValue")) then
				stat.Value = newValue
				successCount = successCount + 1
			else
				table.insert(failedPlayers, player.Name)
			end
		else
			table.insert(failedPlayers, player.Name)
		end
	end

	local msg = string.format("Successfully changed '%s' to %s for %d player(s).", statName, tostring(newValue), successCount)

	if #failedPlayers > 0 then
		msg = msg .. string.format(" (Failed for: %s - leaderstat or stat not found)", table.concat(failedPlayers, ", "))
	end

	return msg
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/charServer.lua`:

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

return function (context, victims, targetUser)
	-- 입력받은 targetUser가 닉네임인지 유저 ID인지 판별
	local targetUserId = tonumber(targetUser)

	if not targetUserId then
		-- 닉네임인 경우 UserId 가져오기
		local success, id = pcall(function()
			return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(targetUser)
		end)

		if success and id then
			targetUserId = id
		else
			return "Could not find a user named '" .. tostring(targetUser) .. "'."
		end
	end

	-- 아바타 외형 데이터(HumanoidDescription) 가져오기
	local success, description = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(targetUserId)
	end)

	if not success or not description then
		return "Failed to load avatar description for UserId: " .. tostring(targetUserId)
	end

	local changedCount = 0

	for _, player in ipairs(victims) do
		local character = player.Character
		if not character then continue end

		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid then continue end

		-- 아바타 외형 적용
		pcall(function()
			humanoid:ApplyDescription(description)
			changedCount = changedCount + 1
		end)
	end

	return "Transformed " .. changedCount .. " player(s) into " .. targetUser .. "'s character!"
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/colorServer.lua`:

```lua
-- 지원되는 주요 색상 리스트
local COLOR_MAP = {
	red     = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
	blue    = Color3.fromRGB(50, 120, 255),
	green   = Color3.fromRGB(60, 220, 60),
	yellow  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 50),
	pink    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 200),
	purple  = Color3.fromRGB(160, 60, 255),
	black   = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30),
	white   = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245),
	orange  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 30),
	cyan    = Color3.fromRGB(50, 230, 255),
	magenta = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 150),
}

return function(context, players, colorArg)
	local affectedPlayers = 0
	local colorLower = string.lower(colorArg or "red")
	local isReset = (colorLower == "reset" or colorLower == "off" or colorLower == "false")

	local targetColor = COLOR_MAP[colorLower] or COLOR_MAP["red"]

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			if not isReset then
				-- [1] 지정한 색상 적용
				for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
						-- 기존 원본 색상 백업
						if not obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalPartColor") then
							local origVal = Instance.new("Color3Value")
							origVal.Name = "OriginalPartColor"
							origVal.Value = obj.Color
							origVal.Parent = obj
						end

						-- 파츠 색상 변경
						obj.Color = targetColor

						-- MeshPart 텍스처 지우기 (몸통 옷 모양 가리기)
						if obj:IsA("MeshPart") and obj.TextureID ~= "" then
							if not obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalTexture") then
								local texVal = Instance.new("StringValue")
								texVal.Name = "OriginalTexture"
								texVal.Value = obj.TextureID
								texVal.Parent = obj
							end
							obj.TextureID = ""
						end

						-- 셔츠, 바지 등 의상 텍스처 잠시 제거
					elseif obj:IsA("Clothing") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
						if not obj:FindFirstChild("WasHiddenByColor") then
							local boolVal = Instance.new("BoolValue")
							boolVal.Name = "WasHiddenByColor"
							boolVal.Value = true
							boolVal.Parent = obj
						end
						obj.Parent = nil
					end
				end
			else
				-- [2] 원래 색상 및 의상 복구
				for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
						local origVal = obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalPartColor")
						if origVal then
							obj.Color = origVal.Value
							origVal:Destroy()
						end

						local origTex = obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalTexture")
						if origTex then
							if obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
								obj.TextureID = origTex.Value
							end
							origTex:Destroy()
						end
					end
				end
			end

			affectedPlayers = affectedPlayers + 1
		end
	end

	if not isReset then
		return string.format("Changed color of %d player(s) to %s!", affectedPlayers, colorLower)
	else
		return string.format("Reset color for %d player(s).", affectedPlayers)
	end
end
```

```lua
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

return function(context, players, toggle, speed)
	local affectedPlayers = 0
	local flySpeed = speed or 50

	-- ReplicatedStorage에 스크립트가 있는지 확인
	local templateScript = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CmdrFlyClient")
	if not templateScript then
		return "Error: 'CmdrFlyClient' LocalScript was not found in ReplicatedStorage!"
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if rootPart and humanoid then
				-- 기존 비행 관련 스크립트 및 객체 제거
				local oldFlyScript = character:FindFirstChild("CmdrFlyClient")
				local oldAlign = rootPart:FindFirstChild("CmdrFlyAlign")
				local oldVelocity = rootPart:FindFirstChild("CmdrFlyVelocity")
				local oldAttachment = rootPart:FindFirstChild("CmdrFlyAttachment")

				if oldFlyScript then oldFlyScript:Destroy() end
				if oldAlign then oldAlign:Destroy() end
				if oldVelocity then oldVelocity:Destroy() end
				if oldAttachment then oldAttachment:Destroy() end

				if toggle then
					-- [1] 비행 활성화
					humanoid.PlatformStand = true

					local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
					attachment.Name = "CmdrFlyAttachment"
					attachment.Parent = rootPart

					local velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
					velocity.Name = "CmdrFlyVelocity"
					velocity.Attachment0 = attachment
					velocity.MaxForce = math.huge
					velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
					velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
					velocity.Parent = rootPart

					local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
					align.Name = "CmdrFlyAlign"
					align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
					align.Attachment0 = attachment
					align.MaxTorque = math.huge
					align.Responsiveness = 200
					align.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame
					align.Parent = rootPart

					-- ReplicatedStorage에 저장해둔 클라이언트 스크립트를 복사해서 적용
					local flyScript = templateScript:Clone()
					flyScript:SetAttribute("FlySpeed", flySpeed)
					flyScript.Parent = character
				else
					-- [2] 비행 해제
					humanoid.PlatformStand = false
				end

				affectedPlayers = affectedPlayers + 1
			end
		end
	end

	if toggle then
		return string.format("Enabled fly for %d player(s) at speed %d!", affectedPlayers, flySpeed)
	else
		return string.format("Disabled fly for %d player(s).", affectedPlayers)
	end
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/giveServer.lua`:

```lua
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- 툴 탐색 전용 함수 (대소문자 무시 및 대안 경로 전체 검색)
local function findTool(name)
	local targetName = name:lower()

	-- Searching places: ServerStorage, ReplicatedStorage
	local searchContainers = { ServerStorage, ReplicatedStorage }

	for _, container in ipairs(searchContainers) do
		for _, descendant in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("Tool") then
				-- 이름이 완벽히 일치하거나 소문자로 변환했을 때 일치하면 반환
				if descendant.Name:lower() == targetName then
					return descendant
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

return function (context, targets, toolName)
	if not toolName or toolName == "" then
		return "Please specify a tool name."
	end

	local targetTool = findTool(toolName)

	if not targetTool then
		return ("Tool '%s' was not found in ServerStorage or ReplicatedStorage."):format(toolName)
	end

	local count = 0
	for _, player in ipairs(targets) do
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if backpack then
			-- 복사본을 만들어 플레이어 가방에 넣음
			local clonedTool = targetTool:Clone()
			clonedTool.Parent = backpack
			count = count + 1
		end
	end

	return ("Gave '%s' to %d player(s)."):format(targetTool.Name, count)
end
```

```lua
	local goldColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 0) -- 황금색

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			if toggle then
				-- [1] 황금 상태로 변경
				for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
					-- 파츠 색상 & 재질 변경
					if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
						if not obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalColor") then
							local colorVal = Instance.new("Color3Value")
							colorVal.Name = "OriginalColor"
							colorVal.Value = obj.Color
							colorVal.Parent = obj

							local matVal = Instance.new("StringValue")
							matVal.Name = "OriginalMaterial"
							matVal.Value = obj.Material.Name
							matVal.Parent = obj
						end

						obj.Color = goldColor
						obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

						-- 메쉬파츠 자체에 텍스처가 박혀있는 경우 숨기기
						if obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
							if not obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalTexture") then
								local texVal = Instance.new("StringValue")
								texVal.Name = "OriginalTexture"
								texVal.Value = obj.TextureID
								texVal.Parent = obj
							end
							obj.TextureID = ""
						end

						-- 옷(Shirt, Pants, ShirtGraphic) 가리기
					elseif obj:IsA("Clothing") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
						if not obj:FindFirstChild("WasEnabled") then
							local boolVal = Instance.new("BoolValue")
							boolVal.Name = "WasEnabled"
							boolVal.Value = obj.Parent ~= nil
							boolVal.Parent = obj
						end
						-- 잠시 플레이어 몸에서 떼어놓기 (숨기기)
						obj.Parent = nil

						-- 얼굴 표정 데칼 가리기
					elseif obj:IsA("Decal") and obj.Name == "face" then
						obj.Transparency = 1
					end
				end

			else
				-- [2] 원래 상태로 복구
				for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
						local origColor = obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalColor")
						local origMat = obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalMaterial")

						if origColor and origMat then
							obj.Color = origColor.Value
							local success, enumMat = pcall(function()
								return Enum.Material[origMat.Value]
							end)
							obj.Material = (success and enumMat) and enumMat or Enum.Material.Plastic

							origColor:Destroy()
							origMat:Destroy()
						end

						-- 메쉬파츠 텍스처 복구
						local origTex = obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalTexture")
						if origTex then
							obj.TextureID = origTex.Value
							origTex:Destroy()
						end

					elseif obj:IsA("Decal") and obj.Name == "face" then
						obj.Transparency = 0
					end
				end

				-- 떼어놓았던 옷(Shirt/Pants) 다시 캐릭터에게 붙이기
				for _, child in ipairs(player:GetChildren()) do
					-- 혹시나 복구용으로 남겨둔 옷이 있다면 캐릭터로 복원
				end
				-- 간단하게 캐릭터 의상은 'Character:LoadCharacter()' 또는 텍스처 재적용 방식으로 복구
			end

			affectedPlayers = affectedPlayers + 1
		end
	end

	if toggle then
		return string.format("Turned %d player(s) into solid gold!", affectedPlayers)
	else
		return string.format("Reset gold effect for %d player(s).", affectedPlayers)
	end
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/headsizeServer.lua`:

```lua
return function(context, players, scale)
	local affectedPlayers = 0

	-- Clamp scale value strictly between 0.2 and 5
	scale = math.clamp(scale, 0.2, 5)

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if humanoid then
				-- 1. Roblox Standard HumanoidDescription Scaling
				local description = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("HumanoidDescription") or humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()

				if description then
					description.HeadScale = scale
					humanoid:ApplyDescription(description)
				else
					-- 2. Fallback for custom rigs without HumanoidDescription
					local headScaleVal = character:FindFirstChild("HeadScale", true) or humanoid:FindFirstChild("HeadScale")
					if headScaleVal then
						headScaleVal.Value = scale
					else
						-- 3. Manual Head and Neck offset adjustment
						local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
						local torso = character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")

						if head then
							if not head:FindFirstChild("BaseSize") then
								local baseVal = Instance.new("Vector3Value")
								baseVal.Name = "BaseSize"
								baseVal.Value = head.Size
								baseVal.Parent = head
							end

							local baseSize = head.BaseSize.Value
							head.Size = baseSize * scale

							local neck = (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Neck")) or head:FindFirstChild("Neck")
							if neck then
								if not neck:FindFirstChild("DefaultC0") then
									local defaultVal = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
									defaultVal.Name = "DefaultC0"
									defaultVal.Value = neck.C0
									defaultVal.Parent = neck
								end

								local defaultC0 = neck.DefaultC0.Value
								local yOffset = (baseSize.Y * (scale - 1)) * 1.2
								neck.C0 = defaultC0 * CFrame.new(0, yOffset, 0)
							end
						end
					end
				end

				affectedPlayers = affectedPlayers + 1
			end
		end
	end

	if scale == 1 then
		return string.format("Reset head size to default (1) for %d player(s).", affectedPlayers)
	else
		return string.format("Set head size scale to %g (Range: 0.2 ~ 5) for %d player(s).", scale, affectedPlayers)
	end
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/jailServer.lua`:

```lua
return function (context, victims)
	for _, player in ipairs(victims) do
		local character = player.Character
		if not character then continue end

		local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not rootPart or not humanoid then continue end

		-- 이미 감옥에 가둬진 상태라면 스킵
		if character:FindFirstChild("JailCell") then continue end

		-- 감옥 모델 생성
		local jailModel = Instance.new("Model")
		jailModel.Name = "JailCell"

		local cf = rootPart.CFrame
		local size = 8

		-- 벽 생성 함수
		local function createWall(wallSize, wallOffset)
			local wall = Instance.new("Part")
			wall.Size = wallSize
			wall.CFrame = cf * wallOffset
			wall.Anchored = true
			wall.CanCollide = true
			wall.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- 대소문자 수정 완료
			wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
			wall.Parent = jailModel
		end

		-- 6방향 벽면 생성
		createWall(Vector3.new(size, 0.5, size), CFrame.new(0, -3.5, 0))
		createWall(Vector3.new(size, 0.5, size), CFrame.new(0, 4.5, 0))
		createWall(Vector3.new(0.5, 8, size), CFrame.new(-size/2, 0.5, 0))
		createWall(Vector3.new(0.5, 8, size), CFrame.new(size/2, 0.5, 0))
		createWall(Vector3.new(size, 8, 0.5), CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -size/2))
		createWall(Vector3.new(size, 8, 0.5), CFrame.new(0, 0.5, size/2))

		jailModel.Parent = character
		rootPart.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)

		-- 이동 제한
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
		if humanoid.UseJumpPower then
			humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		else
			humanoid.JumpHeight = 0
		end
	end

	return "Jailed " .. #victims .. " player(s)."
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/musicServer.lua`:

```lua
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

return function (context, assetId, volume, pitch)
	-- 기존에 Cmdr로 재생 중이던 음악이 있다면 제거
	local existingSound = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CmdrGlobalMusic")
	if existingSound then
		existingSound:Stop()
		existingSound:Destroy()
	end

	-- assetId가 0이면 정지 기능
	if assetId == 0 then
		return "Music stopped."
	end

	-- 새로운 Sound 객체 생성
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "CmdrGlobalMusic"
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId)
	sound.Volume = math.clamp(volume or 1, 0, 10)
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = pitch or 1
	sound.Looped = true
	sound.Parent = Workspace

	sound:Play()

	return ("Now playing Music ID: %d (Volume: %.1f, Pitch: %.1f)"):format(assetId, sound.Volume, sound.PlaybackSpeed)
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/neonServer.lua`:

```lua
-- 미리 지정된 주요 네온 색상표
local COLOR_MAP = {
	cyan    = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
	red     = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50),
	green   = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 50),
	blue    = Color3.fromRGB(50, 100, 255),
	yellow  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0),
	pink    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
	purple  = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 255),
	orange  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0),
	white   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
}

return function(context, players, colorArg)
	local affectedPlayers = 0
	local colorLower = string.lower(colorArg or "cyan")

	-- 끄기 옵션 처리 ("off", "false", "reset" 입력 시)
	local isTurningOff = (colorLower == "off" or colorLower == "false" or colorLower == "reset")
	local neonColor = COLOR_MAP[colorLower] or COLOR_MAP["cyan"]

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			if not isTurningOff then
				-- [1] 네온 상태 적용
				for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
						-- 기존 속성 백업
						if not obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalColor") then
							local colorVal = Instance.new("Color3Value")
							colorVal.Name = "OriginalColor"
							colorVal.Value = obj.Color
							colorVal.Parent = obj

							local matVal = Instance.new("StringValue")
							matVal.Name = "OriginalMaterial"
							matVal.Value = obj.Material.Name
							matVal.Parent = obj
						end

						-- 네온 재질 및 색상 적용
						obj.Color = neonColor
						obj.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

						-- MeshPart 텍스처 지우기 (몸통 옷 모양 가리기)
						if obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
							if not obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalTexture") then
								local texVal = Instance.new("StringValue")
								texVal.Name = "OriginalTexture"
								texVal.Value = obj.TextureID
								texVal.Parent = obj
							end
							obj.TextureID = ""
						end

						-- 셔츠, 바지 등 의상 텍스처 숨기기
					elseif obj:IsA("Clothing") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
						if not obj:FindFirstChild("WasHidden") then
							local boolVal = Instance.new("BoolValue")
							boolVal.Name = "WasHidden"
							boolVal.Value = true
							boolVal.Parent = obj
						end
						obj.Parent = nil

						-- 얼굴 데칼 숨기기
					elseif obj:IsA("Decal") and obj.Name == "face" then
						obj.Transparency = 1
					end
				end
			else
				-- [2] 원래 상태로 복구
				for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
					if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
						local origColor = obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalColor")
						local origMat = obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalMaterial")

						if origColor and origMat then
							obj.Color = origColor.Value
							local success, enumMat = pcall(function()
								return Enum.Material[origMat.Value]
							end)
							obj.Material = (success and enumMat) and enumMat or Enum.Material.Plastic

							origColor:Destroy()
							origMat:Destroy()
						end

						local origTex = obj:FindFirstChild("OriginalTexture")
						if origTex then
							obj.TextureID = origTex.Value
							origTex:Destroy()
						end

					elseif obj:IsA("Decal") and obj.Name == "face" then
						obj.Transparency = 0
					end
				end
			end

			affectedPlayers = affectedPlayers + 1
		end
	end

	if not isTurningOff then
		return string.format("Turned %d player(s) into %s neon!", affectedPlayers, colorLower)
	else
		return string.format("Reset neon effect for %d player(s).", affectedPlayers)
	end
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/sitServer.lua`:

```lua
return function(context, players)
	local affectedPlayers = 0

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if humanoid and rootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				-- 기존 임시 의자 제거
				local oldSeat = character:FindFirstChild("TempCmdrSeat")
				if oldSeat then
					oldSeat:Destroy()
				end

				-- 1. 높이를 바닥 수준으로 낮춘 임시 의자 생성
				local tempSeat = Instance.new("Seat")
				tempSeat.Name = "TempCmdrSeat"
				tempSeat.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.1, 2)

				-- ★ Y축 오프셋을 -2.8로 설정하여 바닥에 딱 안착시킴
				tempSeat.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
				tempSeat.Transparency = 1
				tempSeat.CanCollide = false
				tempSeat.Anchored = true
				tempSeat.Parent = workspace

				-- 2. 의자에 앉히기
				tempSeat:Sit(humanoid)

				-- 3. 일어서면 의자 자동 삭제
				local connection
				connection = tempSeat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
					if not tempSeat.Occupant then
						connection:Disconnect()
						tempSeat:Destroy()
					end
				end)

				affectedPlayers = affectedPlayers + 1
			end
		end
	end

	return string.format("Made %d player(s) sit down.", affectedPlayers)
end
```

```lua
return {
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/sizeServer.lua`:

```lua
return function(context, players, scale)
	local affectedPlayers = 0

	-- 0.1 ~ 10 사이로 제한 (필요시 최대/최소값 조정 가능)
	scale = math.clamp(scale, 0.1, 10)

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if humanoid then
				-- 1. Roblox 표준 HumanoidDescription 사용 (R15 계열)
				local description = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("HumanoidDescription") or humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()

				if description then
					-- 스케일 값 설정 (중첩 안 됨)
					description.BodyTypeScale = 0 -- 커스텀 스케일 적용 시 기본 체형 고정
					description.DepthScale = scale
					description.HeightScale = scale
					description.WidthScale = scale
					description.HeadScale = scale

					humanoid:ApplyDescription(description)
				else
					-- 2. Humanoid 스케일 Value 객체 변경 (R15 fallback)
					local depth = humanoid:FindFirstChild("BodyDepthScale")
					local height = humanoid:FindFirstChild("BodyHeightScale")
					local width = humanoid:FindFirstChild("BodyWidthScale")
					local head = humanoid:FindFirstChild("HeadScale")

					if depth and height and width and head then
						depth.Value = scale
						height.Value = scale
						width.Value = scale
						head.Value = scale
					else
						-- 3. R6 또는 custom rig 수동 Scale (Model:ScaleTo 사용)
						-- ★ 중첩 방지 핵심: 최초 기본 크기를 기억해두고 항상 최초 크기 대비로 변경
						if not character:FindFirstChild("OriginalScale") then
							local origVal = Instance.new("NumberValue")
							origVal.Name = "OriginalScale"
							origVal.Value = 1
							origVal.Parent = character
						end

						local currentScale = character.OriginalScale.Value
						if currentScale > 0 then
							-- 기존에 커져있던 스케일을 1로 되돌린 후 새로운 scale 적용
							local relativeScale = scale / currentScale
							character:ScaleTo(relativeScale)
							character.OriginalScale.Value = scale
						end
					end
				end

				affectedPlayers = affectedPlayers + 1
			end
		end
	end

	if scale == 1 then
		return string.format("Reset body size to normal (1) for %d player(s).", affectedPlayers)
	else
		return string.format("Set body size scale to %g for %d player(s).", scale, affectedPlayers)
	end
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/spinServer.lua`:

```lua
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

return function (context, victims, degreesOrSpeed)
	local count = 0

	for _, player in ipairs(victims) do
		local character = player.Character
		if not character then continue end

		local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not rootPart then continue end

		-- 기존에 적용되어 있던 회전 효과 제거
		local existingSpin = rootPart:FindFirstChild("CmdrSpinAttachment")
		if existingSpin then
			existingSpin:Destroy()
		end
		local existingAngular = rootPart:FindFirstChild("CmdrSpinAngular")
		if existingAngular then
			existingAngular:Destroy()
		end

		-- 속도가 0이면 정지 후 다음 플레이어로
		if degreesOrSpeed == 0 then
			count = count + 1
			continue
		end

		-- 회전 전용 Attachment 및 AngularVelocity 생성
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Name = "CmdrSpinAttachment"
		attachment.Parent = rootPart

		local angularVelocity = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")
		angularVelocity.Name = "CmdrSpinAngular"
		angularVelocity.Attachment0 = attachment
		angularVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		-- Y축(상하 축) 기준으로 회전 (Degrees를 Radians로 변환)
		angularVelocity.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.rad(degreesOrSpeed), 0)
		angularVelocity.MaxTorque = 999999
		angularVelocity.Parent = rootPart

		count = count + 1
	end

	if degreesOrSpeed == 0 then
		return "Stopped spinning for " .. count .. " player(s)."
	else
		return "Started spinning " .. count .. " player(s) at " .. degreesOrSpeed .. " deg/sec!"
	end
end
```

```lua
return function (_, fromPlayers, destination)
	local cframe

	if typeof(destination) == "Instance" then
		if destination.Character and destination.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			cframe = destination.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
		else
			return "Target player has no character."
		end
	elseif typeof(destination) == "Vector3" then
		cframe = CFrame.new(destination)
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(fromPlayers) do
		if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = cframe
		end
	end

	return ("Teleported %d players."):format(#fromPlayers)
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/transparencyServer.lua`:

```lua
return function(context, players, alpha)
	local affectedPlayers = 0

	-- 0~1 사이 값으로 제한 (예: -0.5나 2 같은 잘못된 수치 방지)
	local transValue = math.clamp(alpha or 1, 0, 1)

	for _, player in ipairs(players) do
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				-- 1. 파츠 (몸통, 머리, 액세서리 파츠 등) 투명도 변경
				if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
					-- HumanoidRootPart는 원래 투명해야 하므로 제외
					if obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
						obj.Transparency = transValue
					end

					-- 2. 얼굴 표정 등 데칼 투명도 변경
				elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
					obj.Transparency = transValue
				end
			end

			affectedPlayers = affectedPlayers + 1
		end
	end

	return string.format("Set transparency of %d player(s) to %.2f.", affectedPlayers, transValue)
end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Admin/unbanServer.lua`:

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

return function(context, targetInput, reason)
	local targetUserId = tonumber(targetInput)

	-- 입력값이 숫자가 아닌 '유저네임'일 경우 UserId로 변환
	if not targetUserId then
		local success, id = pcall(function()
			return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(targetInput)
		end)

		if success and id then
			targetUserId = id
		else
			return string.format("Could not find any user named '%s'.", targetInput)
		end
	end

	-- UnbanAsync 실행
	local success, err = pcall(function()
		Players:UnbanAsync({
			UserIds = { targetUserId },
			ApplyToAnyPlace = true
		})
	end)

	if success then
		return string.format("Successfully unbanned UserID %d. (Reason: %s)", targetUserId, reason)
	else
		warn("Unban failed for UserID " .. tostring(targetUserId) .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		return string.format("Failed to unban UserID %d. Error: %s", targetUserId, tostring(err))
	end
end
```

```lua
return {
	Name = "thru";
	Aliases = {"t", "through"};
	Description = "Teleports you through whatever your mouse is hovering over, placing you equidistantly from the wall.";
	Group = "DefaultDebug";
	Args = {
		{
			Type = "number";
			Name = "Extra distance";
			Description = "Go through the wall an additional X studs.";
			Default = 0;
		}
	};

	ClientRun = function(context, extra)
		-- We implement this here because player position is owned by the client.
		-- No reason to bother the server for this!

		local mouse = context.Executor:GetMouse()
		local character = context.Executor.Character

		if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			return "You don't have a character."
		end

		character:MoveTo((diff * 2) + (diff.unit * extra) + pos)

		return "Blinked!"
	end
```

`scripts/ServerStorage/HeadcraftReference/Open __ Read Inside/ServerScriptService/Cmdr/BuiltInCommands/Utility/bind.lua`:

```lua
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

return {
	Name = "bind";
	Aliases = {};
	Description = "Binds a command string to a key or mouse input.";
	Group = "DefaultUtil";
	Args = {
		{
			Type = "userInput ! bindableResource @ player";
			Name = "Input";
			Description = "The key or input type you'd like to bind the command to."
		},
		{
			Type = "command";
			Name = "Command";
			Description = "The command you want to run on this input"
		},
		{
			Type = "string";
			Name = "Arguments";
			Description = "The arguments for the command";
			Default = "";
		}
	};

	ClientRun = function(context, bind, command, arguments)
		local binds = context:GetStore("CMDR_Binds")

		command = command .. " " .. arguments

		if binds[bind] then
			binds[bind]:Disconnect()
		end

		local bindType = context:GetArgument(1).Type.Name

		if bindType == "userInput" then
			binds[bind] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
				if gameProcessed then
					return
				end

				if input.UserInputType == bind or input.KeyCode == bind then
					context:Reply(context.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(context.Cmdr.Util.RunEmbeddedCommands(context.Dispatcher, command)))
				end
			end)
		elseif bindType == "bindableResource" then
			return "Unimplemented..."
		elseif bindType == "player" then
			binds[bind] = bind.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
				local args = { message }
				local chatCommand = context.Cmdr.Util.RunEmbeddedCommands(context.Dispatcher, context.Cmdr.Util.SubstituteArgs(command, args))
				context:Reply(("%s $ %s : %s"):format(
					bind.Name,
					chatCommand,
					context.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(chatCommand)
				), Color3.fromRGB(244, 92, 66))
			end)
		end


		return "Bound command to input."
	end
}
```

```lua
return {
	Name = "replace";
	Aliases = {};
	Description = "Replaces text A with text B";
	Group = "DefaultUtil";
	Args = {
		{
			Type = "string";
			Name = "Haystack";
			Description = "The source string upon which to perform replacement."
		},

			Name = "Needle";
			Description = "The string pattern search for."
		},
		{

			Name = "Replacement";
			Description = "The string to replace matches (%1 to insert matches)."
		},
	};
```

```lua
			Name = "Condition";

		if text then
			return context.Dispatcher:EvaluateAndRun(context.Cmdr.Util.RunEmbeddedCommands(context.Dispatcher, command or text))
		end

		return ""
	end
```

```lua
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

return {
	Name = "banlist",
	Aliases = { "bans", "banned" },
	Description = "Displays a list of all currently banned players and their details.",
	Group = "Admin",
	Args = {},

	-- 1. 서버(Server) 측: 로블록스 DB에서 밴 목록 데이터 가져오기
	Data = function(context)
		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return Players:GetBansAsync()
		end)

		if not success or not result then
			return { Success = false }
		end

		local list = {}
		pcall(function()
			while true do
				local currentPage = result:GetCurrentPage()

				for _, banInfo in ipairs(currentPage) do
					local userId = banInfo.UserIds and banInfo.UserIds[1] or "Unknown"
					local reason = banInfo.DisplayReason or banInfo.Reason or "No reason provided"

					local banType = "Permanent"
					if banInfo.Duration and banInfo.Duration > 0 then
						banType = tostring(banInfo.Duration) .. "s"
					end

					local username = "UnknownUser"
					if typeof(userId) == "number" then
						pcall(function()
							username = Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
						end)
					end

					table.insert(list, {
						Name = username,
						UserId = userId,
						BanType = banType,
						Reason = reason
					})
				end

				if result.IsFinished then break end
				result:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
			end
		end)

		return { Success = true, Items = list }
	end,

	-- 2. 클라이언트(Client) 측: 서버에서 넘겨받은 데이터 화면 출력
	ClientRun = function(context, data)
		context:Reply("=== BANNED PLAYERS LIST ===", Color3.fromRGB(230, 126, 34))

		if not data or not data.Success then
			context:Reply("Failed to retrieve ban list from Roblox servers.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80))
			return ""
		end

		if #data.Items == 0 then
			context:Reply("No banned players found in Roblox Database.", Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100))
			return ""
		end

		for idx, item in ipairs(data.Items) do
			context:Reply(string.format("#%d %s (ID: %s) | Type: %s", idx, item.Name, tostring(item.UserId), item.BanType), Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80))
			context:Reply(string.format("   Reason: %s", item.Reason), Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220))
		end

		context:Reply(string.format("Total Banned Players: %d", #data.Items), Color3.fromRGB(230, 126, 34))

		return ""
	end
}
```

```lua
			local command = context.Cmdr.Registry:GetCommand(commandName)

			end

			end
		else
			local commands = context.Cmdr.Registry:GetCommands()

			for _, cmd in pairs(commands) do
				context:Reply(("%s - %s"):format(cmd.Name, cmd.Description))
			end
		end

	end;
```

```lua
local Util = require(script.Parent.Parent.Shared.Util)

local color3Type = Util.MakeSequenceType({
	Prefixes = "# hexColor3 ! brickColor3";
	ValidateEach = function(value, i)
		if value == nil then
			return false, ("Invalid or missing number at position %d in Color3 type."):format(i)
		elseif value < 0 or value > 255 then
			return false, ("Number out of acceptable range 0-255 at position %d in Color3 type."):format(i)
		elseif value % 1 ~= 0 then
			return false, ("Number is not an integer at position %d in Color3 type."):format(i)
		end

		return true
	end;
	TransformEach = tonumber;
	Constructor = Color3.fromRGB;
	Length = 3;
})

local function parseHexDigit(x)
	if #x == 1 then
		x = x .. x
	end

	return tonumber(x, 16)
end

local hexColor3Type = {
	Transform = function(text)
		local r, g, b = text:match("^#?(%x%x?)(%x%x?)(%x%x?)$")
		return Util.Each(parseHexDigit, r, g, b)
	end;

	Validate = function(r, g, b)
		return r ~= nil and g ~= nil and b ~= nil, "Invalid hex color"
	end;

	Parse = function(...)
		return Color3.fromRGB(...)
	end;
}

return function (cmdr)
	cmdr:RegisterType("color3", color3Type)
	cmdr:RegisterType("color3s", Util.MakeListableType(color3Type, {
		Prefixes = "# hexColor3s ! brickColor3s"
	}))

	cmdr:RegisterType("hexColor3", hexColor3Type)
	cmdr:RegisterType("hexColor3s", Util.MakeListableType(hexColor3Type))
end
```
