function AdminUI:Has(permission: string): boolean
	if type(permission) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	if self._permissions["*"] or self._permissions[permission] then
		return true
	end
	local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
	return family ~= nil and self._permissions[family .. ".*"] == true or false
end

function AdminUI:HasAny(permissions: { string }?): boolean
	if type(permissions) ~= "table" or #permissions == 0 then
		return true
	end
	for _, permission in ipairs(permissions) do
		if self:Has(permission) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function AdminUI:MakeContext()
	local ui = self
	local client = self._client

	-- Seiten rufen die Kontextfunktionen mal mit Punkt, mal mit Doppelpunkt auf (ctx.Request(...) bzw.
	-- ctx:Request(...)). Ist das erste Argument der Kontext selbst (oder die UI), wird es übersprungen.
	local context
	local function isSelf(value)
		return value == ui or (context ~= nil and value == context)
	end
	local function action(first, second, third)
		if isSelf(first) then
			return second, third
		end
		return first, second
	end

	context = {
		Client = client,
		Theme = Theme,
		Components = Components,
		Constants = Constants,
		Maid = Maid,
		Util = Util,
		Signal = Signal,
		Prefix = self._prefix,
		Rank = self._rank,
		Version = self._version,
	}

	context.Permissions = self._permissionList
	context.Request = function(a, b, c)
		local name, args = action(a, b, c)
		return client:Request(name, args)
	end
	context.Command = function(a, b)
		local text = action(a, b)
		return client:Command(text)
	end
	context.Autocomplete = function(a, b)
		local text = action(a, b)
		return client:Autocomplete(text)
	end
	context.OnPush = function(a, b)
		local channel, fn = action(a, b)
		return client:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	context.Report = function(a, b, c)
		local kind, data = action(a, b, c)
		return client:Report(kind, data)
	end
	context.HasPermission = function(a, b)
		local permission = action(a, b)
		return ui:Has(permission)
	end
	context.OpenPage = function(a, b)
		local name = action(a, b)
		return ui:OpenPage(name)
	end
	context.Notify = function(a, b, c, d)
		if isSelf(a) then
			ui._notify(b, c, d)
		else
			ui._notify(a, b, c)
		end
	end
	context.SetStatus = function(a, b)
		local text = action(a, b)
		ui:SetStatus(text)
	end
	context.Escape = function(a, b)
		local text = action(a, b)
		return escapeArgument(text)
	end
	context.BuildCommand = function(a, b, c, d)
		if isSelf(a) then
			return buildCommand(b, c, d)
		end
		return buildCommand(a, b, c)
	end
	return context
end

function AdminUI:SetNotify(fn: (kind: string, title: string, message: string) -> ())
	if type(fn) == "function" then
		self._notify = fn
	end
end

function AdminUI:SetStatus(text: string)
	self._status.Text = tostring(text or "Bereit.")
end

function AdminUI:BuildNav()
	for _, child in ipairs(self._sidebar:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("UIListLayout") and not child:IsA("UIPadding") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._navButtons)
	for _, name in ipairs(PAGE_ORDER) do
		if self:HasAny(PAGE_PERMISSIONS[name]) then
			local button = Components.Button(PAGE_LABELS[name], "ghost")
			button.Name = "Nav" .. name
			button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
			button.Parent = self._sidebar
			self._navButtons[name] = button
			button.Activated:Connect(function()
				self:OpenPage(name)
			end)
		end
	end
	if next(self._navButtons) == nil then
		local hint = Components.Label("Keine zugänglichen Bereiche.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
		hint.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
		hint.Parent = self._sidebar
	end
	self:UpdateNavState()
end

function AdminUI:UpdateNavState()
	for name, button in pairs(self._navButtons) do
		local active = name == self._activePage
		button.BackgroundColor3 = active and Theme.Colors.Accent or Theme.Colors.Surface
		button.TextColor3 = active and Theme.Colors.Text or Theme.Colors.TextSecondary
	end
end

function AdminUI:ShowErrorPage(message: string)
	self._pageFrame:ClearAllChildren()
	local errorState = Components.ErrorState(message, function()
		if self._activePage then
			self:OpenPage(self._activePage)
		end
	end)
	errorState.ZIndex = 5
	errorState.Parent = self._pageFrame
end

function AdminUI:OpenPage(name: string): boolean
	if type(name) ~= "string" or not self:HasAny(PAGE_PERMISSIONS[name]) then
		return false
	end
	if self._activePage == name and self._pageInstance then
		if type(self._pageInstance.OnShow) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				self._pageInstance:OnShow()
			end)
		end
		return true
	end
	if self._pageInstance then
		local current = self._pageInstance
		pcall(function()
			current:Destroy()
		end)
		self._pageInstance = nil
	end
	self._activePage = name
	self._pageFrame:ClearAllChildren()
	self:UpdateNavState()
	self:SetStatus(("Bereich: %s"):format(PAGE_LABELS[name] or name))

	local moduleScript = self._loadedModules[name]
	if moduleScript == nil then
		moduleScript = script.Pages:FindFirstChild(name)
		self._loadedModules[name] = moduleScript
	end
	if not moduleScript then
		self:ShowErrorPage(("Seite %s ist nicht vorhanden."):format(name))
		return false
	end
	local ok, pageModule = pcall(require, moduleScript)
	if not ok or type(pageModule) ~= "table" or type(pageModule.new) ~= "function" then
		self:ShowErrorPage(("Seite %s konnte nicht geladen werden."):format(name))
		return false
	end
	local built, page = pcall(pageModule.new, self._pageFrame, self._ctx)
	if not built or type(page) ~= "table" or type(page.Destroy) ~= "function" then
		self:ShowErrorPage(("Seite %s konnte nicht aufgebaut werden."):format(name))
		return false
	end
	self._pageInstance = page
	if type(page.OnShow) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			page:OnShow()
		end)
	end
	return true
end

function AdminUI:DestroyPages()
	if self._pageInstance then
		local current = self._pageInstance
		pcall(function()
			current:Destroy()
		end)
		self._pageInstance = nil
	end
	self._activePage = nil
	self._pageFrame:ClearAllChildren()
end

function AdminUI:RefreshPermissions(permissions: any, rank: string?)
	local wasAdmin = self._isAdmin
	self._permissions = toPermissionSet(permissions)
	self._permissionList = toPermissionList(permissions)
	if type(rank) == "string" then
		self._rank = rank
	end
	self._isAdmin = self:Has("Admin.Panel")
	self._subtitle.Text = ("Rang %s · Version %s · Präfix %s"):format(self._rank, self._version, self._prefix)

	if not self._isAdmin then
		self:DestroyPages()
		self:BuildNav()
		self:SetVisible(false)
		self._miniButton.Visible = false
		return
	end

	self._miniButton.Visible = true
	self:BuildNav()
	if not wasAdmin then
		self:OpenPage("Overview")
		self:SetVisible(true)
		return
	end
	if self._activePage and not self:HasAny(PAGE_PERMISSIONS[self._activePage]) then
		self:DestroyPages()
		local first = nil
		for _, name in ipairs(PAGE_ORDER) do
			if self:HasAny(PAGE_PERMISSIONS[name]) then
				first = name
				break
			end
		end
		if first then
			self:OpenPage(first)
		else
			self:SetVisible(false)
		end
	end
end

function AdminUI:SetVisible(open: boolean, instant: boolean?)
	self._visible = open == true
	self._tweenToken += 1
	local token = self._tweenToken
	if self._visible then
		self._miniButton.Text = "Schließen"
		self._root.Visible = true
		if instant then
			self._root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
			return
		end
		self._root.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.54, 0)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(self._root, TWEEN, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) })
		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Once(function()
			if token ~= self._tweenToken then
				tween:Cancel()
			end
		end)
		return
	end
	self._miniButton.Text = "Admin"
	if instant then
		self._root.Visible = false
		return
	end
	local tween = TweenService:Create(self._root, TWEEN, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.56, 0) })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		if token == self._tweenToken and not self._visible then
			self._root.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

function AdminUI:Toggle()
	self:SetVisible(not self._visible)
end

function AdminUI:IsVisible()
	return self._visible
end

function AdminUI:SetSidebar(open: boolean)
	self._sidebarOpen = open == true
	self:UpdateLayout()
end

function AdminUI:UpdateLayout()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then
		return
	end
	local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
	local scale = math.clamp(math.min(1, viewport.X / 1180, viewport.Y / 740), 0.5, 1)
	self._scale.Scale = scale
	local compact = viewport.X < 760
	if not self._sidebarUserSet then
		self._sidebarOpen = not compact
	end
	self._sidebar.Visible = self._sidebarOpen
	local contentX = self._sidebarOpen and SIDEBAR_WIDTH or 0
	self._content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(contentX, HEADER_HEIGHT)
	self._content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -contentX, 1, -HEADER_HEIGHT - FOOTER_HEIGHT)
	self._menuButton.Text = self._sidebarOpen and "Menü zu" or "Menü"
	self._miniButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 44 or 76, 28)
	self._miniButton.Text = compact and "HC" or (self._visible and "Schließen" or "Admin")
end

function AdminUI:Destroy()
	self._maid:Clean()
	self:DestroyPages()
	table.clear(self._navButtons)
	table.clear(self._loadedModules)
end

return AdminUI

--!nonstrict
-- Anti-Cheat: Live-Erkennungen, Risikowerte, Details und Whitelist.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local Page = {}

local DETECTION_LIMIT = 200

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		return family ~= nil and perms[family .. ".*"] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function onPush(ctx: any, channel: string, fn: (any) -> ())
	if type(ctx.OnPush) == "function" then
		return ctx:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.OnPush) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	return { Disconnect = function() end }
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local t = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d.%02d.%04d %02d:%02d:%02d", t.day or 0, t.month or 0, t.year or 0, t.hour or 0, t.min or 0, t.sec or 0)
end

local function toArray(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	if type(data.items) == "table" then
		return data.items
	end
	if type(data.detections) == "table" then
		return data.detections
	end
	if type(data.scores) == "table" then
		return data.scores
	end
	if type(data.whitelist) == "table" then
		return data.whitelist
	end
	if #data > 0 then
		return data
	end
	local out = {}
	for _, value in pairs(data) do
		if type(value) == "table" or type(value) == "number" then
			table.insert(out, value)
		end
	end
	return out
end

local SEVERITY_ORDER = { Information = 0, Low = 1, Medium = 2, High = 3, Critical = 4 }

local function severityRank(value: any): number
	local key = tostring(value or "Information")
	return SEVERITY_ORDER[key] or 0
end

	local function passesFilters(item: any): boolean

	end

	local function rebuildCategoryOptions()
		local seen: { [string]: boolean } = { Alle = true }
		local list = { "Alle" }
		for _, item in ipairs(detections) do
			if type(item) == "table" then
				local cat = tostring(item.Category or "")
				if cat ~= "" and not seen[cat] then
					seen[cat] = true
					table.insert(list, cat)
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(list, function(a, b)
			if a == "Alle" then
				return true
			end
			if b == "Alle" then
				return false
			end
			return a < b
		end)
		if not seen[categoryFilter] then
			categoryFilter = "Alle"
		end
		setCategoryOptions(list, categoryFilter)
	end

	renderDetections = function()
		local filtered = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(detections) do
			if passesFilters(item) then
				table.insert(filtered, item)
			end
		end
		table.sort(filtered, function(a, b)
			local ta = tonumber(a.Timestamp) or 0
			local tb = tonumber(b.Timestamp) or 0
			if ta == tb then
				return severityRank(a.Severity) > severityRank(b.Severity)
			end
			return ta > tb
		end)
		renderTable(filtered)
		renderDetails()
	end

	local function setWhitelistState(whitelisted: boolean)
		if not has(ctx, "AntiCheat.Manage") then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Berechtigung", "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung AntiCheat.Manage.")
			return
		end
		local userId = tonumber(whitelistUserInput.Text)
		if not userId or userId < 1 or userId % 1 ~= 0 then
			notify(ctx, "warning", "Whitelist", "Bitte eine gültige numerische UserId eingeben.")
			return
		end
		setStatus(ctx, "Whitelist wird aktualisiert …")
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, result = callRequest(ctx, "SetWhitelist", { userId = userId, whitelisted = whitelisted })
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			if ok then
				whitelist[userId] = whitelisted and true or nil
				notify(ctx, "success", "Whitelist", whitelisted and "Spieler wurde zur Whitelist hinzugefügt." or "Spieler wurde von der Whitelist entfernt.")
				renderDetails()
			else
				notify(ctx, "error", "Whitelist", tostring(result or "Whitelist konnte nicht aktualisiert werden."))
				setStatus(ctx, "Whitelist konnte nicht aktualisiert werden.")
			end
		end)
	end

	whitelistAdd.Activated:Connect(function()
		setWhitelistState(true)
	end)
	whitelistRemove.Activated:Connect(function()
		setWhitelistState(false)
	end)

	local function loadAll()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		setStatus(ctx, "Anti-Cheat-Daten werden geladen …")
		task.spawn(function()
			local okDet, detData = callRequest(ctx, "GetDetections", { limit = DETECTION_LIMIT })
			local okRisk, riskData = callRequest(ctx, "GetRiskScores")
			local okWl, wlData = callRequest(ctx, "GetWhitelist")
			if destroyed then
				return
			end

			if okDet then
				table.clear(detections)
				for _, item in ipairs(toArray(detData)) do
					if type(item) == "table" then
						table.insert(detections, item)
					end
				end
				while #detections > DETECTION_LIMIT do
					table.remove(detections)
				end
			else
				notify(ctx, "error", "Anti-Cheat", tostring(detData or "Erkennungen konnten nicht geladen werden."))
			end

			if okRisk then
				table.clear(riskScores)
				for _, item in ipairs(toArray(riskData)) do
					if type(item) == "table" then
						table.insert(riskScores, item)
					end
				end
				table.sort(riskScores, function(a, b)
					return (tonumber(a.Score or a.score or a.RiskScore) or 0) > (tonumber(b.Score or b.score or b.RiskScore) or 0)
				end)
			end

			if okWl then
				table.clear(whitelist)
				local wlList = toArray(wlData)
				if #wlList > 0 then
					for _, item in ipairs(wlList) do
						if type(item) == "number" then
							whitelist[item] = true
						elseif type(item) == "string" then
							local uid = tonumber(item)
							if uid then
								whitelist[uid] = true
							end
						elseif type(item) == "table" then
							local uid = tonumber(item.UserId or item.userId or item.Id)
							local wl = item.whitelisted
							if wl == nil then
								wl = item.Whitelisted
							end
							if uid and wl == true then
								whitelist[uid] = true
							end
						end
					end
				elseif type(wlData) == "table" then
					for k, v in pairs(wlData) do
						local uid = tonumber(k)
						if uid and v == true then
							whitelist[uid] = true
						end
					end
				end
			end

			rebuildCategoryOptions()
			renderDetections()
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("Anti-Cheat geladen: %d Erkennungen.", #detections))
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(loadAll)

	maid:Give(onPush(ctx, "Detection", function(payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		table.insert(detections, 1, payload)
		while #detections > DETECTION_LIMIT do
			table.remove(detections)
		end
		if visible then
			rebuildCategoryOptions()
			renderDetections()
		end
	end))

	local api = {}

	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		loadAll()
	end

	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end

	return api
end

return Page

--!nonstrict
-- Commands: Browser, Konsole mit Autocomplete und History.
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local Page = {}

local HISTORY_LIMIT = 50
local COMMAND_HISTORY_LIMIT = 100

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function callCommand(ctx: any, text: string): any
	if type(ctx.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx:Command(text)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Command(text)
	end
	return { success = false, message = "Command ist nicht verfügbar." }
end

local function callAutocomplete(ctx: any, text: string): { suggestions: { any } }
	if type(ctx.Autocomplete) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Autocomplete(text)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "table" then
			return result
		end
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Autocomplete) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx.Client:Autocomplete(text)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "table" then
			return result
		end
	end
	return { suggestions = {} }
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function toArray(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	if type(data.commands) == "table" then
		return data.commands
	end
	if type(data.history) == "table" then
		return data.history
	end
	if type(data.items) == "table" then
		return data.items
	end
	if #data > 0 then
		return data
	end
	return {}
end

local function formatArgs(args: any): string
	if type(args) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, arg in ipairs(args) do
		if type(arg) == "table" then
			local name = tostring(arg.Name or arg.name or "?")
			local typ = tostring(arg.Type or arg.type or "string")
			local required = arg.Required == true or arg.required == true
			local piece = string.format("%s:%s", name, typ)
			if required then
				piece = piece .. "!"
			end
			table.insert(parts, piece)
		elseif type(arg) == "string" then
			table.insert(parts, arg)
		end
	end
	if #parts == 0 then
		return "-"
	end
	return table.concat(parts, ", ")
end

local function formatAliases(aliases: any): string
	if type(aliases) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(aliases) do
		if type(a) == "string" and a ~= "" then
			table.insert(parts, a)
		end
	end
	if #parts == 0 then
		return "-"
	end
	return table.concat(parts, ", ")
end

	local function acceptSuggestion(): boolean
		if suggestionIndex < 1 or suggestionIndex > #suggestions then
			return false
		end
		local entry = suggestions[suggestionIndex]

		commandInput.Text = value

		suggestions = {}

	end

	local function requestAutocomplete(text: string)

					end
					if #list >= 8 then

	end

				end

			end
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			if #suggestions > 0 then
				suggestionIndex = math.clamp(suggestionIndex - 1, 1, #suggestions)
				renderSuggestions()
			elseif #localHistory > 0 then

				local idx = #localHistory - localHistoryIndex + 1

				commandInput.CursorPosition = #commandInput.Text + 1
			end

		end
	end))

	local function executeConsole()

		if string.gsub(text, "%s", "") == "" then
			return

			end

				appendOutput(tostring(result.message or "Erfolgreich ausgeführt."), Theme.Colors.Success)
				setStatus(ctx, "Command erfolgreich ausgeführt.")
			else
				local message = type(result) == "table" and tostring(result.message or "Command fehlgeschlagen.") or "Command fehlgeschlagen."
				appendOutput(message, Theme.Colors.Error)
				setStatus(ctx, "Command fehlgeschlagen.")
			end
		end)
	end

	runButton.Activated:Connect(executeConsole)

	local historyLabel = Components.Label("Server-History", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary, true)

				if text == "" then
					local uid = tostring(entry.userId or entry.UserId or "?")

	end

	local function loadData()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		setStatus(ctx, "Commands werden geladen …")
		task.spawn(function()
			local okCmd, cmdData = callRequest(ctx, "GetCommands")
			local okHist, histData = callRequest(ctx, "GetCommandHistory")
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			if okCmd then
				table.clear(commands)
				for _, item in ipairs(toArray(cmdData)) do
					if type(item) == "table" then
						table.insert(commands, {
							Name = tostring(item.Name or item.name or "-"),
							Category = tostring(item.Category or item.category or "-"),
							Description = tostring(item.Description or item.description or "-"),
							Aliases = formatAliases(item.Aliases or item.aliases),
							Args = formatArgs(item.Args or item.args),
							raw = item,
						})
					end
				end
				table.sort(commands, function(a, b)
					if a.Category == b.Category then
						return string.lower(a.Name) < string.lower(b.Name)
					end
					return string.lower(a.Category) < string.lower(b.Category)
				end)
				renderTable(commands)
			else
				notify(ctx, "error", "Commands", tostring(cmdData or "Commands konnten nicht geladen werden."))
			end
			if okHist then
				table.clear(serverHistory)
				for _, item in ipairs(toArray(histData)) do
					table.insert(serverHistory, item)
				end
				renderServerHistory()
			end
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("%d Commands geladen.", #commands))
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(loadData)

	local api = {}

	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		loadData()
	end

	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end

	return api
end

return Page

-- Protokolle: Admin-, Security- und System-Logs.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local Page = {}

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local t = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d.%02d.%04d %02d:%02d:%02d", t.day or 0, t.month or 0, t.year or 0, t.hour or 0, t.min or 0, t.sec or 0)
end

local function toArray(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	if type(data.logs) == "table" then
		return data.logs
	end
	if type(data.entries) == "table" then
		return data.entries
	end
	if type(data.items) == "table" then
		return data.items
	end
	if #data > 0 then
		return data
	end
	return {}
end

function Page.new(parentFrame: Frame, ctx: any)
	local maid = Maid.new()
	local Components = ctx.Components
	local Theme = ctx.Theme
	local destroyed = false
	local visible = false
	local currentTab = "Admin"
	local loading = false
	local loadToken = 0

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "LogsPage"
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.Parent = parentFrame

	local title = Components.Label("Protokolle", Theme.TextSize.Title, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 32)
	title.Parent = root

	local subtitle = Components.Label("Admin-, Sicherheits- und Systemprotokolle.", Theme.TextSize.Body, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
	subtitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)
	subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 20)
	subtitle.Parent = root

	local refreshButton = Components.Button("Aktualisieren", "secondary")
	refreshButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	refreshButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	refreshButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 34)
	refreshButton.Parent = root

	local body = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -114), Color3.new())
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 114)
	body.Parent = root

	local function mountTable(rows: { any })
		body:ClearAllChildren()
		local columns = {
			{ key = "Timestamp", title = "Zeit", width = 1.5, format = function(v) return formatTime(v) end },
			{ key = "Level", title = "Level", width = 0.8 },
			{ key = "Tag", title = "Tag", width = 1.2 },
			{ key = "Message", title = "Nachricht", width = 3.2 },
		}
		local normalized = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(rows) do
			if type(item) == "table" then
				table.insert(normalized, {
					Timestamp = item.Timestamp or item.timestamp or item.Time or item.time,
					Level = tostring(item.Level or item.level or "-"),
					Tag = tostring(item.Tag or item.tag or item.Category or item.category or "-"),
					Message = tostring(item.Message or item.message or "-"),
					raw = item,
				})
			end
		end
		table.sort(normalized, function(a, b)
			return (tonumber(a.Timestamp) or 0) > (tonumber(b.Timestamp) or 0)
		end)
		local tableRoot, _ = Components.Table(columns, normalized, nil, { filter = true, pageSize = 100, emptyText = "Keine Protokolleinträge vorhanden." })
		tableRoot.Parent = body
	end

	local function loadTab(tab: string)
		if destroyed or loading then
			return
		end
		loading = true
		loadToken += 1
		local token = loadToken
		setStatus(ctx, string.format("%s-Protokolle werden geladen …", tab))
		body:ClearAllChildren()
		Components.Spinner("Protokolle werden geladen …").Parent = body
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetLogs", { kind = tab, limit = 200 })
			if destroyed or token ~= loadToken then
				return
			end
			loading = false
			if not ok then
				local message = tostring(data or "Protokolle konnten nicht geladen werden.")
				body:ClearAllChildren()
				Components.ErrorState(message, function()
					loadTab(tab)
				end).Parent = body
				notify(ctx, "error", "Protokolle", message)
				return
			end
			local rows = toArray(data)
			mountTable(rows)
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("%s-Protokolle geladen: %d Einträge.", tab, #rows))
		end)
	end

	local tabsBar, selectTab = Components.Tabs({ "Admin", "Security", "System" }, function(name)
		currentTab = name
		loadTab(name)
	end)
	tabsBar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 64)
	tabsBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
	tabsBar.Parent = root

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		loadTab(currentTab)
	end)

	local api = {}
	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		loadTab(currentTab)
	end
	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end

--!nonstrict
-- Moderation: Bans, Warnungen, Mutes und History.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local Page = {}

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		return family ~= nil and perms[family .. ".*"] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function callCommand(ctx: any, text: string): any
	if type(ctx.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx:Command(text)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Command(text)
	end
	return { success = false, message = "Command ist nicht verfügbar." }
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function escapeArg(ctx: any, value: any): string
	if type(ctx.Escape) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Escape(value)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "string" then
			return result
		end
	end
	local text = string.gsub(tostring(value or ""), "[\r\n]", " ")
	text = string.gsub(text, "\\", "\\\\")
	text = string.gsub(text, '"', '\\"')
	return '"' .. text .. '"'
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local t = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d.%02d.%04d %02d:%02d", t.day or 0, t.month or 0, t.year or 0, t.hour or 0, t.min or 0)
end

local function formatExpiry(expiresAt: any): string
	if expiresAt == nil then
		return "Permanent"
	end
	if type(expiresAt) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	return formatTime(expiresAt)
end

local function toRows(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) == "table" then
		if type(data.records) == "table" then
			return data.records
		end
		if type(data.items) == "table" then
			return data.items
		end
		if type(data.list) == "table" then
			return data.list
		end
		if #data > 0 then
			return data
		end
	end
	return {}
end

local function normalizeRows(rows: { any }): { any }
	local normalized = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(rows) do
		if type(item) == "table" then
			table.insert(normalized, item)
		end
	end
	table.sort(normalized, function(a, b)
		local ta = tonumber(a.Timestamp) or 0
		local tb = tonumber(b.Timestamp) or 0
		return ta > tb
	end)
	return normalized
end

function Page.new(parentFrame: Frame, ctx: any)
	local maid = Maid.new()

		elseif tab == "Warnings" then
			return {

				{ key = "ModeratorId", title = "Moderator", width = 1 },

					return formatTime(v)
				end },
				{ key = "Source", title = "Quelle", width = 0.8 },
			}
		elseif tab == "Mutes" then
			return {
				{ key = "UserId", title = "UserId", width = 1 },
				{ key = "Reason", title = "Grund", width = 2.4 },
				{ key = "ModeratorId", title = "Moderator", width = 1 },
				{ key = "Timestamp", title = "Zeit", width = 1.4, format = function(v)
					return formatTime(v)
				end },
				{ key = "ExpiresAt", title = "Läuft ab", width = 1.4, format = function(v)
					return formatExpiry(v)
				end },
				{ key = "Source", title = "Quelle", width = 0.8 },
			}
		end
		return {
			{ key = "UserId", title = "UserId", width = 0.9 },
			{ key = "Type", title = "Typ", width = 0.9 },
			{ key = "Reason", title = "Grund", width = 2.6 },
			{ key = "ModeratorId", title = "Moderator", width = 0.9 },
			{ key = "Timestamp", title = "Zeit", width = 1.4, format = function(v)
				return formatTime(v)
			end },
			{ key = "Source", title = "Quelle", width = 0.8 },
		}
	end

	local function mountTable(tab: string, rows: { any })
		body:ClearAllChildren()
		selectedRecord = nil
		local cols = columnsForTab(tab)
		local tableRoot = Components.Table(cols, rows, function(item)
			selectedRecord = item
		end, { filter = true, pageSize = 100, emptyText = "Keine Einträge vorhanden." })
		tableRoot.Parent = body
	end

	loadTab = function(tab: string)
		if destroyed then
			return

		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetModeration", { kind = tab })

				return
			end
			loading = false
			if not ok then
				local message = tostring(data or "Moderationsdaten konnten nicht geladen werden.")
				body:ClearAllChildren()
				local err = Components.ErrorState(message, function()
					loadTab(tab)
				end)
				err.Parent = body
				notify(ctx, "error", "Moderation", message)
				setStatus(ctx, "Moderationsdaten konnten nicht geladen werden.")

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(function()

					notify(ctx, "error", "Unban", message)
					setStatus(ctx, "Unban fehlgeschlagen.")
				end
			end)

--!nonstrict
-- Übersicht: Serverstatus, Live-Aktivität und letzte Erkennungen.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Util)

local Page = {}

local ACTIVITY_LIMIT = 200
local DETECTION_LIMIT = 200
local REFRESH_SECONDS = 30

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	if type(ctx.Has) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Has(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		if family and (perms[family .. ".*"] == true) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function onPush(ctx: any, channel: string, fn: (any) -> ())
	if type(ctx.OnPush) == "function" then
		return ctx:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.OnPush) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:OnPush(channel, fn)
	end
	return { Disconnect = function() end }
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local localTime = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(localTime) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", localTime.hour or 0, localTime.min or 0, localTime.sec or 0)
end

local function trimList(list: { any }, limit: number)
	while #list > limit do
		table.remove(list)
	end
end

local function severityText(severity: any): string
	local value = tostring(severity or "Information")
	return value
end

local function detectionMessage(item: any): string
	if type(item) ~= "table" then
		return "Erkennung empfangen"
	end
	local userId = tostring(item.UserId or "?")
	local category = tostring(item.Category or "Unbekannt")
	local severity = severityText(item.Severity)
	local confidence = type(item.Confidence) == "number" and math.floor(item.Confidence * 100) or 0
	return string.format("[%s] %s · Spieler %s · %d%%", severity, category, userId, confidence)
end

local function activityMessage(item: any): string
	if type(item) ~= "table" then
		return "Aktivität"
	end
	local kind = tostring(item.Kind or "Aktivität")
	local message = tostring(item.Message or "")
	if message == "" then
		message = kind
	end
	return string.format("[%s] %s", kind, message)
end

function Page.new(parentFrame: Frame, ctx: any)
	local maid = Maid.new()
	local Components = ctx.Components
	local Theme = ctx.Theme
	local visible = false
	local destroyed = false
	local loading = false
	local refreshToken = 0

	local activities: { any } = {}
	local detections: { any } = {}

	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "OverviewPage"
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.Parent = parentFrame

	local title = Components.Label("Übersicht", Theme.TextSize.Title, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
	title.Parent = root

	local subtitle = Components.Label("Serverstatus, Live-Aktivität und letzte Erkennungen.", Theme.TextSize.Body, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
	subtitle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 30)
	subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	subtitle.Parent = root

	local refreshButton = Components.Button("Aktualisieren", "secondary")
	refreshButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	refreshButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	refreshButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(128, 34)
	refreshButton.Parent = root

	local statsRow = Components.Frame("Stats", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 96), Color3.new())
	statsRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	statsRow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 64)
	statsRow.Parent = root
	local statsLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	statsLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	statsLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 12)
	statsLayout.Parent = statsRow

	local function makeStat(name: string, value: string, color: Color3?)
		local card, valueLabel = Components.StatTile(name, value, color)
		card.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -9, 1, 0)
		card.Parent = statsRow
		return valueLabel
	end

	local playersValue = makeStat("Spieler", "-", Theme.Colors.Accent)
	local uptimeValue = makeStat("Uptime", "-", Theme.Colors.Text)
	local detectionsValue = makeStat("Erkennungen (1h)", "-", Theme.Colors.Warning)
	local moderatorsValue = makeStat("Moderatoren online", "-", Theme.Colors.Success)

	local content = Components.Frame("Content", UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -176), Color3.new())
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 176)
	content.Parent = root

	local leftCard = Components.Card("Live-Aktivität")
	leftCard.Size = UDim2.new(0.58, -8, 1, 0)
	leftCard.Parent = content

	local rightCard = Components.Card("Letzte Erkennungen")
	rightCard.Position = UDim2.new(0.58, 8, 0, 0)
	rightCard.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, -8, 1, 0)
	rightCard.Parent = content

	local leftBody = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -56), Color3.new())
	leftBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	leftBody.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 44)
	leftBody.Parent = leftCard

	local rightBody = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, -56), Color3.new())
	rightBody.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	rightBody.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 44)
	rightBody.Parent = rightCard

	local function setBodyState(body: Frame, state: string, message: string?)
		body:ClearAllChildren()
		if state == "loading" then
			Components.Spinner(message or "Wird geladen …").Parent = body
		elseif state == "error" then
			Components.ErrorState(message or "Daten konnten nicht geladen werden.", function()
				-- wird unten ersetzt
			end).Parent = body
		elseif state == "empty" then
			Components.EmptyState(message or "Keine Daten vorhanden.").Parent = body
		end
	end

	local function renderActivity()
		leftBody:ClearAllChildren()
		if #activities == 0 then
			Components.EmptyState("Noch keine Live-Aktivität empfangen.").Parent = leftBody
			return
		end
		local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		list.BorderSizePixel = 0
		list.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		list.ScrollBarThickness = 5
		list.Parent = leftBody
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
		layout.Parent = list
		for index, item in ipairs(activities) do
			local row = Components.Frame("Activity" .. index, UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 30), Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised)
			Theme.corner(Theme.Radius.Small).Parent = row
			row.Parent = list
			local text = Components.Label(activityMessage(item), Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Text)
			text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
			text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0)
			text.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			text.Parent = row
			local timeLabel = Components.Label(formatTime(item.Timestamp), Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
			timeLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
			timeLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0)
			timeLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 30)
			timeLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
			timeLabel.Parent = row
		end
	end

	local function renderDetections()
		rightBody:ClearAllChildren()
		if #detections == 0 then
			Components.EmptyState("Noch keine Erkennungen empfangen.").Parent = rightBody
			return
		end
		local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
		list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		list.BorderSizePixel = 0
		list.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		list.ScrollBarThickness = 5
		list.Parent = rightBody
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
		layout.Parent = list
		for index, item in ipairs(detections) do
			local row = Components.Frame("Detection" .. index, UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 34), Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised)
			Theme.corner(Theme.Radius.Small).Parent = row
			row.Parent = list
			local msg = detectionMessage(item)
			local text = Components.Label(msg, Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Text)
			text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
			text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 1, 0)
			text.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
			text.Parent = row
			local badge = Components.Badge(severityText(item.Severity), severityText(item.Severity))
			badge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			badge.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0)
			badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 22)
			badge.TextSize = 11
			badge.Parent = row
		end
	end

	local loadOverview

	local function setError(body: Frame, message: string)
		body:ClearAllChildren()
		local err = Components.ErrorState(message, function()
			loadOverview()
		end)
		err.Parent = body
	end

	loadOverview = function()
		if destroyed or loading then
			return
		end
		loading = true
		refreshToken += 1
		local token = refreshToken
		setBodyState(leftBody, "loading", "Übersicht wird geladen …")
		setBodyState(rightBody, "loading", "Erkennungen werden geladen …")
		if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				ctx:SetStatus("Übersicht wird geladen …")
			end)
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetOverview")
			if destroyed or token ~= refreshToken then
				return
			end
			loading = false
			if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
				local message = tostring(data or "Übersicht konnte nicht geladen werden.")
				playersValue.Text = "-"
				uptimeValue.Text = "-"
				detectionsValue.Text = "-"
				moderatorsValue.Text = "-"
				setError(leftBody, message)
				setError(rightBody, message)
				notify(ctx, "error", "Übersicht", message)
				if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
					pcall(function()
						ctx:SetStatus("Übersicht konnte nicht geladen werden.")
					end)
				end
				return
			end

			local server = type(data.server) == "table" and data.server or {}
			local players = tonumber(server.players) or 0
			local maxPlayers = tonumber(server.maxPlayers) or 0
			playersValue.Text = maxPlayers > 0 and string.format("%d/%d", players, maxPlayers) or tostring(players)
			uptimeValue.Text = type(server.uptime) == "number" and Util.formatDuration(server.uptime) or "-"
			detectionsValue.Text = tostring(tonumber(data.detectionsLastHour) or 0)
			local moderators = type(data.moderatorsOnline) == "table" and data.moderatorsOnline or {}
			moderatorsValue.Text = tostring(#moderators)

			local recent = type(data.recentActivity) == "table" and data.recentActivity or {}
			table.clear(activities)
			for _, item in ipairs(recent) do
				if type(item) == "table" then
					table.insert(activities, item)
				end
			end
			trimList(activities, ACTIVITY_LIMIT)
			renderActivity()
			renderDetections()

			if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
				pcall(function()
					ctx:SetStatus("Übersicht aktualisiert.")
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		loadOverview()
	end)

	maid:Give(onPush(ctx, "Activity", function(payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		table.insert(activities, 1, payload)
		trimList(activities, ACTIVITY_LIMIT)
		if visible then
			renderActivity()
		end
	end))

	maid:Give(onPush(ctx, "Detection", function(payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		table.insert(detections, 1, payload)
		trimList(detections, DETECTION_LIMIT)
		if visible then
			renderDetections()
		end
	end))

	local refreshRunning = true
	maid:Give(function()
		refreshRunning = false
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while refreshRunning and not destroyed do
			task.wait(REFRESH_SECONDS)
			if refreshRunning and not destroyed and visible then
				loadOverview()
			end
		end
	end)

	local api = {}

	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		if #activities == 0 and #detections == 0 then
			loadOverview()
		else
			renderActivity()
			renderDetections()
		end
	end

	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		refreshRunning = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end

	return api
end

return Page

--!nonstrict
-- Berechtigungen: Rollen, Matrix, Zuweisungen und Command-basierte Änderungen.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)

local Page = {}

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		return family ~= nil and perms[family .. ".*"] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function callCommand(ctx: any, text: string): any
	if type(ctx.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx:Command(text)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Command(text)
	end
	return { success = false, message = "Command ist nicht verfügbar." }
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function escapeArg(ctx: any, value: any): string
	if type(ctx.Escape) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Escape(value)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "string" then
			return result
		end
	end
	local text = string.gsub(tostring(value or ""), "[\r\n]", " ")
	text = string.gsub(text, "\\", "\\\\")
	text = string.gsub(text, '"', '\\"')
	return '"' .. text .. '"'
end

local KNOWN_PERMISSIONS = {
	"Player.Kick", "Player.Ban", "Player.Teleport", "Player.Manage",
	"Moderation.Warn", "Moderation.Mute", "Moderation.ViewHistory",
	"AntiCheat.ViewDetections", "AntiCheat.Manage",
	"Admin.ManageRanks", "Admin.ManagePermissions", "Admin.Panel",
	"Server.Manage", "Server.Announce", "Server.Shutdown",
	"Logs.View", "Logs.Manage",
}

local function toArray(data: any): { any }
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	if type(data.roles) == "table" then
		return data.roles
	end
	if #data > 0 then
		return data
	end
	return {}
end

local function roleHasPermission(role: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(role) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	local perms = role.Permissions or role.permissions
	if type(perms) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(perms) do
		if p == "*" or p == permission then
			return true
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		if family and p == family .. ".*" then
			return true
		end
	end
	local inherits = role.Inherits or role.inherits
	-- Inheritance resolution is server-side; we display what's in data.
	-- If server provides resolved, use it.
	local resolved = role.ResolvedPermissions or role.resolvedPermissions
	if type(resolved) == "table" then
		for _, p in ipairs(resolved) do
			if p == "*" or p == permission then
				return true
			end
			local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
			if family and p == family .. ".*" then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

		makeActionButton("Permission gewähren (grantpermission)", "Admin.ManagePermissions", "secondary", function()
			local uid = numericUserId()
			local perm = string.gsub(permInput.Text, "^%s+", "")
			perm = string.gsub(perm, "%s+$", "")
			if not uid or perm == "" then return nil end
			return string.format("grantpermission %d %s", uid, escapeArg(ctx, perm))
		end)

		makeActionButton("Permission entziehen (revokepermission)", "Admin.ManagePermissions", "danger", function()
			local uid = numericUserId()
			local perm = string.gsub(permInput.Text, "^%s+", "")
			perm = string.gsub(perm, "%s+$", "")
			if not uid or perm == "" then return nil end
			return string.format("revokepermission %d %s", uid, escapeArg(ctx, perm))
		end)

		local hint = Components.Label("Änderungen werden serverseitig über Commands ausgeführt und geprüft.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
		hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
		hint.TextWrapped = true
		hint.Parent = scroll
	end

	loadData = function()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		setStatus(ctx, "Berechtigungen werden geladen …")
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetRoles")
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
				local message = tostring(data or "Berechtigungen konnten nicht geladen werden.")
				notify(ctx, "error", "Berechtigungen", message)
				leftBody:ClearAllChildren()
				Components.ErrorState(message, loadData).Parent = leftBody
				rightBody:ClearAllChildren()
				Components.EmptyState("Keine Daten.").Parent = rightBody
				return
			end
			table.clear(roles)
			for _, role in ipairs(toArray(data)) do
				if type(role) == "table" then
					table.insert(roles, role)
				end
			end
			table.clear(assignments)
			local as = data.assignments or data.Assignments
			if type(as) == "table" then
				for _, entry in ipairs(as) do
					if type(entry) == "table" then
						table.insert(assignments, entry)
					end
				end
			end
			renderMatrix()
			renderAssignmentsAndActions()
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("%d Rollen geladen.", #roles))
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(loadData)

	local api = {}
	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		loadData()
	end
	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end
	return api
end

return Page

--!nonstrict
-- Spielerverwaltung: Liste, Profil, Moderations- und Teleport-Aktionen.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Util)

local Page = {}

local REFRESH_SECONDS = 20

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	if type(ctx.Has) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Has(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		return family ~= nil and perms[family .. ".*"] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function callCommand(ctx: any, text: string): any
	if type(ctx.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx:Command(text)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Command) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Command(text)
	end
	return { success = false, message = "Command ist nicht verfügbar." }
end

local function notify(ctx: any, kind: string, title: string, message: string)
	if type(ctx.Notify) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:Notify(kind, title, message)
		end)
	end
end

local function setStatus(ctx: any, text: string)
	if type(ctx.SetStatus) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			ctx:SetStatus(text)
		end)
	end
end

local function escapeArg(ctx: any, value: any): string
	if type(ctx.Escape) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:Escape(value)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "string" then
			return result
		end
	end
	local text = string.gsub(tostring(value or ""), "[\r\n]", " ")
	text = string.gsub(text, "\\", "\\\\")
	text = string.gsub(text, '"', '\\"')
	return '"' .. text .. '"'
end

local function buildCommand(ctx: any, name: string, userId: number, reason: string?): string
	if type(ctx.BuildCommand) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:BuildCommand(name, userId, reason)
		end)
		if ok and type(result) == "string" and result ~= "" then
			return result
		end
	end
	local text = string.format("%s %d", name, userId)
	if type(reason) == "string" and reason ~= "" then
		text ..= " " .. escapeArg(ctx, reason)
	end
	return text
end

local function formatTime(timestamp: any): string
	if type(timestamp) ~= "number" then
		return "-"
	end
	local t = os.date("*t", timestamp)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return "-"
	end
	return string.format("%02d.%02d.%04d %02d:%02d", t.day or 0, t.month or 0, t.year or 0, t.hour or 0, t.min or 0)
end

local function safeNumber(value: any, default: number): number
	local n = tonumber(value)
	if n == nil then
		return default
	end
	return n
end

local function asString(value: any, fallback: string?): string
	if value == nil then
		return fallback or "-"
	end
	local text = tostring(value)
	if text == "" then
		return fallback or "-"
	end
	return text
end

	local function runAction(commandName: string, permission: string, promptTitle: string, promptText: string, reasonRequired: boolean, extraBuilder: ((number, string) -> string?)?)

	local function applySelectedAfterRefresh()
		if not selectedUserId then
			renderDetailEmpty("Wähle einen Spieler aus, um Details zu sehen.")
			return
		end
		for _, item in ipairs(playersList) do
			if tonumber(item.userId) == selectedUserId then
				selectedPlayer = item
				loadProfile(selectedUserId)
				return
			end
		end
		selectedPlayer = nil
		renderDetailEmpty("Der ausgewählte Spieler ist nicht mehr online.")
	end

	-- Hook table selection to load profile
	local originalOnSelect = nil
	-- Recreate table with proper onSelect
	tableRoot:Destroy()
	tableRoot, renderTable, tableController = Components.Table(columns, {}, function(item)
		if type(item) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		selectedPlayer = item
		selectedUserId = tonumber(item.userId)
		if selectedUserId then
			loadProfile(selectedUserId)
		end
	end, { filter = true, pageSize = 100, emptyText = "Keine Spieler gefunden." })
	tableRoot.Parent = leftBody

	renderPlayers = function()
		renderTable(playersList)
	end

	local function loadPlayers()
		if destroyed or loading then
			return
		end
		loading = true
		setStatus(ctx, "Spielerliste wird geladen …")
		leftBody.Visible = true
		task.spawn(function()
			local ok, data = callRequest(ctx, "GetPlayers")
			if destroyed then
				return
			end
			loading = false
			if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
				local message = tostring(data or "Spielerliste konnte nicht geladen werden.")
				notify(ctx, "error", "Spieler", message)
				setStatus(ctx, "Spielerliste konnte nicht geladen werden.")
				leftBody:ClearAllChildren()
				local err = Components.ErrorState(message, function()
					loadPlayers()
				end)
				err.Parent = leftBody
				return
			end

			local list = data
			if type(data.players) == "table" then
				list = data.players
			elseif type(data.list) == "table" then
				list = data.list
			end
			table.clear(playersList)
			if type(list) == "table" then
				for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
					if type(entry) == "table" then
						local session = type(entry.session) == "table" and entry.session or entry
						local userId = tonumber(entry.userId or session.userId or session.UserId)
						local name = asString(entry.name or session.name or session.Name or entry.displayName, "Unbekannt")
						local rank = asString(entry.rank or session.rank or session.Rank, "Player")
						local risk = safeNumber(entry.riskScore or entry.risk or session.riskScore, 0)
						local ping = tonumber(entry.ping or session.ping)
						if userId then
							table.insert(playersList, {
								userId = userId,
								name = name,
								rank = rank,
								risk = math.floor(risk),
								ping = ping,
								raw = entry,
							})
						end
					end
				end
			end
			table.sort(playersList, function(a, b)
				return string.lower(tostring(a.name)) < string.lower(tostring(b.name))
			end)
			renderTable(playersList)
			setStatus(ctx, string.format("%d Spieler geladen.", #playersList))
			applySelectedAfterRefresh()
		end)
	end

	refreshButton.Activated:Connect(loadPlayers)

	renderDetailEmpty("Wähle einen Spieler aus, um Details zu sehen.")

	local refreshRunning = true
	maid:Give(function()
		refreshRunning = false
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while refreshRunning and not destroyed do
			task.wait(REFRESH_SECONDS)
			if refreshRunning and not destroyed and visible then
				loadPlayers()
			end
		end
	end)

	local api = {}
	function api:OnShow()
		visible = true
		if #playersList == 0 then
			loadPlayers()
		end
	end
	function api:Destroy()
		if destroyed then
			return
		end
		destroyed = true
		visible = false
		refreshRunning = false
		maid:Clean()
		root:Destroy()
	end
	return api
end

return Page

-- Einstellungen: Framework-/Backend-Status und erlaubte Konfigurationsänderungen.

local Page = {}

local function has(ctx: any, permission: string): boolean
	if type(ctx.HasPermission) == "function" then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return ctx:HasPermission(permission)
		end)
		if ok then
			return result == true
		end
	end
	local perms = ctx.Permissions
	if type(perms) == "table" then
		if perms["*"] == true or perms[permission] == true then
			return true
		end
		for _, value in pairs(perms) do
			if value == permission or value == "*" then
				return true
			end
		end
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		return family ~= nil and perms[family .. ".*"] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function callRequest(ctx: any, action: string, args: any?): (boolean, any)
	if type(ctx.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx:Request(action, args)
	end
	if ctx.Client and type(ctx.Client.Request) == "function" then
		return ctx.Client:Request(action, args)
	end
	return false, "Request ist nicht verfügbar."
end

	end
	return "-"

	if value == nil then
		return fallback
	end
	local text = tostring(value)
	if text == "" then
		return fallback
	end
	return text

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft/Client/ChatControl.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Schaltet die Chat-Oberfläche des lokalen Spielers ab, solange er gemutet ist, und stellt danach
-- exakt den vorherigen Zustand wieder her. Hatte das Spiel den Chat selbst deaktiviert, bleibt er aus.
-- Rein kosmetisch: Die Zustellung von Nachrichten blockiert der Server (MuteService), ein
-- manipulierter Client gewinnt durch erneutes Einschalten nichts.
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local ChatControl = {}
ChatControl.__index = ChatControl

local CORE_GUI_RETRIES = 10 -- SetCoreGuiEnabled schlägt fehl, solange die CoreScripts noch laden
local CORE_GUI_RETRY_DELAY = 0.5

local function isLegacyChat(): boolean
	local ok, version = pcall(function()
		return TextChatService.ChatVersion
	end)
	return ok and version == Enum.ChatVersion.LegacyChatService
end

local function setCoreChat(enabled: boolean)
	for _ = 1, CORE_GUI_RETRIES do
		if pcall(StarterGui.SetCoreGuiEnabled, StarterGui, Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat, enabled) then
			return
		end
		task.wait(CORE_GUI_RETRY_DELAY)
	end
end

function ChatControl.new()
	return setmetatable({ _muted = false, _saved = nil }, ChatControl)
end

function ChatControl:SetMuted(muted: boolean)
	if muted == self._muted then
		return
	end
	self._muted = muted

	if muted then
		if isLegacyChat() then
			self._saved = { core = StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Chat) }
			task.spawn(setCoreChat, false)
		else
			self._saved = {
				window = TextChatService.ChatWindowConfiguration.Enabled,
				input = TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.Enabled,
			}
			TextChatService.ChatWindowConfiguration.Enabled = false
			TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.Enabled = false
		end
		return
	end

	local saved = self._saved
	self._saved = nil
	if not saved then
		return
	end
	if saved.core ~= nil then
		task.spawn(setCoreChat, saved.core)
	else
		TextChatService.ChatWindowConfiguration.Enabled = saved.window
		TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.Enabled = saved.input
	end
end

function ChatControl:IsMuted(): boolean
	return self._muted
end

function ChatControl:Destroy()
	self:SetMuted(false)
end

return ChatControl

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft/Client/CommandClient.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Clientseitiger Wrapper um die Headcraft-Remotes. Alle Eingaben werden begrenzt,
-- bevor sie den Server erreichen; der Server bleibt trotzdem autoritativ.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Signal = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Signal)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Util)
local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)

local CommandClient = {}
CommandClient.__index = CommandClient

local MAX_STRING = 500
local MAX_ENTRIES = 50
local MAX_DEPTH = 3
local DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 8
local MAX_PUSH_LISTENERS = 32
local REPORT_KINDS = {
	UiError = true,
	InputAnomaly = true,
	DetectionSeen = true,
}

local function finiteNumber(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
end

-- Kopiert nur wertebasierte, flache genug Strukturen. Zyklen werden abgewiesen.
local function sanitize(value: any, depth: number, seen: { [any]: boolean }): (boolean, any?, string?)
	if depth > MAX_DEPTH then
		return false, nil, "Daten sind zu tief verschachtelt."
	end
	if type(value) == "string" then
		if #value > MAX_STRING then
			return false, nil, "String ist zu lang."
		end
		return true, value
	elseif type(value) == "number" then
		if not finiteNumber(value) then
			return false, nil, "Ungültige Zahl."
		end
		return true, value
	elseif type(value) == "boolean" then
		return true, value
	elseif type(value) == "table" then
		if seen[value] then
			return false, nil, "Zyklische Daten sind nicht erlaubt."
		end
		seen[value] = true
		local count = 0
		local out = {}
		for key, child in pairs(value) do
			if type(key) ~= "string" and type(key) ~= "number" then
				seen[value] = nil
				return false, nil, "Ungültiger Tabellenschlüssel."
			end
			if finiteNumber(key) and (key < -1e12 or key > 1e12) then
				seen[value] = nil
				return false, nil, "Ungültiger Tabellenschlüssel."
			end
			count += 1
			if count > MAX_ENTRIES then
				seen[value] = nil
				return false, nil, "Tabelle ist zu groß."
			end
			local ok, cleaned, err = sanitize(child, depth + 1, seen)
			if not ok then
				seen[value] = nil
				return false, nil, err
			end
			out[key] = cleaned
		end
		seen[value] = nil
		return true, out
	end
	return false, nil, "Ungültiger Datentyp."
end

local function copyBounded(value: any, maxEntries: number, maxString: number, maxDepth: number): any?
	if type(value) ~= "table" or maxDepth <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local out = {}
	local count = 0
	for key, child in pairs(value) do
		if type(key) ~= "string" and type(key) ~= "number" then
			return nil
		end
		count += 1
		if count > maxEntries then
			return nil
		end
		if type(child) == "string" then
			if #child > maxString then
				return nil
			end
			out[key] = child
		elseif type(child) == "number" or type(child) == "boolean" then
			if not finiteNumber(child) and type(child) == "number" then
				return nil
			end
			out[key] = child
		elseif type(child) == "table" then
			local nested = copyBounded(child, maxEntries, maxString, maxDepth - 1)
			if nested == nil then
				return nil
			end
			out[key] = nested
		else
			return nil
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- RemoteFunctions können ohne Antwort hängen bleiben; der Aufruf wird daher
-- mit einem festen Zeitfenster abgesichert und nie mehrfach zurückgegeben.
local function invoke(remote: RemoteFunction, timeout: number, ...): (boolean, any?)
	local arguments = table.pack(...)
	local done = Signal.new()
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return remote:InvokeServer(table.unpack(arguments, 1, arguments.n))
		end)
		done:Fire(ok, result)
	end)
	local timer = task.delay(timeout, function()
		done:Fire(false, "Zeitüberschreitung beim Serveraufruf.")
	end)
	local ok, result = done:Wait()
	task.cancel(timer)
	done:DisconnectAll()
	return ok, result
end

function CommandClient.WaitForRemotes(timeout: number?, attempts: number?): Folder?
	local waitTime = timeout or 4
	local tries = math.clamp(attempts or 3, 1, 8)
	for _ = 1, tries do
		local headcraft = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Headcraft")
		if headcraft then
			local existingRemotes = headcraft:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
			if existingRemotes and existingRemotes:IsA("Folder")
				and existingRemotes:FindFirstChild(Constants.RemoteNames.Request)
				and existingRemotes:FindFirstChild(Constants.RemoteNames.Push) then
				return existingRemotes
			end
		end
		local ok, folder = pcall(function()
			local headcraftFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Headcraft", waitTime)
			return headcraftFolder:WaitForChild("Remotes", waitTime)
		end)
		if ok and folder and folder:IsA("Folder") then
			return folder
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function CommandClient.new(remotes: Folder): CommandClient?
	if not remotes or not remotes:IsA("Folder") then
		return nil
	end

	local names = Constants.RemoteNames
	local found = {}
	for _, name in pairs(names) do
		local remote = remotes:FindFirstChild(name)
		if not remote then
			local ok, waited = pcall(function()
				return remotes:WaitForChild(name, 3)
			end)
			remote = ok and waited or nil
		end
		if not remote then
			return nil
		end
		found[name] = remote
	end

	local self = setmetatable({
		_remotes = remotes,
		_request = found[names.Request],
		_command = found[names.Command],
		_autocomplete = found[names.Autocomplete],
		_push = found[names.Push],
		_clientReport = found[names.ClientReport],
		_channels = {},
		_listenerCounts = {},
		_lastReport = -1e9,
	}, CommandClient)

	self._pushConnection = self._push.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(channel: any, payload: any)
		if type(channel) ~= "string" or #channel == 0 or #channel > 64 then
			return
		end
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		local signal = self._channels[channel]
		if signal then
			signal:Fire(payload)
		end
	end)

	return self
end

function CommandClient:Request(action: string, args: table?, timeout: number?): (boolean, any?)
	if type(action) ~= "string" or #action == 0 or #action > 64 then
		return false, "Ungültige Request-Aktion."
	end
	local payload = {}
	if args ~= nil then
		local ok, cleaned, err = sanitize(args, 1, {})
		if not ok then
			return false, err or "Ungültige Request-Argumente."
		end
		payload = cleaned :: table
	end

	local ok, response = invoke(self._request, timeout or DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, action, payload)
	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(response)
	end
	if type(response) ~= "table" or type(response.ok) ~= "boolean" then
		return false, "Ungültige Antwort vom Server."
	end
	if response.ok then
		return true, response.data
	end
	return false, tostring(response.error or "Der Server hat die Anfrage abgelehnt.")
end

function CommandClient:Command(text: string): any
	if type(text) ~= "string" or #text == 0 or #text > MAX_STRING then
		return { success = false, message = "Ungültiger Command-Text." }
	end
	local ok, response = invoke(self._command, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, text)
	if not ok then
		return { success = false, message = tostring(response) }
	end
	if type(response) ~= "table" or type(response.success) ~= "boolean" then
		return { success = false, message = "Ungültige Command-Antwort vom Server." }
	end
	return {
		success = response.success,
		message = tostring(response.message or ""),
		data = response.data,
	}
end

function CommandClient:Autocomplete(text: string): { suggestions: { any } }
	if type(text) ~= "string" or #text > MAX_STRING then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	local ok, response = invoke(self._autocomplete, 4, text)
	if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" or type(response.suggestions) ~= "table" then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	local suggestions = {}
	for _, entry in pairs(response.suggestions) do
		if #suggestions >= MAX_ENTRIES then
			break
		end
		if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.text) == "string" and #entry.text <= MAX_STRING then
			table.insert(suggestions, {
				text = entry.text,
				display = type(entry.display) == "string" and Util.truncate(entry.display, MAX_STRING) or entry.text,
				description = type(entry.description) == "string" and Util.truncate(entry.description, MAX_STRING) or nil,
			})
		end
	end
	return { suggestions = suggestions }
end

function CommandClient:OnPush(channel: string, fn: (payload: table) -> ()): any
	if type(channel) ~= "string" or #channel == 0 or #channel > 64 or type(fn) ~= "function" then
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end
	if (self._listenerCounts[channel] or 0) >= MAX_PUSH_LISTENERS then
		return { Disconnect = function() end }
	end
	local signal = self._channels[channel]
	if not signal then
		signal = Signal.new()
		self._channels[channel] = signal
	end
	self._listenerCounts[channel] = (self._listenerCounts[channel] or 0) + 1
	local connection = signal:Connect(function(payload: table)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn, payload)
		if not ok then
			warn("[Headcraft] Push-Listener fehlgeschlagen:", tostring(err))
		end
	end)
	local count = self._listenerCounts[channel]
	return {
		Disconnect = function()
			if count ~= self._listenerCounts[channel] then
				return
			end
			connection:Disconnect()
			self._listenerCounts[channel] = math.max(0, (self._listenerCounts[channel] or 1) - 1)
		end,
	}
end

-- Nur Indizien, nie automatische Sanktionen. Maximal ein Report pro 30 Sekunden.
function CommandClient:Report(kind: string, data: table?): boolean
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or not REPORT_KINDS[kind] then
		return false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - self._lastReport < 30 then
		return false
	end
	local payload = data and copyBounded(data, 8, 120, 2) or {}
	if payload == nil then
		return false
	end
	self._lastReport = now
	pcall(function()
		self._clientReport:FireServer(kind, payload)
	end)
	return true
end

function CommandClient:Destroy()
	if self._pushConnection then
		self._pushConnection:Disconnect()
		self._pushConnection = nil
	end
	for _, signal in pairs(self._channels) do
		signal:DisconnectAll()
	end
	table.clear(self._channels)
	table.clear(self._listenerCounts)
end

return CommandClient

```

local function richEscape(text: string): string
	return (string.gsub(text, "[<>&\"']", {
		["<"] = "&lt;", [">"] = "&gt;", ["&"] = "&amp;", ['"'] = "&quot;", ["'"] = "&apos;",
	}))
end

local function colorHex(color: Color3): string
	return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(color.R * 255), math.floor(color.G * 255), math.floor(color.B * 255))
end

-- Zerlegt die Eingabe wie der Server-Parser grob in Tokens (Anführungszeichen halten Leerzeichen zusammen).
local function tokenize(text: string): ({ string }, boolean)
	local tokens = {}
	local current, inQuote = "", false
	for _, char in utf8.codes(text) do
		local c = utf8.char(char)
		if c == '"' then
			inQuote = not inQuote
		elseif string.match(c, "%s") and not inQuote then
			if current ~= "" then
				table.insert(tokens, current)
				current = ""
			end
		else
			current ..= c
		end
	end
	if current ~= "" then
		table.insert(tokens, current)
	end
	local endsWithSpace = string.match(text, "%s$") ~= nil and not inQuote
	return tokens, endsWithSpace
end

local function label(props)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.FontFace = props.Font or Theme.Font
	l.TextSize = props.TextSize or Theme.TextSize.Body
	l.TextColor3 = props.Color or Theme.Colors.Text
	l.TextXAlignment = props.AlignX or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
	l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	l.RichText = props.Rich == true
	l.Text = props.Text or ""
	l.Size = props.Size or UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	l.Position = props.Position or UDim2.new()
	l.Name = props.Name or "Label"
	return l
end

function Console.new(client, options)

		self._rows[index] = { button = row, display = name, description = description }
