function Console:_connect()
	local input = self._input

	self._maid:Give(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(object: InputObject, processed: boolean)
		if object.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			return
		end
		local key = object.KeyCode
		if key == self._toggleKey then
			-- F-Tasten tippen nichts in TextBoxen, daher auch bei fokussierter Eingabe erlaubt;
			-- in fremden Textfeldern (Chat etc.) aber nicht öffnen.
			if not self._open and processed and UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil then
				return
			end
			self:Toggle()
			return
		end
		if not self._open or not input:IsFocused() then
			return
		end
		if key == Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
			self:_accept()
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Up then
			self:_move(-1)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Down then
			self:_move(1)
		elseif key == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			self:SetOpen(false)
		end
	end))

	self._maid:Give(input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		-- Tab fügt in TextBoxen ein Tabulatorzeichen ein: entfernen und als "Vorschlag übernehmen" werten.
		if string.find(input.Text, "\t", 1, true) then
			self._ignoreTextChange = true
			input.Text = string.gsub(input.Text, "\t", "")
			self._ignoreTextChange = false
			self:_accept()
			return
		end
		if self._ignoreTextChange then
			return
		end
		self._historyIndex = 0
		self:_updateHint()
		self:_requestSuggestions()
	end))

	self._maid:Give(input.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed: boolean)
		if not self._open then
			return
		end
		if enterPressed then
			self:_execute()
			task.defer(function()
				if self._open then
					input:CaptureFocus()
				end
			end)
		elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Escape) then
			-- Escape nimmt Roblox den Fokus, bevor InputBegan feuert – daher hier schließen.
			self:SetOpen(false)
		end
	end))
end

function Console:SetPrefix(prefix: string?)
	if type(prefix) == "string" and prefix ~= "" then
		self._prefix = prefix
	end
end

function Console:IsOpen(): boolean
	return self._open
end

function Console:Toggle()
	self:SetOpen(not self._open)
end

function Console:SetOpen(open: boolean)
	if open == self._open then
		return
	end
	self._open = open
	self._gui.Enabled = open
	if open then
		if self._commands == nil then
			task.spawn(function()
				self:_loadCommands()
			end)
		end
		-- Erst im nächsten Frame fokussieren, sonst landet das F3-Ereignis selbst noch im Textfeld.
		task.defer(function()
			if self._open then
				self._input:CaptureFocus()
				self._input.CursorPosition = #self._input.Text + 1
			end
		end)
	else
		self._input:ReleaseFocus()
		self:_setSuggestions({})
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
	end
end

function Console:_loadCommands()
	local ok, data = self._client:Request("GetCommands")
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local list = type(data.commands) == "table" and data.commands or data
	local map = {}
	for _, command in ipairs(list) do
		if type(command) == "table" and type(command.Name) == "string" then
			map[string.lower(command.Name)] = command
			for _, alias in ipairs(type(command.Aliases) == "table" and command.Aliases or {}) do
				if type(alias) == "string" then
					map[string.lower(alias)] = command
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self._commands = map
	self:_updateHint()
end

-- Text ohne optionalen Präfix, damit Vorschläge sowohl mit als auch ohne ";" funktionieren.
function Console:_stripPrefix(text: string): (string, string)
	local leading = string.match(text, "^%s*") or ""
	local rest = string.sub(text, #leading + 1)
	if string.sub(rest, 1, #self._prefix) == self._prefix then
		return self._prefix, string.sub(rest, #self._prefix + 1)
	end
	return "", rest
end

function Console:_updateHint()
	local _, body = self:_stripPrefix(self._input.Text)
	local tokens, endsWithSpace = tokenize(body)
	local command = tokens[1] and self._commands and self._commands[string.lower(tokens[1])]
	if not command then
		self._hint.Visible = false
		return
	end
	local current = #tokens - 1 + (endsWithSpace and 1 or 0) -- 0 = noch im Command-Namen
	local parts = { "<b>" .. richEscape(command.Name) .. "</b>" }
	local activeDescription = command.Description
	for index, arg in ipairs(type(command.Args) == "table" and command.Args or {}) do
		local text = string.format(arg.Required and "&lt;%s: %s&gt;" or "[%s: %s]", richEscape(tostring(arg.Name)), richEscape(tostring(arg.Type)))
		if index == current or (arg.Rest and current > index) then
			text = string.format('<font color="%s">%s</font>', colorHex(Theme.Colors.Accent), text)
			if type(arg.Description) == "string" and arg.Description ~= "" then
				activeDescription = arg.Description
			end
		end
		table.insert(parts, text)
	end
	local description = type(activeDescription) == "string" and activeDescription ~= ""
		and ("  —  " .. richEscape(activeDescription)) or ""
	self._hint.Text = table.concat(parts, " ") .. description
	self._hint.Visible = true
end

function Console:_requestSuggestions()
	self._requestId += 1
	local requestId = self._requestId
	local text = self._input.Text
	local _, body = self:_stripPrefix(text)
	if string.gsub(body, "%s", "") == "" then
		self:_setSuggestions({})
		return
	end
	task.delay(AUTOCOMPLETE_DEBOUNCE, function()
		if requestId ~= self._requestId or not self._open then
			return
		end
		local response = self._client:Autocomplete(text)
		-- Nur die Antwort auf die neueste Eingabe anzeigen
		if requestId ~= self._requestId or not self._open then
			return
		end
		self:_setSuggestions(type(response) == "table" and type(response.suggestions) == "table" and response.suggestions or {})
	end)
end

function Console:_setSuggestions(suggestions)
	local valid = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(suggestions) do
		if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.text) == "string" and #valid < MAX_VISIBLE_SUGGESTIONS then
			table.insert(valid, entry)
		end
	end
	self._suggestions = valid
	self._selected = 1
	for index, row in ipairs(self._rows) do
		local entry = valid[index]
		row.button.Visible = entry ~= nil
		if entry then
			row.display.Text = tostring(entry.display or entry.text)
			row.description.Text = type(entry.description) == "string" and entry.description or ""
		end
	end
	self._list.Visible = #valid > 0
	self:_paintSelection()
end

function Console:_paintSelection()
	for index, row in ipairs(self._rows) do
		local active = index == self._selected and row.button.Visible
		row.button.BackgroundTransparency = active and 0 or 1
		row.button.BackgroundColor3 = active and Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised or Theme.Colors.Surface
		row.display.TextColor3 = active and Theme.Colors.Accent or Theme.Colors.Text
	end
end

function Console:_select(index: number)
	if self._suggestions[index] then
		self._selected = index
		self:_paintSelection()
	end
end

-- Pfeiltasten: mit Vorschlägen durch die Liste, sonst durch die eigene Command-History.
function Console:_move(direction: number)
	local count = #self._suggestions
	if count > 0 then
		self._selected = ((self._selected - 1 + direction) % count) + 1
		self:_paintSelection()
		return
	end
	if #self._history == 0 then
		return
	end
	-- History: Index 0 = aktuelle Eingabe, 1 = letzter Command, …
	self._historyIndex = math.clamp(self._historyIndex - direction, 0, #self._history)
	local text = self._historyIndex == 0 and "" or self._history[#self._history - self._historyIndex + 1]
	self._ignoreTextChange = true
	self._input.Text = text
	self._input.CursorPosition = #text + 1
	self._ignoreTextChange = false
	self:_updateHint()
end

-- Übernimmt den markierten Vorschlag. Der Server liefert den kompletten Command bis einschließlich
-- des vorgeschlagenen Arguments; ein Leerzeichen dahinter, damit direkt das nächste Argument folgt.
function Console:_accept()
	-- Tab kommt je nach Plattform als InputBegan und/oder als "\t" im Text an – nur einmal übernehmen.
	local now = os.clock()
	if self._lastAccept and now - self._lastAccept < 0.15 then
		return
	end
	local entry = self._suggestions[self._selected]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	self._lastAccept = now
	local prefix = self:_stripPrefix(self._input.Text)
	local text = prefix .. entry.text .. " "
	self._input.Text = text -- löst die nächste Vorschlagsrunde aus (nächstes Argument)
	self._input.CursorPosition = #text + 1
end

function Console:_appendOutput(text: string, color: Color3)
	self._outputCount += 1
	local line = label({ Name = "Line", Font = MONO, TextSize = 13, Color = color, Text = text,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 18) })
	line.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
	line.TextWrapped = true
	line.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	line.LayoutOrder = self._outputCount
	line.Parent = self._output
	local lines = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(self._output:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
			table.insert(lines, child)
		end
	end
	if #lines > MAX_OUTPUT_LINES then
		table.sort(lines, function(a, b) return a.LayoutOrder < b.LayoutOrder end)
		for index = 1, #lines - MAX_OUTPUT_LINES do
			lines[index]:Destroy()
		end
	end
	self._output.Visible = true
	task.defer(function()
		self._output.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, self._output.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - self._output.AbsoluteSize.Y))
	end)
end

function Console:_execute()
	local text = string.gsub(self._input.Text, "^%s+", "")
	text = string.gsub(text, "%s+$", "")
	local _, body = self:_stripPrefix(text)
	if body == "" then
		return
	end
	if self._history[#self._history] ~= text then
		table.insert(self._history, text)
		if #self._history > MAX_HISTORY then
			table.remove(self._history, 1)
		end
	end
	self._historyIndex = 0
	self._ignoreTextChange = true
	self._input.Text = ""
	self._ignoreTextChange = false
	self:_setSuggestions({})
	self._hint.Visible = false

	self:_appendOutput("› " .. text, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
	local result = self._client:Command(body)
	local message = type(result) == "table" and tostring(result.message or "") or "Keine Antwort vom Server."
	local success = type(result) == "table" and result.success == true
	self:_appendOutput(message ~= "" and message or (success and "Ausgeführt." or "Fehlgeschlagen."),
		success and Theme.Colors.Success or Theme.Colors.Error)
end

function Console:Destroy()
	self._open = false
	self._maid:Clean()
end

return Console

-- Options: {"A","B"} oder {{label="A", value=1}, ...}. changed erhält den Wert.
function Components.Select(options, selected, changed)
	local button = Components.Button(selected or "Auswählen", "secondary")
	button.Name = "Select"
	local menu: Frame? = nil

	local function labelOf(option)
		return type(option) == "table" and tostring(option.label or option.value or "") or tostring(option)
	end
	local function valueOf(option)
		return type(option) == "table" and option.value or option
	end

	local function close()
		if menu then
			menu:Destroy()
			menu = nil
		end
	end

	local function open()
		close()
		local list = type(options) == "table" and options or {}
		if #list == 0 then
			return
		end
		menu = Components.Frame("SelectMenu", UDim2.fromOffset(button.Size.X.Offset, math.min(#list, 8) * 32 + 8), Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised)
		menu.Position = UDim2.new(button.Position.X.Scale, button.Position.X.Offset, button.Position.Y.Scale, button.Position.Y.Offset + button.Size.Y.Offset + 4)
		menu.ZIndex = 30
		addCornerStroke(menu, Theme.Radius.Small)
		menu.Parent = button.Parent
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
		layout.Parent = menu
		local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
		padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
		padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4)
		padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4)
		padding.Parent = menu
		for _, option in ipairs(list) do
			local entry = Components.Button(labelOf(option), "ghost")
			entry.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
			entry.ZIndex = 31
			entry.Parent = menu
			entry.Activated:Connect(function()
				button.Text = labelOf(option)
				close()
				if changed then
					changed(valueOf(option))
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		if menu then
			close()
		else
			open()
		end
	end)
	button.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			close()
		end
	end)

	local function setOptions(nextOptions, nextSelected)
		options = nextOptions
		button.Text = nextSelected or (type(nextOptions) == "table" and nextOptions[1] and labelOf(nextOptions[1]) or "Auswählen")
		close()
	end
	return button, setOptions
end

function Components.Tabs(names, changed)

local function cellText(column, item)
	local value = item[column.key]
	if type(column.format) == "function" then
		return tostring(column.format(value, item))
	end
	if value == nil then
		return "—"
	end
	if type(value) == "boolean" then
		return value and "Ja" or "Nein"
	end
	if type(value) == "table" then
		return "—"
	end
	return tostring(value)
end

-- columns: {{key="Name", title="Name", width=2, format=fn}, ...}
-- options: {filter=true, pageSize=100, rowHeight=34, emptyText="…"}
-- Rückgabe: root, render(source), controller
function Components.Table(columns, rows, onSelect, options)
	local opts = type(options) == "table" and options or {}
	local columnList = type(columns) == "table" and columns or {}
	local pageSize = math.clamp(math.floor(opts.pageSize or 100), 10, 500)
	local rowHeight = math.clamp(math.floor(opts.rowHeight or 34), 24, 80)
	local state = {
		source = type(rows) == "table" and rows or {},
		filtered = {},
		visible = {},
		page = 1,
		sortKey = nil,
		descending = false,
		query = "",
	}

	local root = Components.Frame("Table", UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Theme.Colors.Surface)
	addCornerStroke(root, Theme.Radius.Small)

	local topOffset = 0
	local filterInput: TextBox? = nil
	if opts.filter then
		filterInput = Components.SearchField("In dieser Tabelle suchen …")
		filterInput.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		filterInput.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
		filterInput.Parent = root
		topOffset = 44
	end

	local header = Components.Frame("Header", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised)
	header.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, topOffset)
	header.Parent = root

	local body = Components.Frame("Body", UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(topOffset + 32)), Color3.new())
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, topOffset + 32)
	body.Parent = root

	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Name = "Rows"
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -30)
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 5
	list.Parent = body

	local pager = Components.Frame("Pager", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28), Color3.new())
	pager.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	pager.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -28)
	pager.Parent = body
	local previous = Components.Button("Zurück", "ghost")
	previous.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 26)
	previous.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	previous.Parent = pager
	local pageLabel = Components.Label("Seite 1/1", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.TextSecondary)
	pageLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	pageLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
	pageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0)
	pageLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	pageLabel.Parent = pager
	local nextButton = Components.Button("Weiter", "ghost")
	nextButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 26)
	nextButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 0)
	nextButton.Parent = pager

	local render: (table?) -> ()

	local totalWeight = 0
	for _, column in ipairs(columnList) do
		totalWeight += math.max(0.1, tonumber(column.width) or 1)
	end
	if totalWeight <= 0 then
		totalWeight = 1
	end
	local weightOffset = 0
	for _, column in ipairs(columnList) do
		local weight = math.max(0.1, tonumber(column.width) or 1)
		local widthScale = weight / totalWeight
		local button = Components.Button(tostring(column.title or column.key or "—"), "ghost")
		button.TextSize = Theme.TextSize.Small
		button.Size = UDim2.new(widthScale, -4, 1, -4)
		button.Position = UDim2.new(weightOffset, 2, 0, 2)
		button.Parent = header
		weightOffset += widthScale
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			if state.sortKey == column.key then
				state.descending = not state.descending
			else
				state.sortKey = column.key
				state.descending = false
			end
			render(state.source)
		end)
	end

	local rowPool = {}
	local emptyLabel = Components.EmptyState(opts.emptyText or "Keine Einträge vorhanden.")
	emptyLabel.Visible = false
	emptyLabel.Parent = list

	local function draw()
		local visible = state.visible
		for index, item in ipairs(visible) do
			local row = rowPool[index]
			if not row then
				local myIndex = index
				row = {
					button = Instance.new("TextButton"),
					cells = {},
				}
				row.button.AutoButtonColor = false
				row.button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.Surface
				row.button.BorderSizePixel = 0
				row.button.Text = ""
				row.button.ZIndex = 2
				row.button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowHeight)
				row.button.Parent = list
				if onSelect then
					row.button.Activated:Connect(function()
						local target = state.visible[myIndex]
						if target then
							onSelect(target)
						end
					end)
				end
				local innerOffset = 0
				for columnIndex, column in ipairs(columnList) do
					local weight = math.max(0.1, tonumber(column.width) or 1)
					local widthScale = weight / totalWeight
					local cell = Components.Label("", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Text)
					cell.Position = UDim2.new(innerOffset, 8, 0, 0)
					cell.Size = UDim2.new(widthScale, -16, 1, 0)
					cell.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
					cell.ZIndex = 3
					cell.Parent = row.button
					row.cells[columnIndex] = cell
					innerOffset += widthScale
				end
				rowPool[index] = row
			end
			row.button.Visible = true
			row.button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, (index - 1) * rowHeight)
			for columnIndex, column in ipairs(columnList) do
				row.cells[columnIndex].Text = cellText(column, item)
			end
		end
		for index = #visible + 1, #rowPool do
			rowPool[index].button.Visible = false
		end
		emptyLabel.Visible = #visible == 0
		list.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.max(1, #visible * rowHeight))
		local maxPage = math.max(1, math.ceil(#state.filtered / pageSize))
		pageLabel.Text = ("Seite %d/%d"):format(state.page, maxPage)
		previous.Active = state.page > 1
		nextButton.Active = state.page < maxPage
		pager.Visible = maxPage > 1
	end

	render = function(source: table?)
		state.source = type(source) == "table" and source or {}
		state.filtered = {}
		local query = string.lower(state.query)
		for _, item in ipairs(state.source) do
			if type(item) == "table" then
				local matches = query == ""
				if not matches then
					for _, column in ipairs(columnList) do
						if string.find(string.lower(cellText(column, item)), query, 1, true) then
							matches = true
							break
						end
					end
				end
				if matches then
					table.insert(state.filtered, item)
				end
			end
		end
		if state.sortKey then
			local key = state.sortKey
			local descending = state.descending
			table.sort(state.filtered, function(left, right)
				local leftValue, rightValue = left[key], right[key]
				local less: boolean
				if type(leftValue) == "number" and type(rightValue) == "number" then
					less = leftValue < rightValue
				else
					less = string.lower(tostring(leftValue or "")) < string.lower(tostring(rightValue or ""))
				end
				if descending then
					return leftValue ~= rightValue and not less
				end
				return less
			end)
		end
		local maxPage = math.max(1, math.ceil(#state.filtered / pageSize))
		state.page = math.clamp(state.page, 1, maxPage)
		state.visible = {}
		local first = (state.page - 1) * pageSize + 1
		local last = math.min(#state.filtered, first + pageSize - 1)
		for index = first, last do
			table.insert(state.visible, state.filtered[index])
		end
		draw()
	end

	previous.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state.page > 1 then
			state.page -= 1
			render(state.source)
		end
	end)
	nextButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		if state.page < math.max(1, math.ceil(#state.filtered / pageSize)) then
			state.page += 1
			render(state.source)
		end
	end)
	if filterInput then
		filterInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
			state.query = filterInput.Text
			state.page = 1
			render(state.source)
		end)
	end

	render(rows)

	local controller = {
		SetFilter = function(query: string)
			state.query = tostring(query or "")
			state.page = 1
			render(state.source)
		end,
		SetRows = render,
		GetState = function()
			return {
				filtered = #state.filtered,
				total = #state.source,
				page = state.page,
				sortKey = state.sortKey,
				descending = state.descending,
			}
		end,
	}
	return root, render, controller
end

-- onConfirm(text) erhält den eingegebenen Grund. options:
-- {reasonRequired=false, confirmText="Bestätigen", danger=true, onCancel=fn}
function Components.Dialog(parent, title, prompt, onConfirm, options)
	local opts = type(options) == "table" and options or {}
	local overlay = Components.Frame("Dialog", UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Color3.new())
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
	overlay.ZIndex = 20
	overlay.Parent = parent

	local box = Components.Card(title)
	box.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	box.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 220)
	box.ZIndex = 21
	box.Parent = overlay

	local input = Components.TextInput(prompt or "Grund eingeben …", true)
	input.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 52)
	input.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 82)
	input.ZIndex = 22
	input.Parent = box

	local hint = Components.Label("", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Error)
	hint.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 140)
	hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 18)
	hint.ZIndex = 22
	hint.Parent = box

	local keyboardConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local function close()
		if keyboardConnection then
			keyboardConnection:Disconnect()
			keyboardConnection = nil
		end
		if overlay.Parent then
			overlay:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local cancel = Components.Button("Abbrechen", "ghost")
	cancel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -228, 1, -48)
	cancel.ZIndex = 22
	cancel.Parent = box
	cancel.Activated:Connect(function()
		if type(opts.onCancel) == "function" then
			opts.onCancel()
		end
		close()
	end)

	local confirm = Components.Button(opts.confirmText or "Bestätigen", opts.danger == false and "primary" or "danger")
	confirm.Position = UDim2.new(1, -112, 1, -48)
	confirm.ZIndex = 22
	confirm.Parent = box
	confirm.Activated:Connect(function()
		if opts.reasonRequired ~= false and string.gsub(input.Text, "%s", "") == "" then
			hint.Text = "Bitte einen Grund eingeben."
			return
		end
		local text = input.Text
		close()
		if type(onConfirm) == "function" then
			onConfirm(text)
		end
	end)

	keyboardConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(keyObject, processed)
		if processed or keyObject.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
			return
		end
		if type(opts.onCancel) == "function" then
			opts.onCancel()
		end
		close()
	end)

	return overlay, close
end

return Components

--!nonstrict
-- Benachrichtigungen liegen außerhalb der Admin-Oberfläche: Auch Nicht-Admins
-- sehen Toasts, Ankündigungen und den Freeze-Hinweis.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Theme = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Client.Interface.Theme)
local Components = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Client.Interface.Components)
local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Util)
local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)

local Notifications = {}
Notifications.__index = Notifications

local TWEEN = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local MAX_TOASTS = 5

local KIND_COLORS = {
	info = Theme.Colors.Accent,
	success = Theme.Colors.Success,
	warning = Theme.Colors.Warning,
	error = Theme.Colors.Error,
}

local function normalizeKind(kind: any): string
	if type(kind) ~= "string" then
		return "info"
	end
	local lowered = string.lower(kind)
	return KIND_COLORS[lowered] and lowered or "info"
end

function Notifications.new(client: any, parentGui: Instance?): any
	local playerGui = parentGui or (Players.LocalPlayer and Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "HeadcraftNotifications"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	gui.DisplayOrder = 30
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	local self = setmetatable({
		_gui = gui,
		_client = client,
		_maid = Maid.new(),
		_toasts = {},
		_announcement = nil,
	}, Notifications)

	local stack = Components.Frame("ToastStack", UDim2.fromOffset(340, 1), Color3.new())
	stack.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	stack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	stack.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -24)
	stack.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(340, 380)
	stack.ZIndex = 1
	stack.Parent = gui
	self._stack = stack

	local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	list.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
	list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
	list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
	list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
	list.Parent = stack

	self._maid:Give(client:OnPush(Constants.Channels.Toast, function(payload)
		self:Toast(payload.kind, payload.title, payload.message)
	end))
	self._maid:Give(client:OnPush(Constants.Channels.Announcement, function(payload)
		self:Announcement(payload.message, payload.from)
	end))
	self._maid:Give(client:OnPush(Constants.Channels.Freeze, function(payload)
		self:Freeze(payload.frozen == true)
	end))
	self._maid:Give(gui)

	return self
end

function Notifications:Toast(kind: any, title: any, message: any)
	local category = normalizeKind(kind)
	local color = KIND_COLORS[category]
	local frame = Components.Frame("Toast", UDim2.fromOffset(340, 68), Theme.Colors.Surface)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.ZIndex = 2
	frame.Parent = self._stack

	local accent = Components.Frame("Accent", UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 0), color)
	accent.ZIndex = 3
	accent.Parent = frame

	local heading = Components.Label(Util.truncate(tostring(title or "Hinweis"), 60), Theme.TextSize.Body, color, true)
	heading.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 9)
	heading.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 20)
	heading.ZIndex = 3
	heading.Parent = frame

	local body = Components.Label(Util.truncate(tostring(message or ""), 180), Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Text)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 32)
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 28)
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.ZIndex = 3
	body.Parent = frame

	table.insert(self._toasts, frame)
	while #self._toasts > MAX_TOASTS do
		local oldest = table.remove(self._toasts, 1)
		if oldest.Parent then
			oldest:Destroy()
		end
	end

	TweenService:Create(frame, TWEEN, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.04 }):Play()

	local dismissThread: thread? = task.delay(5, function()
		self:Dismiss(frame)
	end)
	local removal: RBXScriptConnection
	removal = frame.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			for index, entry in ipairs(self._toasts) do
				if entry == frame then
					table.remove(self._toasts, index)
					break
				end
			end
			if dismissThread then
				task.cancel(dismissThread)
			end
			removal:Disconnect()
		end
	end)
end

function Notifications:Dismiss(frame: Instance?)
	if not frame or not frame.Parent then
		return
	end
	local tween = TweenService:Create(frame, TWEEN, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		if frame.Parent then
			frame:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

function Notifications:Announcement(message: any, from: any)
	if self._announcement and self._announcement.Parent then
		self._announcement:Destroy()
	end
	local banner = Components.Frame("Announcement", UDim2.fromOffset(620, 66), Theme.Colors.SurfaceRaised)
	banner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	banner.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
	banner.ZIndex = 2
	banner.Parent = self._gui
	self._announcement = banner

	local accent = Components.Frame("Accent", UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), Theme.Colors.Accent)
	accent.ZIndex = 3
	accent.Parent = banner

	local sender = Components.Label("Ankündigung" .. (type(from) == "string" and from ~= "" and (" · " .. Util.truncate(from, 40)) or ""), Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Accent, true)
	sender.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 9)
	sender.Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 0, 18)
	sender.ZIndex = 3
	sender.Parent = banner

	local body = Components.Label(Util.truncate(tostring(message or ""), 220), Theme.TextSize.Body, Theme.Colors.Text)
	body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 30)
	body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -112, 0, 26)
	body.TextWrapped = true
	body.ZIndex = 3
	body.Parent = banner

	local closeButton = Components.Button("Schließen", "ghost")
	closeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 28)
	closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0.5, -14)
	closeButton.ZIndex = 3
	closeButton.Parent = banner
	closeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
		banner:Destroy()
	end)

	task.delay(9, function()
		if banner.Parent then
			banner:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

function Notifications:Freeze(frozen: boolean)
	if self._freezeNotice and self._freezeNotice.Parent then
		if not frozen then
			self._freezeNotice:Destroy()
			self._freezeNotice = nil
		end
		return
	end
	if not frozen then
		return
	end
	local notice = Components.Frame("FreezeNotice", UDim2.fromOffset(360, 42), Theme.Colors.Warning)
	notice.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	notice.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	notice.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 96)
	notice.ZIndex = 2
	notice.Parent = self._gui
	self._freezeNotice = notice

	local label = Components.Label("Bewegung gesperrt — ein Admin-Team-Mitglied hat dich eingefroren.", Theme.TextSize.Small, Theme.Colors.Text, true)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 6)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -12)
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.ZIndex = 3
	label.Parent = notice
end

function Notifications:Destroy()
	self._maid:Clean()
	table.clear(self._toasts)
	self._announcement = nil
	self._freezeNotice = nil
end

return Notifications

--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Signal = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Signal)
local Ring = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Ring)
local Log = {}; Log.__index = Log
function Log.new(maxEntries: number)
	return setmetatable({ _max = maxEntries, _all = Ring.new(maxEntries), _categories = {} :: {[string]: any}, Written = Signal.new() }, Log)
end
function Log:Write(category: string, level: string, tag: string, message: string, data: any?)
	category = ({Admin=true,Security=true,System=true} :: {[string]: boolean})[category] and category or "System"
	local entry = { timestamp = os.time(), category = category, level = level, tag = tag, message = message, data = data }
	self._all:Push(entry); if not self._categories[category] then self._categories[category] = Ring.new(self._max) end; self._categories[category]:Push(entry); self.Written:Fire(entry)
end
function Log:Info(tag: string, message: string, data: any?) self:Write("System", "Info", tag, message, data) end
function Log:Warn(tag: string, message: string, data: any?) self:Write("System", "Warn", tag, message, data) end
function Log:Error(tag: string, message: string, data: any?) self:Write("System", "Error", tag, message, data) end
function Log:Debug(tag: string, message: string, data: any?) self:Write("System", "Debug", tag, message, data) end
function Log:Get(category: string?, limit: number?) local source = category and self._categories[category] or self._all; if not source then return {} end; local values = source:ToArray(true); while limit and #values > limit do table.remove(values) end; return values end
function Log:Clear(category: string?) if category then self._categories[category] = Ring.new(self._max) else self._all:Clear(); table.clear(self._categories) end end
return Log

local Maid = {}; Maid.__index = Maid
function Maid.new() return setmetatable({ _tasks = {} :: {any} }, Maid) end
function Maid:Give(task: any)
	table.insert(self._tasks, task); return task
end
function Maid:Clean()
	for _, item in ipairs(self._tasks) do
		if typeof(item) == "RBXScriptConnection" then item:Disconnect()
		elseif typeof(item) == "Instance" then item:Destroy()
		elseif type(item) == "function" then item()
		elseif type(item) == "table" and type(item.Destroy) == "function" then item:Destroy()
		elseif type(item) == "table" and type(item.Disconnect) == "function" then item:Disconnect() end
	end
	table.clear(self._tasks)
end
return Maid

--!strict
local RateLimiter = {}; RateLimiter.__index = RateLimiter
function RateLimiter.new(limit: number, windowSeconds: number)
	assert(limit > 0 and windowSeconds > 0, "Ungültiges Rate-Limit")
	return setmetatable({ _limit = limit, _window = windowSeconds, _entries = {} :: {[any]: {number}} }, RateLimiter)
end
function RateLimiter:Check(key: any): boolean
	local now = os.clock(); local entries = self._entries[key] or {}; self._entries[key] = entries
	local first = 1; while entries[first] and now - entries[first] >= self._window do first += 1 end
	if first > 1 then for i = 1, first - 1 do table.remove(entries, 1) end end
	if #entries >= self._limit then return false end
	table.insert(entries, now)
	if math.random() < 0.02 then for candidate, values in pairs(self._entries) do if #values == 0 or now - values[#values] > self._window then self._entries[candidate] = nil end end end
	return true
end
function RateLimiter:Reset(key: any) self._entries[key] = nil end
return RateLimiter

--!strict
local Ring = {}; Ring.__index = Ring
function Ring.new(capacity: number) assert(capacity > 0, "Kapazität muss positiv sein"); return setmetatable({ _capacity = capacity, _values = {} :: {any}, _next = 1, _count = 0 }, Ring) end
function Ring:Push(value: any) self._values[self._next] = value; self._next = self._next % self._capacity + 1; self._count = math.min(self._count + 1, self._capacity) end
function Ring:ToArray(newestFirst: boolean?)
	local out = {}; for i = 1, self._count do local index = (self._next - 1 - i) % self._capacity + 1; table.insert(out, self._values[index]) end
	if newestFirst == false then local n = #out; for i = 1, math.floor(n / 2) do out[i], out[n - i + 1] = out[n - i + 1], out[i] end end
	return out
end
function Ring:Clear() table.clear(self._values); self._next = 1; self._count = 0 end
function Ring:Size() return self._count end
return Ring

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft/Shared/Utilities/Signal.lua`:

--!strict
local Signal = {}; Signal.__index = Signal
function Signal.new()
	return setmetatable({ _listeners = {} :: {[any]: (...any) -> ()}, _destroyed = false }, Signal)
end
function Signal:Connect(fn: (...any) -> ())
	assert(type(fn) == "function", "Signal:Connect erwartet eine Funktion")
	local token = {}; self._listeners[token] = fn
	local connection = {}; function connection:Disconnect() self._signal._listeners[self._token] = nil end
	connection._signal = self; connection._token = token
	return connection
end
function Signal:Once(fn: (...any) -> ())
	local connection: any; connection = self:Connect(function(...) connection:Disconnect(); fn(...) end); return connection
end
function Signal:Fire(...: any)
	for _, fn in pairs(self._listeners) do task.spawn(fn, ...) end
end
function Signal:Wait()
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	self:Once(function(...) task.spawn(thread, ...) end)
	return coroutine.yield()
end
function Signal:DisconnectAll() table.clear(self._listeners); self._destroyed = true end
return Signal

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ReplicatedStorage/Headcraft/Shared/Utilities/Util.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
local Util = {}
function Util.deepCopy(value: any): any
	if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
	local copy = {}; for k, v in pairs(value) do copy[Util.deepCopy(k)] = Util.deepCopy(v) end; return copy
end
function Util.deepMerge(base: table, override: table): table
	local result = Util.deepCopy(base); for key, value in pairs(override) do if type(value) == "table" and type(result[key]) == "table" then result[key] = Util.deepMerge(result[key], value) else result[key] = Util.deepCopy(value) end end; return result
end
function Util.truncate(value: string, n: number) if #value <= n then return value end; return string.sub(value, 1, math.max(0, n - 1)) .. "…" end
function Util.formatDuration(seconds: number): string
	seconds = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds)); local units = {{"w",604800},{"d",86400},{"h",3600},{"m",60},{"s",1}}; local chunks = {}
	for _, unit in ipairs(units) do local amount = math.floor(seconds / unit[2]); if amount > 0 then table.insert(chunks, tostring(amount)..unit[1]); seconds %= unit[2]; if #chunks == 2 then break end end end
	return #chunks > 0 and table.concat(chunks, " ") or "0s"
end
-- Liefert (Sekunden, gültig). "perm"/"permanent" → (nil, true); ungültige Eingabe → (nil, false).
-- Unterstützt Kombinationen wie "1d12h" und reine Sekundenangaben ("90").
function Util.parseDuration(text: string): (number?, boolean)
	if type(text) ~= "string" then return nil, false end
	text = string.lower(text)
	if text == "perm" or text == "permanent" then return nil, true end
	if string.match(text, "^%d+$") then return tonumber(text), true end
	local units = { s = 1, m = 60, h = 3600, d = 86400, w = 604800 } :: {[string]: number}
	local total, consumed = 0, 0
	for amount, unit in string.gmatch(text, "(%d+)([smhdw])") do
		total += (tonumber(amount) :: number) * units[unit]
		consumed += #amount + 1
	end
	if consumed ~= #text or total <= 0 then return nil, false end
	return total, true
end
function Util.validate(value: any, schema: any): (boolean, string?)
	if type(schema) ~= "table" or type(schema.type) ~= "string" then return false, "Ungültiges Schema" end
	if schema.type == "string" then if type(value) ~= "string" then return false, "String erwartet" end; if schema.max and #value > schema.max then return false, "String ist zu lang" end
	elseif schema.type == "number" then if type(value) ~= "number" then return false, "Zahl erwartet" end; if schema.integer and value % 1 ~= 0 then return false, "Ganze Zahl erwartet" end; if schema.min and value < schema.min then return false, "Zahl ist zu klein" end; if schema.max and value > schema.max then return false, "Zahl ist zu groß" end
	elseif schema.type == "boolean" then if type(value) ~= "boolean" then return false, "Boolean erwartet" end
	elseif schema.type == "table" then if type(value) ~= "table" then return false, "Tabelle erwartet" end; local count = 0; for _ in pairs(value) do count += 1 end; if schema.maxEntries and count > schema.maxEntries then return false, "Tabelle ist zu groß" end; for name, field in pairs(schema.fields or {}) do local ok, err = Util.validate(value[name], field); if not ok and value[name] ~= nil then return false, name .. ": " .. (err or "ungültig") end end
	else return false, "Nicht unterstützter Typ" end
	return true
end
return Util

```

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/DetectionLogger.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
local DetectionLogger = {
	Name = "DetectionLogger",
	Dependencies = {},
}

function DetectionLogger:Init(framework)
	self._framework = framework
	self._entries = {}
	self._head = 1
	self._size = 0
	self._capacity = 1000
	self._throttle = {}
end

function DetectionLogger:_push(detection)
	self._entries[self._head] = detection
	self._head = self._head % self._capacity + 1
	self._size = math.min(self._size + 1, self._capacity)
end

function DetectionLogger:Write(detection)
	self:_push(detection)
	self._framework.Log:Write("Security", "Warn", "AntiCheat", `{detection.Category} bei {detection.UserId}`, detection)
	local key = `{detection.UserId}:{detection.Category}`
	local now = os.clock()
	local prior = self._throttle[key]
	if prior and now - prior.time < 2 then
		prior.count += 1
		return
	end
	local suppressed = prior and prior.count or 0
	self._throttle[key] = { time = now, count = 0 }
	if suppressed > 0 then detection.Metadata.SuppressedCount = suppressed end
	local eventService = self._framework:TryGetService("EventService")
	if eventService then eventService:Fire("Detection", { detection = detection }) end
	local remote = self._framework:TryGetService("RemoteService")
	if remote then remote:PushToPermission("AntiCheat.ViewDetections", "Detection", detection) end
	local sync = self._framework:TryGetService("SyncManager")
	if sync and sync.QueueDetection then sync:QueueDetection(detection) end
end

function DetectionLogger:Destroy()
	table.clear(self._entries)
	table.clear(self._throttle)
end

return DetectionLogger

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/DetectionManager.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Paket C_anticheat (Teil C1)
-- DetectionManager: zentraler Heartbeat, ladet Detections/*, verwaltet Meldungen,
-- Whitelist, Modus (Monitor/Enforce), sanfte Korrektur und Admin-Anfragen.
-- RiskManager, MovementExceptions, DetectionLogger sowie RemoteService/DataService
-- werden ueber framework:TryGetService angebunden; das Paket laedt auch allein.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Workspace = workspace

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Headcraft"):WaitForChild("Shared")
local Util = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Utilities"):WaitForChild("Util"))
local Constants = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Constants"))
local Ring = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Utilities"):WaitForChild("Ring"))
local RateLimiter = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Utilities"):WaitForChild("RateLimiter"))

local DetectionManager = {
	Name = "DetectionManager",
	Dependencies = {},
}

-- Standardkonfiguration. Fehlende Werte aus framework.Config.AntiCheat werden hiermit ergaenzt.
local DEFAULTS = {
	Enabled = true,
	DetectionMode = "Monitor", -- "Monitor" | "Enforce"
	AutomaticActions = false,
	HeartbeatInterval = 0.25,
	BatchSize = 25,
	GraceSeconds = 3,
	DefaultWalkSpeed = 16,
	DefaultJumpPower = 50,
	DefaultJumpHeight = 7.2,
	DefaultHipHeight = 2,
	DefaultMaxHealth = 100,
	MaxRecentDetections = 1000,
	ConfidenceBase = 0.5,
	ConfidencePerRepeat = 0.1,
	ConfidenceMax = 0.95,
	ViolationTtlSeconds = 60,
	Severity = {
		Speed = "Medium", Fly = "High", Noclip = "High", Teleport = "High",
		Jump = "Medium", Humanoid = "Medium", Physics = "High", Remote = "Medium",
		Tool = "Medium", Character = "High", Pattern = "Low", Instance = "High",
		ClientReport = "Low",
	},
	Modules = {
		Speed = { Enabled = true, ToleranceStuds = 6, ToleranceFactor = 0.12, MaxSpeedStuds = 120, Correct = true },
		Fly = { Enabled = true, AirTime = 1.2, RaycastDistance = 7, MinFallVelocity = -8, Correct = true },
		Noclip = { Enabled = true, MaxCheckDistance = 14, Correct = true },
		Teleport = { Enabled = true, MaxStuds = 70, Correct = true },
		Jump = { Enabled = true, MaxExtraHeight = 1.5, JumpHeightTolerance = 0.3, Correct = true },
		Humanoid = { Enabled = true, SpeedTolerance = 1.0, HealthRegenPerSecond = 6, HipHeightTolerance = 2.2, Correct = false },
	},
	Thresholds = { Log = 0, NotifyAdmin = 20, Warn = 60, Kick = 140, TempBan = 300, Ban = 700 },
	Actions = {
		NotifyAdmin = { CooldownSeconds = 30 },
		Warn = { CooldownSeconds = 60 },
		Kick = { CooldownSeconds = 120 },
		TempBan = { CooldownSeconds = 300, DurationSeconds = 86400 },
		Ban = { CooldownSeconds = 600 },
	},
}

local VALID_MODES = { Monitor = true, Enforce = true }
local VALID_SEVERITY = { Information = true, Low = true, Medium = true, High = true, Critical = true }

function DetectionManager:Init(framework)
	self._framework = framework

	local userConfig = nil
	if framework.Config and type(framework.Config.AntiCheat) == "table" then
		userConfig = framework.Config.AntiCheat
	end
	self._config = Util.deepMerge(Util.deepCopy(DEFAULTS), userConfig)
	self._enabled = self._config.Enabled == true
	self._mode = self._config.DetectionMode
	if not VALID_MODES[self._mode] then
		self._mode = "Monitor"
	end

	self._detectionModules = {}
	self._playerStates = {}
	self._playerConnections = {}
	self._lifecycleConns = {}
	self._watchedRemotes = {}
	self._whitelist = {}
	self._recent = Ring.new(self._config.MaxRecentDetections)
	self._byId = {}
	self._idOrder = {}
	self._accumulator = 0
	self._batchIndex = 0
	self._heartbeatConn = nil
	self._running = false

	local ctx = {
		Framework = framework,
		Report = function(userId, category, severity, confidence, metadata)
			return self:Report(userId, category, severity, confidence, metadata)
		end,
		ReportRemote = function(playerOrUserId, kind, metadata)
			return self:ReportRemote(playerOrUserId, kind, metadata)
		end,
		Config = self._config,
		MovementExceptions = framework:TryGetService("MovementExceptions"),
		Players = Players,
	}
	self._ctx = ctx

	self:_loadDetectionModules(ctx)
end

function DetectionManager:_loadDetectionModules(ctx)
	local antiCheatFolder = script.Parent
	if not antiCheatFolder then
		return
	end
	local detections = antiCheatFolder:FindFirstChild("Detections")
	if not detections then
		return
	end
	local modules = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(detections:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, module = pcall(require, child)
			if ok and type(module) == "table" and module.Name and type(module.Init) == "function" then
				local initOk, initErr = pcall(function()
					module:Init(ctx)
				end)
				if not initOk then
					self._framework.Log:Warn("AntiCheat", `Detektionsmodul „{tostring(module.Name)}“ konnte nicht initialisiert werden: {tostring(initErr)}`)
				else
					table.insert(modules, module)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(modules, function(a, b)
		return tostring(a.Name) < tostring(b.Name)
	end)
	self._detectionModules = modules
	self._framework.Log:Info("AntiCheat", string.format("%d Detektionsmodule geladen", #modules))
end

function DetectionManager:Start()
	local remoteService = self._framework:TryGetService("RemoteService")
	if remoteService then
		remoteService:OnRequest("GetDetections", Constants.Permissions.AntiCheatViewDetections, function(player, args)
			return self:_handleGetDetections(player, args)
		end)
		remoteService:OnRequest("GetRiskScores", Constants.Permissions.AntiCheatViewDetections, function(player, args)
			return self:_handleGetRiskScores(player, args)
		end)
		remoteService:OnRequest("GetWhitelist", Constants.Permissions.AntiCheatViewDetections, function(player, args)
			return self:_handleGetWhitelist(player, args)
		end)
		remoteService:OnRequest("SetWhitelist", Constants.Permissions.AntiCheatManage, function(player, args)
			return self:_handleSetWhitelist(player, args)
		end)
		remoteService:OnClientReport(function(player, kind, data)
			self:_handleClientReport(player, kind, data)
		end)
	else
		self._framework.Log:Warn("AntiCheat", "RemoteService nicht verfuegbar – Admin-Anfragen und ClientReport sind deaktiviert")
	end

	self:_loadWhitelist()

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		self:_setupPlayer(player)
	end
	self._lifecycleConns = {
		Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
			self:_setupPlayer(player)
		end),
		Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
			self:_removePlayer(player)
		end),
	}

	if self._enabled then
		self:_startHeartbeat()
	end
	self._running = true
	self._framework.Log:Info("AntiCheat", string.format("AntiCheat gestartet (Modus: %s, Enabled: %s)", self._mode, tostring(self._enabled)))
end

function DetectionManager:_loadWhitelist()
	local dataService = self._framework:TryGetService("DataService")
	if not dataService then
		return
	end
	local ok, okFetched, value = pcall(function()
		return dataService:Get("Headcraft_Settings", "AntiCheatWhitelist")
	end)
	-- DataService:Get liefert (erfolgreich, wert)
	ok = ok and okFetched == true
	if ok and type(value) == "table" then
		for key, _ in pairs(value) do
			local id = tonumber(key)
			if id then
				self._whitelist[id] = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function DetectionManager:_saveWhitelist()
	local dataService = self._framework:TryGetService("DataService")
	if not dataService then
		return
	end
	local copy = {}
	for id in pairs(self._whitelist) do
		copy[tostring(id)] = true
	end
	pcall(function()
		dataService:Set("Headcraft_Settings", "AntiCheatWhitelist", copy)
	end)
end

function DetectionManager:_setupPlayer(player)
	local state = {
		Player = player,
		UserId = player.UserId,
		Character = nil,
		Root = nil,
		Humanoid = nil,
		LastPosition = nil,
		LastTime = nil,
		LastGoodPosition = nil,
		OnGround = false,
		GroundPart = nil,
		GroundY = nil,
		GroundVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
		Ping = 0,
		GraceUntil = 0,
		ExpectedHumanoid = self:_defaultExpected(),
		Violations = {},
	}
	self._playerStates[player] = state

	local connections = {}
	connections.CharacterAdded = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		self:_onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	end)
	connections.CharacterRemoving = player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
		self:_onCharacterRemoving(player, character)
	end)
	self._playerConnections[player] = connections

	if player.Character then
		self:_onCharacterAdded(player, player.Character)
	end
end

function DetectionManager:_removePlayer(player)
	local connections = self._playerConnections[player]
	if connections then
		for _, connection in pairs(connections) do
			if type(connection) == "table" and type(connection.Disconnect) == "function" then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
		end
		self._playerConnections[player] = nil
	end
	self._playerStates[player] = nil
end

function DetectionManager:_onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	local state = self._playerStates[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	state.Character = character
	state.GraceUntil = os.clock() + (self._config.GraceSeconds or 3)

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	state.Root = root
	state.Humanoid = humanoid

	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		state.LastGoodPosition = root.Position
		state.LastPosition = root.Position
		state.LastTime = os.clock()
	end

	for _, module in ipairs(self._detectionModules) do
		if type(module.OnCharacter) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				module:OnCharacter(player, character)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function DetectionManager:_onCharacterRemoving(player, character)
	local state = self._playerStates[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	state.Character = nil
	state.Root = nil
	state.Humanoid = nil
	state.LastPosition = nil
	state.LastTime = nil
end

function DetectionManager:_defaultExpected()
	return {
		WalkSpeed = self._config.DefaultWalkSpeed,
		JumpPower = self._config.DefaultJumpPower,
		JumpHeight = self._config.DefaultJumpHeight,
		HipHeight = self._config.DefaultHipHeight,
		MaxHealth = self._config.DefaultMaxHealth,
	}
end

function DetectionManager:_startHeartbeat()
	if self._heartbeatConn then
		self._heartbeatConn:Disconnect()
	end
	self._heartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not self._running or not self._enabled then
			return
		end
		self._accumulator += dt
		local interval = self._config.HeartbeatInterval
		while self._accumulator >= interval do
			self._accumulator -= interval
			self:_tick(interval)
		end
	end)
end

function DetectionManager:_tick(dt)
	local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
	local count = #allPlayers
	if count == 0 then
		return
	end
	local batchSize = math.clamp(math.floor(self._config.BatchSize or 25), 1, count)
	self._batchIndex = ((self._batchIndex - 1) % count) + 1
	local start = self._batchIndex
	local processed = 0
	local now = os.clock()

	for i = 0, batchSize - 1 do
		local player = allPlayers[((start - 1 + i) % count) + 1]
		processed += 1
		local ok, state = pcall(function()
			return self:_buildState(player, now)
		end)
		if not ok or not state then
			continue
		end
		for _, module in ipairs(self._detectionModules) do
			local moduleName = tostring(module.Name)
			local cfg = self._config.Modules[moduleName] or {}
			if cfg.Enabled ~= false then
				local modOk, modErr = pcall(function()
					module:OnHeartbeat(self._ctx, state, dt)
				end)
				if not modOk then
					self._framework.Log:Warn("AntiCheat", `Fehler in Detektionsmodul „{moduleName}“: {tostring(modErr)}`)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	self._batchIndex = ((start - 1 + processed) % count) + 1
end

function DetectionManager:_buildState(player, now)
	local state = self._playerStates[player]
	if not state then
		return nil
	end

	local character = player.Character
	state.Character = character
	if not character then
		state.Root = nil
		state.Humanoid = nil
		return state
	end

	local root = state.Root
	if not (root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root:IsDescendantOf(character)) then
		root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		state.Root = root
	end

	local humanoid = state.Humanoid
	if not (humanoid and humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") and humanoid:IsDescendantOf(character)) then
		humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		state.Humanoid = humanoid
	end

	state.Ping = player:GetNetworkPing()

	-- Bodenkontakt per Raycast nach unten (Plattformen werden fuer Geschwindigkeits-Abzug erkannt)
	local onGround, groundPart, groundY, groundVelocity = self:_getGround(root, character)
	state.OnGround = onGround
	state.GroundPart = groundPart
	state.GroundY = groundY
	state.GroundVelocity = groundVelocity or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

	-- Positions-Basis: Letzte Position wird zur letzten guten Position, dann aktuelle als neue letzte.
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		state.LastGoodPosition = state.LastPosition
		state.LastPosition = root.Position
		state.LastTime = now
	end

	return state
end

function DetectionManager:_getGround(root, character)
	if not (root and root:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return false, nil, nil, nil
	end
	local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -5, 0), params)
	if result then
		local part = result.Instance
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			if part.CanCollide then
				return true, part, result.Position.Y, part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			end
			return false, nil, nil, nil
		end
		-- Terrain ist immer kollidierend
		return true, part, result.Position.Y, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	return false, nil, nil, nil
end

-- Oeffentliche API ----------------------------------------------------------

function DetectionManager:IsWhitelisted(userId)
	return self._whitelist[userId] == true
end

function DetectionManager:SetWhitelisted(userId, whitelisted)
	if type(userId) ~= "number" then
		return false, "Ungueltige UserId"
	end
	whitelisted = whitelisted == true
	if whitelisted then
		self._whitelist[userId] = true
	else
		self._whitelist[userId] = nil
	end
	self:_saveWhitelist()
	return true
end

function DetectionManager:SetExpectedHumanoid(player, props)
	if not (typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player")) then
		return false, "Ungueltiger Spieler"
	end
	if type(props) ~= "table" then
		return false, "Ungueltige Eigenschaften"
	end
	local state = self._playerStates[player]
	if not state then
		return false, "Spielerzustand nicht vorhanden"
	end
	state.ExpectedHumanoid = Util.deepMerge(self:_defaultExpected(), props)
	return true
end

function DetectionManager:AllowTool(player, toolName)
	if not (typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player")) then
		return false
	end
	if type(toolName) ~= "string" or #toolName == 0 then
		return false
	end
	self._allowedTools = self._allowedTools or {}
	self._allowedTools[player.UserId] = self._allowedTools[player.UserId] or {}
	self._allowedTools[player.UserId][toolName] = true
	return true
end

function DetectionManager:GetMode()
	return self._mode
end

function DetectionManager:SetMode(mode)
	if mode ~= "Monitor" and mode ~= "Enforce" then
		return false, "Ungueltiger Modus"
	end
	self._mode = mode
	return true
end

function DetectionManager:SetEnabled(enabled)
	self._enabled = enabled == true
	if self._enabled and not self._heartbeatConn then
		self:_startHeartbeat()
	end
	if not self._enabled and self._heartbeatConn then
		self._heartbeatConn:Disconnect()
		self._heartbeatConn = nil
	end
end

function DetectionManager:GetStatus()
	local moduleInfo = {}
	for _, module in ipairs(self._detectionModules) do
		local moduleName = tostring(module.Name)
		local cfg = self._config.Modules[moduleName] or {}
		table.insert(moduleInfo, {
			Name = moduleName,
			Category = module.Category,
			Enabled = cfg.Enabled ~= false,
		})
	end
	local whitelistCount = 0
	for _ in pairs(self._whitelist) do
		whitelistCount += 1
	end
	local antiCheatConfig = self._framework.Config and self._framework.Config.AntiCheat or {}
	return {
		Enabled = self._enabled,
		Mode = self._mode,
		AutomaticActions = antiCheatConfig.AutomaticActions == true,
		HeartbeatInterval = self._config.HeartbeatInterval,
		Modules = moduleInfo,
		DetectionsRecent = self._recent:Size(),
		Whitelisted = whitelistCount,
		Running = self._running,
	}
end

function DetectionManager:GetRecent(limit, userId)
	local all = self._recent:ToArray(true)
	if type(userId) == "number" then
		local filtered = {}
		for _, detection in ipairs(all) do
			if detection.UserId == userId then
				table.insert(filtered, detection)
			end
		end
		all = filtered
	end
	if type(limit) == "number" and limit > 0 then
		local out = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(limit, #all) do
			table.insert(out, all[i])
		end
		return out
	end
	return all
end

function DetectionManager:GetById(id)
	return self._byId[tostring(id)]
end

function DetectionManager:Report(userId, category, severity, confidence, metadata)
	if type(userId) ~= "number" then
		return nil
	end
	if self:IsWhitelisted(userId) then
		return nil
	end
	if type(category) ~= "string" or #category == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	if not VALID_SEVERITY[severity] then
		severity = "Low"
	end
	confidence = math.clamp(tonumber(confidence) or 0, 0, 1)

	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local state = player and self._playerStates[player]
	if state then
		local violations = state.Violations[category]
		if not violations then
			violations = { Count = 0, LastTime = 0 }
			state.Violations[category] = violations
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		if violations.LastTime and now - violations.LastTime > (self._config.ViolationTtlSeconds or 60) then
			violations.Count = 0
		end
		violations.Count += 1
		violations.LastTime = now
		confidence = math.min(confidence + (violations.Count - 1) * (self._config.ConfidencePerRepeat or 0.1), self._config.ConfidenceMax or 0.95)
	end

	local riskManager = self._framework:TryGetService("RiskManager")
	local risk = 0
	if riskManager and type(riskManager.ScoreFor) == "function" then
		risk = riskManager:ScoreFor(severity, confidence)
	end

	local detection = {
		Id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		UserId = userId,
		Category = category,
		Severity = severity,
		Confidence = confidence,
		RiskScore = risk,
		Timestamp = Workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
		Metadata = {},
	}
	if type(metadata) == "table" then
		for key, value in pairs(metadata) do
			detection.Metadata[key] = value
		end
	end

	self._recent:Push(detection)
	self._byId[detection.Id] = detection
	table.insert(self._idOrder, detection.Id)
	if #self._idOrder > 2000 then
		local oldId = table.remove(self._idOrder, 1)
		self._byId[oldId] = nil
	end

	local logger = self._framework:TryGetService("DetectionLogger")
	if logger then
		logger:Write(detection)
	end

	if riskManager then
		riskManager:Add(userId, risk)
		riskManager:Evaluate(userId, detection, self:IsWhitelisted(userId))
	end

	if self._mode == "Enforce" then
		local moduleCfg = self._config.Modules[category] or {}
		if moduleCfg.Correct == true and player then
			self:_correct(player, detection)
		end
	end

	return detection
end

function DetectionManager:ReportRemote(playerOrUserId, kind, metadata)
	local userId = nil
	if type(playerOrUserId) == "number" then
		userId = playerOrUserId
	elseif typeof(playerOrUserId) == "Instance" and playerOrUserId:IsA("Player") then
		userId = playerOrUserId.UserId
	end
	if not userId then
		return nil
	end
	local severity, confidence
	if kind == "RemoteAbuse" then
		severity, confidence = "High", 0.7
	elseif kind == "InvalidRemoteArguments" then
		severity, confidence = "Medium", 0.5
	else
		severity, confidence = "Medium", 0.5
	end
	return self:Report(userId, "Remote", severity, confidence, metadata or {})
end

function DetectionManager:_correct(player, detection)
	local state = self._playerStates[player]
	if not state then
		return
	end
	local lastGood = state.LastGoodPosition
	if not lastGood then
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (root and root:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return
	end
	local movement = self._framework:TryGetService("MovementExceptions")
	if movement and type(movement.Grant) == "function" then
		movement:Grant(player, "Teleport", 2, { Source = "AntiCheatCorrection", Category = detection.Category })
	end
	pcall(function()
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastGood)
	end)
	self._framework.Log:Info("AntiCheat", `Sanfte Korrektur fuer {player.Name} ({player.UserId}) nach {detection.Category}`)
end

function DetectionManager:WatchRemote(remote, schema, rateLimit)
	if not (remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") or remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then
		return false, "remote muss ein RemoteEvent oder RemoteFunction sein"
	end
	if self._watchedRemotes[remote] then
		return false, "Remote wird bereits beobachtet"
	end
	local cfg = type(rateLimit) == "table" and rateLimit or {}
	local entry = {
		Remote = remote,
		Schema = type(schema) == "table" and schema or {},
		RateLimiter = RateLimiter.new(cfg.Limit or 30, cfg.Window or 10),
		Connections = {},
	}
	local function handler(player, ...)
		self:_onRemoteUsed(player, remote, entry, { ... })
	end
	if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		table.insert(entry.Connections, remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(handler))
	else
		remote.OnServerInvoke = handler
	end
	self._watchedRemotes[remote] = entry
	return true
end

function DetectionManager:_onRemoteUsed(player, remote, entry, args)
	if not entry.RateLimiter:Check(player) then
		self:Report(player.UserId, "Remote", "High", 0.7, {
			Remote = remote:GetFullName(),
			Reason = "RateLimit",
		})
		return
	end
	local schema = entry.Schema
	if type(schema) == "table" then
		local maxArgs = schema.MaxArgs
		if type(maxArgs) == "number" and #args > maxArgs then
			self:Report(player.UserId, "Remote", "Medium", 0.6, {
				Remote = remote:GetFullName(),
				Reason = "TooManyArguments",
				Given = #args,
				Max = maxArgs,
			})
			return
		end
		for i, arg in ipairs(args) do
			local field = schema[tostring(i)] or schema[i]
			if type(field) == "table" then
				local ok, err = Util.validate(arg, field)
				if not ok then
					self:Report(player.UserId, "Remote", "Medium", 0.6, {
						Remote = remote:GetFullName(),
						Reason = "InvalidArgument",
						Arg = i,
						Error = err,
					})
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Request-Aktionen (ueber RemoteService:OnRequest registriert) -------------

function DetectionManager:_handleGetDetections(player, args)
	args = args or {}
	local ok, err = Util.validate(args, {
		type = "table",
		maxEntries = 5,
		fields = {
			userId = { type = "number" },
			category = { type = "string", max = 100 },
			limit = { type = "number", integer = true, min = 1, max = 1000 },
		},
	})
	if not ok then
		return { ok = false, error = err or "Ungueltige Argumente" }
	end
	local results = self:GetRecent(args.limit, args.userId)
	return { ok = true, data = results }
end

function DetectionManager:_handleGetRiskScores(player, args)
	local riskManager = self._framework:TryGetService("RiskManager")
	local scores = riskManager and riskManager:GetAll() or {}
	return { ok = true, data = scores }
end

function DetectionManager:_handleGetWhitelist(player, args)
	local list = {}
	for id in pairs(self._whitelist) do
		table.insert(list, id)
	end
	table.sort(list)
	return { ok = true, data = list }
end

function DetectionManager:_handleSetWhitelist(player, args)
	args = args or {}
	local ok, err = Util.validate(args, {
		type = "table",
		maxEntries = 5,
		fields = {
			userId = { type = "number" },
			whitelisted = { type = "boolean" },
		},
	})
	if not ok then
		return { ok = false, error = err or "Ungueltige Argumente" }
	end
	local setOk = self:SetWhitelisted(args.userId, args.whitelisted)
	if not setOk then
		return { ok = false, error = "Whitelist konnte nicht gesetzt werden" }
	end
	return { ok = true, data = { userId = args.userId, whitelisted = args.whitelisted == true } }
end

function DetectionManager:_handleClientReport(player, kind, data)
	if not (typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player")) then
		return
	end
	if type(kind) ~= "string" or #kind == 0 then
		return
	end
	local confidence = 0.3
	if type(data) == "table" and type(data.Confidence) == "number" then
		confidence = math.clamp(data.Confidence, 0, 0.3)
	end
	if confidence <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local metadata = { Kind = kind, Source = "ClientReport" }
	if type(data) == "table" then
		local copy = {}
		for key, value in pairs(data) do
			if key ~= "Confidence" then
				copy[key] = value
			end
		end
		metadata.Data = copy
	end
	self:Report(player.UserId, "ClientReport", "Low", confidence, metadata)
end

function DetectionManager:Destroy()
	if self._heartbeatConn then
		self._heartbeatConn:Disconnect()
		self._heartbeatConn = nil
	end
	for _, connection in ipairs(self._lifecycleConns) do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._lifecycleConns = {}
	for _, connections in pairs(self._playerConnections) do
		for _, connection in pairs(connections) do
			if type(connection) == "table" and type(connection.Disconnect) == "function" then
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._playerStates)
	table.clear(self._playerConnections)
	table.clear(self._watchedRemotes)
	table.clear(self._whitelist)
	table.clear(self._byId)
	table.clear(self._idOrder)
	self._running = false
end

return DetectionManager

```lua
--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Character
-- Vergleicht den serverseitig beobachteten Character mit einer Baseline beim
-- Spawn: fehlende/umbenannte Pflichtteile, gelöschtes Rootteil, ungewöhnliche
-- Größe bzw. Scale und veränderte Motor6D-Verbindungen.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Character = {
	Name = "Character",
	Category = "Character",
}

local DEFAULTS = {
	CheckInterval = 1,
	MaxSizeFactor = 1.4,
	MaxScaleFactor = 1.5,
	JointTolerance = 0.15,
	MaxJoints = 40,
}

local function cframeDiff(current, baseline)
	local relative = current * baseline:Inverse()
	local translation = relative.Position.Magnitude
	local rx, ry, rz = relative:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
	return translation + math.abs(rx) + math.abs(ry) + math.abs(rz)
end

function Character:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Character or {}
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or (ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Character) or "High"
	self._profiles = {}
	self._removeConnection = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self._profiles[player] = nil
	end)
end

function Character:_snapshot(character)
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootSize = nil
	if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		rootSize = root.Size
	end
	local scale = nil
	local scaleOk, observedScale = pcall(function()
		return character:GetScale()
	end)
	if scaleOk and type(observedScale) == "number" then
		scale = observedScale
	end

	local maxJoints = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(self._config.MaxJoints) or DEFAULTS.MaxJoints), 1, 200)
	local joints = {}
	local found = 0
	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("Motor6D") then
			found += 1
			if found <= maxJoints then
				joints[object] = {
					C0 = object.C0,
					C1 = object.C1,
					Part0 = object.Part0,
					Part1 = object.Part1,
				}
			end
		end
	end

	return {
		Character = character,
		HasRoot = root ~= nil,
		HasHumanoid = humanoid ~= nil,
		HasHead = character:FindFirstChild("Head") ~= nil,
		RootSize = rootSize,
		Scale = scale,
		Joints = joints,
	}
end

function Character:OnCharacter(player, character)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") or typeof(character) ~= "Instance" then
		return
	end
	self._profiles[player] = self:_snapshot(character)
end

function Character:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, _dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	if cfg.Enabled == false then
		return
	end

	local player = state.Player
	local character = state.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end

	local profile = self._profiles[player]
	if not profile or profile.Character ~= character then
		profile = self:_snapshot(character)
		self._profiles[player] = profile
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local interval = math.max(tonumber(cfg.CheckInterval) or DEFAULTS.CheckInterval, 0.25)
	if now - (profile.LastCheck or 0) < interval then
		return
	end
	profile.LastCheck = now
	if now - (profile.LastReport or 0) < interval then
		return
	end

	local function report(reason, confidence, extra)
		profile.LastReport = now
		local info = { Reason = reason }
		if type(extra) == "table" then
			for key, value in pairs(extra) do
				info[key] = value
			end
		end
		ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Character", self._severity, confidence, info)
	end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if profile.HasRoot and not root then
		report("RootMissing", 0.75, { Expected = "HumanoidRootPart" })
		return
	end
	if profile.HasHumanoid and not humanoid then
		report("HumanoidMissing", 0.7)
		return
	end
	if profile.HasHead and not character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
		report("PartMissing", 0.65, { Expected = "Head" })
		return
	end

	if profile.RootSize and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		local size = root.Size
		local base = profile.RootSize
		local factor = math.max(
			math.abs(size.X - base.X) / math.max(base.X, 0.01),
			math.abs(size.Y - base.Y) / math.max(base.Y, 0.01),
			math.abs(size.Z - base.Z) / math.max(base.Z, 0.01)
		)
		if factor > (tonumber(cfg.MaxSizeFactor) or DEFAULTS.MaxSizeFactor) then
			report("RootScale", 0.6, { Factor = factor, Expected = tostring(base) })
			return
		end
	end

	if profile.Scale then
		local scaleOk, scale = pcall(function()
			return character:GetScale()
		end)
		if scaleOk and type(scale) == "number" then
			local factor = math.abs(scale - profile.Scale) / math.max(math.abs(profile.Scale), 0.01)
			if factor > (tonumber(cfg.MaxScaleFactor) or DEFAULTS.MaxScaleFactor) then
				report("CharacterScale", 0.6, { Factor = factor, Expected = profile.Scale, Observed = scale })
				return
			end
		end
	end

	local tolerance = math.max(tonumber(cfg.JointTolerance) or DEFAULTS.JointTolerance, 0.01)
	for joint, baseline in pairs(profile.Joints) do
		if joint.Parent == nil or not joint:IsDescendantOf(character) then
			report("JointRemoved", 0.55, { Joint = joint.Name })
			return
		end
		if joint.Part0 ~= baseline.Part0 or joint.Part1 ~= baseline.Part1 then
			report("JointReattached", 0.5, { Joint = joint.Name })
			return
		end
		if cframeDiff(joint.C0, baseline.C0) > tolerance or cframeDiff(joint.C1, baseline.C1) > tolerance then
			report("JointModified", 0.5, { Joint = joint.Name })
			return
		end
	end

	local maxJoints = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.MaxJoints) or DEFAULTS.MaxJoints), 1, 200)
	local inspected = 0
	for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if object:IsA("Motor6D") then
			inspected += 1
			if inspected > maxJoints then
				break
			end
			if profile.Joints[object] == nil then
				report("JointAdded", 0.35, { Joint = object.Name })
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function Character:Destroy()
	if self._removeConnection then
		self._removeConnection:Disconnect()
		self._removeConnection = nil
	end
	table.clear(self._profiles)
end

return Character

--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Fly
-- Erkannt wird Zeit in der Luft ohne Bodenkontakt (Raycast nach unten), Y-Geschwindigkeit
-- und Humanoid-Status. Schwimmen, Klettern, Sitzen sowie Ragdoll/Physik sind ausgenommen.

local Workspace = workspace

local Fly = {
	Name = "Fly",
	Category = "Fly",
}

local EXEMPT_STATES = {
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead] = true,
}

function Fly:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Fly or {}
	local configSeverity = ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Fly
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or configSeverity or "High"
end

function Fly:OnCharacter(player, character)
end

function Fly:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	if cfg.Enabled == false then
		return
	end
	local player = state.Player
	local movement = ctx.MovementExceptions
	if movement and type(movement.IsExempt) == "function" and movement:IsExempt(player) then
		return
	end
	local character = state.Character
	local root = state.Root
	local humanoid = state.Humanoid
	if not character or not root or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end
	if humanoid.SeatPart then
		return
	end
	local hState = humanoid:GetState()
	if EXEMPT_STATES[hState] then
		return
	end

	local origin = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, -(cfg.RaycastDistance or 7), 0), params)
	local onGround = result ~= nil

	if onGround then
		state._FlyAirTime = 0
		return
	end

	state._FlyAirTime = (state._FlyAirTime or 0) + dt
	local airTimeLimit = cfg.AirTime or 1.2
	if state._FlyAirTime < airTimeLimit then
		return
	end

	local vy = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
	local minFallVelocity = cfg.MinFallVelocity or -8
	if vy <= minFallVelocity then
		-- Schneller Fall (z. B. nach Sprung von einem hohen Objekt) ist kein Flug.
		state._FlyAirTime = airTimeLimit * 0.5
		return
	end

	state._FlyAirTime = 0
	local bonus = vy > 0 and 0.2 or 0
	local confidence = math.clamp(0.5 + bonus, 0, 0.9)
	ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Fly", self._severity, confidence, {
		AirTime = state._FlyAirTime + dt,
		VelocityY = vy,
		PositionY = root.Position.Y,
		State = tostring(hState),
	})
end

return Fly

--!strict
-- Headcraft AntiCheat — Detektion: Humanoid
-- WalkSpeed/JumpPower/HipHeight/PlatformStand/MaxHealth/Health-Regeneration.
-- Client-Property-Änderungen replizieren nicht (per Vertrag), daher wird die
-- physikalisch beobachtete Bewegung gewertet.

local Workspace = workspace

local Humanoid = {
	Name = "Humanoid",
	Category = "Humanoid",
}

local EXEMPT_STATES = {
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll] = true,
	[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead] = true,
}

function Humanoid:Init(ctx)
	self._ctx = ctx
	self._config = ctx.Config.Modules.Humanoid or {}
	local configSeverity = ctx.Config.Severity and ctx.Config.Severity.Humanoid
	self._severity = self._config.Severity or configSeverity or "Medium"
end

function Humanoid:OnCharacter(player, character)
end

function Humanoid:OnHeartbeat(ctx, state, dt)
	local cfg = self._config
	if cfg.Enabled == false then
		return
	end
	local player = state.Player
	local movement = ctx.MovementExceptions
	if movement and type(movement.IsExempt) == "function" and movement:IsExempt(player) then
		return
	end
	local character = state.Character
	local root = state.Root
	local humanoid = state.Humanoid
	if not character or not root or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	if type(state.GraceUntil) == "number" and os.clock() < state.GraceUntil then
		return
	end
	if humanoid.SeatPart then
		return
	end

	local expected = state.ExpectedHumanoid or {}
	local now = os.clock()

	-- MaxHealth weicht vom erwarteten Wert ab.
	local maxHealth = humanoid.MaxHealth
	if type(maxHealth) == "number" and type(expected.MaxHealth) == "number" and maxHealth ~= expected.MaxHealth then
		ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Humanoid", self._severity, 0.4, {
			Reason = "MaxHealth",
			MaxHealth = maxHealth,
			Expected = expected.MaxHealth,
		})
	end

	-- PlatformStand ohne Sitz, Fahrzeug oder Ragdoll/Physik-Zustand.
	if humanoid.PlatformStand == true then
		local hState = humanoid:GetState()
		if not EXEMPT_STATES[hState] then
			ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Humanoid", self._severity, 0.4, {
				Reason = "PlatformStand",
				State = tostring(hState),
			})
		end
	end

	-- Health-Regeneration: physikalisch nicht plausible Heilung pro Sekunde.
	local health = humanoid.Health
	local lastHealth = state._HumanoidLastHealth
	local lastTime = state._HumanoidLastTime
	if lastHealth and lastTime and now - lastTime >= 1 then
		local regen = health - lastHealth
		if regen > (cfg.HealthRegenPerSecond or 6) then
			ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Humanoid", self._severity, 0.4, {
				Reason = "HealthRegen",
				RegenPerSecond = regen,
			})
		end
	end
	state._HumanoidLastHealth = health
	state._HumanoidLastTime = now

	-- WalkSpeed-Beobachtung (nur extreme Abweichung; das Speed-Modul deckt den Normalfall ab).
	local expectedWS = type(expected.WalkSpeed) == "number" and expected.WalkSpeed or 16
	if state.OnGround and state.GroundPart and state.GroundPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity - state.GroundPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local horizontal = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
		local limit = expectedWS * (1 + (cfg.SpeedTolerance or 1.0)) + 8
		if horizontal > limit and horizontal > 45 then
			ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Humanoid", self._severity, 0.5, {
				Reason = "WalkSpeed",
				ObservedSpeed = horizontal,
				Expected = expectedWS,
			})
		end
	end

	-- HipHeight im Stand: Entfernung Wurzelteil bis Boden gegen erwarteten Wert.
	if state.OnGround and state.GroundY then
		local observed = root.Position.Y - state.GroundY
		-- Erwarteter Abstand Wurzelteil-Mitte → Boden: R15 = HipHeight + halbe Root-Höhe, R6 = Beinlänge (2) + halbe Root-Höhe.
		local hum = state.Humanoid
		local hipHeight = type(expected.HipHeight) == "number" and expected.HipHeight or (hum and hum.HipHeight or 2)
		local legLength = (hum and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6) and 2 or hipHeight
		local expectedHH = legLength + root.Size.Y / 2
		local diff = math.abs(observed - expectedHH)
		if diff > (cfg.HipHeightTolerance or 2.2) then
			ctx.Report(player.UserId, "Humanoid", self._severity, 0.3, {
				Reason = "HipHeight",
				Observed = observed,
				Expected = expectedHH,
			})
		end
	end
end

return Humanoid

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/AntiCheat/Detections/Instance.lua`:
