--!nonstrict
-- Einziger Datenfluss zwischen Roblox-Server und Headcraft-Backend (hc-api /api/roblox/v1/projects/:projectId/…).
-- Routen und Header: docs/BACKENDS_AND_HMAC_SCHEMA.md, docs/roblox-connection-ops.md.
--
--   Heartbeat ............ POST /servers/heartbeat              (alle Backend.HeartbeatSeconds)
--   Remote-Commands ...... GET  /commands?serverId=…            (alle Backend.CommandPollSeconds) + POST /commands/:id/ack
--   Join/Leave ........... POST /players/session                (Join sofort → activeBan/activeMute werden durchgesetzt)
--   Moderation ........... POST /moderation                     (Queue, Idempotency-Key = Record-Id)
--   Detections ........... POST /detections                     (Queue, Idempotency-Key = Detection-Id)
--   Events ............... POST /events                         (nur die 11 Backend-Typen, siehe EVENT_TYPES)
--   Konfiguration ........ GET  /config                         (Start + alle Backend.ConfigRefreshSeconds)
--   Version .............. POST /version/report                 (einmal nach Verbindungsaufbau)
--   Server-Ende .......... POST /servers/:serverId/shutdown     (BindToClose)
-- Moderationsaktionen mit Source "Backend" stammen aus dem Backend selbst und werden nicht zurückgesendet.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")

local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)

local SyncManager = {
	Name = "SyncManager",
	Dependencies = { "APIClient", "Authentication", "EventService" },
}

-- Die 11 Event-Typen, die POST /events annimmt.
local EVENT_TYPES = {
	PlayerJoined = true, PlayerLeft = true, PlayerBanned = true, PlayerWarned = true, PlayerKicked = true,
	PlayerDetected = true, AntiCheatTriggered = true, ServerStarted = true, ServerShutdown = true,
	ConfigurationUpdated = true, ProjectConnected = true,
}
-- Standard: nur Ereignisse, die das Backend nicht schon aus anderen Routen ableitet (Session, Moderation,
-- Detections erzeugen dort eigene Einträge). Über Backend.Events.<Typ> = true/false anpassbar.
local DEFAULT_EVENTS = {
	ServerStarted = true, ServerShutdown = true, ConfigurationUpdated = true, ProjectConnected = true,
	PlayerJoined = false, PlayerLeft = false, PlayerBanned = false, PlayerWarned = false, PlayerKicked = false,
	PlayerDetected = false, AntiCheatTriggered = false,
}
local MODERATION_ACTIONS = {
	Ban = "ban", TempBan = "tempban", Unban = "unban", Warn = "warn", Kick = "kick", Mute = "mute", Unmute = "unmute",
}
local DEFAULT_SEVERITY_MAP = { Information = "info", Low = "low", Medium = "medium", High = "high", Critical = "critical" }
local MAX_COMMANDS_PER_POLL = 20

local framework
local running = true
local startedAt = os.clock()
local serverId = ""
local connections = {}
local boundClose = false
local flushing = false
local shuttingDown = false
local versionReported = false
local lastSuccess = 0
local lastError = nil
local handledCommands = {} -- commandId → os.clock(), verhindert doppelte Ausführung bei erneutem Poll
local currentFps = 0

local settings = {
	maxQueue = 500, batchSize = 25, syncInterval = 15, heartbeatInterval = 30,
	commandPollInterval = 10, configRefreshInterval = 300, events = DEFAULT_EVENTS, severityMap = DEFAULT_SEVERITY_MAP,
}

local queues = { events = {}, detections = {}, moderation = {}, sessions = {} }
local dropped = { events = 0, detections = 0, moderation = 0, sessions = 0 }

local function getService(name)
	return framework and framework:TryGetService(name) or nil
end

local function api()
	return getService("APIClient")
end

local function isConnected(): boolean
	local authentication = getService("Authentication")
	return authentication ~= nil and authentication:IsConnected() == true
end

local function log(level, message, data)
	if framework then
		framework.Log[level](framework.Log, "SyncManager", message, data)
	end
end

local function isoTime(unixSeconds: number?): string
	return DateTime.fromUnixTimestamp(math.floor(unixSeconds or os.time())):ToIsoDate()
end

local function placeId(): string
	return tostring(game.PlaceId)
end

-- Begrenzt Tiefe, Größe und Typen aller Werte aus anderen Modulen (Zyklen werden abgeschnitten).
local function sanitize(value, depth, counter, seen)
	if depth > 4 or counter.count > 200 then
		return nil
	end
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "boolean" then
		return value
	elseif kind == "number" then
		return (value == value and math.abs(value) ~= math.huge) and value or nil
	elseif kind == "string" then
		return #value > 1000 and string.sub(value, 1, 1000) or value
	elseif kind == "userdata" or kind == "vector" then
		return tostring(value) -- Vector3, CFrame, EnumItem … als Text
	elseif kind ~= "table" or seen[value] then
		return nil
	end
	seen[value] = true
	local output = {}
	for key, child in pairs(value) do
		counter.count += 1
		if counter.count > 200 then
			break
		end
		if type(key) == "string" or type(key) == "number" then
			local cleaned = sanitize(child, depth + 1, counter, seen)
			if cleaned ~= nil then
				output[key] = cleaned
			end
		end
	end
	seen[value] = nil
	return output
end

local function clean(value)
	return sanitize(value, 0, { count = 0 }, {})
end

local function push(queueName, item)
	local queue = queues[queueName]
	if #queue >= settings.maxQueue then
		table.remove(queue, 1)
		dropped[queueName] += 1
	end
	table.insert(queue, item)
	if #queue >= settings.batchSize and not flushing and isConnected() then
		task.spawn(function()
			SyncManager:Flush(false)
		end)
	end
end

-- Antwortobjekte können je nach Route direkt oder unter data/result liegen.
local function unwrap(data)
	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return {}
	end
	if type(data.data) == "table" then
		return data.data
	end
	if type(data.result) == "table" then
		return data.result
	end
	return data
end

local function field(source, ...)
	if type(source) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	for _, name in ipairs({ ... }) do
		if source[name] ~= nil then
			return source[name]
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Einreichen

-- Interne Eventnamen (EventService) bzw. Backend-Typen → POST /events.
function SyncManager:QueueEvent(name, payload)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or type(payload) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	local eventType = name
	if name == Constants.Events.ModerationAction then
		local record = type(payload.action) == "table" and payload.action or {}
		if record.Source == "Backend" then
			return false
		end
		eventType = ({ Ban = "PlayerBanned", TempBan = "PlayerBanned", Warn = "PlayerWarned", Kick = "PlayerKicked" })[record.Type]
	elseif name == Constants.Events.Detection then
		local detection = type(payload.detection) == "table" and payload.detection or {}
		local severity = Constants.Severity[detection.Severity] or 0
		eventType = severity >= Constants.Severity.High and "AntiCheatTriggered" or "PlayerDetected"
	end
	if not eventType or not EVENT_TYPES[eventType] or settings.events[eventType] ~= true then
		return false
	end
	local data = clean(payload) or {}
	local userId = field(data, "userId", "UserId")
		or (type(data.action) == "table" and data.action.UserId)
		or (type(data.detection) == "table" and data.detection.UserId)
	push("events", {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		body = {
			type = eventType,
			serverId = serverId,
			placeId = placeId(),
			userId = userId and tostring(userId) or nil,
			data = data,
			occurredAt = isoTime(),
		},
	})
	return true
end

function SyncManager:QueueDetection(detection)
	if type(detection) ~= "table" or type(detection.UserId) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(detection.UserId)
	local id = type(detection.Id) == "string" and detection.Id or HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	push("detections", {
		id = id,
		body = {
			detectionId = id,
			serverId = serverId,

			playerName = player and player.Name or nil,
			category = type(detection.Category) == "string" and detection.Category or "Unknown",
			severity = settings.severityMap[detection.Severity] or "info",
			confidence = math.clamp(tonumber(detection.Confidence) or 0, 0, 1),
			riskScore = math.clamp(tonumber(detection.RiskScore) or 0, 0, 100000),
			metadata = clean(detection.Metadata) or {},
			detectedAt = isoTime(tonumber(detection.Timestamp)),

	})

end

function SyncManager:QueueModeration(record)
	if type(record) ~= "table" or type(record.UserId) ~= "number" or record.Source == "Backend" then
		return false
	end
	local action = MODERATION_ACTIONS[record.Type]
	if not action then
		return false
	end
	local id = type(record.Id) == "string" and record.Id or HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local expiresAt = tonumber(record.ExpiresAt)
	local timestamp = tonumber(record.Timestamp) or os.time()
	push("moderation", {
		id = id,
		body = {
			action = action,
			userId = tostring(record.UserId),
			reason = type(record.Reason) == "string" and string.sub(record.Reason, 1, 500) or "",
			durationSec = expiresAt and math.max(0, math.floor(expiresAt - timestamp)) or nil,
			moderatorId = tostring(tonumber(record.ModeratorId) or 0),
			source = type(record.Source) == "string" and record.Source or "Command",
			serverId = serverId,
			placeId = placeId(),
			reference = id,
		},
	})
	return true
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Spieler

-- Maßgeblich sind die Booleans banned/muted (Antwort von /players/session bzw. moderationState).
-- activeBan/activeMute sendet das Backend bei jedem Spieler mit – ohne Sanktion als leeres Objekt {}.
local function sanctionState(data, flag, detailField)
	local moderationState = type(data.moderationState) == "table" and data.moderationState or {}
	local active = data[flag] == true or moderationState[flag] == true
	local player = type(data.player) == "table" and data.player or {}
	local details = field(data, detailField) or player[detailField]
	if type(details) ~= "table" or next(details) == nil then
		details = nil
	end
	return active, details or {}
end

local function applyActiveSanctions(player, response)
	local data = unwrap(response)
	local banned, ban = sanctionState(data, "banned", "activeBan")
	if banned and player.Parent then
		local reason = string.sub(tostring(field(ban, "reason", "Reason") or "Du bist in diesem Spiel gesperrt."), 1, 300)
		-- Restlaufzeit aus expiresAt (ISO oder Unix) bzw. durationSec; nil = permanent
		local remaining = nil
		local expiresAt = field(ban, "expiresAt", "ExpiresAt")
		if type(expiresAt) == "string" then
			local ok, dt = pcall(DateTime.fromIsoDate, expiresAt)
			remaining = ok and dt and dt.UnixTimestamp - os.time() or nil
		elseif type(expiresAt) == "number" then
			remaining = (expiresAt > 1e11 and expiresAt / 1000 or expiresAt) - os.time()
		elseif tonumber(field(ban, "durationSec")) then
			remaining = tonumber(field(ban, "durationSec"))
		end
		if remaining ~= nil and remaining <= 0 then
			return -- bereits abgelaufen, Backend hat den Status nur noch nicht aktualisiert
		end
		-- Über die Roblox Ban API (Players:BanAsync via BanService): Roblox blockiert danach jeden Join selbst,
		-- der Ban erscheint im Creator Hub unter Moderation → Bans. Source "Backend" → nicht zurückgesendet.
		local banService = getService("BanService")
		local applied = false
		if banService then
			local ok, success = pcall(banService.Ban, banService, 0, player.UserId, reason,
				remaining and math.max(60, math.floor(remaining)) or nil, "Backend")
			applied = ok and success == true
		end
		log("Info", "Aktiver Backend-Ban über die Roblox Ban API angewendet", { userId = player.UserId, applied = applied })
		if not applied and player.Parent then
			player:Kick("Headcraft Moderation: " .. reason)
		end
		return
	end
	local muted, mute = sanctionState(data, "muted", "activeMute")
	if muted then
		local muteService = getService("MuteService")
		if muteService and not muteService:IsMuted(player.UserId) then
			local expiresAt = field(mute, "expiresAt", "ExpiresAt")
			local remaining = nil
			if type(expiresAt) == "string" then
				local ok, dt = pcall(DateTime.fromIsoDate, expiresAt)
				remaining = ok and dt and math.max(1, dt.UnixTimestamp - os.time()) or nil
			elseif type(expiresAt) == "number" then
				remaining = math.max(1, (expiresAt > 1e11 and expiresAt / 1000 or expiresAt) - os.time())
			end
			pcall(muteService.Mute, muteService, 0, player.UserId, remaining, tostring(field(mute, "reason", "Reason") or "Backend"), "Backend")
		end
	end
end

local function sessionBody(userId, name, displayName, action)
	return {
		serverId = serverId,
		placeId = placeId(),
		userId = tostring(userId),
		username = name,
		displayName = displayName,
		action = action,
	}
end

local function onPlayerJoined(payload)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.userId) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(payload.userId)
	if not player then
		return
	end
	local body = sessionBody(player.UserId, player.Name, player.DisplayName, "join")
	if not isConnected() then
		push("sessions", { id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), body = body })
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, data = api():Request("POST", api():ProjectPath("/players/session"), body, { timeoutOverride = 8, maxRetries = 1 })
		if ok then
			applyActiveSanctions(player, data)
		else
			push("sessions", { id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), body = body })
		end
	end)
end

local function onPlayerLeft(payload)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.userId) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	push("sessions", {
		id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
		body = sessionBody(payload.userId, payload.name or "", payload.name or "", "leave"),
	})
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Senden

-- Arbeitet bis zu batchSize Einträge einer Queue ab. Nicht wiederholbare Fehler (z. B. 400 VALIDATION_ERROR)
-- verwerfen den Eintrag, damit eine fehlerhafte Nachricht die Queue nicht dauerhaft blockiert.
local function drain(queueName, path, deadline)
	local client = api()
	local sent = 0
	while sent < settings.batchSize and #queues[queueName] > 0 and os.clock() < deadline do
		if client:IsCircuitOpen() then
			return
		end
		local item = queues[queueName][1]
		local ok, data, status = client:Request("POST", client:ProjectPath(path), item.body, {
			idempotencyKey = item.id,
			timeoutOverride = math.clamp(deadline - os.clock(), 1, 8),
		})
		if ok then
			table.remove(queues[queueName], 1)
			sent += 1
			lastSuccess = os.time()
			lastError = nil
		elseif status >= 400 and status < 500 and status ~= 408 and status ~= 429 and status ~= 401 and status ~= 403 then
			table.remove(queues[queueName], 1)
			dropped[queueName] += 1
			lastError = tostring(data)
			log("Warn", "Eintrag vom Backend abgelehnt und verworfen", { queue = queueName, status = status, reason = tostring(data) })
		else
			lastError = tostring(data)
			return
		end
	end
end

function SyncManager:Flush(force)
	if flushing or not running or not isConnected() then
		return false
	end
	flushing = true
	local deadline = os.clock() + (force and 20 or 12)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		drain("sessions", "/players/session", deadline)
		drain("moderation", "/moderation", deadline)
		drain("detections", "/detections", deadline)
		drain("events", "/events", deadline)
	end)
	flushing = false
	if not ok then
		log("Error", "Flush fehlgeschlagen", { error = tostring(err) })
	end
	return ok
end

function SyncManager:Heartbeat()
	if not isConnected() then
		return false
	end
	local playerList = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		table.insert(playerList, { userId = tostring(player.UserId), username = player.Name, displayName = player.DisplayName })
	end
	local ok, data = api():Request("POST", api():ProjectPath("/servers/heartbeat"), {
		serverId = serverId,
		placeId = placeId(),
		universeId = tostring(game.GameId),
		playerCount = #playerList,
		maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers,
		frameworkVersion = framework and framework.Version or "1.0.0",
		uptimeSec = math.floor(os.clock() - startedAt),
		players = playerList,
		metrics = {
			fps = currentFps,
			memoryMb = math.floor(Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() * 10 + 0.5) / 10,
		},
	}, { maxRetries = 1 })
	if ok then
		lastSuccess = os.time()
		lastError = nil
	else
		lastError = "Heartbeat fehlgeschlagen: " .. tostring(data)
	end
	return ok
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Remote-Commands

-- Ziel per UserId; ersatzweise per Spielername (Feld "target"), solange der Spieler auf diesem Server ist.
local function targetUserId(data)
	local id = tonumber(field(data, "userId", "targetUserId", "UserId"))
	if id then
		return id
	end
	local target = field(data, "target")
	if tonumber(target) then
		return tonumber(target)
	end
	if type(target) == "string" then
		local player = Players:FindFirstChild(target)
		return player and player:IsA("Player") and player.UserId or nil
	end
	return nil
end

local function durationSeconds(data)
	local seconds = tonumber(field(data, "durationSec", "durationSeconds", "duration"))
	return seconds and seconds > 0 and math.floor(seconds) or nil
end

local function reasonOf(data)
	local reason = field(data, "reason", "Reason")
	return type(reason) == "string" and string.sub(reason, 1, 500) or "Aktion aus dem Headcraft-Dashboard"
end

local function characterHumanoid(userId)
	local player = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local character = player and player.Character
	return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function runModeration(serviceName, method, ...)
	local service = getService(serviceName)
	if not service then
		return false, serviceName .. " ist nicht geladen"
	end
	local ok, success, message = pcall(service[method], service, ...)
	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(success)
	end
	return success ~= false, message
end

local shutdownLock = false

-- Jeder Handler gibt (erfolgreich, Meldung) zurück. Moderator 0 = Systemaktion, Source "Backend".
local COMMAND_HANDLERS = {
	kick = function(d) return runModeration("KickService", "Kick", 0, targetUserId(d), reasonOf(d), "Backend") end,
	ban = function(d) return runModeration("BanService", "Ban", 0, targetUserId(d), reasonOf(d), durationSeconds(d), "Backend") end,
	tempban = function(d)
		local seconds = durationSeconds(d)
		if not seconds then
			return false, "tempban ohne gültige Dauer"
		end
		return runModeration("BanService", "Ban", 0, targetUserId(d), reasonOf(d), seconds, "Backend")
	end,
	unban = function(d) return runModeration("BanService", "Unban", 0, targetUserId(d), reasonOf(d), "Backend") end,
	warn = function(d) return runModeration("WarnService", "Warn", 0, targetUserId(d), reasonOf(d), "Backend") end,
	mute = function(d) return runModeration("MuteService", "Mute", 0, targetUserId(d), durationSeconds(d), reasonOf(d), "Backend") end,
	unmute = function(d) return runModeration("MuteService", "Unmute", 0, targetUserId(d), reasonOf(d), "Backend") end,
	announce = function(d)
		local message = field(d, "message", "text")
		if type(message) ~= "string" or message == "" then
			return false, "announce ohne Nachricht"
		end
		local remote = getService("RemoteService")
		if not remote then
			return false, "RemoteService fehlt"
		end
		remote:PushAll(Constants.Channels.Announcement, { message = string.sub(message, 1, 300), from = "Dashboard" })
		return true, "Ankündigung gesendet"
	end,
	setrank = function(d)
		local userId, rank = targetUserId(d), field(d, "rank", "role")
		local permissions = getService("PermissionService")
		if not userId or type(rank) ~= "string" or not permissions then
			return false, "setrank benötigt userId und rank"
		end
		return permissions:ApplyBackendSync({ assignments = { { userId = userId, rank = rank } } })
	end,
	kill = function(d)
		local humanoid = characterHumanoid(targetUserId(d))
		if not humanoid then
			return false, "Spieler ist nicht auf diesem Server"
		end
		humanoid.Health = 0
		return true, "Spieler getötet"
	end,
	heal = function(d)
		local humanoid = characterHumanoid(targetUserId(d))
		if not humanoid then
			return false, "Spieler ist nicht auf diesem Server"
		end
		humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
		return true, "Spieler geheilt"
	end,
	settime = function(d)
		local value = field(d, "time", "clockTime", "value")
		local hours = tonumber(value)
		if not hours and type(value) == "string" then
			local h, m = string.match(value, "^(%d+):(%d+)$")
			hours = h and (tonumber(h) + tonumber(m) / 60) or nil
		end
		if not hours then
			return false, "settime ohne gültige Uhrzeit"
		end
		Lighting.ClockTime = math.clamp(hours, 0, 24)
		return true, "Uhrzeit gesetzt"
	end,
	setgravity = function(d)
		local gravity = tonumber(field(d, "gravity", "value"))
		if not gravity then
			return false, "setgravity ohne Wert"
		end
		workspace.Gravity = math.clamp(gravity, 0, 1000)
		return true, "Gravitation gesetzt"
	end,
	cleanup = function()
		-- Entfernt herumliegende Tools und Accessoires, die keinem Character gehören.
		local removed = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Tool") or child:IsA("Accessory") then
				child:Destroy()
				removed += 1
			end
		end
		return true, removed .. " Objekte entfernt"
	end,
	shutdown = function(d)
		local message = "Der Server wird von der Administration neu gestartet."
		if type(field(d, "reason", "message")) == "string" then
			message = string.sub(field(d, "reason", "message"), 1, 200)
		end
		shutdownLock = true
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			player:Kick(message)
		end
		return true, "Server wird geschlossen"
	end,
}
COMMAND_HANDLERS.permban = COMMAND_HANDLERS.ban
COMMAND_HANDLERS.addrole = COMMAND_HANDLERS.setrank
COMMAND_HANDLERS.removerole = function(d)
	local userId = targetUserId(d)
	local permissions = getService("PermissionService")
	if not userId or not permissions then
		return false, "removerole benötigt userId"
	end
	return permissions:ApplyBackendSync({ assignments = { { userId = userId } } })
end

function SyncManager:PollCommands()
	if not isConnected() then
		return
	end
	local client = api()
	local ok, data = client:Request("GET", client:ProjectPath("/commands?serverId=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(serverId)), nil, { maxRetries = 0 })
	if not ok then
		return
	end
	local list = unwrap(data)
	list = type(list.commands) == "table" and list.commands or (type(list.items) == "table" and list.items) or list
	if type(list) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local processed = 0
	for _, command in ipairs(list) do
		if processed >= MAX_COMMANDS_PER_POLL then
			break
		end
		local commandId = field(command, "commandId", "id", "_id")
		local commandType = field(command, "type", "command", "action")
		if type(commandId) == "string" and type(commandType) == "string" and not handledCommands[commandId] then
			processed += 1
			handledCommands[commandId] = os.clock()
			local handler = COMMAND_HANDLERS[string.lower(commandType)]
			-- Backend-Format: userId/target auf oberster Ebene, Details (durationSec, reason, rank …) in payload
			local rawPayload = field(command, "payload", "data", "args")
			local payload = type(rawPayload) == "table" and table.clone(rawPayload) or {}
			for _, key in ipairs({ "userId", "target", "reason", "durationSec", "rank", "role", "message" }) do
				if payload[key] == nil and command[key] ~= nil then
					payload[key] = command[key]
				end
			end
			local success, message = false, "Unbekannter Command-Typ: " .. commandType
			if handler then
				local called, result, detail = pcall(handler, payload)
				success, message = called and result ~= false, called and (detail or result) or result
			end
			log(success and "Info" or "Warn", "Remote-Command " .. commandType, { id = commandId, success = success, message = tostring(message) })
			-- Das Ack-Schema ist im Backend nicht dokumentiert: status ist der dokumentierte Wert (done/failed),
			-- success/ok/error decken die üblichen Alternativen ab, damit ein Fehlschlag nicht als "done" erscheint.
			local text = string.sub(tostring(message or ""), 1, 300)
			client:Request("POST", client:ProjectPath("/commands/" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(commandId) .. "/ack"), {
				status = success and "done" or "failed",
				success = success,
				ok = success,
				result = text,
				message = text,
				error = (not success) and text or nil,
				serverId = serverId,
			}, { idempotencyKey = "ack-" .. commandId, maxRetries = 2 })
		end
	end
	-- Erledigte IDs nach 10 Minuten vergessen (Speicher begrenzen)
	for id, at in pairs(handledCommands) do
		if os.clock() - at > 600 then
			handledCommands[id] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Konfiguration

-- Übersetzt camelCase-Felder des Backends in die Schlüssel von Framework:ApplyRemoteConfig.
local function normalizeAntiCheat(source)
	if type(source) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local modules = nil
	if type(source.modules) == "table" or type(source.Modules) == "table" then
		modules = {}
		for name, value in pairs(source.modules or source.Modules) do
			if type(name) == "string" and type(value) == "table" then
				modules[string.upper(string.sub(name, 1, 1)) .. string.sub(name, 2)] = { Enabled = field(value, "enabled", "Enabled") }
			end
		end
	end
	return {
		Enabled = field(source, "enabled", "Enabled"),
		DetectionMode = (function()
			local mode = field(source, "detectionMode", "mode", "DetectionMode")
			if type(mode) ~= "string" then
				return nil
			end
			mode = string.lower(mode)
			return mode == "enforce" and "Enforce" or (mode == "monitor" and "Monitor" or nil)
		end)(),
		AutomaticActions = field(source, "automaticActions", "autoActions", "AutomaticActions"),
		Modules = modules,
	}
end

function SyncManager:FetchConfig()
	if not isConnected() then
		return false
	end
	local ok, data = api():Request("GET", api():ProjectPath("/config"), nil, { maxRetries = 1 })
	if not ok then
		lastError = "Konfiguration konnte nicht geladen werden: " .. tostring(data)
		return false
	end
	local config = unwrap(data)
	config = type(config.config) == "table" and config.config or config
	local partial = { antiCheat = normalizeAntiCheat(config.antiCheat or config.AntiCheat) }
	local applied = framework:ApplyRemoteConfig(partial)
	-- Keine Änderung ist kein Fehler (leere oder unveränderte Konfiguration)
	lastSuccess = os.time()
	if applied then
		log("Info", "Backend-Konfiguration übernommen")
	end
	return true
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Status

function SyncManager:GetStatus()
	local authentication = getService("Authentication")
	local client = api()
	local authStatus = authentication and authentication:GetAuthStatus() or {}
	local diagnostics = client and client:GetDiagnostics() or {}
	local updateManager = getService("UpdateManager")
	return {
		connected = authStatus.connected == true,
		state = authStatus.state or "Idle",
		serverId = serverId,
		signing = authStatus.signing == true,
		lastSuccess = math.max(lastSuccess, diagnostics.lastSuccess or 0),
		lastError = lastError or diagnostics.lastError or authStatus.lastError,
		lastErrorCode = diagnostics.lastErrorCode,
		circuitOpen = diagnostics.circuitOpen == true,
		latencyMs = diagnostics.latencyMs or 0,
		baseURL = diagnostics.baseURL,
		queueSizes = {
			events = #queues.events, detections = #queues.detections,
			moderation = #queues.moderation, sessions = #queues.sessions,
		},
		dropped = table.clone(dropped),
		update = updateManager and updateManager:GetVersionInfo() or nil,
	}
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Lebenszyklus

function SyncManager:Init(currentFramework)
	framework = currentFramework
	running = true
	startedAt = os.clock()
	local backend = type(currentFramework.Config and currentFramework.Config.Backend) == "table" and currentFramework.Config.Backend or {}
	settings.maxQueue = math.floor(math.clamp(tonumber(backend.MaxQueue) or 500, 10, 5000))
	settings.batchSize = math.floor(math.clamp(tonumber(backend.DetectionBatchSize) or 25, 1, 100))
	settings.syncInterval = math.clamp(tonumber(backend.SyncIntervalSeconds) or 15, 5, 3600)
	settings.heartbeatInterval = math.clamp(tonumber(backend.HeartbeatSeconds) or 30, 10, 3600)
	settings.commandPollInterval = math.clamp(tonumber(backend.CommandPollSeconds) or 10, 5, 600)
	settings.configRefreshInterval = math.clamp(tonumber(backend.ConfigRefreshSeconds) or 300, 60, 3600)
	settings.events = table.clone(DEFAULT_EVENTS)
	if type(backend.Events) == "table" then
		for name, enabled in pairs(backend.Events) do
			if EVENT_TYPES[name] and type(enabled) == "boolean" then
				settings.events[name] = enabled
			end
		end
	end
	settings.severityMap = type(backend.SeverityMap) == "table" and backend.SeverityMap or DEFAULT_SEVERITY_MAP
end

local function every(interval, fn)
	task.spawn(function()
		while running do
			task.wait(interval)
			if running and not shuttingDown then
				local ok, err = pcall(fn)
				if not ok then
					log("Error", "Periodische Aufgabe fehlgeschlagen", { error = tostring(err) })
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function SyncManager:Start()
	local backend = type(framework.Config.Backend) == "table" and framework.Config.Backend or {}
	local httpOk, httpEnabled = pcall(function()
		return HttpService.HttpEnabled
	end)
	local authentication = getService("Authentication")
	if backend.Enabled ~= true or not httpOk or httpEnabled ~= true then
		log("Error", "Backend ist deaktiviert – Spiel läuft ohne Synchronisation weiter.", { configured = backend.Enabled == true, httpEnabled = httpEnabled })
		framework:SetServiceStatus(self.Name, "Disabled")
		return
	end
	serverId = authentication and authentication:GetServerId() or game.JobId

	local frames, sampleStart = 0, os.clock()
	table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		frames += 1
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - sampleStart >= 1 then
			currentFps = math.floor(frames / (now - sampleStart) + 0.5)
			frames, sampleStart = 0, now
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		if shutdownLock then
			player:Kick("Der Server wird gerade geschlossen.")
		end
	end))

	local eventService = getService("EventService")
	if eventService then
		table.insert(connections, eventService:Connect(Constants.Events.PlayerJoined, onPlayerJoined))
		table.insert(connections, eventService:Connect(Constants.Events.PlayerLeft, onPlayerLeft))
		table.insert(connections, eventService:Connect(Constants.Events.ModerationAction, function(payload)
			if type(payload) == "table" then
				self:QueueModeration(payload.action)
			end
		end))
		table.insert(connections, eventService:Connect(Constants.Events.ConfigChanged, function(payload)
			self:QueueEvent("ConfigurationUpdated", payload)
		end))
		-- Erst nach bestätigter Verbindung: Start-Ereignisse, Konfiguration, Version, wartende Spieler
		table.insert(connections, eventService:Connect("BackendConnected", function()
			task.spawn(function()
				self:QueueEvent("ProjectConnected", { serverId = serverId })
				self:QueueEvent("ServerStarted", { serverId = serverId, maxPlayers = Players.MaxPlayers })
				self:FetchConfig()
				if not versionReported then
					local updateManager = getService("UpdateManager")
					if updateManager then
						versionReported = updateManager:ReportVersion()
					end
				end
				-- Spieler, die vor der Verbindung beigetreten sind, nachträglich prüfen. Wartende Join-Einträge
				-- entfernen, damit der Join nicht zusätzlich aus der Queue ein zweites Mal gesendet wird.
				for index = #queues.sessions, 1, -1 do
					if queues.sessions[index].body.action == "join" then
						table.remove(queues.sessions, index)
					end
				end
				for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					onPlayerJoined({ userId = player.UserId })
				end
				self:Heartbeat()
				self:Flush(false)
			end)
		end))
	end

	if not boundClose then
		boundClose = true
		game:BindToClose(function()
			shuttingDown = true
			if not isConnected() then
				return
			end
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				onPlayerLeft({ userId = player.UserId, name = player.Name })
			end
			self:QueueEvent("ServerShutdown", { serverId = serverId })
			self:Flush(true)
			api():Request("POST", api():ProjectPath("/servers/" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(serverId) .. "/shutdown"),
				{ reason = "BindToClose", serverId = serverId }, { maxRetries = 0, timeoutOverride = 5 })
		end)
	end

	every(settings.syncInterval, function() self:Flush(false) end)
	every(settings.heartbeatInterval, function() self:Heartbeat() end)
	every(settings.commandPollInterval, function() self:PollCommands() end)
	every(settings.configRefreshInterval, function() self:FetchConfig() end)
end

function SyncManager:Destroy()
	running = false
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(connections)
	for name in pairs(queues) do
		table.clear(queues[name])
	end
	table.clear(handledCommands)
	framework = nil
end

return SyncManager

```

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Backend/UpdateManager.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Versionsprüfung gegen das Backend (GET /projects/:projectId/version) und Meldung der installierten
-- Version (POST /projects/:projectId/version/report). Ein Pflicht-Update wird als Failed-Status und im Log
-- sichtbar, beendet den Server aber nicht eigenmächtig.

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local UpdateManager = {
	Name = "UpdateManager",
	Dependencies = { "APIClient", "Authentication" },
}

local CHECK_INTERVAL = 1800

local framework: any
local running = true
local current = "1.0.0"
local latest: string? = nil
local minimum: string? = nil
local changelogUrl: string? = nil
local critical = false
local outdated = false
local updateRequired = false
local lastChecked = 0
local lastError: string? = nil

local function parseVersion(value: any): { number }?
	if type(value) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local major, minor, patch = string.match(value, "^v?(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)")
	if not major then
		return nil
	end
	return { tonumber(major) :: number, tonumber(minor) :: number, tonumber(patch) :: number }
end

local function compareVersions(left: string, right: string): number?
	local a, b = parseVersion(left), parseVersion(right)
	if not a or not b then
		return nil
	end
	for index = 1, 3 do
		if a[index] ~= b[index] then
			return a[index] < b[index] and -1 or 1
		end
	end
	return 0
end

local function field(source: any, ...: string): any
	if type(source) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	for _, name in ipairs({ ... }) do
		if source[name] ~= nil then
			return source[name]
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function connected(): boolean
	local authentication = framework and framework:TryGetService("Authentication")
	return authentication ~= nil and authentication:IsConnected() == true
end

function UpdateManager:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	current = tostring(currentFramework.Version or "1.0.0")
end

function UpdateManager:Start()
	local backend = type(framework.Config.Backend) == "table" and framework.Config.Backend or {}
	local httpOk, enabled = pcall(function()
		return HttpService.HttpEnabled
	end)
	if backend.Enabled ~= true or not httpOk or enabled ~= true then
		framework:SetServiceStatus(self.Name, "Disabled")
		return
	end
	while running do
		if connected() then
			self:CheckVersion()
			task.wait(CHECK_INTERVAL)
		else
			task.wait(15)
		end
	end
end

function UpdateManager:GetVersionInfo(): { [string]: any }
	return {
		current = current, latest = latest, minimum = minimum, changelogUrl = changelogUrl,
		critical = critical, outdated = outdated, updateRequired = updateRequired,
		lastChecked = lastChecked, lastError = lastError,
	}
end

function UpdateManager:CheckVersion(): boolean
	local client = framework:TryGetService("APIClient")
	if not client then
		return false
	end
	local ok, data, status = client:Request("GET", client:ProjectPath("/version?current=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(current)), nil, { maxRetries = 1 })
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		lastError = tostring(data)
		framework.Log:Warn("UpdateManager", "Versionscheck fehlgeschlagen", { reason = lastError, status = status })
		return false
	end
	local info = type(data.data) == "table" and data.data or data
	latest = field(info, "latest", "latestVersion", "frameworkVersion")
	minimum = field(info, "minimum", "minimumVersion", "minVersion")
	local url = field(info, "changelogUrl", "changelog")
	changelogUrl = type(url) == "string" and string.sub(url, 1, 500) or nil
	critical = field(info, "critical", "mandatory") == true
	lastChecked = os.time()
	lastError = nil

	local latestCmp = type(latest) == "string" and compareVersions(current, latest) or nil
	local minimumCmp = type(minimum) == "string" and compareVersions(current, minimum) or nil
	outdated = latestCmp ~= nil and latestCmp < 0
	updateRequired = (minimumCmp ~= nil and minimumCmp < 0) or (critical and outdated)
		or field(info, "compatible") == false

	if updateRequired then
		framework:SetServiceStatus(self.Name, "Failed")
		framework.Log:Error("UpdateManager", "Diese Version ist nicht mehr zulässig – bitte den Installer erneut ausführen.", {
			current = current, latest = latest, minimum = minimum,
		})
	else
		framework:SetServiceStatus(self.Name, "Ok")
		if outdated then
			framework.Log:Warn("UpdateManager", "Eine neuere Version ist verfügbar", { current = current, latest = latest })
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Meldet Framework- und Modulversionen (installierte Version aus dem Installer-Attribut).
function UpdateManager:ReportVersion(): boolean
	local client = framework:TryGetService("APIClient")
	local authentication = framework:TryGetService("Authentication")
	if not client or not authentication then
		return false
	end
	local root = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("Headcraft")
	local modules = {}
	for name, state in pairs(framework:GetStatus()) do
		if type(state) == "string" then
			modules[name] = state
		end
	end
	local ok = client:Request("POST", client:ProjectPath("/version/report"), {
		serverId = authentication:GetServerId(),
		placeId = tostring(game.PlaceId),
		frameworkVersion = current,
		installedVersion = root and root:GetAttribute("HeadcraftVersion") or current,
		sharedVersion = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants).Version,
		modules = modules,
	}, { maxRetries = 1 })
	return ok == true
end

function UpdateManager:Destroy()
	running = false
	framework = nil
end

return UpdateManager

-- Als Paket (z. B. aus der Toolbox) liegt das Framework zunächst im Workspace.

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Commands/CommandExecutor.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Führt Commands serverseitig aus: Parsing, Rechte, Argumenttypen, pcall,
-- History, Admin-Log und CommandExecuted-Event. Client-Eingaben bleiben
-- überall untrusted und werden erneut geprüft.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Ring = require(Shared.Utilities.Ring)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)
local Maid = require(Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local CommandExecutor = {
	Name = "CommandExecutor",
	Dependencies = { "CommandParser", "TypeRegistry", "PermissionChecker", "CommandRegistry" },
}

local HISTORY_GLOBAL = 100
local HISTORY_USER = 20
local MAX_ARGS = 20
local MAX_TEXT = 500
local SOURCES = { Chat = true, UI = true, Console = true, Test = true }

local function hasPermissionRequirement(permission: any): boolean
	if permission == nil or permission == "" then
		return false
	end
	if type(permission) == "table" then
		return #permission > 0
	end
	return true
end

local framework: any
local maid: any
local globalHistory = Ring.new(HISTORY_GLOBAL)
local userHistory: { [number]: any } = {}

local function getService(name: string): any?
	if framework == nil or type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function normalizeExecutorId(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		return value.UserId
	end
	if type(value) == "number" and value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

local function makeResult(success: boolean, message: string, data: any?): any
	return {
		success = success,
		message = Util.truncate(message, 500),
		data = data,
	}
end

local function recordHistory(executorId: number, commandName: string, rawText: string,
	success: boolean, message: string, source: string)
	local entry = {
		userId = executorId,
		commandName = commandName,
		rawText = rawText,
		success = success,
		message = message,
		source = source,
		timestamp = os.time(),
	}
	globalHistory:Push(entry)
	local ring = userHistory[executorId]
	if ring == nil then
		ring = Ring.new(HISTORY_USER)
		userHistory[executorId] = ring
	end
	ring:Push(entry)
end

local function writeLog(level: string, commandName: string, message: string, data: any)
	if framework == nil or type(framework.Log) ~= "table" or type(framework.Log.Write) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		framework.Log:Write("Admin", level, commandName, Util.truncate(message, 400), data)
	end)
	if not ok and type(framework.Log.Warn) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			framework.Log:Warn("CommandExecutor", "Admin-Log fehlgeschlagen", { error = tostring(err) })
		end)
	end
end

local function fireEvent(executorId: number, commandName: string, rawText: string,
	success: boolean, message: string)
	local eventService = getService("EventService")
	if eventService == nil or type(eventService.Fire) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		eventService:Fire(Constants.Events.CommandExecuted, {
			userId = executorId,
			commandName = commandName,
			rawText = rawText,
			success = success,
			message = message,
		})
	end)
end

local function pushChatResult(player: Player?, success: boolean, message: string, alreadyReplied: boolean)
	if alreadyReplied or player == nil then
		return
	end
	local remote = getService("RemoteService")
	if remote == nil or type(remote.Push) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		remote:Push(player, Constants.Channels.Toast, {
			kind = success and "success" or "error",
			title = "Command",
			message = Util.truncate(message, 400),
		})
	end)
end

function CommandExecutor:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	maid = Maid.new()
	maid:Give(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		userHistory[player.UserId] = nil
	end))
end

function CommandExecutor:Execute(executorValue: any, text: any, sourceValue: any): any
	local executorId = normalizeExecutorId(executorValue)
	if executorId == nil then
		return makeResult(false, "Ungültige Spielerkennung.")
	end
	if type(text) ~= "string" or #text == 0 or #text > MAX_TEXT then
		return makeResult(false, "Der Befehl ist ungültig oder zu lang.")
	end
	local source = (type(sourceValue) == "string" and SOURCES[sourceValue] == true) and sourceValue or "Console"

	local parser = getService("CommandParser")
	if parser == nil or type(parser.Parse) ~= "function" then
		return makeResult(false, "Das Befehlssystem ist noch nicht bereit.")
	end
	local parseOk, parsed = pcall(parser.Parse, parser, text)
	if not parseOk or type(parsed) ~= "table" or type(parsed.name) ~= "string" or parsed.name == "" then
		return makeResult(false, "Der Befehl konnte nicht gelesen werden.")
	end

	local registry = getService("CommandRegistry")
	if registry == nil or type(registry.Get) ~= "function" then
		return makeResult(false, "Das Befehlssystem ist noch nicht bereit.")
	end
	local lookupOk, definition = pcall(registry.Get, registry, parsed.name)
	if not lookupOk or type(definition) ~= "table" or type(definition.Run) ~= "function" then
		return makeResult(false, "Unbekannter Command: " .. parsed.name)
	end
	local commandName = type(definition.Name) == "string" and definition.Name or parsed.name

	-- Rechteprüfung ausschließlich serverseitig; ein fehlender Checker sperrt
	-- alle Commands mitPermission-Anforderung (fail closed).
	local checker = getService("PermissionChecker")
	if checker ~= nil and type(checker.CanExecuteCommand) == "function" then
		local checkOk, allowed, reason = pcall(checker.CanExecuteCommand, checker, executorId, definition)
		if not checkOk then
			return makeResult(false, "Die Berechtigung konnte nicht geprüft werden.")
		end
		if allowed ~= true then
			local message = type(reason) == "string" and reason or "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung für diesen Befehl."
			recordHistory(executorId, commandName, text, false, message, source)
			writeLog("Warn", commandName, message, { userId = executorId, source = source })
			fireEvent(executorId, commandName, text, false, message)
			return makeResult(false, message)
		end
	elseif hasPermissionRequirement(definition.Permission) then
		return makeResult(false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar.")
	end

	local executorPlayer = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(executorId)
	local replies: { string } = {}
	local context = {
		Executor = executorPlayer,
		ExecutorId = executorId,
		Framework = framework,
		Source = source,
		PermissionChecker = checker,
		Reply = function(value: any)
			local message = tostring(value or "")
			table.insert(replies, message)
			if source ~= "Chat" then
				return
			end
			local remote = getService("RemoteService")
			if remote == nil or type(remote.Push) ~= "function" then
				return
			end
			pcall(function()
				remote:Push(executorPlayer, Constants.Channels.Toast, {
					kind = "info",
					title = "Command",
					message = Util.truncate(message, 400),
				})
			end)
		end,
	}

	-- Argumente nach Definition auflösen. Rest-Argumente werden zu einem
	-- String zusammengefügt (Anführungszeichen hat der Parser schon entfernt).
	local typeRegistry = getService("TypeRegistry")
	local rawArgs = type(parsed.rawArgs) == "table" and parsed.rawArgs or {}
	local argDefinitions = type(definition.Args) == "table" and definition.Args or {}
	if #argDefinitions > MAX_ARGS then
		return makeResult(false, "Dieser Command hat zu viele Argumente.")
	end

	local args: { [string]: any } = {}
	-- Token-Zeiger statt fester Position: Ein optionales Argument, dessen Token nicht zum Typ passt,
	-- wird übersprungen und das Token dem nächsten Argument überlassen
	-- (z. B. "ban Spieler Spam im Chat" → keine Dauer, Grund "Spam im Chat").
	local cursor = 1
	for index, argDef in ipairs(argDefinitions) do
		if type(argDef) == "table" and type(argDef.Name) == "string" and argDef.Name ~= "" then
			local raw = nil
			if argDef.Rest == true then
				local parts = {}
				for tokenIndex = cursor, #rawArgs do
					table.insert(parts, tostring(rawArgs[tokenIndex]))
				end
				if #parts > 0 then
					raw = table.concat(parts, " ")
				end
				cursor = #rawArgs + 1
			else
				raw = rawArgs[cursor]
				local hasLaterArgs = argDefinitions[index + 1] ~= nil
				if raw ~= nil and argDef.Required ~= true and hasLaterArgs and typeRegistry ~= nil then
					local optionalType = typeRegistry:Get(type(argDef.Type) == "string" and argDef.Type or "string")
					if optionalType ~= nil and type(optionalType.Parse) == "function" then
						local callOk, fits = pcall(optionalType.Parse, raw, context)
						if not callOk or fits ~= true then
							raw = nil -- passt nicht → Argument auslassen, Token bleibt für das nächste
						end
					end
				end
				if raw ~= nil then
					cursor += 1
				end
			end

			if raw == nil then
				if argDef.Required == true then
					local message = "Fehlendes Argument: " .. argDef.Name .. "."
					recordHistory(executorId, commandName, text, false, message, source)
					writeLog("Warn", commandName, message, { userId = executorId, source = source })
					fireEvent(executorId, commandName, text, false, message)
					return makeResult(false, message)
				end
				args[argDef.Name] = argDef.Default
				continue
			end

			local typeName = type(argDef.Type) == "string" and argDef.Type or "string"
			local argType = nil
			if typeRegistry ~= nil and type(typeRegistry.Get) == "function" then
				argType = typeRegistry:Get(typeName)
			end
			if argType == nil or type(argType.Parse) ~= "function" then
				local message = "Unbekannter Argumenttyp: " .. typeName
				recordHistory(executorId, commandName, text, false, message, source)
				writeLog("Error", commandName, message, { userId = executorId, source = source })
				fireEvent(executorId, commandName, text, false, message)
				return makeResult(false, message)
			end

			-- Typ-Funktionen haben die Signatur Parse(raw, context) (CONTRACT §7), kein Methodenaufruf.
			local callOk, parseOk, value = pcall(argType.Parse, raw, context)
			if not callOk then
				local message = "Argument " .. argDef.Name .. " konnte nicht gelesen werden."
				recordHistory(executorId, commandName, text, false, message, source)
				writeLog("Error", commandName, message, { userId = executorId, source = source, error = tostring(parseOk) })
				fireEvent(executorId, commandName, text, false, message)
				return makeResult(false, message)
			end
			if parseOk ~= true then
				local message = type(value) == "string" and value or ("Ungültiges Argument: " .. argDef.Name)
				recordHistory(executorId, commandName, text, false, message, source)
				writeLog("Warn", commandName, message, { userId = executorId, source = source })
				fireEvent(executorId, commandName, text, false, message)
				return makeResult(false, message)
			end
			args[argDef.Name] = value
		end
	end

	local runOk, success, message, data = pcall(definition.Run, context, args)
	if not runOk then
		local detail = "Command " .. commandName .. " ist fehlgeschlagen: " .. Util.truncate(tostring(success), 200)
		recordHistory(executorId, commandName, text, false, detail, source)
		writeLog("Error", commandName, detail, { userId = executorId, source = source, error = tostring(success) })
		fireEvent(executorId, commandName, text, false, detail)
		pushChatResult(source == "Chat" and executorPlayer or nil, false, detail, #replies > 0)
		return makeResult(false, detail)
	end

	local finalMessage = type(message) == "string" and message
		or (success == true and "Command ausgeführt." or "Der Command wurde abgelehnt.")
	finalMessage = Util.truncate(finalMessage, 500)
	recordHistory(executorId, commandName, text, success == true, finalMessage, source)
	writeLog(success == true and "Info" or "Warn", commandName, finalMessage, { userId = executorId, source = source })
	fireEvent(executorId, commandName, text, success == true, finalMessage)
	pushChatResult(source == "Chat" and executorPlayer or nil, success == true, finalMessage, #replies > 0)
	return makeResult(success == true, finalMessage, data)
end

function CommandExecutor:GetHistory(limit: number?): { any }
	local values = globalHistory:ToArray(true)
	if type(limit) == "number" then
		local count = math.clamp(math.floor(limit), 0, HISTORY_GLOBAL)
		while #values > count do
			table.remove(values)
		end
	end
	return values
end

function CommandExecutor:GetUserHistory(userId: number, limit: number?): { any }
	if type(userId) ~= "number" then
		return {}
	end
	local ring = userHistory[userId]
	if ring == nil then
		return {}
	end
	local values = ring:ToArray(true)
	if type(limit) == "number" then
		local count = math.clamp(math.floor(limit), 0, HISTORY_USER)
		while #values > count do
			table.remove(values)
		end
	end
	return values
end

function CommandExecutor:Destroy()
	if maid ~= nil then
		maid:Clean()
	end
	table.clear(userHistory)
	globalHistory:Clear()
	framework = nil
end

return CommandExecutor

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Commands/CommandParser.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- CommandParser: zerlegt Befehlstexte in Name und Argumente.
-- Die Tokenisierung arbeitet bytegenau: UTF-8-Sequenzen bleiben erhalten und
-- ungültige Bytes vom Client erzeugen keinen Fehler (kein utf8.codes).

local CommandParser = {
	Name = "CommandParser",
	Dependencies = {},
}

type ParsedCommand = {
	name: string,
	rawArgs: { string },
}

local DEFAULT_PREFIX = ";"
local MAX_PREFIX = 8
local MAX_TEXT = 500
local MAX_TOKENS = 50

local framework: any = nil
local fallbackPrefix: string = DEFAULT_PREFIX

local function trim(value: string): string
	return (string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
end

local function isWhitespace(byte: number): boolean
	return byte == 0x20 or (byte >= 0x09 and byte <= 0x0D)
end

-- Bytes statt Codepoints: 0x22 (") und 0x5C (\) kommen in UTF-8-
-- Fortsetzungsbytes (0x80..0xBF) nie vor, die Erkennung bleibt also korrekt.
local function tokenize(text: string): { string }
	local tokens: { string } = {}
	local buffer: { string } = {}
	local quoted = false
	local escaped = false
	local hasContent = false

	local function finishToken()
		if hasContent then
			table.insert(tokens, table.concat(buffer))
			table.clear(buffer)
			hasContent = false
		end
	end

	local length = #text
	if length > MAX_TEXT then
		return tokens
	end
	local index = 1
	while index <= length do
		if #tokens >= MAX_TOKENS then
			break
		end
		local byte = string.byte(text, index)
		if escaped then
			table.insert(buffer, string.sub(text, index, index))
			escaped = false
			hasContent = true
		elseif byte == 0x5C then
			escaped = true
			hasContent = true
		elseif byte == 0x22 then
			quoted = not quoted
			hasContent = true
		elseif not quoted and isWhitespace(byte) then
			finishToken()
		else
			table.insert(buffer, string.sub(text, index, index))
			hasContent = true
		end
		index += 1
	end
	if escaped then
		table.insert(buffer, "\\")
		hasContent = true
	end
	finishToken()
	return tokens
end

function CommandParser:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
end

-- Präfix wird bei jedem Aufruf gelesen, damit eine Änderung über
-- Framework:ApplyRemoteConfig sofort wirkt.
function CommandParser:GetPrefix(): string
	if framework ~= nil and type(framework.Config) == "table" then
		local admin = framework.Config.Admin
		if type(admin) == "table" and type(admin.Prefix) == "string" then
			local value = admin.Prefix
			if #value >= 1 and #value <= MAX_PREFIX then
				fallbackPrefix = value
			end
		end
	end
	return fallbackPrefix
end

function CommandParser:SetPrefix(value: any): boolean
	if type(value) ~= "string" or #value < 1 or #value > MAX_PREFIX then
		return false
	end
	fallbackPrefix = value
	if framework ~= nil and type(framework.Config) == "table" then
		local admin = framework.Config.Admin
		if type(admin) == "table" then
			admin.Prefix = value
		end
	end
	return true
end

function CommandParser:HasPrefix(text: string): boolean
	if type(text) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	local prefix = self:GetPrefix()
	if prefix == "" then
		return false
	end
	return string.sub(trim(text), 1, #prefix) == prefix
end

-- Präfix ist optional: UI-Konsolen senden ohne Präfix, Chat mit Präfix.
function CommandParser:Parse(text: string): ParsedCommand?
	if type(text) ~= "string" or #text > MAX_TEXT then
		return nil
	end
	local body = trim(text)
	if body == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local prefix = self:GetPrefix()
	if prefix ~= "" and string.sub(body, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
		body = string.sub(body, #prefix + 1)
	end
	local tokens = tokenize(body)
	local name = tokens[1]
	if name == nil or name == "" then
		return nil
	end
	table.remove(tokens, 1)
	return { name = string.lower(name), rawArgs = tokens }
end

function CommandParser:Tokenize(text: string): { string }
	if type(text) ~= "string" then
		return {}
	end
	return tokenize(text)
end

return CommandParser

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Commands/CommandRegistry.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Verwaltet Command-Definitionen, lädt die Definitions-Module serverseitig,
-- verdrahtet Remotes/Chat und liefert Autocomplete sowie Admin-Requests.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)

local CommandRegistry = {
	Name = "CommandRegistry",
	Dependencies = { "CommandParser", "TypeRegistry", "PermissionChecker" },
}

local MAX_SUGGESTIONS = 50
local MAX_DEFINITION_MODULES = 64
local MAX_ALIASES = 16
local MAX_ARGS = 20

local framework: any
local maid: any
local started = false
local commandsByName: { [string]: any } = {}
local aliases: { [string]: string } = {}
local chatConnections: { [number]: any } = {}

local function normalized(value: string): string
	return string.lower((string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")))
end

local function beginsWith(value: string, partial: string): boolean
	return string.sub(string.lower(value), 1, #partial) == string.lower(partial)
end

local function quoteToken(value: string): string
	local needsQuotes = false
	for index = 1, #value do
		local byte = string.byte(value, index)
		if byte == 0x20 or (byte >= 0x09 and byte <= 0x0D) or byte == 0x22 or byte == 0x5C then
			needsQuotes = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not needsQuotes then
		return value
	end
	return string.format("%q", value)
end

local function copyList(values: any, limit: number): { string }
	local result: { string } = {}
	if type(values) ~= "table" then
		return result
	end
	for _, value in ipairs(values) do
		if #result >= limit then
			break
		end
		if type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
			table.insert(result, value)
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function serializable(value: any): any?
	local valueType = type(value)
	if valueType == "string" or valueType == "number" or valueType == "boolean" then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

local function getService(name: string): any?
	if framework == nil or type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function log(level: string, message: string, data: any?)
	if framework == nil or type(framework.Log) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local method = framework.Log[level]
	if type(method) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		method(framework.Log, "CommandRegistry", message, data)
	end)
end

function CommandRegistry:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
	maid = Maid.new()
	table.clear(commandsByName)
	table.clear(aliases)
	table.clear(chatConnections)
	started = false
end

function CommandRegistry:Register(definition: any): (boolean, string?)
	if type(definition) ~= "table" or type(definition.Name) ~= "string" then
		return false, "Eine Command-Definition benötigt einen Namen."
	end
	local name = normalized(definition.Name)
	if name == "" or string.match(name, "^[%w_]+$") == nil or #name > 64 then
		return false, "Ungültiger Command-Name."
	end
	if type(definition.Run) ~= "function" then
		return false, "Eine Command-Definition benötigt Run."
	end
	if commandsByName[name] ~= nil or aliases[name] ~= nil then
		return false, "Dieser Command-Name ist bereits registriert."
	end
	if definition.Aliases ~= nil and type(definition.Aliases) ~= "table" then
		return false, "Aliases muss eine Liste sein."
	end
	if definition.Args ~= nil and type(definition.Args) ~= "table" then
		return false, "Args muss eine Liste sein."
	end

	local aliasList = copyList(definition.Aliases, MAX_ALIASES)
	if type(definition.Aliases) == "table" and #aliasList < #definition.Aliases then
		return false, "Zu viele Aliase."
	end
	local seenAliases: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, alias in aliasList do
		local aliasName = normalized(alias)
		if aliasName == "" or #aliasName > 64 or string.match(aliasName, "^[%w_]+$") == nil then
			return false, "Ungültiger Alias."
		end
		if seenAliases[aliasName] == true then
			return false, "Ein Alias ist doppelt angegeben."
		end
		seenAliases[aliasName] = true
		if aliasName == name or commandsByName[aliasName] ~= nil or aliases[aliasName] ~= nil then
			return false, "Ein Alias kollidiert mit einem bestehenden Command."
		end
	end

	local argList: { any } = {}
	if type(definition.Args) == "table" then
		for _, arg in ipairs(definition.Args) do
			if #argList >= MAX_ARGS then
				return false, "Zu viele Argumente."
			end
			if type(arg) ~= "table" or type(arg.Name) ~= "string" or arg.Name == "" then
				return false, "Ein Argument benötigt einen Namen."
			end
			table.insert(argList, arg)
		end
	end

	local permission = definition.Permission
	if permission ~= nil and type(permission) ~= "string" and type(permission) ~= "table" then
		return false, "Ungültige Permission."
	end

	-- Kopie statt Mutation des gemeinsam genutzten Definitions-Moduls.
	local copy: { [string]: any } = {}
	for key, value in pairs(definition) do
		copy[key] = value
	end
	copy.Name = name
	copy.Aliases = aliasList
	copy.Args = argList
	copy.Category = type(definition.Category) == "string" and definition.Category or "Allgemein"
	copy.Description = type(definition.Description) == "string" and definition.Description or "Keine Beschreibung verfügbar."

	commandsByName[name] = copy
	for _, alias in aliasList do
		aliases[normalized(alias)] = name
	end
	return true, nil
end

function CommandRegistry:Unregister(name: string): boolean
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	local canonical = normalized(name)
	canonical = aliases[canonical] or canonical
	local definition = commandsByName[canonical]
	if definition == nil then
		return false
	end
	for _, alias in definition.Aliases do
		if aliases[normalized(alias)] == canonical then
			aliases[normalized(alias)] = nil
		end
	end
	commandsByName[canonical] = nil
	return true
end

function CommandRegistry:Get(nameOrAlias: string): any?
	if type(nameOrAlias) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	local key = normalized(nameOrAlias)
	return commandsByName[aliases[key] or key]
end

function CommandRegistry:GetAll(): { any }
	local result: { any } = {}
	for _, definition in commandsByName do
		table.insert(result, definition)
	end
	table.sort(result, function(left, right)
		return left.Name < right.Name
	end)
	return result
end

function CommandRegistry:GetForUser(userId: number): { any }
	local checker = getService("PermissionChecker")
	local result: { any } = {}
	for _, definition in self:GetAll() do
		local permission = definition.Permission
		if permission == nil or permission == "" or (type(permission) == "table" and #permission == 0) then
			table.insert(result, definition)
		elseif checker ~= nil and type(checker.CanExecuteCommand) == "function" then
			local ok, allowed = pcall(checker.CanExecuteCommand, checker, userId, definition)
			if ok and allowed == true then
				table.insert(result, definition)
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

function CommandRegistry:_registerDefinitionValue(value: any, sourceName: string): number
	local count = 0
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		log("Warn", "Definitions-Modul liefert keine Tabelle: " .. sourceName)
		return count
	end
	if type(value.Name) == "string" and type(value.Run) == "function" then
		local ok, err = self:Register(value)
		if ok then
			return 1
		end
		log("Warn", "Command " .. tostring(value.Name) .. " abgelehnt: " .. tostring(err))
		return count
	end
	for _, definition in ipairs(value) do
		if type(definition) == "table" then
			local ok, err = self:Register(definition)
			if ok then
				count += 1
			else
				log("Warn", "Command aus " .. sourceName .. " abgelehnt: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end
	if count == 0 then
		for _, definition in pairs(value) do
			if type(definition) == "table" and type(definition.Name) == "string" then
				local ok = self:Register(definition)
				if ok then
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return count
end

function CommandRegistry:_loadDefinitions()
	local folder = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("Definitions")
	if folder == nil then
		log("Debug", "Kein Definitions-Ordner vorhanden – Registry startet leer.")
		return
	end
	local modules: { Instance } = {}
	if folder:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		table.insert(modules, folder)
	else
		for _, child in folder:GetChildren() do
			if #modules >= MAX_DEFINITION_MODULES then
				log("Warn", "Zu viele Definitions-Module – weitere ignoriert.")
				break
			end
			if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				table.insert(modules, child)
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(modules, function(left, right)
		return left.Name < right.Name
	end)

	local registered = 0
	for _, moduleScript in ipairs(modules) do
		local ok, value = pcall(require, moduleScript)
		if not ok then
			log("Warn", "Definitions-Modul " .. moduleScript.Name .. " konnte nicht geladen werden: " .. tostring(value))
		else
			registered += self:_registerDefinitionValue(value, moduleScript.Name)
		end
	end
	log("Info", string.format("%d Commands aus %d Definitions-Modulen geladen.", registered, #modules))
end

local function buildSuggestions(self: any, player: Player, text: any): any
	if type(text) ~= "string" or #text > 500 then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	local parser = getService("CommandParser")
	local prefix = ";"
	if parser ~= nil and type(parser.GetPrefix) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(parser.GetPrefix, parser)
		if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
			prefix = value
		end
	end

	local rest = string.gsub(text, "^%s+", "")
	if string.sub(rest, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
		rest = string.sub(rest, #prefix + 1)
	end
	rest = string.gsub(rest, "^%s+", "")
	if string.gsub(rest, "%s", "") == "" then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	local endsWithSpace = string.match(rest, "%s$") ~= nil
	local tokens: { string } = {}
	if parser ~= nil and type(parser.Tokenize) == "function" then
		local ok, values = pcall(parser.Tokenize, parser, rest)
		if ok and type(values) == "table" then
			tokens = values
		end
	end

	local allowed = self:GetForUser(player.UserId)
	local suggestions: { any } = {}

	-- Command-Namen zuerst, aber nur erlaubte Commands.
	if #tokens == 0 or (#tokens == 1 and not endsWithSpace) then
		local partial = #tokens == 1 and tostring(tokens[1]) or rest
		for _, definition in ipairs(allowed) do
			if #suggestions >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
				break
			end
			if beginsWith(definition.Name, partial) then
				table.insert(suggestions, {
					text = definition.Name,
					display = definition.Name,
					description = definition.Description,
				})
			end
		end
		return { suggestions = suggestions }
	end

	local name = string.lower(tostring(tokens[1]))
	local definition = self:Get(name)
	if definition == nil then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	local isAllowed = false
	-- GetForUser liefert Kopien, daher über den Namen vergleichen (nicht über Tabellenidentität).
	for _, candidate in ipairs(allowed) do
		if candidate.Name == definition.Name then
			isAllowed = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not isAllowed then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end

	local argDefinitions = type(definition.Args) == "table" and definition.Args or {}
	local argIndex = #tokens - 1 + (endsWithSpace and 1 or 0)
	if argIndex < 1 then
		argIndex = 1
	end
	local argDefinition = argDefinitions[argIndex]
	if argDefinition == nil then
		for _, candidate in ipairs(argDefinitions) do
			if type(candidate) == "table" and candidate.Rest == true then
				argDefinition = candidate
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if type(argDefinition) ~= "table" or type(argDefinition.Type) ~= "string" then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end

	local typeRegistry = getService("TypeRegistry")
	if typeRegistry == nil or type(typeRegistry.Get) ~= "function" then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end
	local argType = typeRegistry:Get(argDefinition.Type)
	if argType == nil or type(argType.Suggest) ~= "function" then
		return { suggestions = {} }
	end

	local partial = endsWithSpace and "" or tostring(tokens[#tokens])
	local context = {
		Executor = player,
		ExecutorId = player.UserId,
		Framework = framework,
		Source = "UI",
		Reply = function() end,
	}
	local prefixParts = { definition.Name }
	local previousCount = endsWithSpace and #tokens or (#tokens - 1)
	for tokenIndex = 2, previousCount do
		table.insert(prefixParts, quoteToken(tostring(tokens[tokenIndex])))
	end
	local commandPrefix = table.concat(prefixParts, " ")

	-- Typ-Funktionen haben die Signatur Suggest(partial, context) (CONTRACT §7), kein Methodenaufruf.
	local ok, values = pcall(argType.Suggest, partial, context)
	if ok and type(values) == "table" then
		for _, value in ipairs(values) do
			if #suggestions >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
				break
			end
			if type(value) == "table" and type(value.text) == "string" and value.text ~= ""
				and type(value.display) == "string" then
				table.insert(suggestions, {
					text = commandPrefix .. " " .. quoteToken(value.text),
					display = value.display,
					description = type(value.description) == "string" and value.description or nil,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	return { suggestions = suggestions }
end

local function commandSummaries(self: any, player: Player): { any }
	local result: { any } = {}
	for _, definition in ipairs(self:GetForUser(player.UserId)) do
		local args: { any } = {}
		for _, arg in ipairs(definition.Args) do
			if type(arg) == "table" then
				table.insert(args, {
					Name = arg.Name,
					Type = type(arg.Type) == "string" and arg.Type or "string",
					Required = arg.Required == true,
					Description = type(arg.Description) == "string" and arg.Description or "",
					Default = serializable(arg.Default),
					Rest = arg.Rest == true,
				})
			end
		end
		table.insert(result, {
			Name = definition.Name,
			Aliases = copyList(definition.Aliases, MAX_ALIASES),
			Category = definition.Category,
			Description = definition.Description,
			Permission = type(definition.Permission) == "string" and definition.Permission or nil,
			Args = args,
		})
	end
	return result
end

local function commandHistory(): { any }
	local executor = getService("CommandExecutor")
	if executor == nil or type(executor.GetHistory) ~= "function" then
		return {}
	end
	local ok, history = pcall(executor.GetHistory, executor, 100)
	if ok and type(history) == "table" then
		return history
	end
	return {}
end

local function bindChat(self: any, player: Player)
	if chatConnections[player.UserId] ~= nil then
		return
	end
	local connection = player.Chatted:Connect(function(message: any)
		if type(message) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		local parser = getService("CommandParser")
		local prefix = ";"
		if parser ~= nil and type(parser.GetPrefix) == "function" then
			local ok, value = pcall(parser.GetPrefix, parser)
			if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
				prefix = value
			end
		end
		local trimmed = string.gsub(message, "^%s+", "")
		if string.sub(trimmed, 1, #prefix) ~= prefix then
			return
		end
		local executor = getService("CommandExecutor")
		if executor == nil or type(executor.Execute) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			executor:Execute(player.UserId, message, "Chat")
		end)
	end)
	chatConnections[player.UserId] = connection
	maid:Give(connection)
end

function CommandRegistry:Start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true
	self:_loadDefinitions()

	local remote = getService("RemoteService")
	if remote ~= nil then
		remote:OnCommand(function(player: Player, text: string)
			local executor = getService("CommandExecutor")
			if executor == nil or type(executor.Execute) ~= "function" then
				return { success = false, message = "Das Befehlssystem ist noch nicht bereit." }
			end
			local ok, response = pcall(executor.Execute, executor, player.UserId, text, "UI")
			if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" then
				return { success = false, message = "Der Befehl konnte nicht ausgeführt werden." }
			end
			return response
		end)

		remote:OnAutocomplete(function(player: Player, text: string)
			local ok, response = pcall(buildSuggestions, self, player, text)
			if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" then
				return { suggestions = {} }
			end
			return response
		end)

		remote:OnRequest("GetCommands", "Admin.Panel", function(player: Player)
			local ok, summaries = pcall(commandSummaries, self, player)
			if not ok or type(summaries) ~= "table" then
				return {}
			end
			return summaries
		end)

		remote:OnRequest("GetCommandHistory", "Admin.Panel", function()
			return commandHistory()
		end)
	end

	maid:Give(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
		bindChat(self, player)
	end))
	maid:Give(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		local connection = chatConnections[player.UserId]
		if connection ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)
			chatConnections[player.UserId] = nil
		end
	end))
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		bindChat(self, player)
	end
end

function CommandRegistry:Destroy()
	if maid ~= nil then
		maid:Clean()
	end
	table.clear(chatConnections)
	table.clear(aliases)
	table.clear(commandsByName)
	started = false
	framework = nil
end

return CommandRegistry
