--!nonstrict
-- Anti-Cheat-Commands. Alle Dienste werden erst in Run über context.Framework
-- aufgelöst. DetectionManager/RiskManager bleiben die einzigen Schreiber ihrer
-- Daten; die Commands rufen nur deren öffentliche API auf.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local Definitions = {}
local MAX_DETECTIONS = 200
local MAX_RISK = 10000

local function tryService(context: any, name: string): any?
	if type(context) ~= "table" or type(context.Framework) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local framework = context.Framework
	if type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function userIdOf(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
		return nil
	end
	if type(value) == "number" and value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 then
		return value
	end
	if type(value) == "table" then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function labelOf(value: any): string
	local id = userIdOf(value)
	local name = "Unbekannt"
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		name = value.Name
	elseif type(value) == "table" and type(value.Name) == "string" then
		name = value.Name
	end
	if id ~= nil then
		return name .. " (" .. tostring(id) .. ")"
	end
	return name
end

local function executorIdOf(context: any): number?
	if type(context) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local id = userIdOf(context.ExecutorId)
	if id ~= nil then
		return id
	end
	return userIdOf(context.Executor)
end

local function canTarget(context: any, executorId: number, targetId: number): (boolean, string?)
	local checker = type(context) == "table" and context.PermissionChecker or nil
	if checker ~= nil and type(checker.CanTarget) == "function" then
		local ok, allowed, err = pcall(checker.CanTarget, checker, executorId, targetId)
		if ok then
			return allowed == true, type(err) == "string" and err or nil
		end
	end
	local permissionService = tryService(context, "PermissionService")
	if permissionService ~= nil and type(permissionService.CanTarget) == "function" then
		local ok, allowed = pcall(permissionService.CanTarget, permissionService, executorId, targetId)
		if ok then
			return allowed == true, "Du darfst dieses Ziel nicht bearbeiten."
		end
	end
	return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function clampedLimit(value: any, fallback: number, maximum: number): number
	if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
		return fallback
	end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 1, maximum)
end

local function formatTimestamp(value: any): string
	if type(value) ~= "number" then
		return "unbekannt"
	end
	local ok, text = pcall(os.date, "!%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", value)
	if ok and type(text) == "string" then
		return text
	end
	return tostring(value)
end

local function formatDetection(detection: any): string
	if type(detection) ~= "table" then
		return "Ungültige Detection."
	end
	local confidence = math.clamp(tonumber(detection.Confidence) or 0, 0, 1) * 100
	return tostring(detection.Id) .. " | " .. tostring(detection.Category)
		.. " | " .. tostring(detection.Severity)
		.. " | " .. string.format("%.0f%%", confidence)
		.. " | User " .. tostring(detection.UserId)
		.. " | " .. formatTimestamp(detection.Timestamp)
end

local function summarize(notes: { string }, successCount: number, total: number, verb: string): (boolean, string)
	local text = verb .. ": " .. tostring(successCount) .. "/" .. tostring(total) .. " erfolgreich."
	if #notes > 0 then
		text = text .. " " .. table.concat(notes, " ")
	end
	return successCount > 0, Util.truncate(text, 500)
end

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "anticheat",
	Aliases = { "ac" },
	Category = "AntiCheat",
	Description = "Zeigt den Anti-Cheat-Status oder setzt Modus und Aktivierung.",
	Permission = Constants.Permissions.AntiCheatManage,
	Args = {
		{ Name = "mode", Type = "string", Required = false, Description = "Monitor oder Enforce" },
		{ Name = "enabled", Type = "boolean", Required = false, Description = "An oder aus" },
	},
	Run = function(context: any, args: any)
		local manager = tryService(context, "DetectionManager")
		if manager == nil or type(manager.GetStatus) ~= "function" then
			return false, "DetectionManager ist nicht verfügbar."
		end
		local notes: { string } = {}
		local successCount = 0
		local total = 0
		if args.mode ~= nil then
			total += 1
			-- Groß-/Kleinschreibung egal: "monitor" / "ENFORCE" → kanonische Schreibweise
			local mode = type(args.mode) == "string" and args.mode or ""
			mode = ({ monitor = "Monitor", enforce = "Enforce" })[string.lower(mode)] or mode
			if mode ~= "Monitor" and mode ~= "Enforce" then
				table.insert(notes, "Ungültiger Modus: " .. Util.truncate(mode, 40))
			elseif type(manager.SetMode) ~= "function" then
				table.insert(notes, "Modus kann nicht gesetzt werden.")
			else
				local ok, applied, err = pcall(manager.SetMode, manager, mode)
				if ok and applied == true then
					successCount += 1
				else
					table.insert(notes, ok and tostring(err) or ("Modusfehler: " .. tostring(applied)))
				end
			end
		end
		if args.enabled ~= nil then
			total += 1
			if type(manager.SetEnabled) ~= "function" then
				table.insert(notes, "Aktivierung kann nicht gesetzt werden.")
			else
				local ok = pcall(manager.SetEnabled, manager, args.enabled == true)
				if ok then
					successCount += 1
				else
					table.insert(notes, "Aktivierung konnte nicht gesetzt werden.")
				end
			end
		end
		local statusOk, status = pcall(manager.GetStatus, manager)
		if not statusOk or type(status) ~= "table" then
			return false, "Anti-Cheat-Status konnte nicht gelesen werden."
		end
		local message = "Anti-Cheat: " .. tostring(status.Mode) .. ", "
			.. (status.Enabled == true and "aktiv" or "inaktiv")
			.. ", Module " .. tostring(#status.Modules)
			.. ", Detection-Queue " .. tostring(status.DetectionsRecent) .. "."
		if total > 0 then
			local ok, text = summarize(notes, successCount, total, "Einstellung")
			if not ok then
				return false, text
			end
			message = text .. " " .. message
		end
		return true, Util.truncate(message, 500), status
	end,
}

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "detections",
	Aliases = { "dets" },
	Category = "AntiCheat",
	Description = "Zeigt die letzten Detection-Einträge optional für einen Spieler.",
	Permission = Constants.Permissions.AntiCheatViewDetections,
	Args = {
		{ Name = "target", Type = "player", Required = false, Description = "Spieler oder UserId" },
		{ Name = "limit", Type = "integer", Required = false, Default = 25, Description = "Anzahl (1–200)" },
	},
	Run = function(_context: any, args: any)

		end

		local message = #result .. " Detection(s)"
		if targetId ~= nil then
			message = message .. " für " .. labelOf(args.target)
		end
		message = message .. "."
		if #lines > 0 then
			message = message .. "\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n")
		end
		return true, Util.truncate(message, 500), { detections = result }
	end,
}

--!nonstrict
-- Moderationsauswertungen. Die Commands lesen ausschließlich über die
-- öffentlichen APIs der Moderationsdienste und bauen keine History-Einträge
-- selbst. Rechte und Zielprüfung laufen serverseitig.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local Definitions = {}
local MAX_RECORDS = 200
local ALLOWED_KINDS = { Bans = true, Warnings = true, Mutes = true, History = true }

local function tryService(context: any, name: string): any?
	if type(context) ~= "table" or type(context.Framework) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local framework = context.Framework
	if type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function userIdOf(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
		return nil
	end
	if type(value) == "number" and value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 then
		return value
	end
	if type(value) == "table" then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function labelOf(value: any): string
	local id = userIdOf(value)
	local name = "Unbekannt"
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		name = value.Name
	elseif type(value) == "table" and type(value.Name) == "string" then
		name = value.Name
	end
	if id ~= nil then
		return name .. " (" .. tostring(id) .. ")"
	end
	return name
end

local function executorIdOf(context: any): number?
	if type(context) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local id = userIdOf(context.ExecutorId)
	if id ~= nil then
		return id
	end
	return userIdOf(context.Executor)
end

local function canTarget(context: any, executorId: number, targetId: number): (boolean, string?)
	local checker = type(context) == "table" and context.PermissionChecker or nil
	if checker ~= nil and type(checker.CanTarget) == "function" then
		local ok, allowed, err = pcall(checker.CanTarget, checker, executorId, targetId)
		if ok then
			return allowed == true, type(err) == "string" and err or nil
		end
	end
	local permissionService = tryService(context, "PermissionService")
	if permissionService ~= nil and type(permissionService.CanTarget) == "function" then
		local ok, allowed = pcall(permissionService.CanTarget, permissionService, executorId, targetId)
		if ok then
			return allowed == true, "Du darfst dieses Ziel nicht einsehen."
		end
	end
	return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function clampedLimit(value: any, fallback: number, maximum: number): number
	if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
		return fallback
	end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 1, maximum)
end

local function formatTimestamp(value: any): string
	if type(value) ~= "number" then
		return "unbekannt"
	end
	local ok, text = pcall(os.date, "!%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", value)
	if ok and type(text) == "string" then
		return text
	end
	return tostring(value)
end

local function formatRecord(record: any): string
	if type(record) ~= "table" then
		return "Ungültiger Eintrag."
	end
	local text = tostring(record.Type) .. " | " .. formatTimestamp(record.Timestamp)
		.. " | Mod " .. tostring(record.ModeratorId)
		.. " | " .. Util.truncate(tostring(record.Reason or "Kein Grund angegeben."), 80)
	if type(record.ExpiresAt) == "number" then
		text = text .. " | bis " .. formatTimestamp(record.ExpiresAt)
	end
	return text
end

local function formatRecords(records: { any }, heading: string, dataKey: string): (boolean, string, any)
	local lines: { string } = {}
	for _, record in ipairs(records) do
		if #lines >= 25 then
			break
		end
		table.insert(lines, formatRecord(record))
	end
	local message = heading .. ": " .. tostring(#records) .. " Eintrag/Einträge."
	if #lines > 0 then
		message = message .. "\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n")
	end
	local data = {}
	data[dataKey] = records
	return true, Util.truncate(message, 500), data
end

			if ok then

			end
			return nil
		end

				name = targetName,

				joinedAt = nil,
				accountAge = nil,

				muted = false,
			}
		end

		local rank = read("PermissionService", "GetRank", targetId)
		local rankName = type(rank) == "table" and type(rank.Name) == "string" and rank.Name or "Player"

		local warnings = read("WarnService", "GetWarnings", targetId)
		local history = read("HistoryService", "Get", targetId, 50)
		local detections = read("DetectionManager", "GetRecent", 50, targetId)
		local riskScore = read("RiskManager", "Get", targetId)
		local muted = read("MuteService", "IsMuted", targetId)

		if type(warnings) ~= "table" then
			warnings = {}
		end
		if type(history) ~= "table" then
			history = {}
		end
		if type(detections) ~= "table" then
			detections = {}
		end
		if type(riskScore) ~= "number" then
			riskScore = 0
		end

		local profile = {
			session = session,
			rank = rankName,
			ban = ban,
			warnings = warnings,
			history = history,
			detections = detections,
			riskScore = math.floor(riskScore),
			muted = muted == true,
		}
		local message = "Profil " .. labelOf(args.target) .. ": Rang " .. rankName
			.. ", " .. tostring(#warnings) .. " Verwarnung(en), "

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "moderationhistory",
	Aliases = { "mh" },
	Category = "Moderation",
	Description = "Zeigt Bans, Verwarnungen, Mutes oder den Gesamtverlauf der letzten Aktionen.",
	Permission = Constants.Permissions.ModerationViewHistory,
	Args = {
		{ Name = "kind", Type = "string", Required = false, Default = "History", Description = "Bans, Warnings, Mutes oder History" },
	},
	Run = function(context: any, args: any)
		local kind = type(args.kind) == "string" and args.kind or "History"
		if not ALLOWED_KINDS[kind] then
			return false, "Unbekannte Moderationskategorie: " .. Util.truncate(kind, 40)
		end
		local records: { any } = {}
		local serviceName = "HistoryService"
		local method = "GetRecent"
		if kind == "Bans" then
			serviceName, method = "BanService", "GetActiveBans"
		elseif kind == "Warnings" then
			serviceName, method = "WarnService", "GetAllWarnings"
		elseif kind == "Mutes" then
			serviceName, method = "MuteService", "GetMutes"
		end
		local service = tryService(context, serviceName)
		if service == nil or type(service[method]) ~= "function" then
			return false, serviceName .. " ist nicht verfügbar."
		end
		local ok, source = pcall(service[method], service)
		if not ok or type(source) ~= "table" then
			return false, kind .. " konnten nicht gelesen werden."
		end
		for _, record in ipairs(source) do
			if #records >= MAX_RECORDS then
				break
			end
			if type(record) == "table" then
				table.insert(records, record)
			end
		end
		table.sort(records, function(left, right)
			return (tonumber(left.Timestamp) or 0) > (tonumber(right.Timestamp) or 0)
		end)
		local applied, message, data = formatRecords(records, "Moderation " .. kind, "records")
		return applied, message, data
	end,
}

return Definitions

--!nonstrict
-- Rang- und Rechteverwaltung. Alle Mutationen laufen ausschließlich über
-- PermissionService; die Commands prüfen zusätzlich die ausführende UserId,
-- damit ein Client keine fremde Identität in den Service schmuggeln kann.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local Definitions = {}
local MAX_LISTED = 100

local function tryService(context: any, name: string): any?
	if type(context) ~= "table" or type(context.Framework) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local framework = context.Framework
	if type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function userIdOf(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
		return nil
	end
	if type(value) == "number" and value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 then
		return value
	end
	if type(value) == "table" then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function labelOf(value: any): string
	local id = userIdOf(value)
	local name = "Unbekannt"
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		name = value.Name
	elseif type(value) == "table" and type(value.Name) == "string" then
		name = value.Name
	end
	if id ~= nil then
		return name .. " (" .. tostring(id) .. ")"
	end
	return name
end

local function executorIdOf(context: any): number?
	if type(context) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local id = userIdOf(context.ExecutorId)
	if id ~= nil then
		return id
	end
	return userIdOf(context.Executor)
end

local function permissionServiceOf(context: any): any?
	local service = tryService(context, "PermissionService")
	if service == nil or type(service.Has) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	return service
end

local function applyChange(context: any, method: string, target: any, extra: any?): (boolean, string)
	local executorId = executorIdOf(context)
	local targetId = userIdOf(target)
	if executorId == nil or targetId == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Spielerkennung."
	end
	local service = permissionServiceOf(context)
	if service == nil or type(service[method]) ~= "function" then
		return false, "PermissionService ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local ok, applied, err
	if extra ~= nil then
		ok, applied, err = pcall(service[method], service, executorId, targetId, extra)
	else
		ok, applied, err = pcall(service[method], service, executorId, targetId)
	end
	if not ok then
		return false, "Änderung fehlgeschlagen: " .. tostring(applied)
	end
	if applied ~= true then
		return false, Util.truncate(tostring(err or "Änderung abgelehnt."), 500)
	end
	return true, "Änderung für " .. labelOf(target) .. " übernommen."
end

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "setrank",
	Aliases = { "rank" },
	Category = "Permissions",
	Description = "Setzt den Rang eines Spielers; der eigene Rang bleibt unverändert.",
	Permission = Constants.Permissions.AdminManageRanks,
	Args = {
		{ Name = "target", Type = "player", Required = true, Description = "Spieler oder UserId" },
		{ Name = "rank", Type = "rank", Required = true, Description = "Zielrang" },

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "permissions",
	Aliases = { "perms" },
	Category = "Permissions",
	Description = "Zeigt Rang und aufgelöste Berechtigungen eines Spielers.",
	Permission = Constants.Permissions.AdminPanel,
	Args = {
		{ Name = "target", Type = "player", Required = false, Description = "Spieler oder UserId, leer für sich selbst" },
	},
	Run = function(context: any, args: any)
		local service = permissionServiceOf(context)
		if service == nil or type(service.GetPermissions) ~= "function" or type(service.GetRank) ~= "function" then
			return false, "PermissionService ist nicht verfügbar."
		end
		local target = args.target
		if target == nil then
			target = type(context) == "table" and context.Executor or nil
		end
		local targetId = userIdOf(target)
		if targetId == nil then
			return false, "Ungültige Spielerkennung."
		end
		local okRank, role = pcall(service.GetRank, service, targetId)
		local okPermissions, permissions = pcall(service.GetPermissions, service, targetId)
		if not okRank or not okPermissions or type(role) ~= "table" or type(permissions) ~= "table" then
			return false, "Berechtigungen konnten nicht gelesen werden."
		end
		local rankName = type(role.Name) == "string" and role.Name or "Player"
		local listed: { string } = {}
		for _, permission in ipairs(permissions) do
			if #listed >= MAX_LISTED then
				break
			end
			if type(permission) == "string" then
				table.insert(listed, permission)
			end
		end
		local message = labelOf(target) .. ": Rang " .. rankName .. ", "
			.. tostring(#listed) .. " Berechtigung(en)."
		if #listed > 0 then
			message = message .. "\n" .. table.concat(listed, ", ")
		end
		return true, Util.truncate(message, 500), {
			userId = targetId,
			rank = rankName,
			permissions = listed,
			total = #permissions,
		}
	end,
}

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Commands/Definitions/Player.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Spielerbezogene Commands. Alle Zielangaben kommen aus TypeRegistry und
-- können Online-Player oder Offline-Deskriptoren sein. Rechte- und Zielprüfung
-- laufen zusätzlich serverseitig über PermissionChecker/PermissionService.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local Definitions = {}

-- Der gefrorene Zustand liegt pro UserId im Modul. Die Verbindung wird beim
-- Aufheben des Freeze und beim Verlassen des Servers sauber getrennt.
local frozen: { [number]: any } = {}

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
	local state = frozen[player.UserId]
	if state == nil then
		return
	end
	if state.connection ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			state.connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	frozen[player.UserId] = nil
end)

local function tryService(context: any, name: string): any?
	if type(context) ~= "table" or type(context.Framework) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local framework = context.Framework
	if type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function userIdOf(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
		return nil
	end
	if type(value) == "number" and value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 then
		return value
	end
	if type(value) == "table" then
		local id = value.UserId
		if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
			return id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function executorIdOf(context: any): number?
	if type(context) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local id = userIdOf(context.ExecutorId)
	if id ~= nil then
		return id
	end
	return userIdOf(context.Executor)
end

local function playerOf(value: any): Player?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") and value.Parent ~= nil then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

local function labelOf(value: any): string
	local id = userIdOf(value)
	local name = "Unbekannt"
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		name = value.Name
	elseif type(value) == "table" and type(value.Name) == "string" then
		name = value.Name
	end
	if id ~= nil then
		return name .. " (" .. tostring(id) .. ")"
	end
	return name
end

local function reasonOf(value: any, fallback: string): string
	if type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
		return Util.truncate(value, 500)
	end
	return fallback
end

local function canTarget(context: any, executorId: number, targetId: number): (boolean, string?)
	local checker = type(context) == "table" and context.PermissionChecker or nil
	if checker ~= nil and type(checker.CanTarget) == "function" then
		local ok, allowed, err = pcall(checker.CanTarget, checker, executorId, targetId)
		if ok then
			return allowed == true, type(err) == "string" and err or nil
		end
	end
	local permissionService = tryService(context, "PermissionService")
	if permissionService ~= nil and type(permissionService.CanTarget) == "function" then
		local ok, allowed = pcall(permissionService.CanTarget, permissionService, executorId, targetId)
		if ok then
			return allowed == true, "Du darfst dieses Ziel nicht bearbeiten."
		end
	end
	return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
end

local function pushFreeze(context: any, player: Player?, frozenState: boolean)
	if player == nil then
		return
	end
	local playerService = tryService(context, "PlayerService")
	if playerService ~= nil and type(playerService.SetFrozen) == "function" then
		pcall(playerService.SetFrozen, playerService, player.UserId, frozenState)
		return
	end
	local remote = tryService(context, "RemoteService")
	if remote ~= nil and type(remote.Push) == "function" then
		pcall(remote.Push, remote, player, Constants.Channels.Freeze, { frozen = frozenState })
	end
end

local function applyFreezeToCharacter(userId: number)
	local state = frozen[userId]
	if state == nil then
		return
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local character = player ~= nil and player.Character or nil
	if character == nil then
		return
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root ~= nil and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		if state.anchored == nil then
			state.anchored = root.Anchored
		end
		pcall(function()
			root.Anchored = true
		end)
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid ~= nil then
		if state.walkSpeed == nil then
			state.walkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
		end
		if state.jumpPower == nil then
			state.jumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
		end
		pcall(function()
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
			humanoid.JumpPower = 0
		end)
	end
end

local function freezeTarget(context: any, player: Player): (boolean, string?)
	local userId = player.UserId
	if frozen[userId] ~= nil then
		return true, labelOf(player) .. " ist bereits eingefroren."
	end
	local state = { anchored = nil, walkSpeed = nil, jumpPower = nil, connection = nil }
	frozen[userId] = state
	applyFreezeToCharacter(userId)
	local ok, connection = pcall(function()
		return player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.defer(applyFreezeToCharacter, userId)
		end)
	end)
	if ok then
		state.connection = connection
	end
	pushFreeze(context, player, true)
	return true, labelOf(player) .. " wurde eingefroren."
end

local function unfreezeTarget(context: any, player: Player): (boolean, string?)
	local userId = player.UserId
	local state = frozen[userId]
	if state == nil then
		return true, labelOf(player) .. " ist nicht eingefroren."
	end
	if state.connection ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			state.connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if character ~= nil then
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root ~= nil and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			pcall(function()
				root.Anchored = state.anchored == true
			end)
		end
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid ~= nil then
			pcall(function()
				humanoid.WalkSpeed = type(state.walkSpeed) == "number" and state.walkSpeed or 16
				humanoid.JumpPower = type(state.jumpPower) == "number" and state.jumpPower or 50
			end)
		end
	end
	frozen[userId] = nil
	pushFreeze(context, player, false)
	return true, labelOf(player) .. " wurde freigegeben."
end

local function teleportPlayer(context: any, player: Player, destination: CFrame): (boolean, string?)
	local movement = tryService(context, "MovementExceptions")
	if movement ~= nil and type(movement.Teleport) == "function" then
		local ok, moved = pcall(movement.Teleport, movement, player, destination)
		if ok and moved == true then
			return true, nil
		end
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character ~= nil and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
	if root == nil or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return false, "Kein HumanoidRootPart vorhanden."
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		root:PivotTo(destination)
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, "Teleport fehlgeschlagen: " .. tostring(err)
	end
	return true, nil
end

local function summarize(results: { string }, successCount: number, total: number, verb: string): (boolean, string)
	local text = verb .. ": " .. tostring(successCount) .. "/" .. tostring(total) .. " erfolgreich."
	if #results > 0 then
		text = text .. " " .. table.concat(results, " ")
	end
	return successCount > 0, Util.truncate(text, 500)
end

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "kick",
	Aliases = { "k" },
	Category = "Player",
	Description = "Kickt einen oder mehrere online Spieler mit Begründung.",
	Permission = Constants.Permissions.PlayerKick,
	Args = {
		{ Name = "targets", Type = "players", Required = true, Description = "Zielspieler" },
		{ Name = "reason", Type = "string", Required = false, Default = "Kein Grund angegeben", Rest = true, Description = "Grund" },
	},
	Run = function(context: any, args: any)
		local executorId = executorIdOf(context)
		if executorId == nil then
			return false, "Ungültige Spielerkennung."
		end
		local service = tryService(context, "KickService")
		if service == nil or type(service.Kick) ~= "function" then
			return false, "KickService ist nicht verfügbar."
		end
		local reason = reasonOf(args.reason, "Kein Grund angegeben")
		local targets = type(args.targets) == "table" and args.targets or {}
		local notes: { string } = {}
		local successCount = 0
		for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
			local targetId = userIdOf(target)
			if targetId == nil then
				table.insert(notes, "Ungültiges Ziel.")
			else
				local allowed, err = canTarget(context, executorId, targetId)
				if not allowed then
					table.insert(notes, err or "Ziel abgelehnt.")
				else
					local ok, applied, message = pcall(service.Kick, service, executorId, targetId, reason, "Command")
					if ok and applied == true then
						successCount += 1
					else
						table.insert(notes, ok and tostring(message) or ("Kick fehlgeschlagen: " .. tostring(applied)))
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return summarize(notes, successCount, #targets, "Kick")
	end,
}

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "teleport",
	Aliases = { "tp" },
	Category = "Player",
	Description = "Teleportiert ein Ziel zu Koordinaten oder zu einem Spieler.",
	Permission = Constants.Permissions.PlayerTeleport,
	Args = {
		{ Name = "target", Type = "player", Required = true, Description = "Zielspieler" },
		{ Name = "destination", Type = "string", Required = true, Rest = true, Description = "x,y,z oder Spielername" },
	},
	Run = function(context: any, args: any)
		local executorId = executorIdOf(context)
		if executorId == nil then
			return false, "Ungültige Spielerkennung."
		end
		local target = playerOf(args.target)
		local targetId = userIdOf(args.target)
		if target == nil or targetId == nil then
			return false, "Das Ziel ist nicht online."
		end
		local allowed, err = canTarget(context, executorId, targetId)
		if not allowed then
			return false, err or "Ziel abgelehnt."
		end
		local destinationText = type(args.destination) == "string" and args.destination or ""
		local coordinates = string.split(destinationText, ",")
		local destination: CFrame? = nil
		if #coordinates == 3 then
			local x = tonumber(coordinates[1])
			local y = tonumber(coordinates[2])
			local z = tonumber(coordinates[3])
			if x ~= nil and y ~= nil and z ~= nil
				and x == x and y == y and z == z
				and math.abs(x) <= 100000 and math.abs(y) <= 100000 and math.abs(z) <= 100000 then
				destination = CFrame.new(x, y, z)
			end
		end
		if destination == nil then
			local playerService = tryService(context, "PlayerService")
			if playerService == nil or type(playerService.FindPlayers) ~= "function" then
				return false, "Ziel konnte nicht aufgelöst werden."
			end
			local ok, found = pcall(playerService.FindPlayers, playerService, destinationText, context.Executor)
			if not ok or type(found) ~= "table" or #found ~= 1 then
				return false, "Der Zielort ist nicht eindeutig."
			end
			local destinationPlayer = playerOf(found[1])
			if destinationPlayer == nil then
				return false, "Der Zielspieler ist nicht online."
			end
			local destinationRoot = destinationPlayer.Character ~= nil
				and destinationPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
			if destinationRoot == nil or not destinationRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
				return false, "Der Zielspieler hat keinen gültigen Character."
			end
			destination = destinationRoot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		end
		local ok, teleportErr = teleportPlayer(context, target, destination)
		if not ok then
			return false, tostring(teleportErr)
		end
		return true, labelOf(args.target) .. " wurde teleportiert."
	end,
}

		{ Name = "target", Type = "string", Required = false, Default = "off", Rest = true, Description = "Zielspieler oder off" },
	},
	Run = function(context: any, args: any)
		local executor = playerOf(context.Executor)
		if executor == nil then
			return false, "Der ausführende Spieler ist nicht online."
		end
		local remote = tryService(context, "RemoteService")
		if remote == nil or type(remote.Push) ~= "function" then
			return false, "RemoteService ist nicht verfügbar."
		end
		local raw = type(args.target) == "string" and args.target or "off"
		local lower = string.lower(raw)
		if lower == "off" or lower == "stop" or lower == "none" or lower == "clear" then
			pcall(remote.Push, remote, executor, Constants.Channels.Spectate, { targetUserId = nil })
			return true, "Zuschaueransicht beendet."
		end
		local targetId: number? = nil
		local numeric = tonumber(raw)
		if numeric ~= nil and numeric % 1 == 0 and numeric > 0 then
			targetId = numeric
		else
			local playerService = tryService(context, "PlayerService")
			if playerService ~= nil and type(playerService.FindPlayers) == "function" then
				local ok, found = pcall(playerService.FindPlayers, playerService, raw, executor)
				if ok and type(found) == "table" and #found == 1 then
					targetId = userIdOf(found[1])
				end
			end
		end
		if targetId == nil then
			return false, "Zielspieler nicht eindeutig."
		end
		if Players:GetPlayerByUserId(targetId) == nil then
			return false, "Der Zielspieler ist nicht online."
		end
		pcall(remote.Push, remote, executor, Constants.Channels.Spectate, { targetUserId = targetId })
		return true, "Zuschaueransicht auf UserId " .. tostring(targetId) .. " gesetzt."
	end,
}

--!nonstrict
-- Serverweite Commands. Die Definitionen halten keinen Spielerzustand und
-- holen alle Dienste erst in Run über context.Framework:TryGetService.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Constants = require(Shared.Constants)
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local Definitions = {}
local startedAt = os.time()

local function tryService(context: any, name: string): any?
	if type(context) ~= "table" or type(context.Framework) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local framework = context.Framework
	if type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function executorName(context: any): string
	if type(context) == "table" and typeof(context.Executor) == "Instance"
		and context.Executor:IsA("Player") then
		return context.Executor.Name
	end
	return "System"
end

local function clampedLimit(value: any, fallback: number, maximum: number): number
	if type(value) ~= "number" or value ~= value then
		return fallback
	end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 1, maximum)
end

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "announce",
	Aliases = { "say" },
	Category = "Server",
	Description = "Sendet eine serverweite Ankündigung an alle Spieler.",
	Permission = Constants.Permissions.ServerAnnounce,
	Args = {
		{ Name = "message", Type = "string", Required = true, Rest = true, Description = "Ankündigungstext" },
	},
	Run = function(context: any, args: any)
		local message = type(args.message) == "string" and Util.truncate(args.message, 500) or ""
		if message == "" then
			return false, "Die Ankündigung darf nicht leer sein."
		end
		local remote = tryService(context, "RemoteService")
		if remote == nil or type(remote.PushAll) ~= "function" then
			return false, "RemoteService ist nicht verfügbar."
		end
		local from = executorName(context)
		pcall(remote.PushAll, remote, Constants.Channels.Announcement, { message = message, from = from })

		local eventService = tryService(context, "EventService")
		if eventService ~= nil and type(eventService.Fire) == "function" then
			pcall(eventService.Fire, eventService, Constants.Events.ServerEvent, {
				kind = "Announcement",
				message = message,
				data = { from = from },
			})
		end
		return true, "Ankündigung an alle Spieler gesendet."
	end,
}

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "players",
	Aliases = { "pl" },
	Category = "Server",
	Description = "Listet aktive Spieler mit Rang, Sitzung und Risikowert auf.",
	Permission = Constants.Permissions.AdminPanel,
	Args = {
		{ Name = "limit", Type = "integer", Required = false, Default = 50, Description = "Maximale Anzahl (1–100)" },
	},
	Run = function(_context: any, args: any)
		local playerService = tryService(_context, "PlayerService")
		if playerService == nil or type(playerService.GetSessions) ~= "function" then
			return false, "PlayerService ist nicht verfügbar."
		end
		local permissionService = tryService(_context, "PermissionService")
		local riskManager = tryService(_context, "RiskManager")
		local sessions = playerService:GetSessions()
		local limit = clampedLimit(args.limit, 50, 100)
		local result = {}
		for _, session in ipairs(sessions) do
			if #result >= limit then
				break
			end
			local userId = session.userId
			local rank = "Player"
			if permissionService ~= nil and type(permissionService.GetRank) == "function" then
				local ok, role = pcall(permissionService.GetRank, permissionService, userId)
				if ok and type(role) == "table" and type(role.Name) == "string" then
					rank = role.Name
				end
			end
			local risk = 0
			if riskManager ~= nil and type(riskManager.Get) == "function" then
				local ok, score = pcall(riskManager.Get, riskManager, userId)
				if ok and type(score) == "number" then
					risk = math.floor(score)
				end
			end
			table.insert(result, {
				userId = userId,
				name = session.name,
				displayName = session.displayName,
				ping = session.ping,
				accountAge = session.accountAge,
				joinedAt = session.joinedAt,
				frozen = session.frozen == true,
				muted = session.muted == true,
				rank = rank,
				riskScore = risk,
			})
		end
		return true, tostring(#result) .. " Spieler aufgelistet.", { players = result }
	end,
}

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Hilfecommands. Sie lesen nur die CommandRegistry und sind für jeden Spieler
-- verfügbar. Die Registry liefert bereits die für den Nutzer erlaubten Commands.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared
local Util = require(Shared.Utilities.Util)

local Definitions = {}
local MAX_LISTED = 50

local function tryService(context: any, name: string): any?
	if type(context) ~= "table" or type(context.Framework) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local framework = context.Framework
	if type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

local function executorIdOf(context: any): number?
	if type(context) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local id = context.ExecutorId
	if type(id) == "number" and id % 1 == 0 and id > 0 then
		return id
	end
	if typeof(context.Executor) == "Instance" and context.Executor:IsA("Player") then
		return context.Executor.UserId
	end
	return nil
end

local function allowedCommands(context: any): { any }?
	local executorId = executorIdOf(context)
	if executorId == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local registry = tryService(context, "CommandRegistry")
	if registry == nil or type(registry.GetForUser) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, commands = pcall(registry.GetForUser, registry, executorId)
	if not ok or type(commands) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return commands
end

local function describe(definition: any): string
	if type(definition) ~= "table" then
		return "Unbekannter Command."
	end
	local aliases = type(definition.Aliases) == "table" and definition.Aliases or {}
	local args = type(definition.Args) == "table" and definition.Args or {}
	local parts: { string } = {}
	for _, alias in ipairs(aliases) do
		if #parts >= 6 then
			break
		end
		if type(alias) == "string" then
			table.insert(parts, alias)
		end
	end
	local text = tostring(definition.Name)
	if #parts > 0 then
		text = text .. " (" .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. ")"
	end
	text = text .. " — " .. tostring(definition.Description or "Keine Beschreibung verfügbar.")
	if #args > 0 then
		local argNames: { string } = {}
		for _, arg in ipairs(args) do
			if #argNames >= 8 then
				break
			end
			if type(arg) == "table" and type(arg.Name) == "string" then
				table.insert(argNames, arg.Name .. ":" .. tostring(arg.Type or "string"))
			end
		end
		if #argNames > 0 then
			text = text .. " | Argumente: " .. table.concat(argNames, ", ")
		end
	end
	return text
end

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "help",
	Aliases = { "h" },
	Category = "Utility",
	Description = "Zeigt die erlaubten Commands oder die Details eines einzelnen Commands.",
	Args = {
		{ Name = "command", Type = "command", Required = false, Description = "Commandname oder Alias" },
	},
	Run = function(context: any, args: any)
		local commands = allowedCommands(context)
		if commands == nil then
			return false, "Die Command-Liste ist nicht verfügbar."
		end
		if args.command ~= nil then
			local name = type(args.command) == "string" and string.lower(args.command) or ""
			local found = nil
			for _, definition in ipairs(commands) do
				if type(definition) == "table" and type(definition.Name) == "string"
					and string.lower(definition.Name) == name then
					found = definition
					break
				end
			end
			if found == nil then
				return false, "Du hast keinen Zugriff auf diesen Command."
			end
			return true, describe(found), found
		end
		local lines: { string } = {}
		for _, definition in ipairs(commands) do
			if #lines >= MAX_LISTED then
				break
			end
			table.insert(lines, describe(definition))
		end
		local message = #commands .. " verfügbare Command(s)."
		if #lines > 0 then
			message = message .. "\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n")
		end
		return true, Util.truncate(message, 500), { commands = commands }
	end,
}

Definitions[#Definitions + 1] = {
	Name = "cmds",
	Aliases = { "commands" },
	Category = "Utility",
	Description = "Listet alle für dich erlaubten Commands, optional nach Kategorie gefiltert.",
	Args = {
		{ Name = "category", Type = "string", Required = false, Description = "Kategorie, z. B. Player oder Moderation" },
	},
	Run = function(context: any, args: any)
		local commands = allowedCommands(context)
		if commands == nil then
			return false, "Die Command-Liste ist nicht verfügbar."
		end
		local category = type(args.category) == "string" and string.lower(args.category) or ""
		local filtered: { any } = {}
		for _, definition in ipairs(commands) do
			if type(definition) == "table" then
				if category == "" or string.lower(tostring(definition.Category or "")) == category then
					table.insert(filtered, definition)
				end
			end
		end
		table.sort(filtered, function(left, right)
			return tostring(left.Name) < tostring(right.Name)
		end)
		local lines: { string } = {}
		for _, definition in ipairs(filtered) do
			if #lines >= MAX_LISTED then
				break
			end
			table.insert(lines, tostring(definition.Name))
		end
		local message = tostring(#filtered) .. " Command(s)"
		if category ~= "" then
			message = message .. " in " .. category
		end
		message = message .. "."
		if #lines > 0 then
			message = message .. "\n" .. table.concat(lines, ", ")
		end
		return true, Util.truncate(message, 500), { commands = filtered }
	end,
}

return Definitions

--!strict
-- Command-seitige Rechteprüfung. Alle Entscheidungen fallen serverseitig über
-- den PermissionService; ein Client kann hier nichts überschreiben.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)

local PermissionChecker = {
	Name = "PermissionChecker",
	Dependencies = { "PermissionService" },
}

local framework: any

local function normalizeUserId(value: any): number?
	if typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("Player") then
		return value.UserId
	end
	if type(value) == "number" and value % 1 == 0 and value > 0 then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

local function getPermissionService(): any?
	if framework == nil or type(framework.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(framework.TryGetService, framework, "PermissionService")
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

function PermissionChecker:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework
end

function PermissionChecker:CanExecute(userId: any, permission: string?): (boolean, string?)
	if permission == nil or permission == "" then
		return true, nil
	end
	if type(permission) ~= "string" or #permission > 100 then
		return false, "Ungültige Berechtigungsanforderung."
	end

	local id = normalizeUserId(userId)
	if id == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Spielerkennung."
	end

	local service = getPermissionService()
	if service == nil or type(service.Has) ~= "function" then
		return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
	end

	local ok, allowed = pcall(service.Has, service, id, permission)
	if not ok then
		if framework ~= nil and type(framework.Log) == "table" and type(framework.Log.Warn) == "function" then
			pcall(function()
				framework.Log:Warn("PermissionChecker", "Berechtigungsprüfung fehlgeschlagen", {
					userId = id,
					permission = permission,
					error = tostring(allowed),
				})
			end)
		end
		return false, "Die Berechtigung konnte nicht geprüft werden."
	end
	if allowed == true then
		return true, nil
	end
	return false, "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung: " .. permission
end

-- Einzelne Permission oder eine Liste alternativer Permissions.
function PermissionChecker:CanExecuteCommand(userId: any, definition: any): (boolean, string?)
	if type(definition) ~= "table" then
		return false, "Ungültige Command-Definition."
	end
	local permission = definition.Permission
	if type(permission) == "table" and #permission == 0 then
		return true, nil
	end
	if type(permission) == "table" then
		local lastError = "Dir fehlt die Berechtigung für diesen Befehl."
		for _, candidate in ipairs(permission) do
			local allowed, err = self:CanExecute(userId, candidate)
			if allowed then
				return true, nil
			end
			if type(err) == "string" then
				lastError = err
			end
		end
		return false, lastError
	end
	return self:CanExecute(userId, permission)
end

function PermissionChecker:CanTarget(executorId: any, targetId: any): (boolean, string?)
	local source = normalizeUserId(executorId)
	local destination = normalizeUserId(targetId)
	if source == nil or destination == nil then
		return false, "Ungültige Zielangabe."
	end
	local service = getPermissionService()
	if service == nil or type(service.CanTarget) ~= "function" then
		return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
	end
	local ok, allowed = pcall(service.CanTarget, service, source, destination)
	if not ok then
		return false, "Die Zielprüfung ist fehlgeschlagen."
	end
	if allowed == true then
		return true, nil
	end
	return false, "Du darfst dieses Ziel nicht bearbeiten."
end

function PermissionChecker:GetRank(userId: any): string
	local service = getPermissionService()
	local id = normalizeUserId(userId)
	if service == nil or id == nil or type(service.GetRank) ~= "function" then
		return "Player"
	end
	local ok, role = pcall(service.GetRank, service, id)
	if ok and type(role) == "table" and type(role.Name) == "string" then
		return role.Name
	end
	return "Player"
end

function PermissionChecker:GetPermissions(userId: any): { string }
	local service = getPermissionService()
	local id = normalizeUserId(userId)
	if service == nil or id == nil or type(service.GetPermissions) ~= "function" then
		return {}
	end
	local ok, permissions = pcall(service.GetPermissions, service, id)
	if ok and type(permissions) == "table" then
		local result: { string } = {}
		for _, permission in ipairs(permissions) do
			if type(permission) == "string" then
				table.insert(result, permission)
			end
		end
		return result
	end
	return {}
end

function PermissionChecker:IsAdmin(userId: any): boolean
	local allowed = self:CanExecute(userId, Constants.Permissions.AdminPanel)
	return allowed
end

return PermissionChecker

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Commands/TypeRegistry.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Argumenttypen für Commands. Jeder Typ bietet Parse(raw, context) -> (ok, value|err)
-- und Suggest(partial, context) -> {Suggestion}. Weitere Typen können zur Laufzeit
-- über Register(name, definition) nachgerüstet werden.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Util = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Util)
local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)

local TypeRegistry = {
	Name = "TypeRegistry",
	Dependencies = { "PermissionService" },
}

type Suggestion = { text: string, display: string, description: string? }

local MAX_SUGGESTIONS = 50
local MAX_RAW = 500
local framework: any
local types: { [string]: any } = {}

local function suggestion(text: string, description: string?): Suggestion
	return { text = text, display = text, description = description }
end

local function beginsWith(value: string, partial: string): boolean
	return string.sub(string.lower(value), 1, #partial) == string.lower(partial)
end

local function fromValues(values: { string }, partial: string): { Suggestion }
	local result: { Suggestion } = {}
	for _, value in ipairs(values) do
		if #result >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
			break
		end
		if beginsWith(value, partial) then
			table.insert(result, suggestion(value))
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function tryService(context: any, name: string): any?
	if type(context) ~= "table" or type(context.Framework) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local frameworkRef: any = context.Framework
	if type(frameworkRef.TryGetService) ~= "function" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, service = pcall(frameworkRef.TryGetService, frameworkRef, name)
	if ok then
		return service
	end
	return nil
end

-- Offline-Ziel: Keine Player-Instanz vorhanden, aber die UserId ist bekannt.
-- Die Felder spiegeln die von Player benötigten Werte, damit Definitionen
-- einheitlich auf target.UserId / target.Name zugreifen können.
local function offlineDescriptor(userId: number, name: string, displayName: string?): any
	return {
		UserId = userId,
		Name = name,
		DisplayName = displayName or name,
		IsOffline = true,
		Offline = true,
	}
end

local function resolveOffline(raw: string): (any?, string?)
	if raw == "" or #raw > 100 then
		return nil, "Ungültige Spielerangabe."
	end
	local numeric = tonumber(raw)
	if numeric ~= nil then
		if numeric % 1 ~= 0 or numeric <= 0 or numeric > 9999999999 then
			return nil, "Ungültige Spieler-ID."
		end
		return offlineDescriptor(numeric, "Spieler " .. tostring(numeric)), nil
	end

	-- Nur echte Namen async auflösen; Sonderausdrücke (all/me/…) werden
	-- ausschließlich von PlayerService:FindPlayers bearbeitet.
	if string.match(raw, "^[%w_]+$") == nil then
		return nil, "Spieler nicht gefunden."
	end
	local ok, userId = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(raw)
	end)
	if not ok or type(userId) ~= "number" or userId % 1 ~= 0 or userId <= 0 then
		return nil, "Spieler nicht gefunden."
	end
	return offlineDescriptor(userId, raw), nil
end

local function findCandidates(raw: string, context: any): { any }
	local result: { any } = {}
	local playerService = tryService(context, "PlayerService")
	local executor = type(context) == "table" and context.Executor or nil
	if playerService ~= nil and type(playerService.FindPlayers) == "function" then
		local ok, found = pcall(playerService.FindPlayers, playerService, raw, executor)
		if ok and type(found) == "table" then
			for _, player in ipairs(found) do
				table.insert(result, player)
			end
			if #result > 0 then
				return result
			end
		end
	end

	local lower = string.lower(raw)
	local special = lower == "me" or lower == "all" or lower == "others"
		or lower == "random" or lower == "admins" or lower == "nonadmins"
	if special or string.sub(raw, 1, 1) == "@" or string.find(raw, ",", 1, true) ~= nil then
		return result
	end
	local found = resolveOffline(raw)
	if found ~= nil then
		table.insert(result, found)
	end
	return result
end

local TARGET_KEYWORDS = {
	{ "me", "Du selbst" },
	{ "all", "Alle Spieler" },
	{ "others", "Alle außer dir" },
	{ "random", "Ein zufälliger Spieler" },
	{ "admins", "Alle Teammitglieder" },
	{ "nonadmins", "Alle Spieler ohne Teamrang" },
}

local function playerSuggestions(partial: string): { Suggestion }
	local result: { Suggestion } = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if #result >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
			break
		end
		if beginsWith(player.Name, partial) or beginsWith(player.DisplayName, partial) then
			local description: string? = player.DisplayName ~= player.Name and player.DisplayName or nil
			table.insert(result, {
				text = player.Name,
				display = player.Name,
				description = description,
			})
		end
	end
	return result
end

function TypeRegistry:Init(currentFramework: any)
	framework = currentFramework

	self:Register("string", {
		Parse = function(raw: string)
			if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > MAX_RAW then
				return false, "Der Text ist ungültig oder zu lang."
			end
			return true, raw
		end,
		Suggest = function()
			return {}
		end,
	})

	self:Register("number", {
		Parse = function(raw: string)
			local value = tonumber(raw)
			if value == nil or value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
				return false, "Eine gültige Zahl wird erwartet."
			end
			return true, value
		end,
		Suggest = function()
			return {}
		end,
	})

	self:Register("integer", {
		Parse = function(raw: string)
			local value = tonumber(raw)
			if value == nil or value % 1 ~= 0 or value > 9999999999 or value < -9999999999 then
				return false, "Eine ganze Zahl wird erwartet."
			end
			return true, value
		end,
		Suggest = function()
			return {}
		end,
	})

	self:Register("boolean", {
		Parse = function(raw: string)
			local lower = string.lower(raw)
			if lower == "true" or lower == "ja" or lower == "1" or lower == "an" then
				return true, true
			end
			if lower == "false" or lower == "nein" or lower == "0" or lower == "aus" then
				return true, false
			end
			return false, "Erwartet wird true oder false."
		end,
		Suggest = function(partial: string)
			return fromValues({ "true", "false" }, partial)
		end,
	})

	self:Register("player", {
		Parse = function(raw: string, context: any)
			if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 100 then
				return false, "Ungültige Spielerangabe."
			end
			local found = findCandidates(raw, context)
			if #found == 0 then
				return false, "Spieler nicht gefunden."
			end
			if #found > 1 then
				return false, "Die Spielerauswahl ist nicht eindeutig."
			end
			return true, found[1]
		end,
		Suggest = function(partial: string)
			return playerSuggestions(partial)
		end,
	})

	self:Register("players", {
		Parse = function(raw: string, context: any)
			if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 200 then
				return false, "Ungültige Spielerangabe."
			end
			local found = findCandidates(raw, context)
			if #found == 0 then
				return false, "Keine Spieler gefunden."
			end
			if #found > 50 then
				return false, "Zu viele Spieler ausgewählt."
			end
			return true, found
		end,
		Suggest = function(partial: string)
			-- Mehrfachziele: zuerst passende Schlüsselwörter, danach konkrete Spieler.
			local result: { Suggestion } = {}
			for _, keyword in ipairs(TARGET_KEYWORDS) do
				if partial ~= "" and beginsWith(keyword[1], partial) then
					table.insert(result, suggestion(keyword[1], keyword[2]))
				end
			end
			for _, entry in ipairs(playerSuggestions(partial)) do
				if #result >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
					break
				end
				table.insert(result, entry)
			end
			return result
		end,
	})

	self:Register("duration", {
		Parse = function(raw: string)
			if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 32 then
				return false, "Ungültige Dauer."
			end
			local seconds, valid = Util.parseDuration(raw)
			if not valid then
				return false, "Ungültige Dauer."
			end
			-- seconds == nil bedeutet "perm" und ist ausdrücklich erlaubt.
			return true, seconds
		end,
		Suggest = function(partial: string)
			return fromValues({ "10m", "1h", "1d", "7d", "perm" }, partial)
		end,
	})

	self:Register("rank", {
		Parse = function(raw: string, context: any)
			if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 32 then
				return false, "Ungültiger Rang."
			end
			local service = tryService(context, "PermissionService")
			if service == nil or type(service.GetRoles) ~= "function" then
				return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
			end
			local ok, roles = pcall(service.GetRoles, service)
			if not ok or type(roles) ~= "table" then
				return false, "Das Berechtigungssystem ist nicht verfügbar."
			end
			for _, role in ipairs(roles) do
				if type(role) == "table" and type(role.Name) == "string"
					and string.lower(role.Name) == string.lower(raw) then
					return true, role.Name
				end
			end
			return false, "Unbekannter Rang."
		end,
		Suggest = function(partial: string, context: any)
			local result: { Suggestion } = {}
			local service = tryService(context, "PermissionService")
			if service ~= nil and type(service.GetRoles) == "function" then
				local ok, roles = pcall(service.GetRoles, service)
				if ok and type(roles) == "table" then
					for _, role in ipairs(roles) do
						if #result >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
							break
						end
						if type(role) == "table" and type(role.Name) == "string" and beginsWith(role.Name, partial) then
							table.insert(result, suggestion(role.Name))
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return result
		end,
	})

	-- Nur bekannte Permissions (Constants.Permissions), "Familie.*" einer bekannten Familie oder "*".
	-- Groß-/Kleinschreibung der Eingabe ist egal, gespeichert wird die kanonische Schreibweise.
	local knownPermissions: { [string]: string } = {}
	local knownFamilies: { [string]: string } = {}
	for _, permission in pairs(Constants.Permissions) do
		knownPermissions[string.lower(permission)] = permission
		local family = string.match(permission, "^([%w]+)%.")
		if family then
			knownFamilies[string.lower(family)] = family
		end
	end
	self:Register("permission", {
		Parse = function(raw: string)
			if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw == 0 or #raw > 100 then
				return false, "Ungültige Berechtigung."
			end
			local lower = string.lower(raw)
			if knownPermissions[lower] then
				return true, knownPermissions[lower]
			end
			local family = string.match(lower, "^([%w]+)%.%*$")
			if family and knownFamilies[family] then
				return true, knownFamilies[family] .. ".*"
			end
			return false, "Unbekannte Berechtigung: " .. Util.truncate(raw, 60)
		end,
		Suggest = function(partial: string, context: any)
			local result: { Suggestion } = {}
			local seen: { [string]: boolean } = {}
			local service = tryService(context, "PermissionService")
			local executorId = type(context) == "table" and context.ExecutorId or nil
			if service ~= nil and type(service.GetPermissions) == "function" and executorId ~= nil then
				local ok, permissions = pcall(service.GetPermissions, service, executorId)
				if ok and type(permissions) == "table" then
					for _, permission in ipairs(permissions) do
						if #result >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
							break
						end
						if type(permission) == "string" and not seen[permission] and beginsWith(permission, partial) then
							seen[permission] = true
							table.insert(result, suggestion(permission))
						end
					end
				end
			end
			for _, value in pairs(Constants.Permissions) do
				if #result >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
					break
				end
				if type(value) == "string" and not seen[value] and beginsWith(value, partial) then
					seen[value] = true
					table.insert(result, suggestion(value))
				end
			end
			return result
		end,
	})

	self:Register("command", {
		Parse = function(raw: string, context: any)
			if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 64 then
				return false, "Ungültiger Command."
			end
			local registry = tryService(context, "CommandRegistry")
			if registry == nil or type(registry.Get) ~= "function" then
				return false, "Das Command-System ist nicht verfügbar."
			end
			local ok, command = pcall(registry.Get, registry, raw)
			if not ok or type(command) ~= "table" or type(command.Name) ~= "string" then
				return false, "Unbekannter Command."
			end
			return true, command.Name
		end,
		Suggest = function(partial: string, context: any)
			local result: { Suggestion } = {}
			local registry = tryService(context, "CommandRegistry")
			local executorId = type(context) == "table" and context.ExecutorId or nil
			if registry ~= nil and type(registry.GetForUser) == "function" and executorId ~= nil then
				local ok, commands = pcall(registry.GetForUser, registry, executorId)
				if ok and type(commands) == "table" then
					for _, command in ipairs(commands) do
						if #result >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
							break
						end
						if type(command) == "table" and type(command.Name) == "string"
							and beginsWith(command.Name, partial) then
							local description = type(command.Description) == "string" and command.Description or nil
							table.insert(result, suggestion(command.Name, description))
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return result
		end,
	})

	self:Register("detectionId", {
		Parse = function(raw: string, context: any)
			if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw == 0 or #raw > 100 then
				return false, "Ungültige Detection-ID."
			end
			local manager = tryService(context, "DetectionManager")
			if manager == nil or type(manager.GetById) ~= "function" then
				return false, "Anti-Cheat ist nicht geladen."
			end
			local ok, detection = pcall(manager.GetById, manager, raw)
			if not ok or detection == nil then
				return false, "Detection nicht gefunden."
			end
			return true, raw
		end,
		Suggest = function(partial: string, context: any)
			local result: { Suggestion } = {}
			local manager = tryService(context, "DetectionManager")
			if manager ~= nil and type(manager.GetRecent) == "function" then
				local ok, detections = pcall(manager.GetRecent, manager, 25)
				if ok and type(detections) == "table" then
					for _, detection in ipairs(detections) do
						if #result >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS then
							break
						end
						if type(detection) == "table" and type(detection.Id) == "string"
							and beginsWith(detection.Id, partial) then
							local description = type(detection.Category) == "string" and detection.Category or nil
							table.insert(result, suggestion(detection.Id, description))
						end
					end
				end
			end
			return result
		end,
	})
end

function TypeRegistry:Register(name: string, definition: any): (boolean, string?)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" or #name > 32
		or string.match(name, "^[%w_]+$") == nil then
		return false, "Ungültiger Typname."
	end
	if type(definition) ~= "table" or type(definition.Parse) ~= "function"
		or type(definition.Suggest) ~= "function" then
		return false, "Ein Typ benötigt Parse und Suggest."
	end
	types[string.lower(name)] = definition
	return true, nil
end

function TypeRegistry:Get(name: string): any?
	if type(name) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	return types[string.lower(name)]
end

function TypeRegistry:GetNames(): { string }
	local result: { string } = {}
	for name in types do
		table.insert(result, name)
	end
	table.sort(result)
	return result
end

return TypeRegistry

`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/ServerScriptService/Headcraft/Configuration/Ranks.lua`:

```lua
--!strict
-- Rangquellen der Serverkonfiguration.
-- Priorität bei der Auflösung: Backend-Sync > DataStore (Headcraft_Ranks) > diese Datei.
-- Der Platzbesitzer (game.CreatorId bzw. Gruppenbesitzer) ist unabhängig davon immer Owner.
--
-- Beispiele:
--   UserIds = { [1234567] = "Admin" },
--   Groups = { { GroupId = 123456, MinRank = 250, Rank = "HeadAdmin" } },
--   Roles = {
--       { Name = "Builder", Priority = 55, Inherits = { "Player" }, Permissions = { "Admin.Panel" }, Color = "#38BDF8" },
--   },

type GroupRankRule = {
	GroupId: number,
	MinRank: number,
	Rank: string,
}

type RoleDefinition = {
	Name: string,
	Priority: number,
	Inherits: { string }?,
	Permissions: { string },
	Color: string,
}

local Ranks = {
	-- Feste UserId-Zuweisungen. Schlüssel dürfen Zahl oder String sein.
	UserIds = {} :: { [any]: string },

	-- Gruppen-Ränge: erreicht ein Spieler mindestens MinRank, erhält er Rank.
	Groups = {} :: { GroupRankRule },

	-- Zusätzliche benutzerdefinierte Rollen (werden beim Start geladen und persistiert).
	Roles = {} :: { [string]: RoleDefinition },
}

return Ranks
