`scripts/Workspace/HeadcraftConnection/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/HeadcraftClient.lua`:

```lua
--!nonstrict
-- Einstiegspunkt des Clients. Baut nie GUI in StarterGui auf, sondern erst zur
-- Laufzeit in PlayerGui — und auch die Admin-Oberfläche nur für berechtigte Spieler.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Constants)
local SharedConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Configuration)
local Maid = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Shared.Utilities.Maid)
local CommandClient = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Client.CommandClient)
local Notifications = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Client.Notifications)
local AdminUI = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Client.AdminUI)
local ChatControl = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Client.ChatControl)
local Console = require(ReplicatedStorage.Headcraft.Client.Console)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local maid = Maid.new()

local function permissionSet(value: any): { [string]: boolean }
	local set = {}
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return set
	end
	for key, entry in pairs(value) do
		if type(key) == "string" and entry == true then
			set[key] = true
		elseif type(entry) == "string" then
			set[entry] = true
		end
	end
	return set
end

local function hasPanelPermission(value: any): boolean
	local set = permissionSet(value)
	return set["Admin.Panel"] == true or set["*"] == true
end

local function start()
	-- Interface.Enabled steuert nur die Admin-Oberfläche; Mute, Freeze und Benachrichtigungen laufen immer.
	local interfaceEnabled = not (SharedConfig.Interface and SharedConfig.Interface.Enabled == false)

	local remotes = CommandClient.WaitForRemotes(4, 3)
	if not remotes then
		warn("[Headcraft] Remotes nicht erreichbar — Client bleibt im Benachrichtigungsmodus.")
		return
	end
	local client = CommandClient.new(remotes)
	if not client then
		warn("[Headcraft] Ein Remote fehlt — Client bleibt im Benachrichtigungsmodus.")
		return
	end
	maid:Give(client)

	local notifications = Notifications.new(client, playerGui)
	maid:Give(notifications)

	-- Mute: Chat-Fenster und Eingabezeile aus, solange der Server den Spieler als gemutet meldet.
	local chatControl = ChatControl.new()
	maid:Give(chatControl)
	maid:Give(client:OnPush(Constants.Channels.Mute, function(payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.muted) ~= "boolean" then
			return
		end
		chatControl:SetMuted(payload.muted)
	end))

	local bootstrap = {
		isAdmin = false,
		permissions = {},
		rank = "Player",
		prefix = SharedConfig.Admin and SharedConfig.Admin.Prefix or ";",
		version = Constants.Version,
	}
	-- Der Server registriert seine Request-Aktionen erst in Service:Start(); ein früh startender Client
	-- kann daher kurz eine Ablehnung erhalten. Mehrere Versuche mit wachsender Pause.
	local ok, data = false, nil
	for attempt = 1, 6 do
		ok, data = client:Request("GetBootstrap", nil, 6)
		if ok then
			break
		end
		task.wait(math.min(0.5 * attempt, 2))
	end
	if ok and type(data) == "table" then
		bootstrap.isAdmin = data.isAdmin == true
		bootstrap.permissions = type(data.permissions) == "table" and data.permissions or {}
		bootstrap.rank = type(data.rank) == "string" and data.rank or bootstrap.rank
		bootstrap.prefix = type(data.prefix) == "string" and data.prefix or bootstrap.prefix
		bootstrap.version = type(data.version) == "string" and data.version or bootstrap.version
	else
		notifications:Toast("warning", "Headcraft", "Serverdaten nicht verfügbar — nur Benachrichtigungen sind aktiv.")
	end

	-- Konsole (F3): für jeden mit mindestens einer Permission. Welche Commands er sieht und ausführen
	-- darf, entscheidet der Server (Autocomplete und Ausführung filtern serverseitig).
	local console: any = nil
	local function ensureConsole(permissions: any)
		local hasAny = next(permissionSet(permissions)) ~= nil
		if hasAny and not console then
			console = Console.new(client, {
				prefix = bootstrap.prefix,
				toggleKey = SharedConfig.Interface and SharedConfig.Interface.ConsoleKey or "F3",
			})
			maid:Give(function()
				if console then
					console:Destroy()
					console = nil
				end
			end)
		elseif not hasAny and console then
			console:Destroy()
			console = nil
		end
	end

	local admin: any = nil
	local function ensureAdmin(permissions: any, rank: string?)
		ensureConsole(permissions)
		if not interfaceEnabled then
			return
		end
		if hasPanelPermission(permissions) then
			if not admin then
				admin = AdminUI.new(client, {
					isAdmin = true,
					permissions = permissions,
					rank = rank or bootstrap.rank,
					prefix = bootstrap.prefix,
					version = bootstrap.version,
				})
				admin:SetNotify(function(kind, title, message)
					notifications:Toast(kind, title, message)
				end)
				-- Geschlossen starten, damit das Panel nicht bei jedem Join über dem Spiel liegt.
				admin:SetVisible(false)
				local panelKey = SharedConfig.Interface and SharedConfig.Interface.ToggleKey or "F2"
				local consoleKey = SharedConfig.Interface and SharedConfig.Interface.ConsoleKey or "F3"
				notifications:Toast("info", "Headcraft", string.format("Admin-Panel: %s · Konsole: %s", panelKey, consoleKey))
				maid:Give(function()
					if admin then
						admin:Destroy()
					end
				end)
			else
				admin:RefreshPermissions(permissions, rank)
			end
		elseif admin then
			admin:RefreshPermissions(permissions, rank)
		end
	end

	-- Immer aufrufen: ensureAdmin baut Konsole/Panel nur bei passenden Permissions (z. B. TrialModerator
	-- hat Commands, aber kein Admin.Panel → nur Konsole).
	ensureAdmin(bootstrap.permissions, bootstrap.rank)

	maid:Give(client:OnPush(Constants.Channels.PermissionsChanged, function(payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		ensureAdmin(payload.permissions, payload.rank)
	end))

	-- Zuschauermodus: CameraSubject folgt dem Ziel, nil stellt den eigenen Charakter wieder her.
	maid:Give(client:OnPush(Constants.Channels.Spectate, function(payload)
		local targetUserId = type(payload) == "table" and payload.targetUserId or nil
		if type(targetUserId) ~= "number" then
			targetUserId = nil
		end
		local ownHumanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local subject: Humanoid? = ownHumanoid
		if targetUserId then
			local target = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(math.floor(targetUserId))
			local character = target and target.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then
				subject = humanoid
			end
		end
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			camera.CameraSubject = subject
		end
	end))

	-- ClientReport liefert nur kleines, unverbindliches Indizmaterial an den Server.
	maid:Give(client:OnPush(Constants.Channels.Detection, function(payload)
		if type(payload) ~= "table" or payload.UserId ~= player.UserId then
			return
		end
		local category = type(payload.Category) == "string" and string.sub(payload.Category, 1, 60) or "Unbekannt"
		local severity = type(payload.Severity) == "string" and string.sub(payload.Severity, 1, 20) or "Unbekannt"
		client:Report("DetectionSeen", { category = category, severity = severity })
	end))

	maid:Give(player.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil then
			maid:Clean()
		end
	end))
end

task.spawn(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(start)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Headcraft] Clientstart fehlgeschlagen:", tostring(err))
	end
end)

script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	maid:Clean()
end)
```
